title: KA-Gold Bot MT5
summary: On each new bar, buys/sells when the prior closed bar and EMA10 cross outside a Keltner-style channel (EMA50 +/- mean high-low range) on the EMA200 side. One position, fixed-pip SL/TP, step trailing, hour window, max-spread check.
red_flags: 'Risk %' sizing is not risk-based: lot = Risk * FreeMargin / 100000, ignores stop distance and contract size (KA_Gold_Bot.mq5 CalculateVolume)
Sell signal is assigned as 'result = true' and only works because true==1==ORDER_TYPE_SELL (CalculateSignal)
Trailing trigger flags are globals, not per-position, and the buy flag is only reset when a sell position exists - stale state carries into the next trade and is lost on restart
Fixed pip SL/TP/trailing (500/500/300) with no volatility scaling; pip conversion guessed from _Digits parity, so distances differ 10x between 2- and 3-digit gold feeds
CheckVolumeValue rejects (silently skips the trade) instead of rounding when lot is not a volume-step multiple
Time window breaks if it spans midnight; no day-of-week, news or rollover handling
Trade failure only printed via GetLastError; no retcode handling or retry
Stops check uses stops level only, no freeze level; single fixed spread threshold in points

ideas.name: Closed-bar channel breakout with fast-EMA confirmation and trend-side filter
ideas.detail: Channel = EMA(50) +/- average (high-low) of last 50 bars. Entry needs bar-1 close outside the band, EMA10 crossing the band between bar 2 and bar 1, and close on the EMA200 side. Uses only closed bars 1 and 2, so no repaint.

ideas.name: Pre-trade gate chain before OrderSend
ideas.detail: Entry is sent only if four checks pass in sequence: spread <= max, volume within min/max/step, SL and TP farther than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, and OrderCalcMargin requirement <= free margin. Worth keeping as one validation function, but round the lot instead of rejecting.
ideas.evidence: KA_Gold_Bot.mq5 OpenTrades(), CheckSpreadAllow(), CheckVolumeValue(), CheckStopLoss(), CheckMoneyForTrade()

ideas.name: Trigger + distance + step trailing stop
ideas.detail: Trailing arms only after profit exceeds a trigger; SL then moves to price minus trail distance only when the improvement exceeds a step, which limits modify-request spam. Each modify is re-validated against stops level. Should be ATR-scaled and per-ticket in a new bot.

ideas.name: Server-time trading window with hour and minute bounds
ideas.detail: Builds today's start/end datetimes from input hour:minute via StructToTime and allows new entries only inside the window (default 02:30-21:00 server time), while trailing of open positions continues outside it.

ideas.name: New-bar entry gate with magic+symbol ownership scan
ideas.detail: Entries evaluated once per bar by comparing stored iTime(0); position state is rebuilt every tick by scanning positions filtered on magic and symbol, so the one-position rule survives restarts without stored state. Filling mode set via SetTypeFillingBySymbol.

title: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit
summary: Runs two independent H4 trend-flip systems on one symbol with separate magics: SilverTrend candle colour change and JMA-smoothed FATL digital filter slope change. Opens on flip, closes on opposite flip, fixed point SL/TP. Name is unrelated to silver.
red_flags: SL/TP are fixed points and SL=0 disables the stop (TradeAlgorithms.mqh BuyPositionOpen_M1)
SignalBar=0 is allowed and evaluates the still-forming bar every tick (repaint)
Sleep(5000) inside the trade functions blocks OnTick after every send or failure
Filling mode left unset (type_filling line commented out) - orders can be rejected on brokers requiring IOC/RETURN
The two systems are not combined: on hedging accounts they can hold opposite positions at once
No spread, session, news or volatility filter; no trailing or breakeven
Default MMMode=LOT with MM=0.1 is a fixed 0.1 lot regardless of balance
OnDeinit deletes the non-magic global variables while trades write the magic-suffixed ones, so cleanup does not match what was stored
SilverTrend and the FATL coefficients are fixed magic-number filters; nothing in the code is specific to metals

ideas.name: Stop-loss based lot via OrderCalcProfit
ideas.detail: Loss-per-lot is obtained by asking the terminal: OrderCalcProfit(type, symbol, 1 lot, entry, SL price). Lot = (balance or free margin * risk fraction) / |loss per lot|. Correct for any contract size or account currency, so it handles XAUUSD and XAGUSD without tick-value arithmetic.

ideas.name: Lot normalisation with margin-affordability cap
ideas.detail: Lot is floored to volume step, clamped to min/max, then capped at the largest lot that free margin can carry (OrderCalcMargin for 1 lot); returns failure if even the minimum lot is unaffordable instead of sending a doomed order.

ideas.name: Per-symbol/direction/magic re-entry lock stored in terminal GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: After a fill, the next allowed trade time (end of the signal bar) is written to a GlobalVariable keyed by symbol, direction and magic; entries are refused until TimeCurrent passes it. Prevents duplicate entries on the same bar after SL hit or EA restart.
ideas.evidence: TradeAlgorithms.mqh TradeTimeLevelCheckM(), TradeTimeLevelSetM(), GetTimeLevelNameM(); used in BuyPositionOpen_M1()

ideas.name: OrderCheck pre-validation plus explicit retcode handling
ideas.detail: Every request is passed through OrderCheck before OrderSend; result must be TRADE_RETCODE_DONE or PLACED, with a text description logged for each retcode. Signal flag is cleared only on confirmed success, so a failed send is retried on the next tick.

ideas.name: Independent sub-strategies with their own magic and permission switches
ideas.detail: Each signal module has separate buy/sell magic numbers, separate open/close enable flags per direction, own timeframe, own new-bar detector and own SL/TP/lot settings, all routed through one shared trade library. Position lookup is by symbol + magic.
ideas.evidence: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit.mq5 OnTick() blocks A and B; TradeAlgorithms.mqh PositionSelectByMagice()

ideas.name: Recount-on-failed-copy new-bar handling
ideas.detail: New bar is detected from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE of the signal timeframe; if CopyBuffer fails, a Recount flag forces re-evaluation on the next tick so a signal is not lost. Stops are also raised to the broker stops level before use.
ideas.evidence: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit.mq5 OnTick() A_Recount/B_Recount; TradeAlgorithms.mqh CIsNewBar, StopCorrect()

title: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit_MMRec
summary: Two independent stop-and-reverse sub-strategies in one EA (SilverTrend colour flip and JMA-smoothed FATL colour flip, both H6 by default), each with its own buy/sell magic numbers, fixed-point SL/TP, and lot size reduced after a streak of losing trades.
red_flags: SL/TP are fixed point distances (1000/2500) with no volatility scaling; StopLoss=0 sends the position with no SL
Default MMMode=LOT with MM=0.1 means a fixed 0.1 lot regardless of account size; risk-based modes exist but are not default
SignalBar=0 is permitted and then signals are read from the still-forming bar every tick (repaint); default is 1
In OnTick an insufficient-bars or CopyBuffer failure in block A does `return`, silently starving block B
Block A ignores its own A_SellPosClose/A_BuyPosClose inputs and always closes on opposite signal
type_filling is commented out in the *_M1 open functions (TradeAlgorithms.mqh:1793) and hard-coded FOK elsewhere - will be rejected on brokers needing IOC/RETURN
Sleep(5000) after every order attempt blocks the tick handler

OnDeinit calls GlobalVariableDel_(Symbol()) but the magic-specific time-level variables (GetTimeLevelNameM) are the ones in use, so they are never cleaned; also deleting them on deinit defeats restart protection
MMRecounter rescans the entire deal history (HistorySelect(0,...)) on signal ticks - slow on long histories
No spread, session, news or daily-loss protection of any kind
Depends on two custom indicators via iCustom by name (must be compiled and present)

ideas.name: Loss-streak lot reduction (anti-martingale) per direction
ideas.detail: Before each entry, scan deal history for this magic+symbol+direction; if the last N closed positions were all losers, trade with SmallMM instead of normal MM. Size shrinks after losses and restores automatically after a winner. Derived from history, so it survives restarts.

ideas.name: Per-signal re-entry lock stored in terminal GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: After a successful fill, write a 'no new trade before' timestamp (signal bar close time + one indicator period) into a GlobalVariable keyed by symbol+direction+magic. Entry is refused while TimeCurrent() is below it, preventing duplicate entries on the same bar after SL hit or restart.
ideas.evidence: TradeAlgorithms.mqh TradeTimeLevelCheckM / TradeTimeLevelSetM (lines 1976-2005), used in BuyPositionOpen_M1 line 1735/1818

ideas.name: Loss-at-stop sizing via OrderCalcProfit
ideas.detail: Lot = (balance or free margin x risk fraction) / |OrderCalcProfit(1 lot, entry, SL price)|. Uses the broker's own profit calculation, so it is correct for metals contract sizes and non-USD account currencies without manual tick-value math.

ideas.name: Lot clamp to affordable margin via OrderCalcMargin
ideas.detail: After step/min/max normalisation, compute the largest lot free margin can fund (free margin / OrderCalcMargin of 1 lot), cut the requested lot down to it, and abort if even min lot is unaffordable. Also bumps SL/TP distance up to SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL.

ideas.name: Multiple sub-strategies with separate magic per strategy and per direction
ideas.detail: Each signal module owns distinct buy and sell magic numbers; position lookup, close and loss-streak statistics are all filtered by magic, so strategies run side by side on one hedging account without interfering and can be sized independently.
ideas.evidence: Exp_SilverTrend_ColorJFatl_Digit_MMRec.mq5 inputs A_BuyMagic/A_SellMagic/B_BuyMagic/B_SellMagic and OnTick blocks A and B

ideas.name: Higher-timeframe new-bar detector with history preload and recount-on-failure
ideas.detail: A per-timeframe CIsNewBar object gates signal evaluation; history for the indicator timeframe is force-loaded first, and if CopyBuffer fails a Recount flag makes the next tick retry instead of losing the bar's signal.

title: Algo: EMA Trend Cross on Closed Bars — XAUUSD M30
summary: EMA 20/50 cross on the last closed M30 bar, filtered by close versus EMA 200, one position at a time inside a server-time entry window. SL at 1% of price, risk-percent sizing, no TP; everything is closed once daily at 20:00.
red_flags: CopyBuffer return values are not checked in GetBackboneSignal; a failed copy leaves uninitialised arrays that are then compared
CalculateLotsByRisk raises the lot to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN when the risk-based lot is smaller, so actual risk can exceed RiskPercent on small accounts
SL is a fixed 1% of price, not volatility-scaled; no take-profit, exit only by SL or the daily time close
IsNewBar consumes the bar before anything else, so a rejected order or failed data read is never retried on that bar
Ownership relies on exact position comment match in addition to magic; a broker that rewrites or truncates comments would break exposure detection and the daily close
Daily exit is evaluated only on a new-bar tick and lastExitExecution is not persisted; if the terminal is offline at exit time the position is carried overnight
No spread, slippage, news or daily-loss filter; PassesFilters is an empty stub
No filling-mode selection (CTrade default) and trade results from Buy/Sell/PositionClose are not inspected or retried
Magic number is a hard-coded const, so two instances on the same symbol collide
Uses SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE rather than the loss-side tick value for sizing
Header is promotional (vendor free sample) - no performance claim is verifiable from the code

ideas.name: CTrade subclass with mandatory OrderCheck preflight
ideas.detail: Override CTrade::OrderSend so every request first runs OrderCheck; reject on non-zero retcode or when post-trade free margin would be negative, but always let through requests that close or reduce a position even if the check reports NO_MONEY.

ideas.name: Skip no-change SL/TP and pending modifications
ideas.detail: Before sending TRADE_ACTION_SLTP or MODIFY, compare requested values with the live position/order and short-circuit with NO_CHANGES if identical. Avoids server spam and 'too many requests' errors from trailing-stop loops.

ideas.name: Rate-limited rejection logging
ideas.detail: A rejected trade request is printed only when the retcode or reason differs from the last one, or at most once per 60 seconds, keeping the journal readable when a condition blocks trading tick after tick.

ideas.name: Closed-bar-only cross with price-side confirmation
ideas.detail: Read indicator values only at shifts 1 and 2 on the first tick of a new bar; require the fast/slow cross to occur on the closed bar AND the close to sit beyond both the fast EMA and the 200 EMA in the trade direction.

ideas.name: Midnight-wrapping entry window plus once-per-day flat time
ideas.detail: Entry allowed only inside a server-time window that correctly handles start > end; a separate scheduler fires exactly once per day at a set time to close positions and delete pendings, so no metals exposure is held through rollover and swap.

ideas.name: Exposure check over positions and pendings with OCO cleanup on fill
ideas.detail: One-trade-at-a-time is enforced by scanning both open positions and pending orders for symbol+magic+strategy tag; OnTradeTransaction deletes all remaining strategy pendings as soon as one of its own orders produces a deal. Stateless, so restart-safe.

title: GoldWarrior02b
summary: M15 CCI + 'Impulse' (MA of open-close) + ZigZag entry timed at the last 15s of a quarter-hour; then adds 3x lot adds/hedges and a 6x second-level hedge at -2500 loss; closes basket at +300 currency profit; fixed-pip trail.
red_flags: Lot multiplier 3x on first-level hedge/add and 6x (Multiplier*2) on second-level hedge when basket loss < -2500
Signals read from still-forming bar 0 (CCI, Impulse) plus ZigZag bar 0/1, which repaints
Hard-coded money magic numbers (balance 2000, profit 30, loss -2500, close-all 300) not scaled to account or volatility
Bar-end detection via hard-coded minute==14/29/44/59 and sec>=45: only works on M15 and needs a tick in that window
State machine flags (blok, bsb, bloks, blokb, ssig, bsig) are plain globals - lost on restart while positions remain
SL can be set to 0; default trailing 5 pips is unrealistically tight for gold
CloseAllPositions does not check results or retry
Indicator CopyBuffer failure returns 0.0, which is treated as a valid value
Requires hedging account; hedge legs netted on netting accounts

ideas.name: Post-fill cooldown from OnTradeTransaction
ideas.detail: On DEAL_ADD with DEAL_ENTRY_IN matching symbol+magic, store deal time; OnTick returns while TimeCurrent()-LastTradeTime<15s. Prevents duplicate entries during fill latency / requotes.

ideas.name: Filling-mode autodetect at init
ideas.detail: Checks SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE flags and sets FOK, else IOC, else RETURN on CTrade once in OnInit, so the same EA runs on different metal brokers without rejected orders.

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin volume check
ideas.detail: Before each market order, CTrade.CheckVolume returns max affordable lot; order is skipped with a log if it is below requested lot. Input lot validated against min/max/step in OnInit (INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT).

ideas.name: Basket profit close including swap and commission
ideas.detail: Sums Profit+Swap+Commission across all own (symbol+magic) positions each tick and closes everything when net exceeds a currency target. Useful only as a net-of-costs basket exit, not with the hedge logic.

ideas.name: Step-gated trailing stop
ideas.detail: Trail only moves SL when price has advanced TrailingStop+TrailingStep beyond open and beyond current SL, limiting modify spam; init rejects trailing with zero step.

title: Exp_SilverTrend_Duplex
summary: Two independent SilverTrend (N-bar high/low channel flip) instances on H4, one for longs and one for shorts with separate magic numbers, parameters and timeframes; fixed-point SL/TP, closes on opposite color. 'Silver' is the indicator name, not the metal.
red_flags: SL/TP are fixed points (1000/2000) with no volatility scaling; SL=0 allowed
LoadHistory called twice with the long timeframe (short timeframe never preloaded) - copy-paste bug
SignalBar=0 allowed, which trades the forming bar (repaint)
Library hard-codes ORDER_FILLING_FOK in close/modify requests; not broker-adaptive
Only TRADE_RETCODE_DONE accepted (PLACED/DONE_PARTIAL treated as failure), no retry logic
Default lot mode is fixed 0.1 lot; no spread, session, news or daily-loss protection
GlobalVariable time-lock key is not magic-specific in the non-M variant

ideas.name: Duplex long/short split
ideas.detail: Separate parameter set, timeframe, magic number, MM and open/close permission flags for the long side and the short side, so each direction is optimised and disabled independently (gold's long bias vs short behaviour).
ideas.evidence: Exp_SilverTrend_Duplex.mq5 inputs L_*/S_*, OnTick; TradeAlgorithms.mqh BuyPositionOpen_M1/SellPositionOpen_M1

ideas.name: One-trade-per-signal-bar lock in GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: After a filled entry, stores next-bar-open time in a terminal GlobalVariable keyed by login+symbol+direction(+magic); further entries are refused until TimeCurrent passes it. Survives restart; tester keys get a _Test_ suffix and are deleted on deinit.

ideas.name: Loss-based lot via OrderCalcProfit
ideas.detail: LOSSBALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN modes compute the loss of 1 lot at the SL price with OrderCalcProfit, then lot = (balance*risk fraction)/loss. Correct for any contract size/quote currency (XAU 100oz, XAG 5000oz) without tick-value guesswork.

ideas.name: Lot clamp to affordable margin
ideas.detail: LotCorrect floors to volume step, clamps min/max, then LotFreeMarginCorrect uses OrderCalcMargin to cut the lot to what free margin allows, refusing the trade if even min lot is unaffordable.

ideas.name: Stops-level correction plus OrderCheck pre-validation
ideas.detail: SL/TP distances are widened to SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL before building the request; every request goes through OrderCheck before OrderSend, and the signal flag is only cleared when retcode is DONE so the entry is retried next tick.

ideas.name: Closed-bar signal with retry-on-data-failure flag
ideas.detail: Signals are recomputed only on a new bar of the indicator timeframe (SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE comparison) from bar 1/2; if CopyBuffer fails a Recount flag forces recalculation next tick rather than losing the bar's signal.

title: Exp_SilverTrend_CrazyChart
summary: H1 single-instance EA: trades the crossover of an SSP-bar high/low channel line with a copy of itself displaced forward by SSP+1 bars; reverses on opposite cross; fixed-point SL/TP. Shares the same TradeAlgorithms.mqh library as 20943.
red_flags: Indicator is just a channel line vs its own time-shifted copy; Kmin input computed but unused for the plotted line - weak, lagging signal
No magic number: uses PositionSelect(symbol), so it would close/skip on any other EA's position on the symbol (netting-style)
Fixed-point SL/TP (1000/2000), SL=0 allowed, default fixed 0.1 lot
SignalBar=0 permitted (forming-bar signals)
No spread/session/news filters or account-level protection
Hard-coded FOK filling in library close/modify paths; only RETCODE_DONE accepted

ideas.name: Line vs displaced-self crossover
ideas.detail: Trend flip defined as a channel level crossing its own value from SSP+1 bars earlier (a momentum-of-range test) evaluated on closed bars 1 and 2. Could serve as a cheap regime/direction filter, not a standalone entry.

ideas.name: Separate open/close permission per direction
ideas.detail: Four independent flags (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) let the opposite signal close a position without opening a reverse, enabling long-only or exit-only operation modes without code change.
ideas.evidence: Exp_SilverTrend_CrazyChart.mq5 inputs and OnTick signal block

ideas.name: History preload and bars-calculated guard
ideas.detail: Each tick checks BarsCalculated(handle) against minimum required bars and calls LoadHistory for the indicator timeframe before using IsNewBar, avoiding false signals on a cold start or higher-timeframe data gap.

title: Daily Zone Recovery EA mt5 for GOLD
summary: Three state-machine strategies around yesterday's D1 high/low zones (break-retest, retest-break, retest-pullback-retest) on M1 bar opens; fixed lot; adds equal-lot grid positions against the move; virtual basket TP/SL as % of weighted average price.
red_flags: Averaging grid against the move with no cap on number of grid levels (equal lot, no multiplier)
No broker-side SL/TP at all: orders sent with sl=0,tp=0; basket SL is virtual and only evaluated once per new M1 bar, so a gap or terminal outage leaves positions unprotected
Basket SL default 1.5% of average price with fixed 0.01 lot and no account-equity/daily-loss guard
Curve-fit magic numbers: M12/M6 timeframes, zone 0.13/0.31/0.28%, TP 0.01% (Strategy 2 TP ~ spread-sized on gold)
Max spread default 3000 points is effectively no filter
trade.Buy/Sell return used but retcode never checked; PositionClose/PositionModify results ignored
Stage state for S2/S3 held only in memory - lost on restart
Zone width computed from daily HIGH for both high and low zones

ideas.name: Previous-day high/low zone state machine
ideas.detail: Per-direction integer stage (touch zone -> move away by X% -> return into zone) evaluated on closed bars only, reset when D1 bar time changes. Gives break-and-retest and sweep-pullback-retest entries around PDH/PDL without indicators.

ideas.name: Yesterday-range vs daily ATR regime filter
ideas.detail: Compute yesterday's D1 range as % of N-day mean daily range; trade only if between min% and max% (25-150). Skips days following abnormal compression or blow-off days where PDH/PDL levels are unreliable.

ideas.name: Pre-trade gate bundle incl. broker trading-session check
ideas.detail: Before each order: MQL_TRADE_ALLOWED, symbol trade mode, valid tick, loop over SymbolInfoSessionTrade sessions for today's weekday, volume step validity, SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT incl. pending orders, ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, OrderCalcMargin vs free margin.

ideas.name: Per-entry-hour series drawdown/profit statistics in tester
ideas.detail: Tracks each trade series' worst floating loss and closing profit, bucketed by the hour it was opened; prints hour table (count, max DD, avg DD, total/avg profit) at OnDeinit in tester. Useful to derive session filters from data.

ideas.name: Sub-strategy isolation by magic offset with optional mutual lock
ideas.detail: Each sub-strategy gets magic+N, its own CTrade and params struct; IsStrategyBlocked lets only one sub-strategy hold positions at a time (forced on netting accounts). Also no re-entry on the same bar a series closed (lastCloseBar).

ideas.name: Percent-of-price distances instead of points
ideas.detail: All zone widths, grid steps, TP and SL expressed as percent of reference price (GetDistance), so parameters stay meaningful as gold moves from 2000 to 4000 and port to silver without rescaling points.

title: Exp_SilverTrend_Signal_ReOpen
summary: Trades SilverTrend_Signal arrows (close breaking a K%-inset 9-bar high/low channel) on closed H4 bar; reverses on opposite arrow; adds to a WINNING netting position every PriceStep points up to PosTotal times. Name refers to indicator, not silver.
red_flags: SL is in fixed points (1000) and set to none if StopLoss_=0
Add-on state (count/last price/lot) stored in position comment and parsed by fixed character offsets - brokers truncate/overwrite comments; breaks on 4-digit gold prices with differing digits
Netting-only design (PositionSelect(symbol)), no magic-number ownership - will act on manual/other EA positions
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK - rejected by many gold brokers
Pyramiding up to 10 adds with fixed-point SL from each add price increases exposure late in the move
Unused LOSS* margin modes depend on fixed-point stop; no ATR adaptation
No spread, session or news filter
SignalBar=0 option allows repainting bar-0 signals

ideas.name: SilverTrend channel-flip signal
ideas.detail: Trend flips up when close > HH(N) - K%*(HH-LL), down when close < LL(N) + K%*(HH-LL), K=33-RISK; arrow only on state change. Simple Donchian-inset regime switch usable as a direction filter on H1/H4.

ideas.name: Pyramid only into profit at fixed price steps with cap
ideas.detail: On each new bar, if price has moved more than PriceStep in favour since the last add and add count < PosTotal, add another unit; never adds against the move. Would need ATR step and SL-to-breakeven to be robust.

ideas.name: Per-direction trade time-lock persisted in GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: After a successful entry, store 'no new trade before <signal bar end time>' in a terminal GlobalVariable keyed by symbol+direction; checked before every entry so a restart or SL hit within the same signal bar cannot re-enter.

ideas.name: OrderCheck before OrderSend plus stop-level and margin lot correction
ideas.detail: Every request goes through OrderCheck, stops widened to SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL (StopCorrect), lot floored to step/min/max and reduced to what free margin affords (LotFreeMarginCorrect), retcode DONE required with descriptive logging.

ideas.name: Recount flag and last-signal back-scan on restart
ideas.detail: If any CopyBuffer fails, a static Recount flag forces re-evaluation next tick instead of losing the bar; after restart it scans back through history for the most recent arrow to restore the current close-direction state.

title: GoldScalpBot — Autonomous XAUUSD Scalper with Local App Bridge (IC Markets)
summary: M5 EMA9/21 cross or trend+N-bar breakout on closed bar, gated by a 0-100 additive score (H1/H4 bias, EURUSD proxy, ATR ratio, spread, session, news, range position); ATR SL/TP, risk% sizing, partials/BE/trail/time stop, daily loss lock, MT5 calendar news pause.
red_flags: Licence gate: on live accounts a 7-day trial stored in a GlobalVariable, then new trades blocked without an account-bound key; hard-coded licence secret in source (GsLicenseSecret) - trivial to forge, but still a built-in kill-switch for live trading

WebRequest bridge (default off, default URL localhost) can receive remote commands: pause, close, modify, and open market orders (ManualMarket) and pushes account number/equity/positions/history - remote-control surface if URL is changed; static default token
Market order sent WITHOUT SL/TP, stops attached afterwards by PositionModify (one wider retry); if both modifies fail position stays unprotected until the time stop
Tester behaviour differs from live (IsTester disables green-close, partials, BE, trail, news flatten, and uses chart TF) - backtests do not represent live logic
Header marketing/'v1.27 research defaults' are unverified; negative-skew payoff: TP 0.85 ATR vs SL 0.9 ATR and close-when-green at 0.5R
Daily start equity, consecutive losses and trades-today kept only in memory - reset on restart, so daily loss lock can be bypassed by a restart
FloatingDdHit is identical to DailyLossHit (redundant)
EURUSD-as-dollar proxy and score weights are arbitrary magic numbers
Consecutive-loss counter counts each partial close deal as a win/loss
FindOurNewestPosition used to locate the new ticket instead of the trade result

ideas.name: Throttled, validated SafePositionModify/Close wrappers
ideas.detail: Before modify: skip if within freeze level, if SL/TP change < half a point, or if stops violate max(stops,freeze)+pad and 3x spread; on failure record ticket+time and refuse retries for 8 s. Prevents modify spam and invalid-stops errors on gold.
ideas.evidence: GoldScalpBot.mq5 SafePositionModify, StopsLevelsOk, LevelsActuallyChange, PositionNearFreeze, MinStopDistance

ideas.name: Built-in MT5 economic calendar news window with flatten
ideas.detail: CalendarValueHistory for USD between now-AfterMin and now+BeforeMin, block on HIGH (optionally MODERATE) importance, refreshed at most every 20 s; while blocked, no new entries and optionally close all own positions. No external WebRequest needed.

ideas.name: Risk% sizing with min-lot fallback cap and margin ceiling
ideas.detail: Lot = equity*risk% / (SL ticks * tick value); if below broker min lot, allow min lot only when its SL risk <= a second cap (5%); then clamp by OrderCalcMargin using only X% of free margin and a hard max lot; halves size when macro bias opposes.

ideas.name: Additive pre-trade quality score with logged reasons and spread-adjusted RR gate
ideas.detail: Score starts at 50, +/- points for HTF alignment, macro proxy, ATR/avgATR within 0.55-2.2, spread vs max, session overlap, news, close position in 20-bar range; reasons string logged/displayed. Separately rejects if TP/SL minus spread/SL < min net RR.

ideas.name: R-multiple staged exit with restart-safe stage tracking
ideas.detail: Exit ladder in units of initial risk: partial close at 0.55R, second at 0.75R, SL to breakeven at 0.5R, ATR-multiple trail after 0.65R with minimum-improvement step, hard time stop in minutes; partial stage and entry score persisted per ticket in GlobalVariables; dust-volume guard falls back to full close.

ideas.name: Day-level circuit breakers with visible block reason
ideas.detail: UTC day stamp resets start equity; blocks new entries on equity loss >= daily %, max consecutive losses (counted from DEAL_ENTRY_OUT in OnTradeTransaction incl. swap+commission), max trades/day, max positions, Friday >=18 UTC; one-line chart status shows the exact short block code.
ideas.evidence: GoldScalpBot.mq5 SyncDayRisk, DailyLossHit, OnTradeTransaction, OnTick gates, StatusBlockTag/UpdateChartStatus

title: Exp_SilverTrend
summary: Plain stop-and-reverse EA on SilverTrend_Signal arrows (close crossing K%-inset 9-bar high/low channel) read from closed H1 bar; fixed lot, fixed-point SL/TP; single netting position per symbol. Not silver-specific.
red_flags: SL/TP in fixed points (1000/2000), disabled if set to 0; no ATR adaptation for gold volatility
Netting-only, no magic number - closes/reverses any position on the symbol
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK
No spread, session, news or account-level protection
SignalBar=0 would trade repainting bar-0 arrows
Same 2011-2013 shared library as other Kositsin EAs; nothing metal-specific despite the name

ideas.name: SilverTrend channel-flip as direction filter
ideas.detail: Regime flips up when close exceeds HH(N) minus K% of the N-bar range and down when below LL(N) plus K%; signal only on flip. Cheap closed-bar higher-timeframe trend state for a metals bot.

ideas.name: Separate open/close permissions per side with signal-time lock
ideas.detail: Independent BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose switches (long-only or exit-only modes) and a GlobalVariable time level so only one entry per signal bar per direction survives restarts.

ideas.name: New-bar class on SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE with history preload
ideas.detail: CIsNewBar compares SeriesInfoInteger(SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE) of the indicator timeframe (not chart TF) and LoadHistory ensures the signal timeframe is synchronised before reading buffers; Recount flag retries failed CopyBuffer.

title: KA-Gold Bot
summary: MT4. Closed-bar Keltner-style channel (EMA50 +/- average bar range) breakout with EMA10 crossing the band and EMA200 trend filter; fixed-pip SL/TP, step trailing, session window, spread cap, one position at a time.
red_flags: Sell signal coded as `result = true` (works only because true==OP_SELL==1)
OrderSend result tested with `!OrderSend(...)` although failure returns -1, so errors are never detected
'Risk %' lot is free margin / 100000, unrelated to stop distance
Fixed 500-pip SL/TP magic numbers, not volatility-scaled
Session window breaks if start > end (no midnight wrap)
Trailing trigger flags are globals, lost on restart

ideas.name: Range-based Keltner breakout with fast-EMA band cross
ideas.detail: Band = EMA(50) +/- mean(High-Low) over 50 bars. Buy when closed bar closes above upper band, EMA10 crossed above the band between bars 2 and 1, and close is above EMA200. All on bars 1/2, no repaint.

ideas.name: Pre-trade validation chain
ideas.detail: Before sending: spread cap, volume min/max/step conformity, SL/TP distance vs SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, and free-margin-after-trade check; order skipped if any fails.

ideas.name: Trigger + stop + step trailing
ideas.detail: Trailing only arms after profit exceeds a trigger distance; SL then moves to price minus trail distance only when it would improve by at least a step, limiting modify spam.

title: Gold Dust
summary: MT5 port of Reshetov's perceptron EA: weighted sum of price-minus-LWMA at four lagged points gives direction; reverses positions on new bar, closes profitable positions on neutral, pip SL plus step trailing.
red_flags: Perceptron input a1 uses close of bar 0 (start_pos=0) read on the first tick of the new bar
8 integer weights x11..x42 are pure optimisation parameters with no defaults that trade sensibly (all 100 = zero weights) - curve-fit by design
SL can be set to 0; no TP
Margin check compares free-margin-after-trade against margin of a SELL even for buys
No spread, session or news filter

ideas.name: Transaction-confirmed order state machine
ideas.detail: After a successful send, sets waiting flag with order ticket; OnTradeTransaction DEAL_ADD with matching symbol/magic/order clears it. No new orders are issued while waiting, preventing duplicate entries on async fills.

ideas.name: Stops/freeze level fallback to 3x spread
ideas.detail: If broker reports stops or freeze level as 0, substitute 3x current spread, then multiply by 1.1 and use the larger of the two as minimum distance for SL placement and trailing modifications.

ideas.name: Close-opposite-then-open intent flags
ideas.detail: Signal sets need_open_buy/sell flags; subsequent ticks first close opposite positions, verify none remain, then open. Reversal survives partial close failures and retries until state is consistent.

ideas.name: Dual-perceptron agreement vote
ideas.detail: Two independently weighted linear perceptrons on lagged price-vs-MA deviations; in mode 3 a trade is taken only when both agree on direction, otherwise neutral.

ideas.name: New-bar retry on stale quotes
ideas.detail: If RefreshRates or symbol refresh fails on a new bar, the stored bar time is reset to 0 so the bar logic re-runs on the next tick instead of being skipped.

title: Quantum Gold Silver Trader
summary: Weighted sum of RSI, ADX, MA50-MA200 gap and a return mean/std ratio, plus a random 'quantum state' term, thresholded for direction on M15. ATR SL/TP, adaptive ATR trail, daily/total drawdown halts, per-symbol gold/silver presets.
red_flags: 'Quantum state' is MathRand() added to the signal and trailing distance - non-deterministic, unreproducible backtests
'AI' is a uniform nudge of all weights by recent win rate; no real learning
No magic number: manages/closes every position on the symbol and reads last history deal of any EA
MA gap divided by _Point dominates the score, so the signal is effectively MA50 vs MA200
Indicators read at shift 0 (forming bar)
Hard-coded halt when equity < 300
Risk multiplied by 1.2 after wins; risk also scaled by sin() of 'chaos'
In-tester random 'auto-optimisation' overwrites parameters and saves them to file
Daily halt auto-resumes after 1 hour via timer; halt state not persisted across restart
Lot sizing uses SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE with point instead of tick size

ideas.name: In-sample/out-of-sample OnTester fitness
ideas.detail: Splits deal history 70/30 by time, computes PF, recovery factor, payoff per segment; rejects passes with <20 OOS trades, negative OOS or IS profit, OOS RF<1; scores OOS metrics plus IS-vs-OOS consistency ratios.

ideas.name: Layered equity guard with warning buffer
ideas.detail: Tracks day-start and intraday peak equity; halts new entries when drawdown from today's peak or balance-to-equity drawdown exceeds limits, and logs a warning when within a buffer percentage of the limit.

ideas.name: Per-symbol gold/silver parameter presets
ideas.detail: OnInit maps symbol name to an internal parameter set: silver gets wider ATR SL multiplier (2.0 vs 1.5), higher TP ratio, lower base risk (0.3% vs 0.5%), more bars between trades and wider trail.

ideas.name: Loss-streak risk reduction
ideas.detail: OnTrade counts consecutive losing deals; after N losses current risk percent is multiplied by 0.7 (floor 0.1%), reset on a win. The decrease half is reusable; the 1.2x increase after wins is not advised.

ideas.name: Throttled ATR trail with volatility-scaled width
ideas.detail: Trail activates after 1 ATR profit; distance interpolates between base and max ATR multiplier by a volatility metric; modifies at most every 30s, only if SL improves by min change and respects max(stops level, 0.3 ATR).

ideas.name: Margin-aware lot step-down
ideas.detail: After risk-based sizing, lot is reduced one volume step at a time until OrderCalcMargin fits free margin; returns -1 if even the minimum does not fit, and three consecutive margin failures pause trading.

title: Quantum XAUUSD Silver Trader
summary: Re-skinned rewrite of Quantum Gold Silver Trader with English inputs: same weighted RSI/ADX/MA/volatility score with random state term, ATR SL/TP and trail, equity guards, presets; adds session check and suffix-tolerant symbol detection.
red_flags: Same logic as 63193 under a different author name; header claims of '10 years experience, tested, ready for live' are marketing
MathRand() 'adaptive state' still feeds signal and trailing
No magic number: trails any position on the symbol
Gold preset SL = 8x ATR with TP = 0.7x ATR (reward:risk about 0.09)
Default daily loss 15%, total drawdown 50% - protections are nominal
Hard-coded halt when equity < 500
Indicators at shift 0 (forming bar)
Risk x1.2 after a win
Preset match requires symbol to start with XAUUSD/GOLD; prefixed broker symbols miss it

ideas.name: Trade-session and trade-mode gate before any order or modify
ideas.detail: Requires SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL and current server second-of-day inside a SymbolInfoSessionTrade window; applied both before entries and before trailing modifications to avoid market-closed rejections.
ideas.evidence: Quantum_XAUUSD_Silver_Trader.mq5 XP_MarketOpen() line 347, used at 971 and 1202

ideas.name: Suffix-tolerant metal preset detection
ideas.detail: Uses StringFind(symbol,"XAUUSD")==0 / "GOLD" / "XAGUSD" / "SILVER" so broker suffixes like XAUUSDm or XAGUSD.r still receive the metal-specific parameter set.

ideas.name: Drift-to-noise entry filter
ideas.detail: Computes |mean/std| of the last 20 log returns on the analysis timeframe and blocks entries below a threshold, i.e. trades only when recent drift is large relative to noise.

title: XANDER Gold Recovery
summary: Closed-bar re-entry from outside a Keltner-style band in EMA10/200 direction opens a first trade; then adds up to 5 same-direction positions every 300 pips against the move at 1.4x lot; closes basket on currency TP or hard stop.
red_flags: Martingale averaging: lot x1.4 per step against the move
Per-position stop loss defaults to 0; recovery orders always sent with no SL
Basket hard stop is EA-side only (no protection if terminal is offline) and can be disabled
Spread filter returns before ManageBasket, so the basket stop is skipped during wide spreads
Basket TP/stop in fixed currency, not scaled to lot or balance
Trailing modify sent without stops-level check
Signal logic lifted from KA-Gold Bot (same periods and defaults)

ideas.name: Basket-level currency hard stop including swap and commission
ideas.detail: Sums profit+swap+commission of all positions for symbol+magic each tick and closes the whole group when it falls below a negative currency threshold or above a profit target.

ideas.name: Band re-entry reversal with trend filter
ideas.detail: Buy when bar 2 closed below lower band (EMA50 minus mean range) and bar 1 closed back above it, only if EMA10 > EMA200; mirror for sells. Closed bars only.

ideas.name: Input sanity validation at init
ideas.detail: OnInit rejects out-of-range settings (max orders 1-20, multiplier >= 1, distance > 0) with INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT instead of running with invalid configuration.

ideas.name: Minute-resolution session window with midnight wrap
ideas.detail: Trading window defined by start/end hour and minute in server time; handles windows crossing midnight by OR-ing the two halves.

title: Sniper Gold Hybrid Recovery EA
summary: Buy-only M15 gold averaging basket. First buy on ATR-regime-adjusted RSI oversold plus swing-low structure score; further buys at widening ATR distances below the lowest entry with larger 'rescue' lots. Basket trailing in USD, pair trimming, news and crash filters.
red_flags: Every order sent with SL=0 and TP=0; only protection is an EA-side 50% equity loss close-all
Averaging down, long-only; rescue lot equals 100% of existing basket lots (doubles exposure) from the 3rd trade
AutoRecoveryDepth=true means no cap on number of recovery trades
'AI recovery' naming is a hand-weighted score, not ML
Trade retcodes not checked; no filling mode set
Basket trail peak state is in memory only, lost on restart
Basket profit ignores commission
Many hard-coded point distances tuned to gold price level

ideas.name: Built-in calendar news block with CSV fallback
ideas.detail: CalendarValueHistory over [now-after, now+before], keeps high-importance events whose country currency matches (USD for XAU/GOLD), blocks entries in the window; result cached 60s. Optional CSV file with GMT-to-server offset auto-detected from TimeTradeServer-TimeGMT.

ideas.name: Tick-velocity crash detector with cooldown
ideas.detail: Measures points moved per second between consecutive ticks; above a threshold sets a crash flag that blocks first entries for N minutes and widens spacing for a longer post-crash period.

ideas.name: ATR-regime-adaptive RSI threshold
ideas.detail: Compares ATR(14) of the last closed bar to its 50-bar average; oversold level tightens from 40 to 35 at 1.4x and to 30 at 2x average volatility, demanding deeper extremes in fast markets.

ideas.name: Structure confluence score gate
ideas.detail: Additive 0-100 score from RSI depth, lower-low/lower-high swing structure, proximity (0.65 ATR) to or sweep-and-reclaim of last swing low, and bullish rejection candle (lower wick >=35% of range, close in upper half); entry requires minimum score.

ideas.name: Peak-giveback profit trail in money terms
ideas.detail: Once net profit reaches a target scaled by lot size, tracks peak profit and closes when profit retraces by a step amount from the peak; applicable to a single position or group.

ideas.name: On-chart status dashboard
ideas.detail: Label panel showing run state (running/crash pause/post-crash), position count, net P/L, equity and drawdown percent, RSI vs active threshold, ATR ratio, breakeven price and current news-block reason.

title: SMC Gold: Liquidity Sweep and Order Block EA for XAUUSD M15
summary: Closed-bar swing-high/low sweep (wick beyond by ATR fraction, close back inside) aligned with H1 EMA50, confirmed by a later close through the sweep bar body; market entry, stop beyond the wick, fixed R target, optional breakeven.
red_flags: Trend filter reads the still-forming H1 bar (EMA and close at shift 0)
Trend filter fails open when EMA data is unavailable
Setup and swing state held in memory; a pending setup is lost on restart
Position briefly has no SL between fill and modify (mitigated by immediate close on failure)
Risk sized on balance, no daily loss limit or news filter

ideas.name: Point value from OrderCalcProfit
ideas.detail: Asks the server for profit of a 1-lot buy over 1000 points and divides by 1000 to get money-per-point, avoiding SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE which the author notes is wrong for XAUUSD on some brokers; lot floored to volume step, zero if below minimum.

ideas.name: Send naked, attach stops to real fill, close if attach fails
ideas.detail: Market order sent without SL/TP; position found via deal's DEAL_POSITION_ID; SL kept at planned level and TP recomputed as R multiple from actual fill, respecting stops level; if PositionModify fails the position is closed immediately.

ideas.name: Sweep-and-reclaim with body confirmation and expiry
ideas.detail: Closed bar must wick beyond a confirmed N-bar pivot by >=0.15 ATR and close back inside; its body is the zone. Entry only if a bar within 3 bars closes through the zone with range >=0.3 ATR. Each swing is used once.

ideas.name: Stop-width quality gates
ideas.detail: Trade skipped if stop distance is below 0.5 ATR or below 3x current spread, in addition to an absolute spread cap in points, so costs cannot dominate the risk unit.

ideas.name: No entries within 15 minutes of session close
ideas.detail: Iterates SymbolInfoSessionTrade for the current weekday and allows entries only if now is inside a session and at least 900 seconds before its end; also suppresses breakeven modifications when closed.

ideas.name: Restart recovery and position-identifier ownership
ideas.detail: OnInit scans for an existing symbol+magic position and restores its identifier, entry and initial risk from the current SL; management tracks POSITION_IDENTIFIER rather than symbol. Breakeven is attempted once only to avoid retry storms.

title: Stochastic Daily Breakout for Gold, +245 Percent in a 2021-2026 Backtest
summary: On each new bar, a turn in a custom close-only smoothed stochastic signal line plus a Bollinger filter on the open three bars back places a buy stop at yesterday's high or sell stop at yesterday's low; percent SL/TP, bar-count expiry, fixed lot.
red_flags: Title's +245% backtest claim is unverifiable; parameters (band 9, K 23, slowing 7, 1.9%, expiry 9) look curve-fit
Counter-intuitive rule: buy breakout when stochastic turns down
Fixed lot only, no risk-based sizing
No spread, news or volatility filter
Send failures are silent (no logging)
Recomputes 2000-bar stochastic every bar

ideas.name: Pending stop at prior-day extreme with same-side replace
ideas.detail: Entry is a buy stop at yesterday's D1 high or sell stop at yesterday's low; any existing pending order of the same side is deleted first, and none is placed while a position with the magic exists.

ideas.name: Bar-count expiry for pending orders
ideas.detail: Each new bar, pending orders whose setup time is N or more bars old (iBarShift of ORDER_TIME_SETUP) are removed, independent of broker expiration support.

ideas.name: Percent-of-price SL/TP
ideas.detail: Stop and target distances are a percentage of the entry price, rounded to tick size, so they scale automatically as gold's price level changes over years instead of fixed points.

ideas.name: Broker capability adaptation for pending orders
ideas.detail: Chooses FOK else IOC from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE, falls back to ORDER_TIME_DAY when GTC is not allowed, verifies entry/SL/TP distances against stops level with half-point tolerance, checks margin, and accepts only DONE/PLACED retcodes.

ideas.name: Session check handling overnight sessions
ideas.detail: IsMarketOpen compares time-of-day with each SymbolInfoSessionTrade interval and handles intervals that wrap past midnight (from > to).

title: Gold  MT5 Fractal Breakout EA
summary: Every 15 minutes while flat, places buy/sell stop orders near the latest confirmed H1 5/5 swing high/low with percent-of-price SL/TP; cancels remaining pendings after a fill; manages breakeven lock, bounded trail and a 'salvage' reduced-loss target.
red_flags: Default SL 2% vs TP 1% and breakeven after 0.1% - needs very high win rate
Negative entry offset places the stop order 0.1% before the swing level (anticipating the breakout)
Uses the most recent swing only; no trend, spread, news or volatility filter
Risk mode uses SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE (can be wrong for XAUUSD on some brokers)
Expiry passed with ORDER_TIME_GTC so the hour-based expiry input is effectively ignored
InpMaxPending/MaxPositions largely moot since entries are blocked while any symbol position exists
Scan timer and throttles are in-memory statics

ideas.name: OrderCheck pre-validation of the full pending request
ideas.detail: Builds the exact MqlTradeRequest and calls OrderCheck before sending; rejects and logs retcode, comment and resulting free margin when the server-side simulation fails.

ideas.name: Margin budget reserving pending-order activations
ideas.detail: Sums OrderCalcMargin of all pending orders account-wide, allows a new order only if its margin fits in 80% of free margin minus that reserve; skips rather than silently shrinking lot; later deletes own pendings if the reserve exceeds budget.

ideas.name: Freeze-level-aware modify/delete with throttling
ideas.detail: Before modifying a position or deleting a pending, checks existing and new SL/TP and order price against max(freeze, stops level) plus one tick; skipped if inside. Modify attempts throttled to once per 5s, deletes once per 1s.

ideas.name: OCO cancel of opposite pendings on fill
ideas.detail: OnTradeTransaction DEAL_ADD for the symbol (and every tick as retry) deletes all remaining own stop orders once any position exists, giving one-cancels-other behaviour for a two-sided breakout bracket.

ideas.name: Robust volume normalisation with SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT
ideas.detail: Derives lot decimals from the volume step, floors to the step grid, validates min/max, and caps by remaining per-direction SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT counting all positions and pendings on the symbol; returns 0 rather than rounding up.

ideas.name: Structured request/context/result logging
ideas.detail: Logs every pending order's arguments, the quote and broker constraints at send time (stops level, tick size, volume specs), and the full result (retcode, description, order, deal, price, broker comment) for post-mortem diagnosis.

title: SilverTrend v3
summary: MT4 EA: on each new bar computes inline SilverTrend channel direction (9-bar range, 30% bands) confirmed by sign of inline J_TPO rank-correlation; one trade per magic, fixed 1 lot, optional point trailing, Friday no-entry cutoff.
red_flags: InitialStopLoss defaults to 0 and TrailingStop 0: position has no broker SL by default
Bug: 'Signal=OldSignal' assignment is reversed, so OldSignal is never updated and exit-on-reversal logic never fires
Lots hard-coded to 1.0 (not an input), no risk sizing
OrderSelect/OrderClose return values unchecked; err used before GetLastError on close
Symbol-to-magic map only knows 'GOLD' and FX majors; unknown symbols get magic base 0
No stops-level, spread or volume normalisation

ideas.name: Rank-correlation (J_TPO) momentum confirmation
ideas.detail: Spearman-style rank correlation between price ranks and time order over 14 closes gives a bounded -1..+1 trend-quality value; entry only when its sign agrees with the channel-direction flip. Useful as a non-parametric trend filter.

ideas.name: Channel-percent regime flip
ideas.detail: Trend state flips up when close exceeds (9-bar high minus 30% of range) and down when below (low plus 30% of range); state is sticky between bands, giving hysteresis instead of a single threshold.

ideas.name: Friday evening no-new-trades cutoff
ideas.detail: Blocks new entries when bar time is Friday after a configurable hour, avoiding weekend gap exposure on fresh positions.

ideas.name: GlobalVariable trade-context mutex
ideas.detail: Wraps OrderSend in a terminal GlobalVariable lock ('InTrade') with 30s timeout so several EAs do not collide on the trade context. MT4-era, but the pattern applies to cross-EA coordination.

ideas.name: Magic derived from symbol and timeframe
ideas.detail: Magic = base + symbolCode*100 + timeframeCode so the same EA on several charts never manages another instance's trades.

title: Pending tread EA (Best for Gold)
summary: Keeps 10 pending orders per side at fixed pip steps from current price (buy stops above, sell stops below by default; type configurable to limits), fixed lot, fixed SL/TP per order, equity-floor kill that closes everything.
red_flags: No signal at all: blind symmetric pending grid, refilled every 5 seconds
Grid levels are computed from the current price each refill, so order prices drift and can duplicate or cluster
CloseAllTradesAndOrders closes positions of every symbol and every magic on the account
Equity baseline is balance at OnInit, reset by any restart; after the limit trips it retries close-all on every tick forever
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_RETURN and GTC; no spread, session or volatility filter
Pip conversion (digits 3/5 x10) is wrong for gold with 2 digits
Above/below order types can be set to limits, turning it into an averaging grid

ideas.name: Equity floor versus starting balance with flatten-all
ideas.detail: If equity <= startBalance*(1-MaxLoss%), close all positions and delete pendings before any other logic. Reusable if the baseline is persisted and the close is filtered by magic.

ideas.name: Skip tick after busy/requote retcode
ideas.detail: Checks the last CTrade retcode for 10006/10010/10011 and skips the tick, combined with a 5-second throttle between order batches to avoid flooding the server.

ideas.name: Pending price validated against stops level
ideas.detail: Each pending order is skipped when its distance from market is below SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, instead of sending and getting rejected.

ideas.name: Minimum equity gate
ideas.detail: No new orders are placed while account equity is under a configured absolute floor.

title: GoldWarrior02b MT4
summary: MT4 EA: CCI plus custom DayImpuls and ZigZag indicators give a counter-swing entry near the M15 bar end; then adds/hedges with 30x and 60x base lot, closes all when floating profit exceeds a money threshold.
red_flags: Hedge/add orders sized k1=30x and k2=60x the base lot: extreme lot escalation after losses
Second-level hedge triggers at floating loss below -2500 currency units, a hard-coded magic number
Depends on external custom indicators DayImpuls and ZigZag not included; ZigZag repaints
Signals read CCI and impulse on forming bar 0
Magic number 1 is set on orders but never checked; manages every order on the symbol
No OrderSend/OrderClose result checks, no volume or stops-level normalisation
Hard-coded account thresholds (balance 2000, profit 30, 150, 300) and a 'testing year' input
Entry timing by wall-clock minute 14/29/44/59 and seconds>=45, only valid on M15
SL of 1000 points with TP of 150 points: strongly negative reward to risk

ideas.name: Basket close on floating profit threshold with latch
ideas.detail: When summed floating profit of all symbol orders exceeds a money threshold, a latch flag is set and orders are closed one per tick until flat, so a partial close failure is retried.
ideas.evidence: Goldwarrior02b.mq4 start(), pm flag and 'summa>porog' block

ideas.name: Last-trade timestamp in GlobalVariables as cooldown
ideas.detail: Stores last entry time in a terminal GlobalVariable and refuses to act for 15 seconds after it, a restart-surviving anti-double-entry guard.

title: XANDER Grid XAUUSD
summary: Bidirectional martingale grid: opens in the direction of the previous candle, adds every 390 points against the move with doubled lot (capped at 0.04), exits via shared TP on best and worst positions or partial close.
red_flags: Lot doubles on each grid level against the move
No stop loss on any position; PositionModify(tk,0,0) explicitly strips stops
Max floating drawdown option only pauses new entries, never closes; off by default
'Daily target' uses current floating profit as a proxy, not realised daily P/L
Unlimited number of levels at max lot once the cap is reached
Entry logic runs every tick, no new-bar gate, no spread or session filter
Header claims of tested/10 years experience are marketing, not evidence
Hides chart trade levels and bid/ask lines on load

ideas.name: Pairwise unwind of extreme positions
ideas.detail: Computes volume-weighted breakeven of only the best and worst priced positions plus a minimum profit, and closes that pair there (or partial-closes the best), reducing a basket in pieces instead of all-or-nothing.

ideas.name: Hard lot ceiling plus exact volume-step validation
ideas.detail: Next lot is clamped to a max-lot input, then rejected unless it is within min/max and an exact multiple of SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP.

ideas.name: Floating P/L including swap and commission
ideas.detail: Floating profit for the EA's magic sums profit, swap and commission, so basket targets and drawdown gates use net figures.

ideas.name: Save and restore chart settings
ideas.detail: Chart display properties changed in OnInit are saved first and restored in OnDeinit, so the EA leaves the user's chart as found.

title: SilverTrend v3
summary: MT5 port of the MT4 SilverTrend v3: new-bar channel-direction signal confirmed by J_TPO sign, fixed 0.1 lot, 50-pip TP and trailing, Friday cutoff; hedging accounts only.
red_flags: InitialStopLoss defaults to 0: position has no SL until the 50-pip trail activates in profit
Inherited bug 'Signal=OldSignal': OldSignal stays 0, so a new entry fires on every bar the trend state persists and reversal exits never fire
The MT4 one-trade-at-a-time check was dropped: positions can stack without limit
Fixed lot 0.1 and magic hard-coded, not inputs
Trailing only evaluated once per bar
No spread filter, no stops-level check, no filling mode set
Refuses to run on netting accounts

ideas.name: Quote refresh with zero bid/ask protection
ideas.detail: Before any order or stop modification the symbol quotes are refreshed and the action is aborted if bid or ask is zero.

ideas.name: Deal-ticket confirmation after CTrade call
ideas.detail: Treats an order as opened only if CTrade returns true and ResultDeal() is non-zero; otherwise logs retcode and description.

ideas.name: Friday evening no-new-trades cutoff
ideas.detail: New entries are blocked on Friday after a configurable server hour.

title: GoldLondonBreakout
summary: Locks the Asian-session high/low, skips days when the range is outside 15-70% of daily ATR, places buy-stop/sell-stop pair with ATR buffer, ATR stop, 1.8R target, percent-risk sizing, expiry and OCO cancel.
red_flags: Daily state (range computed, orders placed, tickets) lives only in memory; a restart mid-session deletes pendings and can re-place them
OCO uses PositionSelect(_Symbol), unreliable on hedging accounts with other positions on the symbol
Lot is raised to broker minimum when the risk lot is smaller, silently exceeding the risk percent
Spread and range checks are one-shot: a wide spread on the first tick of the window skips the whole day
Session hours are raw server hours with no DST or broker-offset handling
Daily ATR read from the still-forming daily bar
No trailing or breakeven; no daily loss limit; order placement not retried on failure

ideas.name: Session range sanity filter as fraction of daily ATR
ideas.detail: Asian range must be between 0.15 and 0.70 of D1 ATR(14); too narrow or too wide ranges skip the day. Normalises the filter across gold price levels and volatility regimes.

ideas.name: Session-range stop-order pair with expiry and OCO
ideas.detail: Buy stop above and sell stop below the locked range with ATR buffer, broker-side ORDER_TIME_SPECIFIED expiry at window end, and cancellation of the remaining pending once one side fills.

ideas.name: Stops/freeze-level aware distances with safety margin
ideas.detail: Minimum distance = max(stops level, freeze level) x 1.2; entry buffer and stop distance are floored by it, and each side is skipped if price is already through its level at placement.

ideas.name: Tick-size price rounding
ideas.detail: All prices are rounded to a multiple of SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE rather than only to digits, which matters on metals where tick size can differ from point.

ideas.name: Risk-percent lot with double margin pre-check
ideas.detail: Lots = equity risk / (stop distance in ticks x tick value), floored to volume step, then OrderCalcMargin checked both inside the sizing function and at the call site; returns 0 lots if unaffordable.

ideas.name: Daily state machine with new-day reset
ideas.detail: Day boundary detected from server time; reset clears range, flags and leftover pendings; phases are range-locked, orders-placed (attempted once), managed, expired.

title: Gold Breakout EA for XAUUSD H4 +90 Percent in a 2020 to 2026 Backtest
summary: Closed-bar Donchian (20-bar) breakout with EMA200 side filter, long-only by default; ATR stop, percent-risk sizing via OrderCalcProfit, stops attached to actual fill, three exit modes (fixed R, ATR trail, opposite channel).
red_flags: Title backtest claim is marketing; default long-only setting is admitted in the header to be chosen because shorts lost in 2020-2026 (regime fit to a gold bull market)
Position is briefly without SL between market fill and stop attach
Trailing and Friday close are evaluated only once per bar (H4), so reaction can lag hours
After restart the best-price tracker resets to entry and risk is inferred from current SL
Lot rounded with NormalizeDouble(lot,2) regardless of volume step
Risk based on balance, no daily loss or drawdown lock

ideas.name: Lot sizing from OrderCalcProfit instead of tick value
ideas.detail: Asks the server for the loss of 1 lot over the stop distance with OrderCalcProfit and divides the risk money by it; avoids wrong SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE on metals and non-USD accounts. Returns 0 (skip) if below minimum lot rather than rounding up.

ideas.name: Attach stops to real fill or close immediately
ideas.detail: Sends the market order without stops, resolves the position via DEAL_POSITION_ID, computes SL/TP from the actual fill price respecting stops level, and closes the position at once if the modify fails.

ideas.name: Spread as a fraction of stop distance
ideas.detail: Trade is skipped when current spread exceeds 10% of the ATR-based stop distance, a volatility-relative cost filter instead of a fixed point cap.

ideas.name: Broker trade-session check with pre-close margin
ideas.detail: Uses SymbolInfoSessionTrade for the current weekday and allows entries and stop moves only if the session is open and not ending within 15 minutes; handles gold's daily break without hard-coded hours.

ideas.name: Fresh closed-bar channel breakout with EMA side filter
ideas.detail: Bar 1 must close beyond the N-bar channel built from bars before it, while bar 2 did not break its own channel; plus close on the right side of EMA200 and per-direction enable flags. No bar-0 data.

ideas.name: Tighten-only trail with stops-level room and failure cap
ideas.detail: Chandelier (best price minus m x ATR) or opposite-channel stop, moved only if better by more than a point and outside stops level; consecutive modify failures capped at 3. Restart recovers the position by magic in OnInit.

title: EMA Cross Scalper M15 (XAUUSD, WIB session filter)
summary: Educational EMA10/EMA30 closed-bar cross on M15 during a 4-hour local-time window; fixed lot, fixed-point SL/TP, one position, spread cap, stops-level and margin pre-checks.
red_flags: Default SL of 70 points (0.70 USD on gold) is smaller than the default max spread of 100 points: stop sits inside noise
Fixed lot, no risk-based sizing
No exit other than SL/TP; no trailing, breakeven or opposite-signal close
TimeGMT in the strategy tester does not reflect real GMT, so the session window shifts in backtests
A cross that occurs outside the window is never traded; signal consumed by the new-bar flag before the filter check
No daily loss limit

ideas.name: Session window in GMT-offset time, independent of broker server time
ideas.detail: Session hour derived from TimeGMT plus a fixed offset instead of server time, so the window does not move between brokers; wrap-around midnight windows supported.

ideas.name: Stops validated on the triggering side of the quote
ideas.detail: Before sending, checks SL/TP distance against stops level using bid for buys and ask for sells (the side that actually triggers the exit), skipping the signal instead of getting a rejection.

ideas.name: Margin pre-check that fails closed
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin compared with free margin before every order; if the calculation itself fails the signal is skipped.

ideas.name: Closed-bar cross with ownership count
ideas.detail: Signal uses buffers from shift 1 and 2 only, evaluated once per new bar, with position count filtered by magic and symbol and filling mode set by symbol.

title: Xander Grid RSI Gold
summary: RSI zone-exit on closed bar opens a basket; adds a level every 400 points against the move with 1.5x lot up to 8 levels; closes basket at money or points-from-average target; optional basket stop.
red_flags: Lot multiplier 1.5x per level, averaging against the move up to 8 levels
No broker-side stop loss on any position; basket SL is software-only and off by default
Basket take profit default 5 currency units versus open-ended basket loss
Basket profit ignores commission
Level additions run on every tick with no spread, volatility or trend filter
Fixed 400-point grid step not scaled to gold volatility
No filling mode set on CTrade
Header claims (tested, 10+ years) are marketing

ideas.name: RSI zone re-entry trigger on closed bars
ideas.detail: Buy only when RSI was at or below oversold on bar 2 and back above it on bar 1 (mirror for sells), i.e. the exit from the extreme rather than being in it.

ideas.name: Basket exit in points from volume-weighted average
ideas.detail: Computes volume-weighted average open price per direction and closes the whole direction when price is N points beyond it, or when net money reaches a target or a negative basket limit.

ideas.name: Exposure caps: max levels and max total positions
ideas.detail: Separate hard limits on levels per direction and on total EA positions, plus an option to allow only one direction at a time.

ideas.name: Once-per-bar warning throttle
ideas.detail: A static datetime holding the bar time of the last warning limits repeated log messages (insufficient margin) to one per bar.

ideas.name: Hour window with midnight wrap
ideas.detail: Time filter handles start<end and start>end (overnight) windows, and treats equal hours as always open.

title: Moving Average Crossover EA Gold
summary: Closed-bar 20/50 MA cross, optional close on opposite cross, fixed-point SL/TP, fixed lot or percent-risk lot from tick value, optional breakeven with offset, hour window, margin pre-check.
red_flags: Stop loss can be switched off (on by default)
Fixed-point SL/TP (300/600 points) not scaled to volatility
Risk sizing relies on SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE, which can be wrong for metals on some brokers
Lot raised to broker minimum when risk lot is smaller, exceeding the risk percent
No spread filter and no stops-level check on entry SL/TP
No filling mode set on CTrade
Plain MA cross with no trend or range filter; header experience claims are marketing

ideas.name: Breakeven with offset and stops-level guard
ideas.detail: When profit reaches N points, SL moves to entry plus an offset; skipped if SL is already at or beyond the target or if the new SL would be inside the broker stops level.

ideas.name: Init-time rejection of risk sizing without a stop
ideas.detail: OnInit returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT if percent-risk lot mode is selected while the stop loss is disabled, preventing an undefined-risk configuration.

ideas.name: Close opposite positions before reversing
ideas.detail: On a new cross, positions of the EA's magic in the opposite direction are closed first, then the new entry is attempted under the max-positions cap.

ideas.name: Volume floor with epsilon
ideas.detail: Lot floored to volume step using MathFloor(lot/step+1e-7)*step to avoid floating-point under-rounding, then clamped to min/max.

title: Hon APS Advanced Pattern Scanner with DOM and  News Integration
summary: Chart-pattern breakout EA (cup/handle, H&S, double bottom, triangles, flags) scored by volume/indicator/DOM consensus; enters via expiring stop orders with ATR/SR stops, R-based partials and ATR trail; plus a calendar-driven news blackout and S/R straddle module.
red_flags: Magic number is regenerated from TimeCurrent()+MathRand() on every OnInit (GenerateUniqueMagicNumber) - after a restart the EA no longer owns its open positions/pending orders and daily P/L history is orphaned
All logic incl. ManageOpenPositions, trailing, emergency shutdown and news OCO runs only once per new bar (OnTick returns early) - slow trade management on higher timeframes
Daily/weekly loss baselines and partial-close flags are in-memory statics only: reset on restart; loss limits use Balance not Equity (floating loss ignored)
News module uses WebRequest to third-party hosts (ec.forexprostools.com over plain http, Forex Factory, faireconomy) with fragile HTML scraping; fallback IsNewsTime is hard-coded clock times
Hard-coded per-pattern 'success rates' (e.g. 'Rounding Bottom 97%') feed scoring and Kelly - unverified marketing numbers as priors
Kelly/adaptive risk can raise risk to 1.5x base; NewsRiskPercent default 2% with 6% daily news risk; lot forced up to MinLotSize even if that exceeds risk budget
Pip conversion hard-coded as Point*10 and 50-point minimum floors; spread class by symbol-name string length - wrong for XAUUSD/XAGUSD
Margin check uses symbol MarginInitial (often 0) instead of OrderCalcMargin; no explicit retcode handling beyond bool result; ExpertRemove on emergency
Very large monolith (8.4k lines) with duplicated functions (two pending-order placers, two ValidateStopLoss), DOM dependence that most CFD metal brokers do not supply
GetAverageSpread actually averages M1 high-low range, not spread

ideas.name: Performance-throttled risk multiplier with hard clamp
ideas.detail: Base risk% scaled down by consecutive losses (x0.75 at 2, x0.5 at 3+), recent win-rate <35%, drawdown >5%/10%, volatile regime and poor per-hour P/L; result clamped to [0.25%, 1.5x base]. Keep only the reduction side (anti-martingale).

ideas.name: Layered lot sizing: risk-by-stop, dollar cap, confidence scaling, margin cap
ideas.detail: lots = risk$*tickSize/(stopDist*tickValue); risk$ capped by absolute MaxRiskPerTrade and fractional Kelly (min of both), multiplied by signal score/100, then lot reduced so required margin stays under MaxMarginPercent of balance, then volume-step normalised.

ideas.name: R-multiple staged exit: partials, two-speed ATR trail, time stop
ideas.detail: Profit measured in R from entry-to-SL distance: close 30% at 1R, 40% at 2R; trail at 1.0xATR after 1.5R, tightening to 0.5xATR beyond 3R; close stagnant trades after 48h if under 0.5R.
ideas.evidence: Hon_APS.mq5 ManageOpenPositions() L6591, ApplyPartialProfits() L6639, ApplyTrailingStop() L6686

ideas.name: Stop-modify safety distance = max(stops level, freeze level, 2x spread)
ideas.detail: Before trailing: RefreshRates, compute safe distance as max of SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, FREEZE_LEVEL and 2x current spread, widen trail distance to it, only move SL in favourable direction and only if still that far from Bid/Ask.

ideas.name: Breakout via expiring stop orders with entry push-out and TP shift
ideas.detail: Enter with BuyStop/SellStop at pattern level + buffer, ORDER_TIME_SPECIFIED expiry (24h), cap on pending count, duplicate-per-pattern check; if entry is inside the broker minimum distance, push entry out and shift TP to keep target distance; expired orders cleaned up.

ideas.name: Native MT5 calendar news blackout plus OCO straddle
ideas.detail: Loads events via CalendarValueHistory filtered by currency and importance; halts new entries N min before / M min after while still managing positions; optional BuyStop/SellStop straddle beyond nearest S/R with expiry, cancel opposite leg on fill, breakeven at 1R, 0.5xATR trail, separate daily news-risk budget.
ideas.evidence: Hon_NewsTrader.mqh LoadFromInternalCalendar() L414, IsTradingAllowed() L1822, PlaceNewsTradeSetup() L1224, ManageNewsTradeSetup() L1406; Hon_APS.mq5 OnTick() L1565

title: Straddle&Trail
summary: MT4 news straddle: places buy-stop/sell-stop at fixed distance before a manually entered event time, re-pegs them every minute, removes the opposite leg on fill, then breakeven + fixed-pip trail. Also manages manual (magic 0) trades.
red_flags: Fixed lot default 1.0, no risk-based sizing
Unchecked OrderSelect/OrderModify/OrderClose return values; error detection via stale GetLastError
Global Retry counter not reset before most retry loops
IsTimeToPlaceEntries fails when the pre-event window crosses an hour boundary, and event minute 0 disables the feature
CalcMagic returns no value for symbols outside a hard-coded list (broker suffixes other than 'm' break it)
Fixed pip distances, no spread/volatility adaptation: straddle is exposed to news spread widening and slippage
Sleep() calls of 2-3 s inside tick handler
Modifies externs at runtime; no stop-level/freeze-level check on pending re-peg
ShutDown with Current.Pair.Only=false closes trades of all symbols and all magics

ideas.name: Pre-event straddle with re-pegging and freeze window
ideas.detail: Place buy-stop/sell-stop N minutes before a scheduled event at a distance from Bid/Ask, re-peg entry/SL/TP once per minute to follow price, then stop adjusting X minutes before the release so orders sit still.

ideas.name: OCO cancel of opposite pending on fill
ideas.detail: After each tick's position recount, if one straddle leg is a triggered market position while the opposite pending still exists, delete the pending (optional flag).

ideas.name: Breakeven-plus-lock gate before trailing
ideas.detail: Move SL to entry + lock pips once profit reaches a trigger; the trailing stop is only allowed to start after that breakeven trigger has been reached (Trail.Starts.After.BreakEven).

ideas.name: Auto-attach SL/TP to naked positions
ideas.detail: Every tick, any tracked position (EA or manual magic 0) with SL==0 or TP==0 gets the default SL/TP applied relative to its open price, so no position stays without a broker-side stop.

ideas.name: Selective panic shutdown switch
ideas.detail: First input is a ShutDown.NOW flag with a selector code (everything / triggered longs / triggered shorts / pendings only / per side) and a current-symbol-only scope option.

ideas.name: Clamp distances to broker stop level
ideas.detail: Each tick reads MODE_STOPLEVEL and raises SL, TP and trail distances to at least that minimum before using them.

title: Proper Bot
summary: MT4 averaging grid. First order follows the previous candle's direction (or an EMA stack) with a tick-volume filter; then adds same-direction orders against the move at configured distances with growing lots; closes the basket by a summed-points profit trail.
red_flags: Averaging grid against the move with increasing lot map (0.08 -> 0.19), up to unlimited steps (last map level reused)
Default SL 30000 points / TP 10000 points: effectively no protective stop
Under Market_Execution the SL/TP is added by a second OrderModify whose result is ignored, so positions can stay without SL
Hard-coded price band High_Level 1.50001 / Low_Level 1.40001 (pair-specific magic numbers); outside the band it forces a direction
Volume filter reads the still-forming bar 0
No new-bar discipline: entry evaluated every tick
Grid level stored in order comment (brokers may alter comments); phase/trail state in static variables lost on restart
Get_Lot raises a too-small lot to broker minimum and ignores free margin
No spread filter, no equity/drawdown stop

ideas.name: Error-class dispatcher for retries
ideas.detail: Maps each trade error code into retryable (busy, requote, off quotes: sleep, RefreshRates, retry), non-retryable (invalid stops, no money, market closed: give up) and fatal (account disabled, FIFO/hedge prohibited) classes, driving a bounded retry loop.

ideas.name: Basket profit trail in points
ideas.detail: Sums floating points of all the EA's positions; once above a start threshold it tracks the maximum and closes the whole basket when the sum retraces by a step. A 'phase 3' flag keeps retrying the close on later ticks until flat.

ideas.name: Session window with midnight wrap
ideas.detail: Converts current time to seconds since the D1 bar open and tests it against start/finish seconds, handling both normal and overnight (start > finish) windows; only gates opening a new cycle.

ideas.name: Two-step ECN order placement
ideas.detail: When the broker uses market execution, send the order with no stops and then attach SL/TP via modify. Reusable only with a checked modify result and an emergency close if attaching the stop fails.

title: ASQ RiskGuard Professional Risk Management EA
summary: Standalone account guard: equity drawdown stop (from balance or peak equity) and daily loss limit that close positions and delete pendings, with warnings, CSV log, composite risk score and dashboard. Never opens trades.
red_flags: All state (day-start equity, peak equity, halt flags, order count) is in memory only: restarting the EA resets the daily limit and equity stop
After a limit triggers the close routine runs once; the check is skipped afterwards, so failed closes are never retried and new positions are not closed
IsTradeAllowed() gate and CalculateLotSize() are never called by anything that trades: session filter, spread guard, position/lot/order-per-day limits are display-only
CLOSE_LARGEST_LOSS closes a single position and then stops acting
Day boundary is server midnight only, no configurable reset time
Log file opened with FILE_WRITE truncates previous log on each start
Close results checked only by bool, no retcode handling; filling mode detected for chart symbol only
Peak equity reset daily in balance mode; g_equityStopHit never clears without restart

ideas.name: Dual drawdown base: balance or trailing peak equity
ideas.detail: Equity stop computes drawdown either from current balance or from a high-water mark of equity (trailing max drawdown), in percent or money, selected by enum.

ideas.name: Early-warning threshold before the limit
ideas.detail: Fires an alert (popup/sound/push/email) when drawdown or daily loss reaches a configurable percentage (default 80%) of its limit, throttled to once per 60 seconds.
ideas.evidence: ASQ_RiskGuard.mq5 CheckEquityStop() and CheckDailyLimit() warning blocks

ideas.name: Composite 0-100 risk score
ideas.detail: Weighted score: 40% drawdown-vs-limit, 30% daily-loss-vs-limit, 20% exposure (positions or lots vs caps), 10% spread-vs-max, renormalised over enabled components. Could drive lot scaling or entry throttling.

ideas.name: Pre-trade gate checklist
ideas.detail: Single function returning false with a logged reason if: equity stop active, daily limit active, outside session, spread above max, open positions at cap, total lots at cap, or entries-per-day at cap (counted from DEAL_ENTRY_IN in OnTradeTransaction).

ideas.name: Tick-value based risk lot sizing
ideas.detail: Lot = risk money / (SL points x tickValue x point/tickSize), floored to volume step and clamped to min/max; falls back to fixed lot when symbol data is invalid. Correct for metals where tick size differs from point.

ideas.name: Structured CSV event log with account snapshot
