ideas.detail: Every event row carries timestamp, event type, equity, balance, drawdown %, daily P/L, risk score, open positions and details, flushed immediately.

title: Trading Performance journal
summary: Canvas-based trade journal dashboard: reads deal history incrementally, computes performance statistics, bootstrap Monte Carlo, calendar P/L and heuristic behaviour tags. Sends no trade requests and no network calls.
red_flags: Placeholder journal fields are hard-coded for every trade (setup 'Breakout', emotion 'Calm', note 'VWAP retest...') - presented as data but fabricated
Sharpe/Sortino are per-trade money ratios, not annualised; 'institutional' labels overstate rigor
Partial closes produce one record per exit deal; DEAL_ENTRY_INOUT and OUT_BY are ignored
Monte Carlo uses a fixed 10000 starting balance and absolute money P/L, seed from GetTickCount (not reproducible)
Behaviour tags (FOMO, panic exit) are crude heuristics with magic thresholds

ideas.name: Bootstrap Monte Carlo of trade outcomes
ideas.detail: 1000 runs resampling net trade P/L with replacement; reports median ending equity, median max drawdown % and risk of ruin (share of runs touching 50% of start). Usable in OnTester as a robustness criterion.

ideas.name: Extended trade-distribution metrics
ideas.detail: Computes SQN, Ulcer index, Calmar, Sortino, skewness, excess kurtosis, Kelly fraction, max consecutive losses and peak losing-run value, plus separate long/short win rate, P/L and duration.

ideas.name: SL-widening audit from order history
ideas.detail: For a closed position, selects its order history and flags it if any later order's SL is further from price than the first recorded SL (lower for buys, higher for sells). Useful as an invariant test that the bot never loosens stops.

ideas.name: Revenge-trade pattern detector
ideas.detail: Flags a trade opened within 30 minutes after a losing trade with volume at least 1.5x the previous one. Can be inverted into a rule: block or cap size on re-entries soon after a loss.

ideas.name: Chunked incremental history scan
ideas.detail: Processes deal history in 500-deal chunks per timer call with a persistent scan index and dirty-flag task scheduler, so a long history never blocks the terminal thread.

title: Order Watchdog - alerts on unknown magic, duplicates, no SL, stop outs (read-only)
summary: Read-only account monitor: alerts on positions/orders with unknown magic, more than N positions per magic/symbol/direction, positions without SL, broker stop-outs, SL slippage, and events that happened while offline. Trades only inside the Strategy Tester demo.
red_flags: Optional WebRequest to api.telegram.org with the user's own bot token (off by default, no other endpoints)
Tester-only demo routine opens example trades without SL (hard-guarded by MQL_TESTER)

ideas.name: SL slippage measurement from exit deals
ideas.detail: On DEAL_ADD with DEAL_REASON_SL, compares the deal price against DEAL_SL carried on the exit deal and reports points filled worse than the stop. Feeding this back gives realised gap/slippage statistics for sizing.

ideas.name: Duplicate-position detector per magic/symbol/direction
ideas.detail: Counts open positions keyed by symbol|magic|direction and alerts when the count exceeds a maximum, re-alerting only if it grows; catches duplicate orders sent after a reconnect or timeout.

ideas.name: Offline gap reconciliation on start
ideas.detail: Stores a 'last seen' server time in a terminal global variable (flushed every 5 minutes); on start, after the connection has been up 15 s, scans deal history since that time for unknown opens and stop-outs that happened while the EA was off.

ideas.name: Deduplicated, restart-persistent alert keys
ideas.detail: Each issue has a key; alert once, mark seen per scan, forget when the issue disappears. Keys saved to a per-login+server state file via temp-file-then-FileMove (atomic) so restarts do not re-alert.

ideas.name: Batched notifications sent only from OnTimer
ideas.detail: Alerts go into a bounded queue; the timer sends at most one merged push (255 chars, 'first + N more') and one Telegram message per 10 s, never from OnTick/OnTradeTransaction, avoiding push rate limits and blocking network calls in trade paths.

ideas.name: Startup self-test of pure helpers plus strict input validation
ideas.detail: Pure functions (parsers, slippage math, key logic) are exercised with known-answer tests, including must-not-match cases, written to a file; invalid inputs or a missing symbol name (suffix check via SymbolExist) return INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT instead of silently defaulting.

title: PropGuard Lite - daily and max loss guard for prop firm accounts
summary: Account guard for prop rules: daily loss and overall max loss floors on equity (minus credit) with a safety buffer; when breached it closes positions FIFO, deletes pendings and keeps enforcing until next day or manual reset. Trades only in tester demo.
red_flags: Cannot block other EAs from opening; it only closes what they open while halted
Day-reset time zone is a fixed hour offset with no DST handling (documented by the author)
Auto capital = first deposit heuristic can be wrong; guard disables limits (with alert) when it looks implausible
Tester-only demo routine opens trades without SL (hard-guarded by MQL_TESTER)

ideas.name: Day reference rebuilt from deal history
ideas.detail: Day-start balance is recomputed on every check as current balance minus today's trading P/L from deal history (deposits/withdrawals separated), so restart, recompile or VPS migration cannot reset the daily loss baseline. If history is unreadable the check is skipped and counted, never guessed.

ideas.name: Crash-proof halt flags with stored expiry
ideas.detail: Daily halt is stored as an 'until' timestamp and max-loss halt as a flag in terminal global variables keyed by login + server hash, flushed to disk immediately; max-loss halt can only be cleared by an explicit input that then refuses to start.
ideas.evidence: PropGuard_Lite.mq5 GvSetFlush(), UpdateDay() lines 359-362, Check(), OnInit() lines 990-1006

ideas.name: Act-before-limit buffer on equity excluding credit
ideas.detail: Breach test is equity <= floor + buffer, where buffer is a % of initial capital and equity is ACCOUNT_EQUITY minus ACCOUNT_CREDIT; daily floor can be % of initial capital or % of day reference, with the higher of balance/equity snapshot at reset chosen when unsure.

ideas.name: Persistent FIFO flatten loop with retcode-aware backoff
ideas.detail: While halted, every check closes all in-scope positions oldest-first, sets filling mode per symbol, retries once on requote/price-changed, backs off 60 s on market-closed/trade-disabled retcodes, rate-limits to about one round per second and alerts if closing fails for 30+ s.

ideas.name: Single-instance heartbeat lock
ideas.detail: Writes chart ID and a TimeLocal heartbeat to global variables on each check; a second copy refuses to start if another chart's heartbeat is younger than 10 s, and the owner releases the lock on deinit.
ideas.evidence: PropGuard_Lite.mq5 OnInit() lines 974-988, Check() lines 707-711, OnDeinit()

ideas.name: Configurable trading-day boundary
ideas.detail: Day start computed from server time with a server-minus-firm-timezone offset and reset hour (e.g. 17:00 New York), unit-tested for boundary seconds; timer plus tick both drive the check so limits are enforced without ticks.

title: eaTemplate
summary: MT4 skeleton: placeholder signal (last closed candle colour) opens one market order with fixed-point SL/TP, closes on opposite candle. Bulk of the code is reliable-order wrappers (retry loops, stop-level fixes, ECN two-step).
red_flags: Lot sizing is leverage*balance*Risk% (default 30%), not tied to stop distance
XGetPoint multiplies point x10 for 3/5-digit symbols - wrong pip assumption for gold/silver
No new-bar gate: can re-enter on every tick of the same bar after an exit
MT4-only API; empty OnInit, no input validation
In ECN mode a failed SL modify leaves the position without a stop (no fallback close)

ideas.name: Error-classified retry loop for order send
ideas.detail: Wrapper separates retryable errors (server busy, off quotes, context busy, no connection) with capped attempts and randomized sleep from requote/price-changed (refresh and retry immediately) and fatal errors (exit). Port to MT5 retcodes.

ideas.name: Pre-send stop-level clamp
ideas.detail: Before sending, SL/TP distance is compared with broker STOPLEVEL and pushed out to stop level (+ spread for SL) rather than letting the order be rejected with invalid stops.

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin and order-count checks
ideas.detail: Free-margin check for the exact lot/type and ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS check executed before every order, logging a reason instead of producing a rejected request.

ideas.name: Pending-to-market fallback
ideas.detail: If a stop order is rejected for invalid stops because price is already within the minimum distance of the entry level, the wrapper converts it to a market order instead of losing the breakout.

ideas.name: Levelled logging wrapper
ideas.detail: Single XPrint(level, text) with ERR/WARN/INFO/DBG threshold so verbosity is switchable without editing call sites; sleeps are skipped in tester.

title: Professional Close All Positions Panel
summary: Manual button panel that closes positions account-wide by filter: all, buys, sells, chart symbol, profitable only, losing only. Raw OrderSend close with filling-mode cascade. Never opens trades.
red_flags: Filling check uses logical && instead of bitwise & (filling && SYMBOL_FILLING_FOK) - works only because it brute-forces all three modes
No magic filter: closes every position on the account including other EAs
Hard-coded 50-point deviation; Sleep(100) between closes inside chart event handler
No confirmation step before close-all; pending orders not removed

ideas.name: Filling-mode cascade on close
ideas.detail: Close request is retried with FOK, then IOC, then RETURN until retcode DONE, so the emergency close still works on brokers whose metal symbols accept only one filling type.

ideas.name: Selective bulk close (profit-only / loss-only / side)
ideas.detail: Separate close routines filtered by position type, symbol, or sign of floating profit, each reporting closed/failed counts in an alert.

title: RiskSizer Panel Lite MT5 - Risk Percent Lot Calculator With One Click Buy Sell
summary: Manual trading panel: two draggable horizontal lines define SL/TP; lot is computed from risk % of balance and stop distance; one-click Buy/Sell with SL attached and optional max-spread check.
red_flags: Loss per lot = points * TICK_VALUE assumes tick size equals point - mis-sizes symbols where they differ (some gold/silver/CFD feeds)
Uses TICK_VALUE not TICK_VALUE_LOSS; ignores commission and spread in risk
No stops-level or free-margin check before sending
Spread filter defaults to off (0)
Risk can be set up to 50% from the panel

ideas.name: Floor-rounded risk lot with zero-on-undersize
ideas.detail: Lot = riskMoney / lossPerLot, floored to volume step and clamped to max; if the result is below min volume it returns 0 and the trade is refused instead of silently rounding up and exceeding the risk.

ideas.name: Draggable SL/TP lines drive live lot preview
ideas.detail: Two chart lines (low/high) are interpreted as SL/TP for either side; the panel recomputes buy lot, sell lot and money at risk on every drag and timer tick before the order is sent.

ideas.name: Half-close with volume-step normalisation
ideas.detail: Partial close of 50% per position filtered by symbol+magic, volume floored to lot step and skipped when the half is below minimum volume.

ideas.name: Chart-ID-scoped object prefix
ideas.detail: All object names are prefixed with a base tag plus ChartID so several instances on different charts never collide, and cleanup deletes by prefix only.

title: Equity Guard — Daily Loss Limit Guardian with Panic Panel
summary: Account-level daily loss guard: snapshots balance/equity at a configurable server reset time, flattens all positions and pending orders when equity loss hits a trigger fraction of the limit, then keeps the account flat until next reset. Canvas panel.
red_flags: Acts on the whole account with no magic/symbol filter
CloseAll does not check result retcode for partial success beyond OrderSend boolean, no retry within a pass (relies on next timer)
If attached mid-day with no saved state, base is taken from current balance, not rebuilt from history
GlobalVariables not flushed explicitly (could be lost on terminal crash)

ideas.name: Pre-emptive trigger below the hard limit
ideas.detail: Lock fires at a configurable percentage (default 80%) of the daily loss limit, leaving a buffer for slippage and gaps before the real prop-firm limit is breached.

ideas.name: Persisted daily lock with stale-lock release
ideas.detail: Day-start base, reset timestamp and lock flag are stored in GlobalVariables keyed by account login; on restart the lock is restored if the reset period matches and dropped if it belongs to a previous day.

ideas.name: Flat enforcement while locked
ideas.detail: While locked, any new position or pending order (from any EA or manual) is closed again on timer/OnTrade, with log output throttled to once per 30 s.

ideas.name: Manual-unlock re-arm hysteresis
ideas.detail: After a manual unlock the auto-trigger stays disarmed until the daily loss recovers below 90% of the trigger, preventing an instant re-lock loop.

ideas.name: Two-click arm/confirm for destructive buttons
ideas.detail: Close-All and Lock/Unlock require a second click within a 5-second arm window; the button text changes to CONFIRM and the arm expires automatically.

ideas.name: Server-time sanity gate before capturing the day base
ideas.detail: The daily reference is not captured until server time is valid (after 2020) and balance/equity are positive, avoiding a zero/garbage baseline when the terminal starts disconnected.

title: BEC Trade Breakeven Trail Manager
summary: Chart-symbol trade manager: basket breakeven (sets all SLs to one net breakeven price once total profit in currency exceeds a threshold), fixed-point trailing, manual buttons (close smallest winner, half-close + BE, close all) and one-click scalp orders.
red_flags: One-click scalp orders are opened with no SL and no TP; SL only appears after the trail activates
Scalp positions identified by comment string 'SCALP' (brokers can alter comments)
Scalp trailing has no stops-level check and uses a 10x pip assumption for 3/5-digit symbols
Half-volume normalised to 2 decimals regardless of lot step
Most PositionModify results not checked; trailing runs on every tick with no step threshold (modify spam)
Close-all button ignores the magic/comment filters

ideas.name: Net-basket breakeven price
ideas.detail: For all filtered positions on the symbol, computes the single price at which net P/L equals a chosen locked profit: (totalProfit - lockMoney) / (|netVolume| * pointValue) from current bid/ask, then moves every SL (or TP for the opposite side) there.

ideas.name: Calc-mode-aware point value with currency conversion
ideas.detail: Point value uses TICK_VALUE_LOSS/PROFIT for forex/futures calc modes, else tickSize*contractSize converted through an automatically located FX pair between profit and account currency (ask for risk, bid for reward).

ideas.name: Breakeven including swap and entry commission
ideas.detail: Optional adjustment adds POSITION_SWAP and the entry-deal commission (read from history by position identifier) to profit so the breakeven level is true net-of-costs.

ideas.name: Tick-size rounding of stop prices
ideas.detail: New SL/BE prices are rounded to a multiple of SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE before normalising to digits, and skipped when the change is below half a point.

ideas.name: Modification rate limiter
ideas.detail: Breakeven adjustments are throttled by a minimum number of seconds since the last adjustment to avoid flooding the trade server.

title: Trade Manager Panel Simple Interactive Chart Trading Tool with Risk Management for MT5
summary: Manual order panel: risk-% lot sizing from a points or ATR(14)-multiple stop, TP as an R-multiple, market or auto-typed pending orders, draggable entry/SL/TP preview lines, settings persisted in GlobalVariables.
red_flags: ATR read from the still-forming bar 0
Lot rounds UP to minimum volume when computed lot is smaller - silently exceeds chosen risk
No magic number set; Close All / Del Pend hit every position/order on the symbol
No retcode checks, no stops-level/freeze-level validation, prices not normalised
No spread filter

ideas.name: Tick-size-correct risk lot
ideas.detail: Loss per lot = (stopDistance / TICK_SIZE) * TICK_VALUE, then lot = floor(risk / loss / step) * step. Correct for metals where tick size differs from point.

ideas.name: ATR-multiple stop with R-multiple target
ideas.detail: Stop distance selectable as fixed points or k*ATR(14); TP is always stopDistance * ratio, so risk:reward stays constant as volatility changes.

ideas.name: Automatic pending-order type selection
ideas.detail: Given an entry price and a side, chooses limit vs stop by comparing the entry with current ask/bid (buy below ask = BuyLimit, above = BuyStop; mirror for sells).

ideas.name: Per-symbol panel settings persisted in GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: Risk %, order mode, SL mode/values, TP ratio and panel state saved under a prefix+symbol key on deinit and reloaded on init, so timeframe changes and restarts keep the configuration.

title: Trailing Stop Breakeven Manager
summary: Position manager for existing trades: optional auto-SL for naked positions, breakeven with offset after N points profit, then points- or ATR-multiple trailing with a minimum step. Works across all symbols with per-symbol ATR handles. Never opens trades.
red_flags: Auto stop loss defaults to 0 (off)
Trigger thresholds are fixed points even in ATR mode (not volatility-scaled for gold vs silver)
No freeze-level check; SL not rounded to tick size
ATR timeframe is the chart period for every symbol

ideas.name: Staged exit: breakeven first, trail only after BE is done
ideas.detail: Breakeven function returns true once SL is at/above entry+offset; trailing is gated on that flag, so the trail never loosens or precedes the breakeven lock.

ideas.name: Closed-bar ATR trail with minimum improvement step
ideas.detail: Trail distance = ATR(shift 1) * multiplier; SL is modified only if it improves by at least a step threshold, cutting modify spam on fast metals ticks.

ideas.name: Auto-attach protective SL to naked positions
ideas.detail: Any managed position found with SL=0 gets a stop at a configured distance from open, provided it satisfies the broker stops level - a safety net after a failed SL placement or manual trade.

ideas.name: Stops-level gate before every modify
ideas.detail: Each candidate SL is checked against SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL relative to current bid/ask and silently skipped if too close; failures log retcode and description.

ideas.name: Lazy per-symbol indicator handle cache
ideas.detail: ATR handles are created on first use per symbol and cached in parallel arrays, released in OnDeinit; lets one instance manage XAUUSD and XAGUSD together.

ideas.name: Tick plus 1-second timer management
ideas.detail: Management runs from both OnTick and OnTimer so stops keep being maintained when the chart symbol is quiet but other managed symbols move.

title: Live Test Bench: automated checks of an EA on a demo account
summary: Article example: a daily-loss-lock EA (GlobalVariable state, single-instance ownership, history rebuild) plus a demo-only driver EA that attaches it via generated template, forces losses, restarts the terminal and writes PASS/FAIL results per phase.
red_flags: Driver deliberately opens market trades without SL to force losses (guarded by demo-account check)
Driver calls TerminalClose and opens/closes charts - must never be run on a live terminal
Example lock closes positions but does not delete pending orders
Manual unlock resets the daily base to current equity, effectively granting a fresh loss budget

ideas.name: Single-instance ownership with heartbeat
ideas.detail: Instance claims an 'owner' GlobalVariable via atomic GlobalVariableSetOnCondition, writes a heartbeat each second; a second copy is refused unless the heartbeat is older than 10 s, and a copy that loses ownership removes itself.

ideas.name: Day-start balance rebuilt from deal history
ideas.detail: When no saved state exists for today, day-start balance = current balance minus sum of profit+swap+commission+fee of today's buy/sell deals (deposits/withdrawals excluded), so the lock is re-derived after state loss.

ideas.name: Connection-ready gate before loading state
ideas.detail: State is not loaded or saved until terminal is connected, login and balance are valid and 3 seconds have passed for history sync; nothing is persisted before the ready flag is set.

ideas.name: Explicit GlobalVariablesFlush on state change
ideas.detail: Every state save is followed by GlobalVariablesFlush (outside tester) so lock state survives a terminal crash rather than only a clean shutdown.

ideas.name: Phased live acceptance test with restart
ideas.detail: Driver EA reads a phase file, attaches the EA under test through a generated .tpl with inputs, checks GlobalVariable state, forces a lock, snapshots state, closes the terminal, then verifies identical state and lock enforcement after restart; writes PASS/FAIL file.
ideas.evidence: LiveTestDriver.mq5 PhaseA(), PhaseB(), Attach(), SaveSnapshot(), SnapshotMatches()

ideas.name: Compile-time demo-only build
ideas.detail: A wrapper file defines DEMO_ONLY and includes the production source, yielding a test binary that refuses to start on non-demo accounts without forking the code.

title: Daily Loss Guard - daily loss and total drawdown limits for funded / prop-firm accounts
summary: Account guard: monitors equity against a daily loss limit and a static or trailing total drawdown limit; on breach deletes pending orders, closes positions with retries, and stays locked until next server day. State persisted; magic/symbol filters; tester demo mode.
red_flags: Tester demo mode opens random trades (and a pending order without SL) - only active in Strategy Tester when enabled
Sleep-based retry inside event handlers blocks the EA briefly
No explicit GlobalVariablesFlush

ideas.name: Dual limit: daily loss plus static/trailing total drawdown
ideas.detail: Daily loss measured from day-start balance or equity; total drawdown measured either from a fixed reference balance or from the persisted equity high-water mark; each limit in % or money, each with its own trigger reason.

ideas.name: Lock-until timestamp with re-close enforcement
ideas.detail: On breach stores blocked flag, reason and blockUntil = next day start; while blocked, matching positions/orders are re-closed at most once per second; lock released automatically at day rollover.

ideas.name: Snapshot-then-close pass with retries and leftover count
ideas.detail: Tickets are collected into arrays first, pending orders deleted before positions closed (prevents fills mid-flatten), filling set per symbol, then repeated up to N attempts with pause until CountMatching()==0; leftovers reported.

ideas.name: Early-warning threshold with hysteresis
ideas.detail: One-shot alert/push when loss reaches a % of a limit; daily flag resets at day change, total-DD flag re-arms only after falling below 90% of the warning level; flags persisted across restarts.

ideas.name: Mid-day start: base estimated from history and flagged
ideas.detail: On first run the day base is rebuilt from today's deals (trading results only) and marked as estimated in the panel; state saved when dirty or every 30 s; AutoTrading-off condition detected and alerted once.

ideas.name: Built-in state round-trip self-test
ideas.detail: In tester, saves state with non-default values, wipes variables, reloads and compares every field, printing OK/FAILED - a cheap regression test for persistence code.

title: Spread Session Recorder
summary: Non-trading recorder: reads tick history via CopyTicksRange for one or many symbols, writes per-interval CSV rows of min / time-weighted average / max spread labelled by session, keeps per-hour and per-session monthly tables, backfills gaps after restart, includes self-tests.
red_flags: Only records; produces no live filter by itself
Session hours are fixed GMT inputs without DST handling
Auto GMT offset relies on TimeGMT from the local PC clock

ideas.name: Time-weighted spread statistics per interval
ideas.detail: Each spread value is weighted by how long it stood (ms) until the next tick, giving true average spread per row plus min/max; zero-duration spikes still count in the max. Basis for a data-driven spread filter.

ideas.name: Per-hour and per-session spread baseline tables
ideas.detail: Rows are aggregated into 24 server-hour buckets and session buckets (Asia, London, NY, overlap, off) with avg, average-of-row-max and max; lets an EA set its max-spread threshold relative to the normal spread for that hour/session.

ideas.name: Dedicated rollover window label
ideas.detail: A configurable window (default 10 min before to 60 min after server midnight) is classified as ROLLOVER ahead of any session, isolating the period when metal spreads blow out so it can be excluded from trading.

ideas.name: Auto-detected server GMT offset
ideas.detail: Server-minus-GMT offset computed from TimeTradeServer() - TimeGMT(), rounded to 15 minutes, with manual override; converts GMT session hours to broker time without hard-coding.

ideas.name: Stale-quote cutoff
ideas.detail: A quote older than N seconds stops being counted (market closed/feed dead); the same test can gate trading so the bot does not act on a frozen price.

ideas.name: Idempotent restart-safe CSV logging with self-test
ideas.detail: On start finds the last written row and resumes after it (backfilling from tick history), buffers rows in memory when the file is locked, never duplicates rows; a built-in self-test replays synthetic ticks and asserts results.

title: News EA Template Without DLL From 2 Sources
summary: MT4 skeleton that downloads the weekly economic calendar via WebRequest (Investing widget or DailyFX CSV), blocks trading inside per-impact time windows around events, draws news lines. Its demo trade logic is a throwaway H1 candle rule with 0.01 lot.
red_flags: WebRequest to third-party servers (ec.forexprostools.com, dailyfx.com) over plain HTTP; both endpoints are scraped HTML/CSV and likely dead or changed
Fragile HTML string-offset parsing with no validation; parse failure silently means 'no news' so trading continues (fail-open)
Currency filter takes chars 0-3 and 3-6 of symbol: XAUUSD yields 'XAU','USD' (works for USD by accident), breaks with broker prefixes/suffixes
Manual GMTplus offset input, no DST handling
Demo entry uses forming bar 0 close, OrderSend result unchecked, OrdersTotal() without magic/symbol filter, fixed 100-point SL/TP
MessageBox call inside the trading thread on WebRequest failure
News not available in the Strategy Tester (WebRequest disabled), so the filter cannot be backtested

ideas.name: Tiered news blackout windows by impact
ideas.detail: Separate minutes-before/minutes-after pause windows per impact level (low 15/15, medium 30/30, high 60/60) plus a dedicated wider window for NFP (180/180) matched by event title; strongest active event wins.

ideas.name: Currency-scoped event filter
ideas.detail: Only events whose currency appears in the traded symbol block trading (OnlySymbolNews). For metals this should be mapped explicitly to USD (plus optionally CNY/EUR) instead of substring slicing.
ideas.evidence: Trade_EA_Template_for_News.mq4 OnInit() ValStr, UpdateNews() OnlySymbolNews check

ideas.name: Single gate in front of all trade logic
ideas.detail: OnTick computes one boolean 'trade' from the news check and calls ManageTrade() only when it is true and IsTradeAllowed(); strategy code stays unaware of the filter. Note it also stops management, which a real bot should not do.

ideas.name: Calendar cached to a dated local file, refreshed once a day
ideas.detail: DailyFX weekly CSV is saved under a week-stamped filename and re-read from disk if it already exists; refresh interval is 86400 s, so the EA does not hit the network on every tick or restart.

ideas.name: On-chart news lines and blackout status label
ideas.detail: Vertical lines coloured by impact at each event time, plus a large label showing which impact class is pausing trading and the event time.

title: Universal trailing stop
summary: MT5 trailing-stop utility for existing positions on the chart symbol with seven methods: candle extremes, fractals, ATR, Parabolic SAR, MA, percent of profit, fixed points. Optional virtual (hidden) trailing from the volume-weighted breakeven price.
red_flags: Magic filter reads OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) while iterating positions - wrong object, filter effectively broken unless Magic=-1
Virtual trailing stop keeps the stop only in memory (SLB/SLS globals): lost on restart, no broker-side protection
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK for virtual closes; will be rejected on many metals brokers
request struct never ZeroMemory'd, retcode not inspected, only buy side lacks OrderCheck
Stops level checked, freeze level ignored; no tick-size rounding
Runs full loop every tick with chart object recreation

ideas.name: Pluggable trailing-method selector
ideas.detail: One function returns the candidate SL for a position from an enum-selected method (previous candle low/high, last 4-bar fractal, ATR distance, SAR, MA, % of open profit, fixed points) plus a common offset 'delta' and separate timeframe for the trailing indicators.

ideas.name: Structure trail that walks back to the first valid swing
ideas.detail: For candle/fractal modes it scans bars backwards until it finds a low/high that is at least the broker stops-level away from price, so the trail always lands on a real structure level that the broker will accept.
ideas.evidence: cm_universal_trailing_stop_hedge.mq5 SlLastBar() case 1 and case 2 loops

ideas.name: Percent-of-open-profit lock
ideas.detail: SL = open + (price - open) * PercentProfit/100, so a fixed fraction of the unrealised move is always locked in; scales naturally with large gold moves without ATR tuning.

ideas.name: Start and step gates on trailing
ideas.detail: Trailing only begins once SL would be StartTrall points beyond entry, and a modify is sent only if the improvement exceeds StepTrall points; indicator values are read from the closed bar [1].
ideas.evidence: cm_universal_trailing_stop_hedge.mq5 OnTick() non-virtual branch; atrVal[1], sarVal[1], maVal[1]

ideas.name: Basket breakeven price as trailing reference
ideas.detail: Computes volume-weighted average entry for all buys and all sells and trails from that net breakeven level rather than per-ticket open price (used in virtual mode).

title: Expert Advisor Template with Trailing Stop v2
summary: Old-style MT4 tutorial template: ADX +DI/-DI crossover places a buy-stop/sell-stop a few points from price with fixed SL/TP, then fixed-point breakeven, fixed-point trailing and close on opposite DI cross. Author states it is not meant to be profitable.
red_flags: Signals read from forming bar 0 (iADX shift 0) - repaint/intrabar flip-flop
OrderSend/OrderModify/OrderClose return values stored in Ticket and never checked; no error handling
Uses deprecated start(), no #property strict, no stops-level, lot or price normalisation
Default Lot = 1 and AutoLots = balance/10000 with no relation to stop distance
Breakeven only fires inside a 5-point price band (Ba..Ba+5) and can be skipped on a gap, with a hard-coded +10 point lock
Pending orders never expire or get cancelled; LastOrder state is in memory and lost on restart
TP for buy-stop computed as Ask - Pips + TP (sign error relative to entry)

ideas.name: Spread gate before placing entries
ideas.detail: Entry block is wrapped in (Ask-Bid)/Point < MaxSpread. Trivial, but the right place for it: checked at order placement only, never blocking management.

ideas.name: Stop-order confirmation entry
ideas.detail: Instead of a market order on the signal, a buy-stop/sell-stop is placed Pips points beyond current price so the trade only triggers if price continues in the signal direction.

ideas.name: Alternating-direction latch
ideas.detail: LastOrder flag prevents a second consecutive entry in the same direction until the opposite signal fires or all orders are gone, limiting repeat entries on a stale signal.

title: TrailingStopAndTake
summary: MT5 hedging-account utility that adds missing initial SL/TP to positions, then trails SL behind price and optionally trails TP toward price, filtered by symbol/magic/ticket/side. Only opens trades in the Strategy Tester for demonstration.
red_flags: Opens a 0.1 lot buy and sell every bar in tester mode only (demo scaffolding, harmless live)
Refuses netting accounts
Loop starts at index PositionsTotal() (off by one, harmless)
CheckFreezeLevel() is defined but never called
Retcode only printed, no retry/backoff; modifies sent every tick while conditions hold
Fixed point distances, no ATR scaling

ideas.name: Fallback stop level = spread x multiplier
ideas.detail: When the broker reports SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL = 0 (common on ECN gold), the minimum stop distance is taken as current spread times a configurable multiplier instead of zero, avoiding 'invalid stops' rejections near price.

ideas.name: Correct-or-check stop helpers
ideas.detail: Two helper families: CorrectStopLoss/CorrectTakeProfit clamp a desired level to the nearest legal price (used for initial stops), CheckCorrectStopLoss/CheckCorrectTakeProfit only validate (used for trailing, skip if illegal).

ideas.name: Auto-attach missing initial SL/TP
ideas.detail: Any matching position found with SL==0 or TP==0 gets an initial level from entry price, clamped to stops level - a safety net if the entry order went through without stops.

ideas.name: Trailing take-profit
ideas.detail: TP is pulled toward price as price moves against the position (never below breakeven+offset unless loss-zone trailing is enabled), turning a stalled trade into a small-profit or breakeven exit.

ideas.name: Profit-zone-only trailing switch
ideas.detail: InpTrailingLoss=No suppresses SL trailing until the candidate stop is beyond entry + breakeven offset, so the initial stop is not tightened while the trade is still negative.
ideas.evidence: TrailingStopAndTake.mq5 Trailing() breakeven comparison with InpTrailingLoss

ideas.name: Freeze-level check helper
ideas.detail: Function verifies the distance between current price and the level to modify exceeds SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL before attempting modification (present but unused in this file).

title: Random Trader with Customizable Risk/Reward Ratio, Break-Even
summary: Coin-flip entry EA (MathRand) used as a baseline/demo: one position at a time with ATR- or pip-based SL, TP at a fixed R multiple, percent-risk lot sizing, margin check and a one-shot move to breakeven. Includes a reusable CTradeValidation class.
red_flags: Entry is purely random - no edge by design
PositionsTotal() is account-wide with no magic/symbol filter; ticket taken from PositionGetTicket(0)
pip_point left uninitialised for symbols with digits other than 2-5 (e.g. 1-digit indices)
Lot sizing uses tick value per point without dividing by tick size; rounds UP to min lot when risk is too small (silent over-risk)
ATR read from forming bar 0 with unchecked CopyBuffer; hard-coded ATR period 10
CTrade retcodes not checked; breakeven flag and ticket are in memory only (lost on restart)
Opens a new trade on the very next tick after any close, no new-bar discipline

ideas.name: Order-type-aware stop validation class
ideas.detail: ValidateOrderPlacement() checks SL/TP/entry distances against stops level for all six order types (market vs limit vs stop each measured from the correct reference price), after rounding to tick size.

ideas.name: Freeze-then-stops check before SL modify
ideas.detail: ValidateSLModify() first rejects if the existing SL is inside the freeze distance from market (modification would be refused), then checks the new SL against stops level; both levels carry a 10-point safety pad.

ideas.name: Margin pre-check with 10% buffer and optional downsize
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin for the planned lot, inflated by 10%; if free margin is insufficient either skip or recompute the largest affordable lot (rounded down to step) instead of sending a doomed order.

ideas.name: Percent-risk lot from actual SL distance, capped by SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT
ideas.detail: Lot = balance*risk% / (SL points * tick value), floored to volume step, and capped by SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT (aggregate per-symbol limit) falling back to VOLUME_MAX.

ideas.name: Random-entry benchmark
ideas.detail: Keeping a coin-flip entry variant with identical SL/TP/sizing/breakeven lets you measure how much of a strategy's backtest result comes from the exit and risk engine versus the signal - a null hypothesis for the real metals bot.

ideas.name: Fail-fast input validation
ideas.detail: OnInit returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT for non-positive risk, R:R, ATR multiple, pip stop or breakeven distance, so bad optimisation passes are discarded rather than run.

title: SessionReopenEA
summary: Gold time-of-day seasonality EA: buys once per session in the first minutes after the CME daily maintenance break (fixed server hour), fixed lot, server-side SL at a multiple of mean H1 range, time exit after N hours. Long-only, skips the weekly reopen.
red_flags: Statistical claims in the header (t-stats, 11-year results) are author assertions, not verifiable from the code
Entry hour hard-coded to one broker's server clock (01:00); wrong on brokers with a different GMT offset or DST rule
Long-only single-hour anomaly - by the author's own figures a tiny edge highly sensitive to reopen spread
Fixed lot, no risk-based sizing; lot is clamped UP to broker minimum (announced in the log, but still over-size)
No take-profit; time exit is not retried with backoff if PositionClose fails (retries every tick)
Spread cap of 60 points is tuned to the validated run rather than adaptive
Summary bps maths assumes 100 oz contract size

ideas.name: Rebuild 'already traded this session' from deal history on start
ideas.detail: OnInit scans the last 7 days of deals for this symbol+magic DEAL_ENTRY_IN and restores the last entry time, so a restart inside the entry window cannot open a duplicate trade. No files or GlobalVariables needed.

ideas.name: One attempt per session, success or failure
ideas.detail: The last-entry timestamp is set BEFORE sending the order, so a rejection is not retried on every following tick during the entry window; prevents hammering the broker with failing orders.

ideas.name: Announced lot clamp plus margin affordability check
ideas.detail: BrokerLots() clamps to min/max/step and prints a warning with the size multiple when the traded lot differs from the requested one; then OrderCalcMargin vs free margin skips the entry with an explicit message instead of getting 'No money'.

ideas.name: Gap-free volatility unit for stops
ideas.detail: Stop distance = k x mean(high-low) of the last 480 completed H1 bars rather than ATR, deliberately excluding the session-break gap that true range would include; slow, stable unit (~20 sessions) with stops-level floor.

ideas.name: Server-time session anchor with weekly-reopen skip and logged spread veto
ideas.detail: Entry allowed only in the first N minutes of a fixed server hour, skipping the Monday (weekly) reopen; spread above cap skips the trade and LOGS it so filtered trades are visible when comparing live vs backtest. Time-based exit after fixed hold.

ideas.name: Per-magic end-of-run summary in basis points
ideas.detail: OnDeinit walks deal history for this magic and prints trades, win rate, count of SL exits (DEAL_REASON_SL) and average P/L in bps of price using actual traded volume - comparable across years where gold price tripled. Header also warns M1 bar spread understates real reopen spread ~3x; test on real ticks.

title: Partial Close Multi TP Manager
summary: MT5 position manager (never opens trades): up to five partial-close levels in points or R multiples of the SL distance, each closing a percent of initial volume, then breakeven after a chosen level, optional fixed-point trailing and auto-SL for unprotected positions.
red_flags: Auto stop loss is off by default (InpAutoStopLoss=0)
R mode measures risk from the CURRENT SL, so after breakeven/trailing moves the stop the remaining R targets shrink or change
Partial close volume below min lot is rounded UP to min lot (closes more than the configured percent on small positions)
No freeze-level check, no filling-mode selection (CTrade default), no tick-size rounding
GlobalVariables for tickets closed while the EA was offline are never cleaned up
Marketing-style header claims ('10+ years', 'tested') are not evidence

ideas.name: Scale-out ladder in R multiples of initial volume
ideas.detail: Each TP level closes a percentage of the volume the position had when first seen (not of the remainder), at distances given in points or in multiples of entry-to-SL distance; last active level optionally closes everything left.

ideas.name: Per-ticket ladder state persisted in GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: Initial volume and last executed TP level are stored as terminal global variables keyed by ticket, reloaded on restart and deleted when the position closes - so a restart never re-fires a level or recomputes percentages from the reduced volume.

ideas.name: Partial-close volume normaliser with dust guard
ideas.detail: Close volume is floored to step and clamped to min/max/current; if the leftover would be below the minimum lot the whole position is closed instead, avoiding an untradeable remainder.

ideas.name: Breakeven tied to a TP level, trailing only after it
ideas.detail: SL moves to entry +/- offset once the Nth partial has filled (only if it improves the current SL), and the trailing stop is disabled until that level is reached - sequencing protect-then-trail off realised partials rather than raw price.

ideas.name: Tick plus 1-second timer driving the same idempotent manage pass
ideas.detail: OnTick and OnTimer both call one pass over positions that is safe to repeat (level counter advances only on confirmed close), so management continues in quiet markets and catches several levels in one gap via the while loop.
ideas.evidence: Partial_Close_Multi_TP_Manager.mq5 OnTick()/OnTimer(), XP_Manage(), while loop in XP_CheckLevels()

title: Trade Manager Utility
summary: MT5 manager for existing positions only: adds missing SL/TP (points or ATR), breakeven, stepped trailing, max-position cap, and a daily equity/balance loss or profit threshold that closes matching positions and pauses until the next server day, persisted across restarts.
red_flags: Daily protection, breakeven and trailing are all disabled by default; only initial SL is on
Breakeven trigger/lock are points-only (no ATR mode)
During a daily pause it closes ALL matching positions including new manual ones - intended, but aggressive if magic=-1
Daily state is not persisted in the Strategy Tester (by design), so restart behaviour is untestable there
Dense one-line style makes review harder despite sound logic

ideas.name: Daily loss/profit pause with commit-marker persistence
ideas.detail: Day baseline (equity or balance) and paused flag are stored in GlobalVariables keyed by login+magic+scope+symbol. Writes first zero the day marker, then write base and pause, then commit the day key and flush - a torn write is detected and never yields a false baseline.

ideas.name: Trading-availability gate: permissions, fresh quote, session table
ideas.detail: Before any action checks terminal/EA/account trade permissions, symbol trade mode, a sane tick (bid>0, ask>=bid), quote age below a limit versus TimeTradeServer, and that server time lies inside SymbolInfoSessionTrade windows including sessions spilling past midnight.

ideas.name: Frozen-ticket retry backoff
ideas.detail: If a close is blocked because SL/TP is inside the freeze level or the server returns TRADE_RETCODE_FROZEN, the ticket is recorded with retry_after = now+60s and logged once, instead of re-sending every cycle.

ideas.name: Directional tick-size rounding and max(stops,freeze)+1 tick distance
ideas.detail: Stops are rounded to tick size toward the safer side (floor for buy SL, ceil for sell SL), and legality uses max(stops level, freeze level) plus one tick; modification is skipped if change is under half a tick or an existing level is inside the freeze zone.

ideas.name: Risk lot via OrderCalcProfit with verification pass
ideas.detail: Loss for min volume at the stop is obtained from OrderCalcProfit (correct for any contract/quote currency), scaled to the equity risk budget, floored to step, then re-verified that actual loss <= budget and OrderCalcMargin <= free margin; returns 'below minimum volume' rather than rounding up.

ideas.name: Throttled re-entrancy-guarded cycle on a sorted snapshot
ideas.detail: Tick and timer share one Cycle() with a busy flag and server-time throttle; it snapshots matching tickets sorted oldest-first, aborts all actions if the snapshot fails, uses closed-bar ATR via a per-symbol handle cache, and treats only DONE/DONE_PARTIAL/NO_CHANGES retcodes as success.
ideas.evidence: TradeManagerUtility.mq5 Cycle(), Snapshot(), AtrHandle()/AtrValue(), TradeResult(), OnInit() validation

title: Trade Journal Exporter - closed trades to CSV, one row per position, with MFE/MAE, R multiple and session
summary: Read-only MT5 tool that rebuilds closed positions from deal history and writes one CSV row per position: entry/exit, duration, initial SL/TP, gross/commission/swap/net, R multiple, MFE/MAE from M1 bars, entry session, weekday and close reason. Includable as a library.
red_flags: Session tagging uses a fixed manual server-UTC offset input (no DST handling)
MFE/MAE from M1 highs/lows is approximate (bar resolution, bid-only prices) and blank if M1 history does not reach the entry
Sleep(200) retry loop for CopyRates on the calling thread
Selects entire account history on every export, which is slow on large accounts with timed re-export

ideas.name: Position-level journal rebuilt from deals
ideas.detail: Iterates deals chronologically, groups by DEAL_POSITION_ID in a hash map, handles partial closes, netting reversals (INOUT split into close and open volume with pro-rata commission) and emits a row only when open volume reaches zero.
ideas.evidence: TradeJournalExporter.mq5 TJE_Export() deal loop, struct TJE_Pos

ideas.name: R multiple from initial order SL
ideas.detail: Initial SL is read from the opening order (HistoryOrderGetDouble ORDER_SL), risk money is computed with OrderCalcProfit from entry to SL, and net P/L (incl. commission and swap) is divided by it - R is measured against the original stop, not a trailed one.
ideas.evidence: TradeJournalExporter.mq5 TJE_Row() risk/rmul block, TJE_Money(), TJE_Export() st[ix].sl assignment

ideas.name: MFE/MAE per trade in points and money
ideas.detail: Highest high and lowest low of M1 bars between entry and exit give maximum favourable/adverse excursion; exported in points and account currency so stop and target distances can be tuned from the excursion distribution.

ideas.name: Session, weekday and close-reason tags
ideas.detail: Each trade is labelled Asia/London/NY from entry UTC hour, weekday, and DEAL_REASON (SL, TP, Expert, manual, stop-out), enabling per-session expectancy tables - directly useful for deciding gold/silver trading hours.

ideas.name: Embed as a library and export in OnDeinit/tester
ideas.detail: With #define TJE_LIBRARY the file is included in another EA and TJE_Export(config, path) is called at the end of a test; supports magic ranges ('1001,2000-2999'), symbol wildcards ('XAU*'), common-folder output and UTF-8 BOM.
ideas.evidence: TradeJournalExporter.mq5 header usage note, TJE_Config, TJE_ParseMagics(), TJE_SymbolOk()

title: Prop Risk Guard - daily loss and drawdown protection
summary: Account-protection EA: daily loss limit, static or trailing max drawdown and profit-target lock in percent or money, scoped to account/symbol/magic. On breach it closes positions, deletes pending orders and keeps flattening until reset. State persists in GlobalVariables; Canvas panel.
red_flags: Opens random aggressive demo trades with no SL - Strategy Tester only (MQL_TESTER guard), default on
It is a watchdog, not a hard guarantee: fast gaps can exceed the limit before closes fill; close failures are only printed
No filling-mode selection per symbol and no market-closed/session check in CloseAll; 3 blind passes
Max-DD and target locks are permanent until the start-balance input is changed
Trailing-DD percent limit is computed from start balance, not peak (deliberate prop-firm convention, but may surprise)
GlobalVariableSet without flush; Balance-minus-closed day base ignores deposits/withdrawals during the day

ideas.name: Three persisted locks: daily, max drawdown, profit target
ideas.detail: Separate lock flags stored in GlobalVariables keyed by account login and scope: daily lock clears at day rollover, drawdown and target locks are permanent until a new starting balance is entered. Tester runs use a separate key prefix so they never touch live state.

ideas.name: Daily loss = closed deals since day start + floating, scoped
ideas.detail: Today's loss is recomputed from history (profit+swap+commission of in-scope deals since the day start) plus floating P/L of in-scope positions, so it is restart-proof and can be limited to one magic or symbol; day base selectable as balance, equity or the higher.

ideas.name: Configurable day-reset hour and early-trigger buffer
ideas.detail: Guard day starts at a chosen server hour (matches prop-firm reset times), and a buffer percent makes every limit fire early (e.g. at 90% of the true limit) to absorb slippage on fast gold moves; a one-time warning fires at a set percent used.
ideas.evidence: Prop_Risk_Guard.mq5 DayStartFor(), Evaluate() 'early' factor and InpWarnPercent

ideas.name: Static vs trailing drawdown with persisted equity peak
ideas.detail: Equity high-water mark is updated every evaluation and stored in a GlobalVariable; drawdown is measured from either the starting balance (static) or the peak (trailing), covering both common prop-firm rule types.

ideas.name: Event-driven lock enforcement
ideas.detail: OnTradeTransaction reacts to TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD while any lock is active and immediately closes positions and deletes pending orders; a 250 ms timer also keeps the account flat without waiting for ticks.

ideas.name: Limit-usage panel with push/popup alerts
ideas.detail: Canvas panel shows status badge, equity, today's P/L, used/limit bars coloured by usage for each rule, time until daily reset and last event; click toggles compact mode; events go to Alert and optional SendNotification.

title: Trailing Stop that can do everything
summary: MT4 trailing manager for existing orders (by magic or all): moves SL by candle extremes, fractals, ATR, Parabolic SAR, MA, percent of profit or fixed points; optional virtual (hidden) stop and basket breakeven anchoring. Opens test trades only in tester.
red_flags: ATR/SAR/MA trail modes read the still-forming bar 0
Virtual stop levels SLB/SLS kept only in memory - lost on restart, no broker-side protection
Virtual close is nested inside the 'SL improved' condition, so a virtual stop may not fire when price reverses
Buy branch lacks OSL==0 handling asymmetry vs sell; loop starts at OrdersTotal() (off by one)
OrderModify errors only shown via Comment, no retry, no freeze-level check
Magic=-1 default manages every order on the symbol including other EAs/manual
Tester-only code opens unprotected 0.1 lot buy+sell hedge
Does not place an initial SL - trail only starts after profit threshold

ideas.name: Pluggable trailing-method enum
ideas.detail: Single function returns candidate SL for a selected method (candle extreme, fractal, ATR, SAR, MA, % of profit, points) plus a common offset 'delta'; caller applies uniform start/step/stops-level gates. Clean strategy pattern for swapping trail types per regime.

ideas.name: Structure trail: nearest swing beyond stops level
ideas.detail: Walk back bar by bar (or fractal by fractal) on a chosen higher timeframe until a low/high minus offset sits further than STOPLEVEL from price; use that as SL. Avoids invalid-stops rejections while trailing behind structure.

ideas.name: Basket breakeven-anchored trailing
ideas.detail: Compute lot-weighted average open price per side (sum(price*lot)/sum(lot)) and start trailing only once the candidate SL is beyond that net breakeven plus a start threshold, so all same-side positions lock profit together.

ideas.name: Percent-of-open-profit lock
ideas.detail: SL = open + (price-open)*Percent/100, i.e. always protect a fixed fraction of the floating gain; gives a trail that widens with the move instead of a fixed distance.

ideas.name: Trail step gate to limit modify spam
ideas.detail: Only send OrderModify when the new SL improves the current one by at least StepTrall points and the distance to price exceeds the broker stop level.

title: Virtual Trailing Stop
summary: MT5 utility managing existing positions on the chart symbol with hidden SL/TP/trailing levels kept in memory and drawn as horizontal lines; closes by market when price crosses. Works for one position per side only.
red_flags: No broker-side stop at all - stops are virtual, lost on terminal/VPS outage
Stoploss input defaults to 0 (disabled)
Trail levels TrallB/TrallS are plain globals, not persisted across restart
Trailing close only executes if position profit > 0, so a hit level can be ignored
No magic-number filter - acts on any position of the symbol
Self-declared: only correct with a single position per side
Empty OnTradeTransaction; tester-only code opens min-lot buy and sell

ideas.name: Hidden trailing level with visible chart line
ideas.detail: Keep the trailing stop price in EA state, draw/move an HLine at that level each tick, and close by market when Bid/Ask crosses it. Useful as a secondary tight stop inside a wider broker-side catastrophic SL.

ideas.name: Quote sanity guard before management
ideas.detail: Refresh rates and abort the tick if Ask or Bid equals zero, preventing decisions on empty quotes after reconnects or at session open.

ideas.name: Filling mode and margin mode from symbol
ideas.detail: Initialise CTrade with SetTypeFillingBySymbol and SetMarginMode instead of hard-coding FOK/IOC, so the same code works across brokers' metals symbols.

title: News Hour Trade
summary: MT4 straddle generated by an EA builder: once per day at a manually entered server hour/minute it places a buy stop and sell stop at a fixed offset with SL/TP and expiry; when one fills the opposite is deleted; optional point trailing.
red_flags: News time is a manual hour/minute input - no calendar, fires every day
No spread or slippage filter although stop orders fill into news spikes
Fixed lot, no risk sizing
Blocking Sleep() inside tick handler
Expiration input commented as seconds but multiplied by 60 (minutes); very short expiries are rejected by many brokers
No stop-level/freeze-level validation; 4-point slippage hard-coded
Once-per-day flags held in memory only; DayOfWeek guard and exact-minute match can skip the day if no tick arrives
Trailing also pushes TP away by a hard-coded 200 pips (NewTakeProfit), effectively removing the target
Machine-generated spaghetti function names

ideas.name: Timed straddle with OCO cancel
ideas.detail: At a scheduled time place buy stop above Ask and sell stop below Bid at a fixed gap; each tick, if a market position of one side exists, delete the opposite pending order (one-cancels-other).

ideas.name: Pending-order expiry
ideas.detail: Attach an expiration time to the breakout stop orders so unfilled straddle legs are removed automatically by the server even if the EA is offline.

ideas.name: Trail with hysteresis gap
ideas.detail: Modify SL only when current SL lags price by more than TrailingStop+TrailingGap, reducing modification frequency during fast moves.

title: News Detector for both Mt4 and Mt5
summary: Template that downloads a 7-day economic calendar HTML widget from fxstreet via WebRequest, string-parses events, filters by importance/currency/keyword, draws lines and a list, and sets a NEWS_ON flag inside a before/after window. Places no trades.
red_flags: WebRequest to third-party server over plain HTTP (calendar.fxstreet.com legacy widget endpoint, likely defunct)
Fragile HTML scraping by CSS class names; no validation of parsed fields
Time handling bug-prone: TIME_CORRECTION = -TimeGMTOffset() is the local PC offset, not broker server offset, yet compared to TimeCurrent()
Tester guard uses || instead of && so it is always true
NEWS_ON reset logic: flag is overwritten per row; an unfiltered later row can clear it only until break - last matching row decides
OnDeinit calls ObjectsDeleteAll(0) wiping every chart object including user drawings
Fails open: if download fails the table is empty and no block is applied
Currency match by substring of a comma list; default list would need USD only for metals
MessageBox in EA code
MT5 has a native calendar API making this unnecessary

ideas.name: Pre/post news blackout window flag
ideas.detail: Loop events; if now is within STOP_BEFORE minutes before or START_AFTER minutes after any qualifying event, set a global NEWS_ON flag that the trading logic checks before entries.

ideas.name: Importance + currency + keyword event filter
ideas.detail: Qualify events by star-level importance toggles, by currency membership in a configurable list, and optionally by a keyword in the event title (e.g. 'employment') to block only specific releases such as NFP/CPI/FOMC.

ideas.name: Timer-driven calendar refresh with backoff counter
ideas.detail: Evaluate news state from a 1-second timer rather than ticks (works in quiet markets) and re-download the calendar only every ~100 timer cycles after a successful read, retrying immediately on failure.

ideas.name: Upcoming-event vertical lines on chart
ideas.detail: Draw a VLINE at each filtered event time named with currency, importance and title, plus a short on-chart list of the next events, so the operator sees why trading is paused.

title: News Detector for Mt4 & MT5
summary: Byte-identical copy of entry 40590 (same file content under an .mq4 name): fxstreet calendar scrape via WebRequest, importance/currency/keyword filter, chart lines, NEWS_ON blackout flag. Places no trades.
red_flags: Duplicate of 40590 (files compare identical)
WebRequest to third-party server over plain HTTP, legacy endpoint
Fragile HTML scraping
Local-PC GMT offset used as server-time correction
ObjectsDeleteAll(0) on deinit wipes all chart objects
Fails open when download fails

ideas.name: Pre/post news blackout window flag
ideas.detail: Same mechanism as 40590: NEWS_ON set when current time falls within configurable minutes before/after a qualifying calendar event. In MT4 a web feed is the only option since there is no built-in calendar.

title: Risk Calculator
summary: On-chart calculator panel: user types lot, TP points and SL points, presses a button, and it shows money at risk/reward as lot*points*tick value. No trading, empty OnTick.
red_flags: Money formula ignores tick size (points*TICK_VALUE only correct when tick size equals point)
Fallback substitutes TICK_SIZE for a zero TICK_VALUE, which is dimensionally wrong
No lot step/min validation; clicking an edit field erases its content
Pure UI, nothing persisted

ideas.name: Edit-field what-if risk panel
ideas.detail: OBJ_EDIT inputs for lot, SL points, TP points and a button handled in OnChartEvent that displays monetary loss/gain before committing; useful as a manual-override pre-trade check panel in a metals bot.

title: Risk Management EA Based on ATR Volatility
summary: Long-only fast/slow MA crossover checked once per new bar; SL = ATR x multiplier (or fixed pips), lot sized from % of balance with optional money cap. One position per magic. No take profit and no exit logic other than the stop.
red_flags: No TP, no trailing, no signal exit - positions only ever close at the initial SL (guaranteed eventual loss unless managed manually)
Long only despite generic description
Signal and ATR read bar 0 at new-bar open (just-opened bar value) rather than closed bars 1/2
Lot formula uses points*TICK_VALUE, ignoring tick size - wrong where tick size differs from point
Lot is clamped UP to broker minimum, silently exceeding the configured risk
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK - rejected by brokers needing IOC/RETURN
Fixed-pip mode assumes pip = 10 points (wrong for metals digits)
Sleep(100) in OnInit; decorative box-drawing log spam; no spread/session/news filter

ideas.name: ATR-multiple stop with percent-risk sizing and absolute money cap
ideas.detail: Stop distance = ATR(period) x multiplier; risk money = balance x risk%, then capped by MaximumRiskInMoney so sizing stops scaling beyond a fixed currency amount; lots = risk / stop cost, floored to lot step.

ideas.name: Input validation returning INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT
ideas.detail: OnInit rejects out-of-range risk %, non-positive ATR period and fast>=slow MA periods, and fails on invalid indicator handles; prevents optimiser/operator from running nonsensical configurations.

ideas.name: Pre-send stops-level check
ideas.detail: Before sending, compare actual entry-to-SL distance with SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL and skip the order with a logged reason instead of letting the server reject it.

ideas.name: Magic+symbol position ownership check
ideas.detail: Entry is gated by scanning positions for matching symbol and magic, so restart or other EAs on the account do not cause duplicate entries.

title: RiskManager with InfoPanel and Support
summary: Information panel only: shows account stats, a suggested lot from equity risk % for a manually typed entry price and percent SL/TP, reward:risk, and today's realised P/L versus a daily limit. Never places or blocks trades.
red_flags: 'Trading suspended' is text only - nothing is enforced
GetDailyProfit iterates HistoryDealsTotal without calling HistorySelect, so the sum may be empty/stale
Daily P/L uses DEAL_PROFIT only (no commission/swap) and ignores floating loss
Promotional 'support' button printing a broker affiliate link (bybit partner URL)
Entry price is a static input (default 1.1000), irrelevant for metals unless edited
Panel built with OBJ_RECTANGLE/OBJ_TEXT using corner properties that do not apply to those object types
Lot not normalised to step/min/max

ideas.name: Tick-size-correct lot formula
ideas.detail: lots = riskMoney / ((|entry - SL| / TICK_SIZE) * TICK_VALUE) - correctly uses tick size rather than point, which matters on metals symbols where tick size and point can differ.

ideas.name: Daily realised P/L vs equity-percent limit
ideas.detail: Sum today's deal profits by matching deal date to server date and compare to equity x MaxDailyRisk%; exceeded state flagged. Idea is sound as a daily loss lock if actually enforced, with HistorySelect and commission/swap added.

ideas.name: Percent-of-price stop and target
ideas.detail: SL and TP expressed as a percentage of entry price (e.g. 0.2% / 0.5%) rather than points, which scales automatically with gold/silver price level across years.

title: Session Opening Range Breakout EA
summary: Builds a session opening range from M1 bars at a server-time start, then within a limited window buys/sells by market when a closed chart bar closes beyond the range plus buffer. SL at opposite range side, TP by R multiple, risk-% sizing, max trades per session.
red_flags: Session state (trades count, range, date) is memory-only: a restart inside the window resets g_tradesThisSession and can re-enter the same session
Range end bar is inclusive of the M1 bar starting at range end time (one extra minute in range)
No spread, news, volatility or minimum/maximum range-width filter
SL at the far side of the range can be very wide on gold; no cap on stop distance
Session hours are raw server time with no DST/GMT handling
No trailing/breakeven and no end-of-session flat rule; position can run overnight
If stops are pushed outward by EnforceMinStopDistance the TP is not recomputed, so R multiple drifts
Lot digits heuristic limited to 2 decimals; price/SL not normalised to tick size
If range computation fails it is still marked computed and the day is silently skipped

ideas.name: Closed-bar opening-range breakout with buffer and time window
ideas.detail: Range high/low from M1 bars between session start and start+N minutes (iBarShift/iHighest/iLowest); entry only when last closed chart bar closes beyond range ± buffer points, only until rangeEnd+window, direction toggles per side.

ideas.name: Min stop distance = max(stops, freeze) + spread + pad
ideas.detail: Push SL/TP outward (never inward) to at least max(STOPS_LEVEL, FREEZE_LEVEL)+current spread+10 points, because some symbols report 0 yet reject close stops; done before sizing so lot uses the real SL distance.

ideas.name: Risk lot clamped by free-margin capacity
ideas.detail: After risk-% sizing with (distance/tickSize)*tickValue, call OrderCalcMargin for 1 lot and cap volume at 90% of free margin / margin-per-lot, so the order is never rejected for no money.

ideas.name: Skip trade instead of rounding up to min lot
ideas.detail: Lot is floored to step; if result is below SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN return 0 and skip the trade rather than forcing min lot, preserving the risk cap on small accounts trading gold.

ideas.name: Per-session trade quota with daily reset
ideas.detail: Counter incremented only on successful send, compared to MaxTradesPerSession, reset when server calendar day changes along with range anchors; prevents repeated re-entries on whipsaw breakouts. Needs persistence to be restart-safe.
ideas.evidence: SessionORB_EA_04x.mq5 CheckNewSession() lines 142-174, OnTick line 129, OpenBreakoutTrade() lines 287-291

ideas.name: Structure stop with R-multiple target
ideas.detail: SL at opposite range boundary plus buffer points; TP = entry ± RewardToRisk x (entry-SL), giving a self-scaling target tied to the session's own range rather than fixed points.

title: Spread lister - current, min, max
summary: Timer-driven monitor that polls every Market Watch symbol each second, computes spread from Ask-Bid, tracks per-day min and max, and renders a monospace table of labels. No trading.
red_flags: Statistics are memory-only and start from EA attach; lost on restart
Blacks out the host chart by default (changes chart colours, not restored on deinit)
Symbol list loaded once at init; later Market Watch changes ignored
O(n^2) sort every second; daily reset tied to server midnight only
Only min/max kept - no average, median or percentile

ideas.name: Per-day spread min/max tracker
ideas.detail: Sample spread on a timer (not just ticks), keep running min and max per symbol and reset at server-day change; gives a live baseline to derive an adaptive spread gate (e.g. block entries when current spread > k x day minimum).

ideas.name: Spread from validated Bid/Ask with SYMBOL_SPREAD fallback
ideas.detail: Compute spread as (ask-bid)/point only when bid>0, ask>0 and ask>=bid; otherwise fall back to SYMBOL_SPREAD, else mark symbol inactive. Avoids acting on stale or zero quotes.

ideas.name: Multi-symbol spread comparison table
ideas.detail: Side-by-side current/min/max spread for all watched symbols (e.g. XAUUSD vs XAGUSD variants/suffixes), useful for choosing broker symbol and trading hours before deploying the bot.

title: News EA Template without DLL
summary: Template that downloads the weekly Investing.com calendar HTML via WebRequest, string-parses time/currency/importance, draws vertical lines and sets a CheckNews flag inside a before/after minutes window. Places no trades.
red_flags: WebRequest to third-party server over plain HTTP (ec.forexprostools.com), fragile HTML scraping that breaks when page markup changes
NomNews is never reset in UpdateNews, so each daily refresh appends duplicates until the 300 cap and then stops loading new events
Manual GMT offset input, no DST handling; failed download silently leaves no news (fails open)
MessageBox inside OnTick on WebRequest failure blocks the EA
Not usable in Strategy Tester (WebRequest unavailable), so news filter cannot be backtested

ideas.name: Before/after news blackout window by currency and impact
ideas.detail: Loop over cached events; block trading when now+MinBefore*60 > eventTime and now-MinAfter*60 < eventTime, filtered by a currency list string and High/Moderate/Low impact toggles. For metals use USD-only high-impact (NFP, CPI, FOMC).

ideas.name: Cached calendar with periodic refresh, no DLL
ideas.detail: Calendar is fetched once per Upd seconds (86400) and kept in an in-memory array, so the per-tick check is a cheap array scan. On MT5 the same pattern should use the built-in CalendarValueHistory instead of scraping.

ideas.name: Colour-coded news lines and pre-news alert
ideas.detail: Draws one vertical line per upcoming event coloured by impact and raises a single alert per event (index remembered in Now) when the blackout window is entered.

title: Robust EA Template
summary: MT4 skeleton exported by a strategy builder: CCI(14)+RSI(14) bucket conditions on closed bar 1, one position per magic/symbol, fixed lot, fixed pip SL/TP, reverse on opposite signal, closes its position on deinit.
red_flags: Curve-fit magic-number indicator buckets (CCI between -200..-150 or -100..-50, RSI<=25 etc.)
lastBar variable declared but never used: signal logic runs on every tick, no new-bar gate
reinitEA calls OnInit again from OnDeinit, re-multiplying extern takeProfit/stopLoss/slippage by 10 on 3/5-digit symbols
Closes open position on terminal close/chart close/recompile path, which is surprising behaviour for a live EA
No stops-level, lot normalisation, spread or margin checks; relies on implicit OrderSelect state from isPositionOpen
Fixed lot, no risk-based sizing; digit adjustment (3/5 digits) is wrong for gold (2-digit) pricing

ideas.name: Explicit handling of every deinit reason
ideas.detail: OnDeinit switches over all REASON_* codes and decides per reason whether to flatten or just reinitialise state. Reuse the structure, but persist state instead of closing on chart/parameter changes.

ideas.name: Signal function returning +1/0/-1 separated from execution
ideas.detail: LongSignal()+ShortSignal() produce a single signed integer on closed bar 1; processSignal branches on has-position vs no-position. Clean seam for swapping strategies without touching order code.

ideas.name: Input sanity validation in OnInit
ideas.detail: Rejects too-small SL/TP and insufficient bars with INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT / INIT_FAILED before any trading starts.

title: Exp_breakeven_trailing_SL
summary: MT5 trade-manager that never opens trades: moves SL to entry+offset once profit reaches a threshold, then step-trails behind price. Works on current or all symbols, filtered by magic (-1 all, 0 manual).
red_flags: PositionModify result/retcode never checked
Fixed point distances (500/200/300/100) not volatility-scaled; unsuitable as-is for gold vs silver
Runs on every tick with no throttle; freeze level ignored (only stops level clamped)

ideas.name: Two-stage exit: breakeven-plus lock, then trailing gated on breakeven
ideas.detail: Breakeven moves SL to open+StepSL once price is PlusPoints in profit. Trailing is skipped until SL is already at or beyond that breakeven level, so the two stages never fight each other.

ideas.name: Clamp new SL to broker stops level and never loosen
ideas.detail: If computed SL is closer than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL to Bid/Ask it is pushed out to exactly that distance, normalised to symbol digits, and discarded if not strictly better than current SL.

ideas.name: Step trailing to limit modify spam
ideas.detail: SL moves only when price has advanced a full PlusPoints_trail beyond current SL, then jumps by StepSL, reducing the number of modification requests on fast metals ticks.

ideas.name: Magic scope selector (-1 all / 0 manual / >0 EA) with per-symbol properties
ideas.detail: One manager handles multiple symbols by reading point, digits and stops level per position symbol, with a single magic input selecting ownership scope.

title: Levels with Trail
summary: MT4 semi-manual EA: user draws trendlines, EA renames them and adds arrow objects selecting direction; opens one fixed-lot trade when current price crosses the line within bar 0, then sets SL/TP and simple-trails the SL.
red_flags: Order sent with SL=0/TP=0 then modified afterwards; if modify fails the position stays without stop
SL can be disabled (sl=0) and sl_/tp_ are uninitialised in that case
Entry triggers on the forming bar 0 (intrabar cross), no closed-bar confirmation
Error handling via GetLastError()!=false without ResetLastError; no stops-level or lot checks
Old init/start handlers, state held in chart objects with fixed 20-line arrays and no bounds checks
Trailing uses the initial SL distance, effectively trailing from entry with no profit condition

ideas.name: User-drawn chart lines as tradable levels
ideas.detail: EA adopts manually drawn trendlines, evaluates the line price at the current bar with ObjectGetValueByShift and trades on a cross relative to the bar open. Useful for discretionary support/resistance levels on gold.

ideas.name: On-chart arrows as per-level direction switches
ideas.detail: Each line gets up/down/flat arrows; deleting arrows selects bounce-buy, bounce-sell or breakout behaviour, and line width shows armed/disarmed state. No input dialog needed.

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin check
ideas.detail: Skips entries when MODE_MARGINREQUIRED*lot exceeds account equity before sending the order.

title: TP SL Trailing
summary: MT5 utility for the chart symbol: attaches a pip-based SL/TP to positions that lack them, then applies a classic stop+step trailing once profit exceeds stop+step. Does not open trades.
red_flags: Manages every position on the symbol regardless of magic (filter commented out)
No stops-level/freeze-level check before PositionModify
Initial SL measured from current price, not open price; 3/5-digit pip adjustment is not correct for metals quoting
With InpOnlyZeroValues=true a position with InpTakeProfit=0 keeps TP=0 and is re-modified every tick, never reaching the trailing branch

ideas.name: Safety net that attaches missing SL/TP to naked positions
ideas.detail: On each tick any position with SL==0 or TP==0 gets default protective levels. As a watchdog in a metals bot this guarantees no position survives without a broker-side stop after a failed modify or manual trade.

ideas.name: Broker-aware trade object setup
ideas.detail: SetTypeFillingBySymbol, SetMarginMode and tick-size NormalizePrice via CSymbolInfo, plus a RefreshRates guard that rejects zero Bid/Ask quotes.

ideas.name: Full request-result dump after each modify
ideas.detail: Logs retcode with description, deal/order ticket, confirmed price, requote bid/ask and broker comment after every modification for post-mortem analysis.

ideas.name: Preserve original magic when modifying foreign positions
ideas.detail: Before each PositionModify the trade object's magic is set to the position's own magic so later ownership filters are not broken by the manager.

title: Risk Manager
summary: MT5 account watchdog: stores day-start balance in terminal GlobalVariables, closes all positions and pending orders when day loss reaches risk%, optionally closes single positions exceeding a per-trade loss % and trails daily profit.
red_flags: Daily profit trailing never fires: flag is a local reset each call and the close condition requires flag set in the same call
Forward loops with 'PositionsTotal()>=loop' while closing skip positions; relies on next tick to finish
Slippage set to 10000 points for closes
After the daily limit it only keeps closing; no block flag exported to other EAs
Day rollover by day_of_year comparison; day-start balance wrong if terminal was offline at rollover or after deposits
tr.PositionClose(symbol) is netting-style; unreliable on hedging accounts with several positions per symbol
Per-trade loss cap is a software close, not a broker-side stop

ideas.name: Day-start balance persisted in GlobalVariables keyed by account login
ideas.detail: Balance, day and year are stored as terminal global variables prefixed with ACCOUNT_LOGIN, so the daily loss reference survives EA restarts and does not mix accounts.

ideas.name: Daily loss kill switch on balance plus floating P/L
ideas.detail: Computes (dayStartBalance - (balance+floating profit)) as % of day-start balance each tick; at or above the limit it closes all positions and deletes all pending orders and returns false to stop further processing.

ideas.name: Per-position loss cap as percent of day balance
ideas.detail: Any position whose floating loss reaches riskTrade% of day-start balance is closed. Useful as a secondary emulated stop behind the broker SL against gap or stop-modify failures.

ideas.name: Daily equity-profit trailing lock (concept)
ideas.detail: Track peak daily gain %; once gain exceeded a threshold, flatten everything when it retraces by that amount from the peak. Implementation here is broken and must persist peak and armed state.

ideas.name: Startup check of terminal and program trade permissions
ideas.detail: OnInit alerts when TERMINAL_TRADE_ALLOWED or MQL_TRADE_ALLOWED is off, and exposes order filling policy as an input.

title: Channel Trailing
summary: MT5 trade manager for the chart symbol: trails SL to the N-bar high/low channel plus offset on each new bar, optional 'noose' trailing that keeps SL as far from price as TP is, and deletes pending orders once a position exists.
red_flags: PositionModify/OrderDelete results not checked
PositionSelect(_Symbol) is netting-style; manages only one position per symbol and ignores magic
Deletes every pending order on the symbol regardless of owner
Channel SL is not normalised and could loosen relative to the noose stop if both modes fight
Default 5-bar channel and 50-point offset are fixed, not volatility-scaled

ideas.name: Donchian channel trailing on closed bars
ideas.detail: On each new bar, SL for longs moves to the lowest low of the last N closed bars minus an offset (shorts: highest high plus offset), only when it improves the current SL. Structure-based trail that tolerates gold pullbacks better than fixed-distance.
ideas.evidence: chtrailing.mq5 GetIndicatorData, CheckTrailing, OnTick new-bar gate

ideas.name: Noose trailing: SL mirrors remaining distance to TP
ideas.detail: Every tick SL is set to price minus (TP minus price), so remaining risk always equals remaining reward and the stop tightens automatically as price approaches the target.

ideas.name: Stop and freeze level validation before modify
ideas.detail: Proposed SL is accepted only if it is beyond both SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL and SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL from the current Bid/Ask; otherwise the modify is skipped.

ideas.name: OCO cancel of remaining pending orders on fill
