ideas.detail: OnTradeTransaction reacts to TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD for the symbol and deletes all remaining pending orders once a position exists; ready-made OCO for straddle/breakout stop orders.

ideas.name: Immediate protective stop for positions without SL
ideas.detail: On any tick, a position found with SL==0 gets the channel stop applied at once instead of waiting for the next new bar.

title: Close All Orders
summary: MT5 chart button that, after an optional confirmation dialog, closes every open position and deletes every pending order on the account with raw OrderSend requests, then reports closed/failed counts.
red_flags: request.type_filling never set, so closes can be rejected on brokers not supporting the default filling mode
No symbol or magic filter: acts on the whole account
No retry on requote/price-changed; MessageBox blocks the EA thread
Label redrawn and ChartRedraw on every tick

ideas.name: Panic button with confirmation and result summary
ideas.detail: OBJ_BUTTON handled in OnChartEvent; shows a MessageBox listing how many positions/orders will be closed, then reports closed vs failed counts via Alert and resets button state.

ideas.name: Close by position ticket with explicit retcode acceptance
ideas.detail: Builds TRADE_ACTION_DEAL with request.position=ticket (hedging-safe), reverse order type and current Bid/Ask, and treats only DONE, PLACED or DONE_PARTIAL as success; iterates backwards over positions.

title: Prop Firm Guardian - daily loss, max loss and profit target lock
summary: MT5 account guardian checked on tick and 1s timer: computes daily and max-loss equity floors (static or trailing), optional profit target, closes everything and sets a persistent PFG_BLOCKED global variable; while blocked it keeps closing new trades.
red_flags: Enforcement is reactive (closes after the fact); other EAs must read PFG_BLOCKED themselves to avoid opening
Global variable names are not namespaced per account, state is reset when login changes
Close deviation fixed at 50 points, no filling-mode setup; failed closes only retried on next check
Trailing max-loss peak uses closed balance, not equity high-water mark, which differs from some prop rules
Permanent block needs manual deletion of the global variable

ideas.name: Day-start balance rebuilt from deal history
ideas.detail: Sums profit+swap+commission+fee of BUY/SELL deals since the reset hour and subtracts from current balance to recover the day-start balance, so the daily floor is right even if the terminal was off at rollover.

ideas.name: Deposits and withdrawals excluded from P/L
ideas.detail: Non-trade deals are accumulated separately as balanceOps and added to the floor, so a deposit raises and a withdrawal lowers the daily floor instead of counting as trading result.

ideas.name: Tiered persistent block flag shared across EAs
ideas.detail: GlobalVariable PFG_BLOCKED: 0 free, 1 until next trading day (auto-lifted on day index change), 2 permanent for max loss or target. Level only escalates; any EA can check it before trading and it survives restarts.

ideas.name: Safety buffer before the real limit
ideas.detail: Limits are computed as (LimitPct - BufferPct), so liquidation starts before the actual threshold to absorb slippage and gaps, which matters on fast gold moves.

ideas.name: Static or trailing max-loss floor plus profit-target lock
ideas.detail: Max floor is initial balance minus limit, or trails a persisted peak balance (GV PFG_PEAK). Optional equity target closes all and blocks so gains are not given back.

ideas.name: Timer plus tick checks with configurable day reset hour and account-change reset
ideas.detail: Check runs from OnTick and a 1-second timer (covers quiet symbols); trading day index is (time - resetHour*3600)/86400; state is reinitialised only when connected and the login differs from the stored one.

title: Execution Quality Logger - slippage, fill delay and spread of every deal
summary: MT5 non-trading logger: on each deal it derives requested price, fill price, signed slippage in points, order-to-fill delay in ms and spread, appends a CSV row and shows running averages on the chart.
red_flags: Spread is sampled when the row is written (up to 10s after the deal), not at fill time
Statistics are in-memory only and reset on restart (CSV persists)
HistorySelect window of +/-1 day on every queue pass; fine for low frequency only

ideas.name: Per-deal signed slippage measurement
ideas.detail: Slippage = (requested - filled)/point for buys, reversed for sells, positive meaning favourable. Requested price is the SL/TP level for stop/target exits, else ORDER_PRICE_OPEN.

ideas.name: Tick-history reconstruction of the quote at order time
ideas.detail: When the server stores no price for a market order, CopyTicks over the 60s before ORDER_TIME_SETUP_MSC recovers the last ask/bid at send time as the requested price.

ideas.name: Fill latency in milliseconds
ideas.detail: Delay = DEAL_TIME_MSC minus ORDER_TIME_SETUP_MSC per deal, with running average and maximum; detects slow execution around news on metals.

ideas.name: Deferred deal queue until the order reaches history
ideas.detail: DEAL_ADD transactions are queued; processing waits for HISTORY_ADD or a 500ms timer until the originating order is selectable, with a 10s timeout fallback. Avoids the common race in OnTradeTransaction.

ideas.name: Append-mode CSV journal with deal reason tagging
ideas.detail: File opened READ|WRITE|SHARE_READ, header written only when empty, seek to end, FileFlush per row; each row tagged with reason (SL, TP, stop_out, expert, manual), entry direction, magic and volume.

ideas.name: Live slippage statistics as an execution-quality gate (derived use)
ideas.detail: Running average/worst slippage and percent negative fills are maintained; a trading bot could reuse these counters to pause entries or widen limits when recent slippage degrades. The logger itself only displays them.

title: Universal trailing stop
summary: MT4 script/EA that trails SL of existing orders (by magic or all on symbol) using fixed points, last lower/upper fractal, or prior candle lows/highs, with profit-only and breakeven-only modes. Opens no trades.
red_flags: Infinite while(true)+Sleep(1000) loop inside start() - blocks the EA thread, script-style
Sell branch of OnlyWithoutLoss uses OSL>=OOP (copy of buy logic) so breakeven-only mode is wrong for shorts
Fixed TrailingStop branch does not respect stop level beyond a simple max; no freeze-level check; errors only shown in Comment, no retry
Magic=0 manages every order on the symbol including other EAs' and manual trades
2010 pre-build-600 syntax (dots in variable names) will not compile in modern MT4

ideas.name: Structure trail: first swing/candle extreme beyond stop-level
ideas.detail: Scan closed bars 1..100 and pick the first fractal (or bar low/high) that lies farther than max(STOPLEVEL, user distance) from current price; use it as the new SL, only ever tightening.

ideas.name: Trail modes: profit-only and breakeven-only
ideas.detail: Flags gate SL moves: OnlyProfit skips any candidate SL not beyond the open price; OnlyWithoutLoss stops modifying once SL is at/over entry, turning the trailer into a one-shot breakeven mover.

ideas.name: Chart markers for candidate SL and minimum stop distance
ideas.detail: Draws an arrow at the next candidate SL level and another at price minus/plus broker stop level, so the operator sees where the trail will move and what the broker allows.

title: Grid Template EA
summary: MT4 template: when no own orders exist, places N buy-stops above and N sell-stops below price at fixed pip steps, each with fixed SL/TP and a pending expiration. No entry signal, no lot escalation, no averaging against the move.
red_flags: Structurally a two-sided stop-order grid with no OCO: both sides can trigger in a whipsaw (each leg does carry SL, fixed lot, not averaging-down, hence flag set false)
PosSelect filter uses && instead of || (symbol AND magic mismatch) - weak ownership logic
Only the last OrderSend ticket is checked; earlier failures in the loop are silent
MM formula AccountFreeMargin*Risk/1000/100 is an arbitrary magic-number scaling, not risk-per-stop
SL/TP not normalised, no stop-level/freeze-level check, no spread or session filter, no new-bar discipline
Pip conversion uses MODE_TICKSIZE*10 for 3/5 digits - wrong for 2-digit gold quotes

ideas.name: Pre-send guards: margin check + account order-count limit
ideas.detail: Before each pending order: AccountFreeMarginCheck must be non-negative for that lot, and OrdersTotal must be below ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS (0 = unlimited). Skips the order instead of triggering broker rejections.

ideas.name: Two-sided stop-order ladder with server-side expiration
ideas.detail: Buy-stops at Ask+distance+i*step and sell-stops at Bid-distance-i*step, each with own SL/TP and a broker-side expiration timestamp so stale pendings self-delete without EA being online.

ideas.name: Volume snap to min/max/step
ideas.detail: Clamp requested lot to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/MAX and round to the nearest VOLUME_STEP multiple before sending.

title: NewsTradingEA
summary: MT4 time-scheduled straddle: inside a manually entered date/time window it places a buy-stop and sell-stop at fixed distance, re-centres both on each new bar while neither is filled, and deletes the remaining pending once one side triggers. No news feed.
red_flags: StopLoss=0 allowed (no SL)
News time is a single hand-typed date/time input - no calendar, must be re-entered for every event
Distances in raw Points with fixed defaults (55 points) - meaningless on gold without rescaling; no stop-level, spread or slippage/gap protection for news spikes
start() called from init(); no retry on failed send, could leave a one-sided straddle (which is then deleted, so the event is missed)
Fixed lot, no risk sizing; header is mostly Telegram/YouTube signal-channel promotion
Stop orders through news are exposed to large slippage - not handled

ideas.name: Trailing straddle re-centred each new bar until trigger
ideas.detail: While both pending stops are still unfilled, on every new bar OrderModify both to Ask+D / Bid-D with refreshed SL/TP and expiration, so the bracket hugs price right up to the event.
ideas.evidence: NewsTradingEA.mq4 start() lastbar!=Bars block, OrderModify branch

ideas.name: OCO by pending-count asymmetry
ideas.detail: Each tick count own buy-stops and sell-stops by magic+symbol; if only one side remains (other filled or gone) delete the survivor, both inside and after the window.

ideas.name: Event window = start offset + duration, plus pending expiry
ideas.detail: Activation window defined as event time + StartStraddle minutes for StopStraddle minutes; pendings also carry a broker-side expiration (Expiration minutes) so nothing lingers if the terminal dies.

title: Basic Moving Average template
summary: MT4 template: when flat, buys/sells 0.01 lot if previous chart bar opened on one side of an H4 SMA(49) and closed on the other; fixed pip SL/TP attached by a second OrderModify (ECN style).
red_flags: New-bar detection via Volume[0]>1 - misses bars if first tick is skipped, unreliable
MA read at shift 0 of H4 (still-forming higher-TF bar) compared against chart bar 1 - mild repaint/inconsistency
Two-step SL: market order sent with SL=0 then modified; if OrderModify fails the position stays naked with no retry
Stale Ticket reused if margin check fails (OrderSelect on an old ticket)
Hard-coded 0.01 lot, curve-fit looking defaults (38.5/48.5 pips, period 49)
PosSelect uses && instead of || in the skip filter

ideas.name: ECN two-step entry: market order then attach SL/TP
ideas.detail: Send market order with SL/TP=0, then OrderSelect the ticket and OrderModify to set stops, for market-execution brokers that reject stops on the opening request. Needs a retry/emergency-close fallback, which this code lacks.

ideas.name: Clamp stop distance to broker stop level
ideas.detail: sc(): if requested SL/TP distance is smaller than MODE_STOPLEVEL it is raised to the stop level before price calculation, avoiding error 130.

title: Basic Rsi Template EA
summary: MT4 template: when flat, sells if RSI(14) on the forming bar is above 70 and buys below 30, 0.01 lot, fixed pip SL/TP attached by a follow-up OrderModify. No new-bar rule (author states this).
red_flags: Signal from bar 0 on every tick - repaints, and re-enters immediately after a stop-out while RSI stays extreme (serial losses in a gold trend)
Counter-trend fade with no trend/volatility filter
Two-step SL with no retry if OrderModify fails (naked position)
Hard-coded 0.01 lot, no spread/session filter
Same ownership-filter && bug as the other templates from this author

title: Basic expert adviser with trailing stop
summary: MT4 template with no entry rule: whenever flat it immediately opens a fixed-direction 0.01 lot order with SL/TP, then trails SL by a fixed pip distance once profit exceeds that distance.
red_flags: No entry logic - reopens instantly after every close (author says not for trading)
Hard-coded 0.01 lot
Trailing modifies without stop-level/freeze-level check; error only printed
Ticket<0 check does not cover stale ticket when margin check skips the send

ideas.name: Step-gated fixed-distance trail
ideas.detail: Trail starts only after profit > trail distance and SL is moved only if the new level improves the current SL by more than one pip, limiting OrderModify spam and broker 'too many requests' errors.

title: HFT Spreader for FORTS
summary: MT5 exchange market-maker for FORTS futures: on OnBookEvent, if spread >= N ticks it posts buy and sell limits one tick inside the spread, re-quotes when outbid, and after a fill places an opposite limit for double volume to flip.
red_flags: No stop loss at all (sl/tp lines commented out); inventory risk is unbounded if price runs
Opposite limit placed at 2x position volume - reverses rather than exits
OrderSend result ignored (empty if-body); no retcode handling
COrderInfo objects used without Select (pendingOrder.OrderType() after raw OrderSelect) - undefined behaviour
Deletes ALL account pending orders regardless of magic/symbol
Author notes OnDeinit cleanup does not work; requires exchange DOM (MarketBook) - not applicable to OTC CFD gold/silver
Order-book array indexed without bounds checks (index-1, index+1)

ideas.name: Spread threshold expressed in tick-size multiples
ideas.detail: Gate logic on spread >= N * SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE rather than raw points, making the threshold portable across symbols with different tick sizes (inverted here: a metals bot would require spread <= N ticks).

ideas.name: Re-quote stale pending when price drifts more than one tick
ideas.detail: Each event compares the pending order price to current bid/ask and deletes/replaces it if it is through the market or more than one tick behind the best price.

title: EMA_RSI_RISK-EA
summary: MT5 EA: on a new bar, EMA 12/26 cross on closed bars confirmed by RSI above 55 / below 45 opens one position with fixed pip SL/TP, equity-percent lot sizing, spread cap, server-hour window, breakeven and fixed-pip trailing.
red_flags: No retcode checks on trade.Buy/Sell/PositionModify; no filling-mode setup
PositionSelect(_Symbol) without magic check - assumes netting / single EA per symbol, will manage foreign positions on hedging accounts
Lot floor MathMax(minLot, ...) silently exceeds the risk budget when computed lots < minimum
PipSize() via 3/5-digit rule is wrong for 2-digit gold and 3-digit silver quotes; SL/TP/trail in fixed pips, not ATR-scaled
No daily loss / drawdown guard; no freeze-level check; NewBar state not persisted across restart
Modifies SL on every tick with no minimum step

ideas.name: Equity-percent sizing from tick value and stop distance
ideas.detail: lots = equity*Risk% / (stopPips * tickValue*(pip/tickSize)), floored to VOLUME_STEP, clamped to min/max, normalised to step digits; returns 0 (no trade) if tick data or stop is invalid.

ideas.name: Hour window with overnight wrap
ideas.detail: TradingWindow(): if StartHour<=EndHour use h>=Start && h<End, else h>=Start || h<End, so sessions that cross midnight (e.g. 22 to 6 server time) work with two inputs.

ideas.name: Combined breakeven + trail as a monotonic SL candidate
ideas.detail: Compute newSL = max(currentSL, entry if profit>=BE, bid-trail if profit>trail) for longs (mirror for shorts, handling sl==0), then modify only if it tightens and respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL.

ideas.name: Closed-bar cross with momentum confirmation, filters before bar consumption
ideas.detail: CopyBuffer from shift 1 for 2 bars to detect the cross on completed bars, RSI threshold as confirmation; spread/session filters are evaluated before NewBar() so a blocked bar is not marked consumed.

ideas.name: Widen SL/TP to broker minimum stop distance before send
ideas.detail: If intended SL or TP distance is below SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL*_Point, replace it with max(minStop, intended) and normalise to symbol digits. (Sizing should be recomputed after widening - not done here.)

title: Restart-Safe EA Template - no duplicate entries after a restart
summary: MT5 template: demo MA-cross on closed bars; the last processed bar time is stored in a terminal GlobalVariable keyed by symbol/timeframe/magic so a restart cannot re-fire the same bar; spread, margin, stop-level, volume checks and decision logging.
red_flags: SL optional (InpSLPoints=0 means none); fixed lot, no risk sizing
Bar is marked processed before the order is sent - a rejected/requoted order is never retried for that signal
Spread spike at bar open permanently skips that signal (same cause)
GlobalVariable is terminal-local: lost on terminal reinstall/VPS migration and shared with Strategy Tester namespace considerations
Demo signal only; author states not profitable; no freeze-level check

ideas.name: Persisted last-processed-bar in GlobalVariable
ideas.detail: Key 'RSEA_<symbol>_<tf>_<magic>_lastbar' stores iTime(shift 1); OnTick returns if stored value >= current closed-bar time, so terminal/VPS restarts or re-inits never duplicate an entry on the same bar.
ideas.evidence: RestartSafeEA.mq5 StateName(), OnTick() lines with GlobalVariableCheck/Set

ideas.name: Mark-before-act idempotency
ideas.detail: The bar is recorded as processed immediately after reading the signal and before any order call, guaranteeing at-most-once execution per bar even if the terminal crashes mid-send (trade-off: no retry).
ideas.evidence: RestartSafeEA.mq5 OnTick() 'mark before acting: never twice'

ideas.name: Pre-trade checklist: ownership, spread, OrderCalcMargin, stops level, filling mode
ideas.detail: Magic+symbol position scan via PositionGetTicket, spread cap, OrderCalcMargin vs ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE, SL/TP distance = max(points, STOPS_LEVEL+1), volume floored to step, SetTypeFillingBySymbol and deviation set once in OnInit.

ideas.name: One log line per decision with skip reason and retcode
ideas.detail: Every signal produces a PrintFormat line: skipped (position open / spread X > Y / insufficient margin) or sent/FAILED with ResultRetcode and description, making live behaviour auditable against backtests.

ideas.name: Parameter sanity check returning INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT
ideas.detail: OnInit rejects inconsistent inputs (fast >= slow) with INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT, which also makes the optimiser skip invalid combinations instead of wasting passes.

title: BotWatchdog - phone alerts when your EAs silently stop working
summary: MT5 timer-driven monitor that places no trades: push-notifies on state changes of broker connection, algo-trading permission, named EAs missing from charts, account switch, positions without SL, daily equity loss versus day-start balance, and low margin level; daily heartbeat.
red_flags: Alert-only: daily loss and no-SL conditions are reported, never enforced (no closing/locking)
Day-start balance held in memory and keyed to PC clock - reset on restart, so daily-loss baseline is lost mid-day
No-SL timer is account-wide (one timestamp for any position), not per ticket
EA presence matched by substring of CHART_EXPERT_NAME - can false-positive on similar names
No external network calls beyond MetaQuotes SendNotification; no DLL/WebRequest found

ideas.name: Edge-triggered health state machine with push notifications
ideas.detail: Each check computes 0/1 states (connected, algo allowed, EAs present, expected login, no-SL, day loss, margin) and pushes only when a state differs from the previous one, with recovery messages - no alert spam.

ideas.name: Naked-position detector with grace period
ideas.detail: Scan all positions for POSITION_SL==0; start a timer on first detection and raise an alert if any position remains without SL longer than NoStopMinutes. Reusable as a self-check that forces an emergency SL/close.

ideas.name: Daily equity-loss and margin-level thresholds
ideas.detail: Snapshot balance at day rollover; flag when equity < dayStart*(1-DailyLossPct/100); separately flag when margin in use > 0 and ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL < MinMarginLevel. In a trading bot these should lock entries and be persisted.

ideas.name: Daily heartbeat and deinit 'watcher stopped' message
ideas.detail: Sends one status push per day at a set hour (connection, algo, EAs, balance, equity, open count) and a push from OnDeinit when removed/chart closed, so silence itself becomes a signal.

ideas.name: Environment guards: algo permission, account login, EA-on-chart
ideas.detail: Checks TERMINAL_TRADE_ALLOWED && ACCOUNT_TRADE_EXPERT, compares ACCOUNT_LOGIN with the login remembered at start, and iterates ChartFirst/ChartNext reading CHART_EXPERT_NAME to confirm required EAs are attached.

title: News Expert Advisor (no indicators)
summary: Permanently keeps a BuyStop and SellStop straddle Step points from price, re-pegging them every TimeModify seconds; filled orders get breakeven and step trailing. No news/time awareness at all; fixed lot.
red_flags: No actual news or time filter despite name - straddle is live 24/5
No OCO: opposite pending stays after one side fills (whipsaw double loss)
SL/TP silently dropped to 0 if below broker STOPLEVEL
Uninitialised local TP passed to OrderModify when trailing (can wipe TP)
Operator precedence bug in sell breakeven condition (|| vs &&)
Default 10-point SL/Step is far inside gold spread
No spread filter, fixed lot, OrderSend errors not logged

ideas.name: Floating straddle re-pegged on a throttle
ideas.detail: BuyStop/SellStop kept at fixed distance from Ask/Bid; moved only if last modify was more than TimeModify seconds ago AND price drifted more than StepTrall points, limiting modify spam before a news release.
ideas.evidence: cm_EA_News.mq4 start(), TicketB/TicketS blocks with TimeBarB/TimeBarS

ideas.name: Breakeven-plus then step trail with stops-level guard
ideas.detail: Move SL to open+MinProfitNoLoss once allowed by STOPLEVEL, then trail at TrailingStop after TrailingStart profit, only modifying when improvement exceeds StepTrall points and never loosening the stop.

title: PROphet
summary: New-bar EA on M5 EURUSD: weighted sum of four high-low range differences of bars 1-3 (perceptron-like, optimised weights) triggers buy/sell between 10-18h; fixed 0.1 lot, SL always set, trailing, forced close after 18h.
red_flags: Curve-fit magic weights (x1..x4, y1..y4) optimised for EURUSD M5
Fixed lot 0.1, no risk sizing
OrderSelect/OrderClose return values unchecked
Sleep(30000) inside tick handler on errors
No spread filter, stops level or lot normalisation
Buy weights scored with the same formula direction-agnostic - no real edge evidence

ideas.name: Entry window plus hard end-of-session flatten
ideas.detail: Entries only between hours 10-18; any open position is market-closed once hour > 18, so no exposure is carried through the rollover/thin session.
ideas.evidence: PROphet.mq4 BBB()/SSS(), h>=10 && h<=18 and h>18 OrderClose

ideas.name: Spread-padded trailing trigger
ideas.detail: Trail only when price exceeds current SL by (current spread + 2*SL distance), so the stop steps in chunks that scale with live spread instead of modifying every tick.

ideas.name: Retry-same-bar on failure
ideas.detail: On OrderSend/Modify failure or trade context busy, resets prevtime to Time[1] so the new-bar gate reopens and the action is retried on the next tick rather than lost until the next bar.

title: Virtual Trailing Stop
summary: Utility that manages SL, TP and trailing stop virtually (hidden from broker): tracks trail level in memory, draws it as a chart line, and market-closes the order when price crosses it. Works for one order per side.
red_flags: No broker-side stop at all - disconnect/terminal crash leaves position unprotected
Trail level held only in RAM, lost on restart
No magic filter - manages any order on the symbol
Sell close uses Ask but buy trail close also uses Ask (wrong price for buy close)
Trail close skipped if OrderProfit()<=0
Only correct with one order per direction
In tester it opens unprotected buy+sell test orders

ideas.name: Virtual (stealth) trail level with chart line
ideas.detail: Trail level kept in a variable, ratcheted only when new level beats old by TrailingStep, drawn as an HLINE; position closed by market when Bid/Ask crosses. Useful as a tighter soft layer inside a wider broker-side catastrophic SL.

title: Basic Trailing Stop
summary: Template EA: CCI+RSI closed-bar rule placeholders, one position per magic, fixed lot, initial SL at fixed pips and a tick-by-tick trailing stop at the same distance. Long CCI rule is logically impossible.
red_flags: Long rule CCI>-100 && CCI<=-150 can never be true (dead code)
Trail measured from Ask for buys / Bid for sells (wrong side)
Sell trail never starts if OrderStopLoss()==0 edge; modify every tick with no step or stops-level check
OrderModify result ignored
Fixed lot, no spread or session filter
Pip conversion only for 3/5 digits - wrong for gold 2-digit quotes

ideas.name: Signal = LongRule()+ShortRule() plug-in skeleton
ideas.detail: Separates management (trail, initial stop) from signal functions returning +1/-1/0 from closed bar 1, summed so conflicting signals cancel to zero; position ownership via magic+symbol.

ideas.name: Input validation in OnInit
ideas.detail: Returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT when stop distance is below a minimum and INIT_FAILED when too few bars exist, preventing the EA from running misconfigured.

title: Expert adviser licence protection template
summary: Template showing hard-coded licence checks in OnInit (demo-only, single real account number, expiry date) that call ExpertRemove. Opens one test buy with SL/TP only in the strategy tester.
red_flags: Purpose is licence lock: account-number binding and date expiry kill-switch (local, not remote)
Expiry only checked at OnInit, not during runtime
SL/TP not checked against stops level
OrderSelect loop breaks instead of continues on failure

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin check
ideas.detail: AccountFreeMarginCheck(symbol,type,lots) must be non-negative before OrderSend; logs and skips the trade otherwise.

ideas.name: Lot normalisation to step/min/max
ideas.detail: Lot rounded to MODE_LOTSTEP then clamped between MODE_MINLOT and MODE_MAXLOT before sending.

ideas.name: Account-type guard at init
ideas.detail: OnInit refuses to run (ExpertRemove + INIT_FAILED) if account is not demo or account number mismatches; reusable as a safety guard to keep an untested build off a live account.

title: AutoCloseOnProfitLoss Expert - Automatically Close All Positions on Profit/Loss
summary: Utility that sums floating POSITION_PROFIT across all account positions each tick and closes everything when total reaches a money profit target or max loss.
red_flags: No magic/symbol filter - closes every position on the account
Ignores swap and commission in the total
Prints to log on every tick (log flooding)
No lock after trigger - new trades can reopen immediately; state not persisted
Tick-driven only: no check when the chart symbol is quiet
Fixed 10-point deviation is tight for gold

ideas.name: Basket money target / max floating loss close-all
ideas.detail: Aggregate floating P/L of all positions compared against account-currency profit target and negative loss limit; breach triggers reverse-order close loop that reports whether every close succeeded.

ideas.name: Sign/range validation of risk inputs
ideas.detail: OnInit rejects non-positive profit target or non-negative loss limit with INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT and checks ACCOUNT_TRADE_ALLOWED before starting.

title: Trailing_Profit
summary: Utility that trails total account floating profit (incl. swap and commission): once profit exceeds a minimum, it sets a floor at profit minus a percentage, ratchets it up, and closes all positions when profit falls below.
red_flags: No magic/symbol filter (commented out) - closes all account positions
Trail floor held in RAM only, lost on restart
No loss-side protection at all
Close retcodes not inspected beyond bool

ideas.name: Percent-giveback equity profit trail
ideas.detail: After basket profit exceeds minimum_profit, floor = profit*(1-percent/100); floor only ratchets up; when profit drops below floor a close-all state is latched.

ideas.name: Latched close-all state machine
ideas.detail: m_close_start flag stays set and close loop is retried every cycle until position count is zero, then all state is reset - guarantees partial close failures are retried.

ideas.name: Filling-mode auto-detection
ideas.detail: Reads SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE bitmask and selects FOK, else IOC, else RETURN for CTrade at init, avoiding 'unsupported filling mode' rejections across brokers.

ideas.name: Time throttle for management loop
ideas.detail: Management logic runs at most once every 3 seconds using TimeCurrent delta, reducing per-tick load and request spam.

title: Forex news events reaction EA: An mql5 calendar introduction.
summary: Polls the built-in MQL5 economic calendar each tick; alerts on events for the symbol's currencies, or in trading mode places a BuyStop/SellStop straddle with SL/TP around CPI/PPI/rate-decision events and deletes pendings after 500 seconds.
red_flags: Alert fires on MODERATE importance while comment says high
Custom StringContains is buggy (off-by-one: matches on length-1, bad reset on partial match)
No OCO - surviving pending remains until expiry after other side fills
Expiry state in a static variable, lost on restart
No spread/slippage guard at release time; fixed lot and fixed 150-point distances (inside gold spread on news)
Calendar unavailable in strategy tester - untestable
DeletePending filters on magic only, not symbol; no retcode checks
For XAUUSD, base currency is XAU so only the profit currency (USD) matches

ideas.name: Native MQL5 calendar polling filtered by symbol currencies
ideas.detail: CalendarValueHistory from last-request time to now+lookahead, then CalendarEventById/CalendarCountryById; keep events whose country currency equals SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE or SYMBOL_CURRENCY_PROFIT. No WebRequest needed.

ideas.name: Event-name keyword whitelist
ideas.detail: Lower-cased event name matched against keywords (cpi, ppi, interest rate decision) to select only market-moving releases; combine with importance field to build a news blackout or news-trade list.

ideas.name: Timed news straddle with auto-expiry
ideas.detail: BuyStop and SellStop placed a fixed distance either side at event time, each with its own SL/TP; all pendings with EA magic deleted after a fixed lifetime (500 s) if untriggered.

title: Clickable button excample (close all positions)
summary: Draws one chart button; when pressed, sends market close deals for all positions on all symbols and releases the button once position count is zero.
red_flags: OrderSend result/retcode never checked
No filling mode set on raw request (rejections on many brokers)
Forward loop while closing positions skips entries
Magic read via OrderGetInteger without an order selected
Reacts to any chart event while button state is set, not specifically the click
Closes all symbols/magics with no confirmation

ideas.name: Latching panic close-all button
ideas.detail: OBJ_BUTTON whose pressed state persists; each chart event re-attempts closing and the button only un-latches when the position count reaches zero, giving a manual kill switch that retries.

title: Expert Advisor required to fetch news data for the FFC Calendar indicator.
summary: Non-trading utility: on init and on a timer every N hours downloads the Forex Factory weekly calendar JSON via WebRequest and writes it to a local cache file for a companion indicator; shows status on chart.
red_flags: WebRequest to third-party server nfs.faireconomy.media (read-only GET, no account data sent)
OnTester returns constant 1.0 just to pass Market validation
No retry/backoff until next timer interval; cache written non-atomically
No JSON validation before overwriting cache

ideas.name: Decoupled news feeder with file cache
ideas.detail: Separate timer-driven EA fetches weekly calendar JSON (GET, 10 s timeout) and saves it to MQL Files; the trading EA only reads the local cache, so trading logic never blocks on network and works as MT4 fallback where no native calendar exists.

ideas.name: Explicit WebRequest failure handling with status surface
ideas.detail: Distinguishes error 4060 (URL not whitelisted) with setup instructions, other transport errors, and non-200 HTTP codes; last-success timestamp shown in chart comment so stale news data is visible.

title: 1 Click Button To Close All Open Positions
summary: MT4 chart button that closes every open market order on the account (all symbols, all magics) via OrderClose at OrderClosePrice. OnTick is empty; no trading logic.
red_flags: On a non-fatal OrderClose error the loop does `continue` without decrementing index or RefreshRates: can spin forever on a persistent error (e.g. requote/off quotes)
No symbol or magic filter: closes other EAs' positions too
Pending orders are left in place
Fixed button name can collide with other tools; slippage in raw points, not scaled for metals

ideas.name: Fatal vs retryable error classification in close loop
ideas.detail: On close failure, read GetLastError: abort the whole sweep for fatal codes (1,2,5,6,64,65,132 market closed,133 trade disabled,139 locked), retry the same ticket for transient ones. Needs a bounded retry count and RefreshRates, which the original lacks.

ideas.name: Side-agnostic close price via OrderClosePrice()
ideas.detail: Use the selected order's own OrderClosePrice() instead of branching on Bid/Ask per order type; avoids wrong-side price bugs in flatten routines (MT4 only; MT5 CTrade.PositionClose does this itself).

ideas.name: On-chart panic 'Close All' button
ideas.detail: OBJ_BUTTON created in OnInit, handled in OnChartEvent by object name, state reset after action, removed in OnDeinit. A manual kill-switch that works without ticks (weekend/illiquid hours).

title: Trailing Master
summary: MT4 fixed-distance trailing stop for existing orders on the chart symbol: once price is TS pips beyond entry, SL follows Bid/Ask at TS pips. Optional filter by magic and/or exact comment.
red_flags: OrderModify result stored but never checked; no stop-level/freeze-level check; no NormalizeDouble
No minimum trail step: sends a modify on every favourable tick (broker spam)
Default settings manage every order on the symbol regardless of owner
Fixed pip distance, not volatility-scaled; pip rule gives 0.01 on 2-digit gold so 50 'pips' = $0.50
Comment matching is brittle (brokers append [sl]/[tp] or truncate comments)
Eight near-duplicate if-lines instead of one filter function

ideas.name: Trail activates only after profit exceeds the trail distance
ideas.detail: Trailing starts only when price >= entry + TS, so the first trailed SL is already at breakeven or better; the initial protective stop is never loosened or tightened before that. Sell side also handles SL==0 explicitly.

ideas.name: Selectable ownership filter (magic and/or comment)
ideas.detail: Inputs toggle whether the manager acts on orders by magic number, by comment, both, or all. For a metals bot keep magic+symbol only; comment matching is unreliable.

title: EA Move StopLoss to BreakEven
summary: Old-style MT4 script-EA that moves SL to the exact open price once price is BE_Pips in profit. Two copies: one hardcodes pip=0.0001, the JPY copy pip=0.01.
red_flags: Pip size hardcoded (0.0001 / 0.01) with symbol-name string checks; on XAUUSD the non-JPY file makes 30 pips = $0.003, i.e. instant breakeven
Pointless nested j-loop repeats the same OrderSelect(i) i+1 times (O(n^2) duplicate modifies)
OrderModify return value ignored; no stop-level check
Sell orders with SL=0 never get moved (condition stopPrice > openPrice fails), buys with SL=0 do
Breakeven at exact entry ignores spread/commission/swap, so 'breakeven' is a small loss
No magic filter

ideas.name: One-shot breakeven guarded by SL-vs-entry comparison
ideas.detail: Move SL to entry only while the current SL is still on the losing side of entry; that comparison acts as a stateless 'already done' flag, so it survives restarts without stored state. Should add a cost offset and derive pip from symbol properties.

title: An Expert Advisor template
summary: Non-compilable skeleton from the 2010 Automated Trading Championship: one CExp object per symbol, daily and M30 new-bar dispatch, and debug wrappers around OrderSend/OrderCheck with championship-specific volume and order-count caps.
red_flags: Placeholder code (/*...*/), strategy methods not included: does not compile and contains no signal logic
Hard-coded contest limits (12 orders, 5 lots per order, 15 lots per direction, min 0.1) instead of symbol properties
IsNewBar uses _Symbol only and a 2-slot static array keyed by 'period==M30': wrong for multi-symbol use and any third timeframe
Returns after the D1 branch, so the M30 handler is skipped on the first tick of each day
Only OrderSend's boolean is tested, retcode merely printed; request logs show tp but no sl field

ideas.name: One strategy object per symbol driven from a single EA
ideas.detail: A class instance per instrument (Init(symbol,...), DayTrade(), IntraDayTrade()) called from one OnTick. Fits a single EA running XAUUSD and XAGUSD with separate parameters and shared account-level risk.
ideas.evidence: ch2010structure.mq5 class CExp line 10-24, OnInit/OnTick line 113-144

ideas.name: OrderSend/OrderCheck wrappers that log call site and full request
ideas.detail: All sends go through DebugOrderSend(__LINE__, request, result): on failure it prints retcode, calling line, symbol, volume, type, price, action. One choke point for logging and pre-trade validation.

ideas.name: Aggregate exposure cap before placing pending orders
ideas.detail: Before a pending order, sum existing position volume in the same direction plus all same-type pending volumes on the symbol; shrink the new order to fit a total cap or reject it. Prevents stacked pendings from exceeding intended exposure.

ideas.name: Two-tier new-bar scheduling (D1 then M30)
ideas.detail: Daily-bar event runs the slow planning routine, M30-bar event runs intraday management; all decisions are on bar open, none on raw ticks. Implementation needs per-symbol/per-timeframe timestamps to be correct.

title: Close all positions
summary: MT5 EA that sums profit+swap+commission of every open position on the account and, when the total reaches a money threshold, latches a flag and closes all positions on following ticks until none remain.
red_flags: PrevBars is never assigned, so the 'only on new bar' gate never blocks: the profit check runs every tick, contrary to the comment
No symbol/magic filter: closes every position on the account including other EAs'
PositionClose result not checked or logged; no deviation or filling mode configured
Only a profit target, no loss-side basket stop
CPositionInfo.Commission() is deprecated and often 0, so net profit can be overstated

ideas.name: Latched close-all flag retried until flat
ideas.detail: When the trigger fires, set m_close_all=true; each tick, if any position still exists, re-run the close sweep, and clear the flag only when none remain. Partial failures, requotes or closed markets are retried automatically. Persist the flag for restart safety.

ideas.name: Basket net-P/L trigger including swap and commission
ideas.detail: Sum Profit+Swap+Commission across positions and compare to a money threshold to flatten the whole basket. Same mechanism works with a negative threshold as a daily/basket loss cut for a gold+silver portfolio.

title: Close All Orders by Current Symbol
summary: MT4 chart with two buttons: 'Close Orders' closes market orders of the chart symbol, then deletes all chart objects and removes the EA; 'Exit' just removes the EA.
red_flags: Sends two OrderClose calls per order (once at Ask, once at Bid) and relies on one failing: guaranteed error on every order
OrderClose returns bool but is stored as a ticket int; success test `_ticket>0` reflects only the last call
Loop starts at index OrdersTotal() (off by one)
ObjectsDeleteAll() wipes every object on the chart, including the user's drawings and other tools' objects
No magic filter, no retry, hardcoded slippage 5 points
EA removes itself even when some closes failed

ideas.name: Self-removing one-shot action via ExpertRemove()
ideas.detail: After completing its job the EA calls ExpertRemove() to unload itself. Useful as the final step of a hard kill-switch (e.g. after a max-drawdown breach) so the bot cannot re-enter until a human re-attaches it; only after confirming the account is flat.

title: 1 Click To Close All Open Positions at Current Attached Chart
summary: Version 2 of the close-all button: limited to the chart symbol, with an input choosing between all orders or only manual orders (magic number 0).
red_flags: Same possible infinite loop as v1: `continue` on a non-fatal error without index-- or RefreshRates
Two copy-pasted functions differing by one condition
Pending orders not removed
Slippage in raw points, not adapted to metals

ideas.name: Manual-vs-EA separation through magic 0
ideas.detail: Treat OrderMagicNumber()==0 as 'manual trade' and let the user choose whether a bulk action touches manual trades or everything on the symbol. Inverse rule for the bot: never touch magic 0 or foreign magics.

ideas.name: Abort sweep on fatal trade errors
ideas.detail: Same classification as v1: break the close loop on fatal error codes (market closed, trade disabled, no connection, account disabled), retry otherwise. Must be combined with a retry cap.

title: Function for calculating lot size from risk per deposit
summary: Demo of a risk-percent lot function: alternates buy/sell at market with symmetric SL/TP of N ticks, sizes by equity% over SL distance via tick value/size, then logs expected vs realised profit on the closing deal.
red_flags: Bug: `MathFloor(volume/lot_step)*min_lot` multiplies by min_lot instead of lot_step: wrong size whenever min lot != lot step
When computed volume is 0 it is forced up to min_lot, silently exceeding the requested risk instead of skipping the trade
OrderSend result/retcode not checked; pos_open set true even if the send failed, and it lives only in memory (restart reopens a trade)
No filling mode set, no stops-level check, SL/TP not normalised to tick size
Uses SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE (profit-side value) and ignores spread, commission and slippage, so real loss exceeds the target
No signal: blind alternating entries on every tick when flat; no magic number

ideas.name: Lot size from equity risk % and SL distance using tick value/tick size
ideas.detail: lots = (equity*risk%/100) / (|entry-SL|/tick_size*tick_value), floored to the volume step and clamped to min/max. Correct basis for metals where contract size and tick value differ by broker; fix the step bug and use TICK_VALUE_LOSS.

ideas.name: Expected-vs-realised risk audit on the exit deal
ideas.detail: Store equity and the planned risk amount at entry; in OnTradeTransaction on DEAL_ADD with DEAL_ENTRY_OUT, log volume, equity before/after, planned +/- amount and actual DEAL_PROFIT. Reveals sizing errors and slippage cost per trade.

ideas.name: OrderCheck gate before OrderSend
ideas.detail: Build the full MqlTradeRequest (price, SL, TP, volume) and call OrderCheck first; send only if the server-side pre-validation (margin, volume, stops) passes. Should also log result_check.retcode on rejection.

ideas.name: Flat-state detection from the closing deal event
ideas.detail: Reset the 'position open' flag when a DEAL_ENTRY_OUT deal arrives in OnTradeTransaction rather than polling positions. Needs symbol/magic filtering and a startup resync to be restart-safe.

title: Institutional ATR Trailing Stop and Breakeven Manager
summary: MT4 manager for existing orders on the chart symbol: moves SL to entry plus a lock offset after N pips profit, then trails at ATR(14, closed bar) x multiplier behind Bid/Ask, with a 2-pip minimum step.
red_flags: 'Institutional'/'Prop' is naming only: plain ATR trail plus fixed-pip breakeven
Uses `input group`, an MQL5 keyword; may not compile as .mq4
Magic 0 means manage ALL orders on the symbol, although the comment says manual trades
Trailing OrderModify results unchecked; no MODE_STOPLEVEL/FREEZELEVEL check; prices not normalised
ATR not validated: if iATR returns 0 the trail SL is placed at the current price
Breakeven thresholds are fixed pips (pip = 0.01 on 2-digit gold, so 20 pips = $0.20), inconsistent with the ATR-scaled trail
No profit precondition for trailing: a position with no SL immediately gets an ATR stop, and in-loss buys get SL raised as price recovers

ideas.name: Breakeven-plus-lock then ATR trail in one pass
ideas.detail: Stage 1: at +X profit move SL to entry + small lock offset covering costs. Stage 2: trail at price - k*ATR, only ever tightening. After a successful BE modify the local current_sl is updated so the trail check in the same tick uses the new value.

ideas.name: Trail distance from closed-bar ATR
ideas.detail: ATR is read at shift 1 (last completed bar), so the trail distance does not change with the forming bar and behaves the same in tester and live. Distance = ATR x multiplier, adapting to gold/silver volatility regimes.

ideas.name: Minimum SL improvement step before modifying
ideas.detail: Send OrderModify only when the new SL improves on the current one by more than a threshold (2 pips here). Cuts modify spam and broker throttling on fast metals ticks; better expressed as a fraction of ATR.

ideas.name: Auto-attach an ATR stop to positions without SL
ideas.detail: The trail branch treats current_sl==0 as 'always modify', so any managed position lacking a stop gets one at k*ATR on the next tick. Reusable as a safety net that guarantees a broker-side stop exists.

ideas.name: SL sanity guard against the current price
ideas.detail: Every candidate SL must be on the correct side of the market (new_sl < bid for buys, > ask for sells) before modification, avoiding invalid-stops rejections. Should be extended with the broker stop level.

title: Stealth Trade Manager (Hidden SL/TP and Spread Protector)
summary: MT5 manager that closes chart-symbol positions at virtual SL/TP distances in points from entry, with no broker-side stops. The virtual SL is skipped while spread exceeds a limit. Opens a dummy buy in the Strategy Tester.
red_flags: No broker-side SL at all: if the terminal, VPS or connection drops, positions are unprotected
Virtual SL is suppressed whenever spread > InpMaxSpread, so the loss is unbounded exactly during news/rollover spread blowouts, which is when gold and silver gap
Code labelled 'MQL5 VALIDATION BYPASS' opens a dummy min-lot buy with no stops once a day in the tester purely to pass automated validation
Uses SYMBOL_SESSION_DEALS (number of deals in the current session, often 0 on OTC metals) as a 'market open' test: the EA can silently do nothing
Any failed close other than MARKET_CLOSED is ignored and retried every tick with no logging
Fixed point distances (500/1000) and spread cap 40 points are not adapted to metals volatility
Magic 0 manages every position on the symbol; `#property strict` is meaningless in MQL5

ideas.name: Cooldown after TRADE_RETCODE_MARKET_CLOSED
ideas.detail: If a close attempt returns MARKET_CLOSED, stamp the time and skip all processing for 300 seconds. Prevents hammering the server during the daily metals break and weekends; generalisable to a per-retcode backoff table.

ideas.name: Spread gate on discretionary exits
ideas.detail: Compare SYMBOL_SPREAD with a maximum before executing a soft exit. Worth reusing only for non-protective exits (trail tightening, time exits, entries); a hard server-side SL must still exist as the catastrophic stop.

ideas.name: Virtual TP/soft stop layered inside a hard stop
ideas.detail: Monitor POSITION_PRICE_CURRENT against entry +/- distance and close by market instead of resting orders. Usable as an inner, hidden exit level when a wider broker-side SL is always in place behind it.

ideas.name: Margin pre-check with OrderCalcMargin before sending
ideas.detail: Compute required margin for the intended volume with OrderCalcMargin and compare to ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE before sending, avoiding 'no money' rejections. Seen here only on the tester dummy order, but the check itself is sound.

title: STRADDLE NEWS
summary: One-shot manual straddle: on attach, if spread is below a cap and no orders exist, places a buy-stop and sell-stop N points from price with SL/TP, deletes the opposite pending once one fills, then trails the SL by fixed points.
red_flags: No news calendar or time trigger at all - fires immediately on attach, user must time it manually
OrderSend/OrderModify/OrderDelete return codes unchecked; second leg may fail leaving a one-sided straddle
One-shot counter t lives in memory only: restart re-arms the straddle
Uses OrdersTotal() account-wide with no magic/symbol filter; OrderDelete called every tick
Lot formula assumes 100000 contract size and hard-coded leverage input (wrong for XAU/XAG), no volume normalisation
Fixed 5-digit FX point distances; no stop-level or freeze-level check; tight straddle highly exposed to news slippage and spread widening after placement
SL/TP of pendings computed from Ask/Bid, not from the pending entry price

ideas.name: OCO straddle with bracket orders
ideas.detail: Buy-stop above Ask and sell-stop below Bid at a fixed offset, each carrying its own SL/TP; when one leg becomes a market position the other pending is deleted (OCO).

ideas.name: Spread gate before placing pendings
ideas.detail: Pending orders are only sent when MODE_SPREAD is below a SpreadOperation cap; otherwise nothing is placed. A simple pre-entry spread veto, useful around metal news spikes.

ideas.name: Profit-activated fixed-distance trail
ideas.detail: Trailing only starts after price has moved TrailingStop points beyond the open price, then SL follows Bid/Ask at that distance and is only ever tightened.
ideas.evidence: DANCA_NEWS.mq4 start(): OrderModify block for OP_BUY / OP_SELL

title: Trailing
summary: Account-wide floating-profit trailer: once total profit (incl. swap) of all open orders exceeds a money threshold, it ratchets a profit floor at peak minus 33% and closes every order when profit falls back to the floor.
red_flags: Infinite while(IsExpertEnabled()) loop with Sleep(50) inside start() - blocks the EA thread, not tester-compatible
Protects profit only: no loss-side stop of any kind
OrderSelect/OrderClose unchecked, no retry on requote; fixed slippage 3
No magic/symbol filter - closes every order on the account including other EAs and manual trades
Peak/floor state in memory only, lost on restart
Commission ignored in profit sum; pending orders included in loop

ideas.name: Basket-level profit ratchet (equity trailing take-profit)
ideas.detail: Arm when summed floating profit exceeds a minimum money amount; keep floor = peak profit x (1 - giveback%); raise floor only on new peaks; when profit drops below floor set a close-all latch that persists until the basket is flat.
ideas.evidence: trailing_profit.mq4 start(): profit_off / trail_enable / close_start logic

ideas.name: Close-all latch that retries until flat
ideas.detail: A close_start flag stays true across loop iterations and re-attempts closing every order until OrdersTotal()==0, then resets state and reports realised result - a simple retry-until-flat pattern for emergency exits.
ideas.evidence: trailing_profit.mq4 start(): if(close_start) loop and reset block

title: EA Template
summary: MetaQuotes teaching template: stochastic signal line crossing out of 10/90 zones on closed bars 2 and 1 opens a fixed-lot market order with fixed SL/TP after closing opposite positions. No trade guard, so it re-sends every tick.
red_flags: No new-bar or one-position guard: signal stays true for the whole bar so a new order is sent on every tick
No magic number or symbol filter; closes any opposite order on the account
OrderSend/OrderClose results unchecked
Buy SL/TP computed from Bid, sell from Ask; no stop-level check; fixed lot
SL can be set to 0

ideas.name: Closed-bar oscillator zone-exit cross
ideas.detail: Signal uses only completed bars (shift 2 vs shift 1): buy when the stochastic signal line crosses back above the oversold level, sell when it crosses back below overbought - non-repainting exit-from-extreme trigger.

ideas.name: Close-opposite-before-reverse
ideas.detail: On a new directional signal, iterate orders backwards and close all positions of the opposite side before sending the new entry, so the account never holds hedged legs.
ideas.evidence: Manual_EA.mq4 start(): reverse loop with OrderClose before OrderSend

title: Trailing Stop EA
summary: Trails the stop of one manually specified ticket: once price is trailing_points in profit, SL follows Bid/Ask at that distance and only tightens. Clamps the distance up to the broker stop level.
red_flags: Sell-side trail never starts if the position has no SL (StopLoss < OrderStopLoss() fails when SL is 0)
Uses chart Point instead of the order symbol's point
Mutates the input variable and alerts inside the per-order loop on every tick
OrderModify result stored but not checked; no freeze-level check, no minimum step so it modifies every tick
Single hard-coded ticket, no persistence

ideas.name: Clamp trail distance to broker stop level
ideas.detail: Before trailing, compare the configured distance with MarketInfo(symbol, MODE_STOPLEVEL) and raise it to the minimum allowed, alerting the user, so SL modifications are not rejected with invalid stops.

ideas.name: Ticket-scoped trailing with tighten-only rule
ideas.detail: Management is applied only to an explicitly owned ticket, activates after profit >= trail distance, and modifies SL only if the new level is better than the current one (never loosens).

title: Close by Equity Percent
summary: Closes all market orders on the account whenever equity exceeds balance times a multiplier (default 1.2, i.e. +20% floating profit). Displays account stats in a chart comment.
red_flags: Profit-side only: no drawdown or loss protection
No magic/symbol filter - closes everything on the account
No retry on failed close (Sleep(0)), fixed slippage 5
Pending orders are left in place
Typically used as a companion to grid/martingale baskets

ideas.name: Equity-to-balance ratio basket take-profit
ideas.detail: Account-level target expressed as equity > balance x k: once floating profit reaches a percent of balance, flatten all positions in a reverse-indexed loop. Scale-free alternative to a money target.

title: Droneox Equity Guardian
summary: Account guardian: when equity falls to an absolute stop level or rises to an absolute target, closes all market orders, deletes pendings, and switches off terminal AutoTrading by simulating Ctrl+E via user32 keybd_event.
red_flags: DLL import (user32 keybd_event via WinUser32.mqh) - requires DLLs allowed; keystroke goes to whichever window has focus
Ctrl+E toggle is blind: if it lands twice or focus is elsewhere it can re-enable trading or type into another app
CloseAllTrade always selects index 0 and loops total+1 times; a failed close stalls the loop and leaves later orders open; results unchecked
EquityStop default 0 means loss guard is effectively disabled by default
Absolute USD levels, not percent/daily; no persistence, no magic filter

ideas.name: Equity floor and ceiling kill-switch
ideas.detail: Two absolute equity thresholds (stop and target). Crossing either triggers flatten-all including deletion of pending orders, then disables further trading so nothing re-enters after the guard fires.

ideas.name: Post-trigger trading lockout
ideas.detail: After the guard closes positions it halts all automated trading (here via Ctrl+E). The reusable concept: a latched global halt state after an account-level stop; implement with an internal persisted flag rather than keyboard simulation.

ideas.name: Init-time permission pre-flight
ideas.detail: OnInit verifies IsTradeAllowed and required permissions and returns a non-zero init code with an explicit alert if missing, so the guard never runs silently disabled.

title: Risk management and bot ict daily bias
summary: Empty stub. OnInit, OnDeinit and OnTick contain no logic; a comment says the real EA is in a separate MQL5.zip archive that is not part of this download.
red_flags: Placeholder file with no functionality - title claims (risk management, ICT daily bias) cannot be verified from this source
Actual code lives in an external archive not included in the batch

title: Basket Manager EA
summary: MT5 basket closer: when position count reaches n and equity is above balance, closes all positions. In OnTradeTransaction, when a new entry deal makes the count equal n in profit, closes every position except the new one.
red_flags: while(PositionsTotal()>0) close loops have no exit on failure - can spin forever if market is closed or close is rejected
OnTick branch closes everything at n positions in profit, making the keep-newest branch in OnTradeTransaction largely redundant/racy
No magic or symbol filter - acts on the whole account
PositionClose retcodes unchecked
Designed as a companion for averaging/grid baskets (it does not add positions itself)

ideas.name: Event-driven reaction to new entry deals
ideas.detail: Uses OnTradeTransaction with TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD, HistoryDealSelect, and DEAL_ENTRY_IN plus DEAL_POSITION_ID to identify the exact position just opened and act immediately, instead of polling positions on ticks.

ideas.name: Count-gated net-profit basket close
ideas.detail: Basket is flattened only when both conditions hold: open position count >= n and account equity > balance (net floating profit positive). A cap on concurrent exposure that exits at aggregate breakeven-plus.

title: Range BreakOut EA
summary: Code-generator output (Bots Builder Pro). On every tick, if the high-low range of the last N closed bars is <= MaxRange points and Bid exceeds the range high (or falls below the low), opens one fixed-lot market trade, then attaches fixed-point SL/TP in a second modify step.
red_flags: SL/TP not sent with the entry order: position is opened naked and SL/TP are attached by a separate modify on a later pass (gap of exposure; if modify fails position stays unprotected); SL input can be set to 0
Tick-level breakout on raw Bid (no closed-bar confirmation, no buffer) - prone to false breaks/whipsaw on spread spikes; buy signal compares Bid, not Ask, to range high
Fixed lot 0.1, fixed-point SL 500/TP 1000 and MaxRange 300 points: magic numbers not scaled to volatility or instrument (unusable as-is on XAUUSD)
No spread, session, news or volatility filter; no daily loss limit
No retry/handling of retcodes: errors are captured in retcode variables but only asserted in debug macros
12,000 lines of auto-generated framework for ~10 lines of logic; opaque input names (Inp_element_NNN); most framework features (trailing, breakeven, risk lot) are compiled in but unused
Rolling N-bar range, not a session/time-anchored range; no time-of-day concept at all

ideas.name: Range-compression gate before breakout
ideas.detail: Only allow breakout entries when the high-low of the last N closed bars (bars 1..N, excluding forming bar) is <= a maximum width. Trades only breakouts from tight consolidation. For metals, express the max width in ATR multiples instead of fixed points.
ideas.evidence: Range_Breakout.mq5 OnInit: elements 'Price History' (BARTILL=1), 'Range, points', 'Good Range' (RELATIONTYPE_LESSOREQUAL vs Max Range)

ideas.name: Layered pre-trade validation pipeline with own error enum
ideas.detail: Before OrderSend, sequentially check: terminal/account trading allowed, symbol trade mode allows this direction, account order-count limit, lot min/max/step, symbol volume limit, tick available, stops level, margin, then OrderCheck. Each failure returns a distinct custom error code for logging.
ideas.evidence: Range_Breakout.mq5 cTrade::OpenTrade (approx. lines 6215-6410), CanTrade, OpeningAllowed, CheckMaxOrders, CheckLot, CheckMargin

ideas.name: Symbol volume-limit and account order-limit guards
ideas.detail: Sum existing position plus pending volume in the same direction and reject the order if new volume would exceed SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT; also reject when PositionsTotal+OrdersTotal reaches ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS. Avoids broker rejections on metals with small per-symbol caps.

ideas.name: Freeze-level and stops-level checks before modify/close
ideas.detail: Separate checks that SL/TP distance respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL and that the position/pending order is not inside SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL before sending a modify or delete, so trailing/breakeven requests are skipped rather than rejected.

ideas.name: Tighten-only stop modification
ideas.detail: When recomputing SL/TP, clamp with the existing levels (buy: SL=max(new,old), TP=min(new,old); mirrored for sell) so any management routine can only reduce risk and never widens a stop. Also makes repeated per-tick modify calls idempotent.
ideas.evidence: Range_Breakout.mq5 cTrade::ModifyTrade(ticket,tightenstopsonly,...) line ~7192; 'Set SL and TP' element with TIGHTENSTOPSONLY=true

ideas.name: Automatic filling-mode detection and netting/hedging awareness
ideas.detail: Derive ORDER_FILLING (FOK/IOC/RETURN) from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE and execution mode, cached per symbol, and detect netting vs hedging via ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE so the same code runs on different brokers. Also a duplicate-order guard (CheckPlaced) by symbol/type/magic.

title: MMA_Breakout_strategy_Volume I - coded by WhooDoo22.
summary: Price (SMMA1) crossing the 200 SMMA on closed bars opens a fixed 0.04-lot trade, then attempts four 0.01-lot scale-outs as price crosses back through 5/25/50/200 MAs; stop-and-reverse at the 200 MA. No inputs; everything hard-coded.
red_flags: SL is a hard-coded 5000 points and TP 99999 points - effectively a catastrophe stop only, not sized to volatility
All parameters hard-coded (0.04 lot, MA periods, magic numbers); no inputs, tuned to EURUSD M30 2003-2012 per the author's comment
Scale-out bookkeeping is broken: OrderClose is called with a counter variable 'i' instead of a real ticket, and long positions are closed at Ask
No return-code checks on OrderSelect/OrderSend/OrderClose; no symbol or magic filtering (uses OrdersTotal for the whole account)
State kept in in-memory booleans only, lost on restart; lot matching via floating-point equality (OrderLots()==0.03)
Profit-side exits compare MAs on forming bar 0 (intrabar flicker)
Uses identifiers ending with a dot, does not compile on modern MQL4 builds

ideas.name: MA-ladder scale-out in four equal tranches
ideas.detail: Position split into 4 equal parts; each part exits when price crosses back through a progressively slower MA (5, 25, 50, 200), so fast tranches bank profit and the last rides the trend until the trend-defining MA breaks.

ideas.name: Stop-and-reverse on final tranche exit at trend MA
ideas.detail: When the last tranche closes at a loss because the closed bar crossed back through the 200 MA, the opposite position is opened immediately in the same tick. Idea only; implementation here is unreliable.

title: Multi Strategy Ea
summary: Configurable unanimous-vote EA: RSI, Stochastic, SAR, MA-cross and MACD modules (each with own timeframe/mode) must all agree; ADX classifies trend vs range, range mode uses a triple Bollinger/RSI reversal, Damiani volatmeter blocks noise. Fixed SL/TP, pip trail.
red_flags: Depends on external custom indicators (Damiani_volatmeter, ZeroLag MACD) read on forming bar 0 - intrabar repaint; ADX regime also read at shift 0
switch statements in Signal()/CloseSignal() have no break, so the selected RSI/MA/MACD mode falls through and the last case always wins - mode inputs do not work as described
Daily halt flag 'cantrade' is computed by checkcanTrading() but never consulted before opening orders, so Cancel_Trading_On_Profit/Loss has no effect
Trail() also rewrites the take-profit to price + trail distance on every step, so TP recedes and is never hit once trailing starts
Sell positions closed at Bid instead of Ask; OrderClose/OrderModify results unchecked; no stops-level or spread checks
Save_Profit/Save_Loss use account-wide AccountProfit() and close every order on the account regardless of symbol or magic
Risk sizing is a percent of free margin divided by margin requirement, unrelated to stop distance; default Risk=5
Up to 4 orders / 2 same-direction can stack on repeated signals (not averaging-on-loss, but adds exposure)
Dozens of interacting inputs - heavy curve-fitting surface

ideas.name: ADX/DI four-state regime switch selecting strategy
ideas.detail: ADX below both DI lines or below a main level = range; otherwise +DI vs -DI gives up/down trend. Trend states only allow with-trend indicator votes; range states route to a separate Bollinger mean-reversion entry. ADX can be on a higher timeframe.
ideas.evidence: Multi_StrategyiFSF.mq4, adxSignal() line 1520, trend_detect() line 1506, start() Combo_Trader_Factor branches

ideas.name: Triple-deviation Bollinger re-entry with RSI memory
ideas.detail: Range entry: closed bar pierced the 3-sigma band, RSI was oversold/overbought within the last N bars (Range_Parameter), and the bar closed back inside the 2-sigma band. Uses shift 1 only.

ideas.name: Volatility-vs-noise gate (Damiani volatmeter) for entry and exit
ideas.detail: Entries are vetoed whenever the noise line exceeds the volatility line; open trades are also closed in that state if in profit or beyond a NOISE_LOSS money threshold. Should be re-implemented on closed bars with ATR/StdDev ratios.
ideas.evidence: Multi_StrategyiFSF.mq4, signalTRIX() line 1556, calculate(), start() USE_NOISE_CLOSING block

ideas.name: Unanimous vote over pluggable signal modules with separate close set
ideas.detail: Each module returns 1/2/0; a trade needs agreeing votes equal to the number of enabled modules. A parallel, independently configured module set (own timeframes/modes) produces the close signal, decoupling entry and exit logic.
ideas.evidence: Multi_StrategyiFSF.mq4, Signal() line 1158, CloseSignal() line 1253, SelectedCount()

ideas.name: Floating P/L close-all with halt until next day derived from history
ideas.detail: When floating profit or loss crosses a money threshold all positions close and a halt flag is set; the flag is cleared by checking that the last closed order's day differs from today, so the reset comes from trade history. Wiring here is incomplete.
ideas.evidence: Multi_StrategyiFSF.mq4, Save_Profit() line 1569, Save_Loss() line 1626, checkcanTrading() line 1605

ideas.name: One-order-per-bar guard plus per-direction and total caps
ideas.detail: OPENORDER refuses to send if LastTradeBarTime equals the current bar time, and entries require total orders below Max_orders and same-direction orders below Max_same_orders, counted by magic number.

title: Examples from the book "Neural networks for algorithmic trading with MQL5"
summary: Template EA that loads a pre-trained network file, feeds the last N closed bars of RSI and MACD on each new bar, and opens one fixed-lot position per direction when the predicted direction and predicted move exceed thresholds. Bundled files are the NN library layers.
red_flags: Educational template: no trained model is shipped, so there is no evidence of any edge
Fixed lot, fixed point SL; no spread, session, stops-level or margin checks; trade.Buy/Sell result not checked
No magic number - position check is by symbol only, so it collides with other EAs or manual trades
Buy SL/TP are computed from Bid rather than Ask
Inputs are raw unnormalised RSI/MACD values; MACD scale depends on price level, so a model would not transfer between symbols such as gold and silver without normalisation
Batch file list omits the main neuronnet.mqh include, so the listed sources are incomplete

ideas.name: Two-headed model output: direction confidence plus expected move
ideas.detail: Network outputs a direction score and a predicted move size. A trade requires the score beyond TradeLevel (0.9) and the predicted move beyond MinTarget points, filtering low-conviction and low-payoff signals.
ideas.evidence: ea_template.mq5, OnTick() checks on input_data.At(0) and At(1)

ideas.name: Take-profit from predicted move, haircut and capped
ideas.detail: TP distance = min(predicted move x ProfitMultiply (0.8), MaxTP points), so the target adapts per trade to the forecast while a fixed broker-side SL bounds the loss.

ideas.name: Fail-fast init and closed-bar-only feature window
ideas.detail: OnInit returns INIT_FAILED if the model file, an indicator handle or the symbol filling mode (SetTypeFillingBySymbol) cannot be set; features are copied from shift 1 on a new-bar gate, so nothing reads the forming bar.
ideas.evidence: ea_template.mq5, OnInit(), OnTick() lastbar check and CopyBuffer(...,1,BarsToPattern,...)

ideas.name: Native MQL5 inference library with file-saved models and OpenCL
ideas.detail: Layer classes (dense, conv, attention, batch-norm, dropout) each implement Save/Load to a file handle and optional OpenCL execution, letting an EA run a trained model in the terminal with no DLL or web calls.
ideas.evidence: neuronbase.mqh CNeuronBase::Save/Load/SetOpenCL; neuronconv.mqh, neuronattention.mqh, neuronbatchnorm.mqh, neurondropout.mqh

title: CyberiaTrader
summary: 2006 MT4 M1 'pipsator': classifies bars by two-candle reversal pattern, collects average sizes of moves exceeding spread over an auto-chosen lookback, fades moves larger than that average and closes at the first tick of profit.
red_flags: No magic number: FindSymbolOrder matches any order on the symbol; ExitMarket acts on whatever order was last selected
Closes any position as soon as it is 1 point in profit (OrderOpenPrice()<Bid) - tiny wins vs. statistically wide SL, negative-skew scalper
Signals and stop 'dispersion' read from still-forming M1 bar 0 (iClose/iHigh/iLow shift 0)
BlockStopLoss input sends SL=0; 'shadow' stop is disabled by default and held only in memory (lost on restart)
AutoLots sizes from Balance*Risk*Leverage (margin-based, default Risk=0.5 = half of account margin), not from stop distance; returns 0 for non-USD/EUR symbols
OrderSend/OrderClose results barely checked, no retry, no stop-level normalisation, 4-digit era assumptions
Re-optimises lookback (23 candidates x up to 115 bars) on every tick - in-sample self-fit with no validation
start() runs on every tick, no new-bar gating

ideas.name: Spread-relative move-quality statistic
ideas.detail: Over a lookback, count bars whose directional body exceeds current spread ('successful') vs. all classified bars, and average their size. Use the ratio as a tradability score and the average as an adaptive minimum-move threshold instead of fixed points.

ideas.name: Online lookback selection by quality score
ideas.detail: Loop candidate periods (1..N), recompute the statistic for each and pick the period with the highest share of moves that beat the spread. Idea is reusable only if done on closed bars, infrequently, with out-of-sample checking.

ideas.name: Measured spread instead of quoted spread
ideas.detail: Compute spread as Ask-Bid each tick rather than trusting MODE_SPREAD (which can be stale with variable-spread brokers) and feed it into both thresholds and stop offsets.

ideas.name: Stop = stops-level + spread + recent bar range
ideas.detail: Stop distance is the larger of broker stop level and an adaptive move size, padded by current spread and the max high-low range of recent M1 bars times an index. Volatility-plus-cost padding is a useful floor for metals stops.

ideas.name: Abnormal-impulse entry block
ideas.detail: Blocks a direction when the current bar's move exceeds 2x the average 'successful' move, i.e. refuses to fade outsized impulse candles. A z-score style 'do not fade spikes' guard.

title: Prime Quantum AI —  TRADE WITH AI (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, xAI Grok).
summary: ADX>25 + DI + Alligator alignment on closed bar opens one position with fixed/AI SL-TP. Optional hybrid mode screenshots three timeframes and asks an LLM via WebRequest to confirm direction and levels. Prop-firm drawdown locks, news/time/spread filters, panel.
red_flags: Optional martingale (default off): lot x2^level after a loss, up to 5 levels
WebRequest sends chart screenshots and the user's API key to third-party LLM endpoints (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/DeepSeek/xAI); API key is a plain input parameter
LLM call plus 3x ChartOpen/Sleep(2500)/ChartScreenShot runs synchronously inside OnTick - blocks trade management ~8-40 s; not backtestable
LLM output parsed with naive string search; invalid/missing confidence is silently set to 50; AI TP price is not validated for side or distance
No new-bar gating and no cooldown in indicators-only mode: re-enters on the next tick after a stop-out while ADX/Alligator state persists
Daily/total drawdown state (start-of-day balance, high-water mark, limit flags) is memory-only; restart resets day baseline and clears a hit limit
Standard-account 'money filter' uses absolute equity levels (defaults 5000/2500) that block all trading on accounts outside that band
Indicators-only 'confidence' is just ADX*2 - cosmetic
ATR trail handle hard-coded to M15 and reads forming bar 0; 'pips' rely on user-set multiplier (wrong default for gold)
PositionModify/partial-close results not checked; stops-level not checked on trailing modifications

ideas.name: Prop-firm style drawdown tracker with static or trailing reference
ideas.detail: Tracks start-of-day balance and equity high-water mark; flags daily-loss, total-DD (from initial balance or trailing HWM) and daily-profit-target; on any flag closes own positions and blocks entries. Limits accepted in % or money. Needs persistence added.
ideas.evidence: Prime_Quantum_AI.mq5 CRiskManager::UpdateDrawdown() line 956, IsTradingAllowed() line 993, PropValueAsPercent/Money lines 2456-2472, OnTick lines 2691-2698

ideas.name: Lot cap from remaining daily loss budget
ideas.detail: After risk-based sizing, computes potential loss at SL (lot x SL points x tick value per point) and, if it exceeds 80% of the remaining daily loss allowance, shrinks the lot so one trade cannot breach the daily limit.

ideas.name: Tick-value based risk sizing with selectable base
ideas.detail: Lot = riskAmount / (SL points x tickValue x point/tickSize), where riskAmount is % of balance, % of equity, % of free margin or fixed money; then step-normalised and clamped to min/max. Correct for XAU/XAG contract sizes without pip assumptions.

ideas.name: SL distance clamp plus R-multiple partial closes
ideas.detail: Any proposed SL is clamped between min and max distance and pushed beyond broker stops level +5 points before sending. Then closes X% at 1R and Y% at 2R, measured from entry-to-SL distance, with floor-rounded volume and per-position done flags.

ideas.name: Native MT5 calendar news window + session/day/Friday-flat gates with reason string
ideas.detail: CalendarValueHistory for today, keeps events whose country currency is contained in the symbol name (USD matches XAUUSD), high-impact only, blocks N minutes before/after. Also overnight-wrapping session window, weekday toggles, Friday close-all time; each gate writes a block reason shown on the panel.
ideas.evidence: Prime_Quantum_AI.mq5 CFilters::IsNewsBlocking() line 684, IsInTradingTime() line 749, IsFridayCloseTime() line 779, OnTick lines 2663-2728

ideas.name: Deterministic pre-filter gating an optional external model
ideas.detail: Closed-bar indicator signal must fire first; only then is the external model called (rate-limited by scan interval), and its answer is accepted only if direction equals the pre-filter and confidence >= threshold. The model can veto, never originate. Good pattern for any ML/LLM confirmation layer.

title: Hon Matrix
summary: Averaging basket EA: enters on S/R bounce, regression-channel edge, S/R breakout or Fib 61.8 + RSI in H4 MA trend direction, then adds limit orders at Fib retracement levels with lot multiplier. Basket exits by virtual TP/breakeven/trail; no broker SL.
red_flags: Every position and pending order is sent with SL=0 and TP=0; only protection is a software close-all at 30% of balance floating loss (default)
Averaging against the move with geometric lot multiplier (default 1.1^level, up to 5 orders; live-adjustable from panel edit boxes)
Breakeven, trailing level and best price are virtual, memory-only and evaluated only every 10 s (OnTick throttle) - lost on restart, exposed to gaps and disconnects
Breakout momentum/volume/close checks use forming bar 0 (CopyClose/CopyTickVolume shift 0) - partial-bar volume compared with full-bar average
'Pips' inputs are multiplied by _Point (points), so 50 'pips' TP is 50 points - meaningless on gold without rescaling
'Backtest validation' only checks the date span is >= 1 year and is not invoked in OnInit; header implies validated performance
Web news fallback (WebRequest to nfs.faireconomy.media with spoofed browser User-Agent) is a placeholder: parser loads nothing, so filter silently passes
News currency list defaults to 8 majors regardless of symbol; exposure check measures floating P/L percent, not actual exposure
Creates a new iATR handle on every CalculateMomentumScore call (handle leak); Sleep(100) in close loops; trade result retcodes not inspected
Magic curve-fit constants (velocity/20, weights 0.3/0.3/0.2/0.2, ATR>100 points cutoff)

ideas.name: Touch-count S/R levels with composite breakout confidence
ideas.detail: Swing highs/lows are clustered into levels with touch counts; a break is scored as 0.3*touches/10 + 0.3*momentum/3 + 0.2*volume ratio/3 + 0.2*distance/max, and must exceed a threshold. Reusable if computed on closed bars and ATR-normalised.
ideas.evidence: Hon_Matrix.mq5 CEnhancedSRDetector::DetectSupportResistanceLevels() line 910, AddOrUpdateSRLevel() line 971, CalculateBreakoutConfidence() line 1295

ideas.name: Breakout distance band + ATR expansion + tick-volume ratio filter
ideas.detail: Accepts a breakout only if price is between min and max distance beyond the level (not too early, not chasing), ATR/9-bar average ATR plus price velocity exceeds a threshold, tick volume exceeds N-bar average by a multiplier, and close is beyond level plus penetration.
ideas.evidence: Hon_Matrix.mq5 CheckResistanceBreakout() line 1115, CalculateMomentumScore() line 1214, CalculateVolumeScore() line 1250, PassesFalseBreakoutFilter() line 1272
