ideas.name: Cached calendar news filter with flatten-before-news and chart markers
ideas.detail: Loads next 7 days from MT5 calendar every 6 hours into a sorted array filtered by impact and a currency list; halts inside before/after window, optionally closes positions and deletes pendings once per event before release, 5-minute alert cooldown, draws vertical lines with tooltips.
ideas.evidence: Hon_Matrix.mq5 CAdvancedNewsFilter::LoadFromInternalCalendar() line 343, IsTradingAllowed() line 565, DrawNewsVerticalLines() line 503

ideas.name: Freeze-level check before deleting pendings; stops-level check before placing limits
ideas.detail: Before OrderDelete, skips orders whose price is within SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL of bid/ask; before placing a limit, verifies it is at least SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL from market on the correct side; prices rounded to tick size.
ideas.evidence: Hon_Matrix.mq5 CTradeManager::CloseAllBasketPositions() lines 2236-2267, AddToGrid() lines 2046-2075, NormalizePrice() line 2884

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin validation with 2x buffer
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin for the intended order type/lot/price and requires free margin greater than twice the required margin, plus volume min/max check and a cap on positions+pendings, before any order is sent.

ideas.name: Strategy-level floating P/L circuit breaker
ideas.detail: Sums profit+swap+commission of positions owned by magic+symbol; if the floating loss or profit reaches a percent of balance, closes all positions and pendings. Useful as a last-resort layer on top of hard stops, with a far lower threshold than the 30% default.

title: CyberiaTrader
summary: 2008 MT4 EA that builds statistics of candle-body sizes exceeding spread over an adaptive sampling period, then enters on pattern/'pipsator' logic with optional MACD/MA/ADX/CCI/fractal vetoes; exits when profit exceeds the average 'successful' move.
red_flags: No magic number (magic 0) - FindSymbolOrder manages any order on the symbol
Signals read from still-forming bar 0 (iClose(...,0))
StaticStopLoss default 7 points - unusable on metals; BlockStopLoss input sends SL=0
Lot size from balance*Risk*leverage (margin-based, not stop-distance based); only handles USD/EUR pairs, returns 0 lots for other symbols
OrderClose/OrderSend results mostly unchecked, no retries, no lot/stops-level normalisation at send
Extern inputs (Lots, StopLoss) mutated at runtime; state such as shadow StopLevel lost on restart
Order comment 'NeuroCluster-testing-AI' is marketing only - no ML in code

ideas.name: Statistical take-profit from average favourable candle body
ideas.detail: Exit target is not fixed pips: close when open profit >= rolling mean of candle bodies that exceeded spread (per direction), and hold if the latest bar moved >4x that mean in favour (let momentum run).

ideas.name: Only count moves larger than current spread as tradable signal
ideas.detail: When building directional statistics, candle bodies smaller than Ask-Bid are discarded, so the model measures only moves that could cover costs; avoids trading noise when spread widens.

ideas.name: Stop distance from max bar range of recent window, floored at broker stop level + spread
ideas.detail: SL = max(High-Low) over the last N bars times an index, then compared against StopLevel+spread and widened if too tight before sending.

ideas.name: Per-direction manual block and exit-only switches
ideas.detail: Inputs BlockBuy/BlockSell, DisableExitBuy/Sell and ExitMarket (stop new entries, keep managing open trade) give an operator one-sided or wind-down control without removing the EA.
ideas.evidence: CyberiaTrader.mq4 inputs lines 9-22; RunPipsator() ExitMarket check

ideas.name: Outlier-move reversal toggle
ideas.detail: If the current move exceeds ReverceIndex (3x) the average same-direction move, allowed trade direction is inverted (treats extreme candle as exhaustion rather than continuation).

title: Volatility Trader and Breakout EA (X-liquidex)
summary: MT4 tick scalper: enters market in direction of current bar when price is beyond a 3-LWMA and outside Keltner channel, gated by average spread+commission; then sets SL, breakeven and tight trailing by modify; trails pending stop orders.
red_flags: Signal uses forming bar 0 (Bid vs iOpen(0), MA and Keltner at shift 0) - tick-level, heavily spread/latency sensitive, tester results unreliable
Account lock implemented as deliberate division by zero ('bar_direction /= is_ok') - crashes EA if Account_Number constant mismatches (disabled by default =0)
Order sent with SL=0, SL attached afterwards by OrderModify - position is unprotected if modify fails; StopLoss=0 disables it
Lot sizing = balance*leverage*Risk/lot size (leverage-based, ignores stop distance)
5-pip trailing and 15-pip max spread assumptions do not transfer to gold without rescaling
Persists last-history-check timestamp as the price of a chart HLINE object (fragile state store)

ideas.name: Rolling 30-tick average spread plus commission-in-price gate
ideas.detail: Keeps a 30-sample ring of Ask-Bid, averages it, adds commission converted to price units, and blocks new entries (shows 'Robot is OFF') when the all-in cost exceeds MaxSpreadWithCommission.

ideas.name: Auto-derive commission per lot from closed-trade history
ideas.detail: Scans history for a closed trade on the symbol, computes money-per-price-unit from profit/(close-open), then converts OrderCommission into price points; used so cost filter works on ECN/raw accounts without manual input.

ideas.name: Error-code-specific retry wrapper for send/modify/close/delete
ideas.detail: OrderSendEx/ModifyEx/CloseEx pre-validate stop-level distances, wait on busy trade context, and retry with per-error policies (requote: immediate retry up to 3; off-quotes: sleep 6s; timeout: sleep 70s and re-check order closed; expirations denied: drop expiration).
ideas.evidence: x_liquidex.mq4 OrderSendEx() line 696, OrderModifyEx() line 873, OrderCloseEx() line 1235

ideas.name: Trailing pending stop entry that ratchets toward price
ideas.detail: BuyStop is kept at Ask+TrailingLimit and only moved downward as price falls (SellStop mirrored), so entry triggers only on a bounce of fixed size; pending is deleted when the MA/bar filter no longer agrees.

ideas.name: Staged protection: attach SL/TP, then breakeven with offset, then tick trail
ideas.detail: Per tick in priority order: add missing SL/TP if stop-level allows; once profit >= MoveToBE move SL to open+offset; afterwards trail SL at fixed distance from price, only ever tightening.

ideas.name: Metal-aware pip definition
ideas.detail: At init, detects XAU/GOLD (pip=0.1) and XAG/SILVER (pip=0.01) by symbol name and converts all pip inputs (SL, BE, trail, spread cap, slippage) to price via that unit regardless of broker digits.

title: BreakRevertPro EA Adaptive Trading Edge for Breakout Mean Reversion
summary: MT5 EA that feeds raw close prices into Weibull/Poisson/exponential functions (statistically meaningless), buys on 'breakout', sells on 'mean reversion', fixed 0.01 lot with ATR 1.5/2.0 SL/TP; mostly scaffolding to pass MQL5 Market validation.
red_flags: Signal is pseudo-statistics: Weibull PDF evaluated on raw price levels with hard-coded shape 1.5/scale 5; lookback default 1 bar
Contains 'safety trade' code that forces a trade (no SL, magic 999999) in the tester and detects the MQL5 validator environment by balance/symbol/timeframe - backtests include artificial trades
risk_per_trade input is never used; lot is hard-coded 0.01
Direction is asymmetric: breakout only buys, mean reversion only sells
ValidateStopLoss returns 0 (no SL) when the check fails instead of rejecting the trade
Runs on every tick with bar-0 data, no new-bar gate; ATR handle created and released on every call
CountOpenPositions ignores magic number; fabricates balance 1000 when balance<10
Normalises metal volume to 3 decimals irrespective of broker lot step

ideas.name: Trade validator class: stops-level clamp with safety buffer
ideas.detail: Before sending, SL/TP are checked for correct side, then pushed out to at least StopsLevel*1.2 (min 5 points if broker reports 0) from current Bid/Ask and normalised to digits.

ideas.name: OrderCalcMargin pre-check with 15% reserve and stepwise volume reduction
ideas.detail: Computes required margin via OrderCalcMargin, requires free margin >= 1.15x, otherwise shrinks volume by 25% steps down to min lot, returning 0 (skip trade) if even min lot does not fit.

ideas.name: Consecutive-failure circuit breaker and minimum seconds between trades
ideas.detail: Counts failed order attempts; after >3 consecutive failures entries pause and timer resets; also enforces trade_delay_seconds since last successful trade to avoid order spam.

ideas.name: Throttled logging in non-visual tester
ideas.detail: Debug print wrapper emits only every 500th message when running in Strategy Tester without visual mode, with a force flag for important events, keeping tester logs small.

title: Liquidity Sweep H4 - M15 (Swing Highs and Lows) / MQL5
summary: MT5 EA storing H4 pivot highs/lows (21 bars each side) in arrays; on each closed M15 bar, if the bar wicked through a stored level but closed back inside, it fades with min lot, fixed-point SL and RR-based TP.
red_flags: No magic number, no retcode checks, no spread/session filter, no position limit
Fixed 100-point SL (about $1 on gold) regardless of volatility or the sweep wick - not viable on metals as is
Always trades minimum lot; no risk sizing
Fixed 100-element swing arrays with no bounds check (possible overflow); removal while iterating can skip levels
Swing levels held only in memory - lost on restart, not rebuilt from history
Pivot confirmation loop touches the forming H4 bar (index 0) when i==Range
SL/TP computed from current Bid/Ask without stops-level validation

ideas.name: HTF liquidity-sweep-and-reclaim entry on closed LTF bar
ideas.detail: Maintain a list of unmitigated H4 pivot highs/lows; on a closed M15 bar, sell if high > level and close < level (buy mirrored). Each level is consumed after one trade.
ideas.evidence: Sweep_H4_M15.mq5 OnTick() swing-high/low loops (close(1)/high(1) vs SwingHighs[i])

ideas.name: Level invalidation on close-through
ideas.detail: If an LTF bar closes beyond a stored swing level (true break, not a sweep), the level is deleted from the liquidity list so stale levels are never traded later.

ideas.name: Independent new-bar gates per timeframe
ideas.detail: Separate static bar counters for M15 (signal evaluation) and H4 (structure update) so structure mapping and entry logic run only once per closed bar of their own timeframe.

title: EA KCI N-Matrix engine
summary: MT5 EA computing a custom 'KCI' oscillator (z-scored efficiency ratio, deviation from mean, stdev, net move) with MTF polarity filter, slope and over-extension filters; volatility-unit SL/TP/trailing; optional averaging with 1.3x lots and basket close. File holds several commented older versions.
red_flags: Optional averaging grid with lot multiplier 1.3 up to 10 positions per direction plus optional hedge (off by default); input comment suggests 12x SL for 'grid survival'
Active version triggers on forming bar 0 ('instant trigger'), every tick - repaint/look-ahead risk; older commented versions used closed bars
OrderSend only checks boolean, not result.retcode; no stops-level or freeze-level validation
Entry gate uses PositionsTotal() for whole account, not filtered by symbol/magic
Daily limits disabled by default, held in memory only (reset on restart) and do not close open positions
Slope/distance thresholds in raw points (500/1000) are symbol-digit dependent magic numbers
Lot multiplier result normalised to 2 decimals regardless of lot step; author states EA is not production-ready
Aggressive trailing presets (0.05-0.1 volatility units) will be whipsawed by gold spread

ideas.name: Efficiency-adjusted volatility unit (KVR) for SL/TP/trail
ideas.detail: Volatility unit = stdev(close, N) * (2 - Kaufman efficiency ratio): choppy markets widen stops up to 2x stdev, clean trends tighten to 1x. All SL, TP, trailing start/step/distance and grid step are expressed in this unit.

ideas.name: Risk-percent lot from tick value and stop distance
ideas.detail: lot = balance*risk% / ((SL distance / tick size) * tick value), floored to volume step and clamped to min/max, with fallbacks to fixed lot when tick data is zero. Works correctly for metals contract sizes.

ideas.name: Over-extension (rubber band) entry filter
ideas.detail: Blocks a trend entry when price is further than a maximum distance from the rolling mean line, so the EA does not chase an exhausted move; pairs with minimum mean-slope (3-bar slope in points) momentum requirement.

ideas.name: Daily loss and intraday peak-drawdown equity lock
ideas.detail: At each new server day stores start equity and tracks the day's max equity; disables new entries when loss from day start >= X% or drawdown from the day's equity peak >= Y%, re-enabling next day.

ideas.name: Step-gated volatility trailing stop
ideas.detail: Trailing starts after profit >= start*KVR; SL is moved to price - stop*KVR only when the improvement exceeds step*KVR, limiting modify spam and broker rejections.

ideas.name: Filling-mode autodetect and net-of-cost profit accounting
ideas.detail: Chooses FOK/IOC/RETURN from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE flags before sending; basket profit sums POSITION_PROFIT + swap + commission read from deal history via HistorySelectByPosition, so targets are net of real costs.
ideas.evidence: EA_KCI_N_Matrix_engine.mq5 GetFillingMode() line 322; GetPositionCommission() line 806; CheckBasketClose() line 848

title: Trade-Arbitrage
summary: MT4 triangular/synthetic-cross arbitrage: builds every way to synthesise each pair from Market Watch currencies, compares synthetic bid vs ask in a 100ms infinite loop, and nets real-symbol volumes to open. Companion script checks net currency exposure.
red_flags: No stop loss on any leg (OrderSend with SL=0/TP=0)
Infinite while(!IsStopped()) loop in start() with Sleep(100); not tick driven
No magic number: manages and closes any order on the symbols
Legs sent sequentially without atomicity; leg risk if one fails, residual volume just retried
OrderSelect/OrderSend return values largely unchecked; fill detected by comparing last ticket
Retail single-broker latency arbitrage is unrealistic; SlipPage=0 default, MinPips 0.5
Position state held only in memory arrays (XPosition) - lost on restart
Pair names assumed 6 chars; point size guessed from price > 10

ideas.name: Per-fill slippage measurement logged on every order
ideas.detail: After each send/close, re-select the resulting order and compute signed slippage in points between requested and actual open/close price, printing it with requested volume vs filled volume.

ideas.name: Partial-fill aware volume loop
ideas.detail: Send function returns actually filled volume; caller subtracts it from remaining target and keeps the unfilled remainder as pending desired position, splitting orders above MaxLot into chunks.

ideas.name: Synthetic cross bid/ask construction
ideas.detail: Compute synthetic instrument bid/ask from two real symbols with correct side per formula (S1/S2: Bid1/Ask2 and Ask1/Bid2, S1*S2, inverses) to compare against a direct quote including spread costs.

ideas.name: Opportunity monitor with periodic statistics file
ideas.detail: Every detected opportunity is counted per combination and appended to a file with timestamp and both quotes; a ranked frequency summary is rewritten every N minutes to decide which combinations to whitelist.

ideas.name: Net currency exposure audit
ideas.detail: Script walks all open orders and sums signed volume per currency (base and quote converted) to verify the book is flat per currency; reusable as a USD/metal net exposure check.

title: Volatility Quality EA
summary: MT4 stop-and-reverse style EA: reads buy/sell arrow buffers of the custom VQ indicator (MA-smoothed volatility quality sum with point filter) on closed bar, opens one fixed-lot position, closes on opposite arrow, optional breakeven/trailing.
red_flags: StopLoss in fixed points (60) can be set to 0; not volatility scaled
MagicNumber default 0 makes it manage every order on the symbol
VQ indicator with RealTime=true recalculates bar 0 (repaints); safe only with TradeAtCloseBar=true
Bug: OP_SELLLIMIT branch sends OP_BUYLIMIT
Retry loop sleeps and retries any error without classifying; no stop-level check for market orders
Risk money management effectively disabled (mm hard-coded 0), fixed lot
Requires external iCustom indicator with 15 positional params

ideas.name: Volatility Quality direction with noise filter
ideas.detail: Cumulative sum of a per-bar quality term (MA close change normalised by true-range of MAs, times body) that is frozen when the increment is below Filter*Point; direction flips only when the sum actually moves.

ideas.name: Order wrappers with bounded retries and trade-context check
ideas.detail: OrdSend/OrdClose/OrdModify check IsTradeContextBusy/IsTradeAllowed, RefreshRates before each of up to 5 attempts, and clamp pending prices to MODE_STOPLEVEL distance.

ideas.name: Daily per-symbol trade log file
ideas.detail: Every order attempt, error description and result is appended with timestamp to a file named Symbol+tag+month+day, giving an audit trail independent of the terminal journal.

ideas.name: Breakeven then stepped trailing
ideas.detail: Moves SL to entry once profit exceeds BreakEven points, then trails by TrailingStop only when improvement exceeds TrailingStep to avoid modify spam.

title: Ilan Expert Advisor for Metatrader 4
summary: Classic Ilan 1.6 averaging martingale: opens on last two closes direction (RSI H1 filter), adds positions against the move every PipStep with lot multiplied by 1.4-1.59^n, shared TP at weighted average price plus 10 points.
red_flags: Martingale lot exponent 1.59 (1.4 in Dynamic) up to 10 levels
Averaging against the move with no broker-side SL: Stopper is computed but OrderModify passes the existing OrderStopLoss (0)
Equity stop, trailing and timeout all disabled by default
TakeProfit 10 points from basket average - tiny reward vs unbounded loss
OrderSelect/OrderModify/OrderClose results unchecked; retry loop up to 100 tries with 5s sleeps
lotdecimal hard-coded instead of volume step normalisation
In-memory state flags (LongTrade, NewOrdersPlaced) lost on restart
On gold this structure would blow up in a trending session

ideas.name: Range-derived dynamic step with clamps
ideas.detail: Step distance = (highest high - lowest low over last 24 closed bars)/3, clamped between DefaultPips/3 and DefaultPips*3; usable as a volatility-adaptive distance for scale-in spacing or minimum re-entry distance.

ideas.name: Basket loss cut versus equity high-water mark
ideas.detail: Closes all EA positions when floating basket loss exceeds TotalEquityRisk percent of the highest account equity seen (tracked while flat).

ideas.name: Momentum-extreme emergency basket exit
ideas.detail: Closes the whole basket if M15 CCI(55) exceeds +/-Drop (500) against the basket direction - an impulse/shock kill-switch independent of price distance.

title: Bollinger Band Width calculation with Neural Network using
summary: Single tanh neuron over 7 normalised Bollinger band-width values with 14 manually input weights; buys if output<0, sells if >0 on each new bar, fixed lot with fixed-pip SL/TP. No training code.
red_flags: 'Neural network' is one neuron with hand-typed/optimised weights - pure curve fit, no learning
Half the weights (odd indices) multiply inputs that are never filled
Inputs include bar 0 Bollinger values (forming bar, though read at bar open)
Normalisation formula mixes price levels with width ratio; effectively arbitrary
PositionSelect by symbol without magic check; netting-only logic
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_RETURN, deviation 100, fixed Lot=1.0 input (computed min lot unused)
No stops-level, spread or margin checks; Alert() spam each bar

ideas.name: Normalised Bollinger band-width as regime feature
ideas.detail: Uses (upper-lower)/middle over several consecutive bars as a volatility-compression feature vector; in a rules bot it can serve as a squeeze/expansion filter rather than a direction signal.

title: Three neural networks
summary: Not a neural net: three weighted sums of SMMA relative changes on H1/H4/D1 (9 optimisable weights). Opens buy if all positive, sell on an asymmetric rule, with fixed-pip SL/TP, trailing, risk-% sizing and transaction-confirmed order handling.
red_flags: 'Neural networks' are 3 linear combinations with optimiser-fitted weights - curve-fit prone
Sell rule is n1>0 && n2<0 && n3<0 (asymmetric, looks like a bug/port artefact)
No check for existing positions before opening: can stack a new position on every qualifying bar
SL/TP in fixed pips; InpStopLoss=0 disables stop
Margin check compares FreeMarginCheck with MarginCheck using ORDER_TYPE_SELL in the buy branch
Trailing only evaluated once per new bar

ideas.name: Order-in-flight guard confirmed via OnTradeTransaction
ideas.detail: After a send returning 10009, stores the order ticket and blocks all new logic until a DEAL_ENTRY_IN deal with matching order, symbol and magic arrives in OnTradeTransaction; prevents duplicate entries on async fills.

ideas.name: Freeze/stops level with spread fallback
ideas.detail: Takes max of SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL and STOPS_LEVEL; when broker reports 0 substitutes 3x current spread, then multiplies by 1.1; SL/TP distances and trailing are clamped to this level.

ideas.name: New-bar latch that re-arms on data failure
ideas.detail: Bar-time latch is reset to 0 when RefreshRates, level calculation or CopyBuffer fails, so the bar's signal is retried on the next tick instead of being silently skipped.

ideas.name: Risk-percent lot from SL distance plus margin pre-check
ideas.detail: Lot computed by CMoneyFixedMargin.CheckOpenLong/Short(price, sl) as percent risk; zero lot aborts; FreeMarginCheck performed before sending; fixed-lot mode validated against min/max/step at init.

ideas.name: Multi-timeframe slope agreement on closed bars
ideas.detail: Direction requires weighted relative slope of shifted SMMA on H1, H4 and D1 (bars 1-4 only) to share sign; usable as a higher-timeframe bias vote.

title: Simple Expert Advisor based on WPR, Bollinger Bands and ATR indicators
summary: Mean reversion: WPR turning up from oversold (closed bars) plus bar open in outer quarter of Bollinger channel. Fixed lot, max one entry per bar, adds further positions only at better prices; SL = 2.6x half BB width, TP = 1.3x ATR.
red_flags: Adds same-direction positions against the move (only when price is better than the last entry) with no cap on count - fixed-lot averaging
SL and TP are stripped on netting accounts; InpStopLoss=0 disables SL
Bug: TP branch tests InpStopLoss<0 instead of InpTakeProfit<0
Bug: sell add condition uses price_last<Ask (buy-side mirror wrong)
Default SL about 2x or more TP distance: negative reward/risk, needs very high win rate
Fixed lot, no risk-based sizing; no spread/session filter
Runs logic on every tick (no new-bar gate; relies on one-position-per-bar check)
CloseBuy/CloseSell exist but no signal exit is wired

ideas.name: Uncertain-environment check before sending
ideas.detail: Scans active market orders with own magic and symbol lacking ORDER_POSITION_ID (order sent but position not yet registered); waits up to 3x1000ms and aborts if still unresolved, preventing duplicate entries.

ideas.name: Automatic filling-mode selection
ideas.detail: Derives valid ORDER_FILLING from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE bitmask and SYMBOL_TRADE_EXEMODE (RETURN for exchange/instant, else IOC or FOK) instead of hard-coding.

ideas.name: Stop distance clamp with spread-multiple fallback
ideas.detail: SL/TP distance forced to at least StopLevel; when broker stop level is 0 uses 3x current spread as effective minimum, applied from Ask for buys and Bid for sells.

ideas.name: Volume normalisation plus SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT check
ideas.detail: Lots floored to step and clamped to min/max; CTrade.CheckVolume reduces to affordable margin; total open volume per direction plus new lot is checked against the symbol's aggregate volume limit.

ideas.name: Volatility-derived SL/TP from band width and ATR
ideas.detail: SL distance = multiplier x half Bollinger channel width in points, TP = multiplier x ATR; both adapt to current volatility (ratio must be re-tuned for positive expectancy).

ideas.name: One-entry-per-bar and better-price-only re-entry gate
ideas.detail: Checks the newest own position's open time via iBarShift to block a second entry in the same bar, and requires the new entry price to improve on the last entry.

title: Visualization of Optimization Results in Real Time
summary: MetaQuotes demo: standard Moving Average EA (price crossing shifted SMA, no SL/TP, lot reduced after losing streak) plus a frame-based library that streams each optimisation pass's balance curve and statistics to a live chart panel.
red_flags: Trading EA opens with SL=0/TP=0; exit only on opposite MA cross
No magic number; PositionSelect by symbol (netting only)
Lot sized from free margin fraction, not from stop distance
New-bar detection via tick_volume>1 is unreliable on live feeds
Trade results unchecked; strategy is a teaching example, not viable alone

ideas.name: Composite OnTester fitness
ideas.detail: Custom optimisation criterion = |Sharpe x net profit| with the sign of profit, so losing passes rank negative and high-profit low-Sharpe passes are penalised.

ideas.name: Per-pass balance curve and stats shipped via frames
ideas.detail: OnTester rebuilds the closed-deal balance curve from history and sends it with profit, PF, recovery factor, trades, equity DD% through FrameAdd; OnTesterPass reads FrameNext/FrameInputs to chart all passes live and replay them.

ideas.name: Lot decrease after consecutive losses
ideas.detail: Counts consecutive losing deals on the symbol from history and reduces lot by lot*losses/DecreaseFactor when more than one loss in a row (anti-martingale throttle), then normalises to step/min/max.

ideas.name: Optimisation dashboard widgets
ideas.detail: Bitmap-label multi-series chart, two-column table and coloured pass progress bar classes drawn on the optimiser chart to show profitable vs losing pass ratio in real time.

title: KSQ Fair Value Gap EA FVG with Regime Detection and Dual SL TP Mode
summary: Tracks 3-candle fair value gaps on closed bars, enters at market when a closed bar retests the zone with a rejection candle, gated by HTF EMA50/200 and ADX/DI regime. ATR or point SL/TP, breakeven, partial close, ATR trail, daily/total DD entry block.
red_flags: All logic including trailing, breakeven and partial close runs only once per new bar
Filling mode hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK (will fail on many gold brokers)
Drawdown baselines and FVG isTraded state are in memory only - reset on restart; start balance re-read at every init
Drawdown breach only blocks new entries (and also stops position management); does not close positions
Regime filter reads bar 0 of HTF EMA and ADX (forming bar values)
UpdateFillStatus tests the just-opened bar only, so mitigated zones can stay active
Partial close can repeat on later bars (guarded only by volume > minLot+step)
Risk lot is raised to min lot even if that exceeds the risk budget; lots rounded to 2 decimals
No spread filter; session filter off by default; trade retcode not inspected
Dashboard drawn only in OnChartEvent

ideas.name: FVG zone registry with one-trade-per-zone flag
ideas.detail: Scans closed bars for low[i]>high[i-2] (bullish) or high[i]<low[i-2] gaps above a minimum size, stores zones keyed by middle-bar time with isFilled/isTraded flags and FIFO cap, so each gap is traded at most once.

ideas.name: Closed-bar retest with rejection candle confirmation
ideas.detail: Entry only when the last closed bar's low dips into the bullish zone (tolerance of one zone height below) and that bar closes bullish above the zone's lower edge; mirrored for shorts.

ideas.name: Combined HTF EMA stack and ADX/DI regime gate
ideas.detail: Longs require price > HTF EMA50 > EMA200 and ADX >= threshold with +DI > -DI; shorts the mirror; otherwise regime is neutral and no trades are taken. Filter mode selectable (none/EMA/ADX/both).

ideas.name: ATR breakeven with buffer, partial at mid-TP or R multiple, ATR trail
ideas.detail: SL moves to entry plus buffer points after price advances N x ATR; closes a percentage at 50% of TP distance or at a fixed R multiple; remaining volume trailed at ATR multiple, never moved backwards and kept beyond stops level.

ideas.name: SL/TP minimum distance = stops level + spread + 1 point, with 120% margin pre-check
ideas.detail: Stop and target distances are floored at broker stops level plus current spread plus one point; OrderCalcMargin must be covered by free margin with a 20% buffer before sending.

ideas.name: Daily and total equity drawdown entry lock
ideas.detail: Daily baseline balance reset on server-day change; new entries blocked when (baseline - equity)/baseline exceeds daily % or when equity drawdown from start balance exceeds total %; throttled hourly log. Needs persistence to survive restarts.

title: Self Optimizing RSI or MFI Trader
summary: On each new bar re-simulates the last 144 bars for every RSI/MFI level 0-100 with the current ATR SL/TP, picks the most profitable crossing level per side, trades only the side whose in-sample profit is higher. ATR SL/TP, risk-% lots, breakeven.
red_flags: Walk-forward 'optimisation' is in-sample fit on only 144 bars (few trades per level) - high overfit risk
inAggressive=true enters every bar with no signal
OrderSend result not checked, no retcode/retry handling; OrdersTotal()==0 check ignores magic/symbol
SL for sells computed as Ask+SL, buys Bid-SL (spread applied twice)
Internal simulation uses close prices only (ignores intrabar SL/TP hits and spread)
Lot formula uses tick value without tick size (wrong on metals where tick size != point)
BreakEven loop filters by magic but not symbol

ideas.name: Rolling in-EA threshold re-optimisation
ideas.detail: Each new bar, replay the last N bars for every candidate oscillator level using the live SL/TP distances, score each level by simulated P/L, then trade the best level. Reusable as adaptive threshold selection if paired with out-of-sample validation and minimum trade count.

ideas.name: Direction bias from recent simulated long vs short profitability
ideas.detail: Compare simulated profit of best buy level vs best sell level over the lookback window; only allow entries on the side that performed better recently (sellProfits>buyProfits gate). Acts as a self-calibrating regime/direction filter.

ideas.name: ATR-multiple SL/TP with risk-% lot and hard cap
ideas.detail: SL = 2xATR, TP = 7xATR on closed bar; lot = balance*risk% / (SL points * tick value), risk percent clamped by compile-time MAX_PERCENT=10, then clamped/rounded to min/max/step volume.

ideas.name: Breakeven with padding honoring stop level
ideas.detail: When price is trigger points in profit and beyond broker MODE_STOPLEVEL, move SL to open price plus padding; only modifies if the new SL improves the current one and SL is still on the loss side.

ideas.name: Pre-trade volume and free-margin validation
ideas.detail: CheckVolumeValue verifies min/max/step multiple and CheckMoneyForTrade uses AccountFreeMarginCheck before sending; order skipped with a description string if invalid.

title: Multi-Trendlines Breakout
summary: Semi-manual tool: tracks every trendline the user draws on the chart, alerts (popup/email/push) when bar-0 price crosses a line, optionally sends a fixed-lot market order with fixed SL/TP plus optional stop-order pyramiding and simple trailing.
red_flags: Magic number 0 - no ownership; trailing loop modifies every order on the symbol including manual ones
Breakout detected on tick price of forming bar (no close confirmation)
Default lot 1.0 fixed, no risk sizing
OrderSend/OrderModify results unchecked, no stop-level checks
ProcessTrailingStop reads OrderStopLoss() before OrderSelect; breakeven code adds iDigiExtend (10) as a price, not points - bug
OnDeinit deletes ALL arrows and trendlines on chart when EA is removed
Hour filter uses TimeLocal (PC clock) not server time

ideas.name: User-drawn trendlines as live trigger levels
ideas.detail: OnChartEvent captures OBJECT_CREATE/DELETE/DRAG for OBJ_TREND, keeps a registry with pending/alerted state per line, reads the line's price at the current bar via ObjectGetValueByShift and fires once on cross. Lets a discretionary trader arm levels for the bot.

ideas.name: Trigger state persisted in chart object properties
ideas.detail: Alerted/pending state is encoded in the colour of a companion arrow object, so on re-init (timeframe change, restart) the EA rebuilds which lines were already triggered from the chart rather than from memory.

ideas.name: Breakout with extra threshold and stop-order add-ons in profit direction
ideas.detail: Cross requires line price between previous tick price and current price plus PriceDelta buffer; optional N extra buy-stop/sell-stop orders at step intervals beyond the entry (pyramiding only if price keeps going).

ideas.name: Multi-channel breakout notification
ideas.detail: On trigger, sends popup, sound, push notification and an email containing symbol, timeframe, current price, line price and server time; each channel individually switchable.

title: SelfLearningExperts
summary: Not a neural net: builds renko-like binary up/down patterns at 20 brick sizes, opens virtual trades per pattern with symmetric SL/TP, keeps exponentially-forgotten up/down win counts, and trades when a pattern's probability exceeds 0.8 with >10 samples.
red_flags: Fixed-size 1-indexed arrays (5000x30x3) - NN>12 or Nidelt>29 overflows
File handles never checked (FileOpen may return INVALID_HANDLE); writes to COMMON folder on every signal
No magic number, netting-style Pos.Select(_Symbol) only
Tick-driven learning from Ask only; results depend heavily on tick data quality in tester
Learning starts empty unless ReadHistory=true; symmetric SL=TP=250 points with 80% probability threshold is an unvalidated statistical claim
Fixed lot, no risk sizing; CheckSetBuyCloseSignal2 passes wrong reference (sell flag) - copy/paste bug
Trade retcodes not inspected

ideas.name: Online pattern-probability table via virtual trades
ideas.detail: Encode the last N price-step directions as a bit pattern index; for each pattern open a virtual trade with symmetric SL/TP, update up/down counters when it resolves, and trade only patterns with probability > threshold and a minimum sample count.

ideas.name: Exponential forgetting of learned statistics
ideas.detail: On each virtual-trade outcome, both counters are divided by a factor slightly above 1 (forg=1.05) before incrementing the winner, so old evidence decays and the table adapts to regime change without a fixed window.

ideas.name: Price-step (renko-like) sampling at multiple brick sizes
ideas.detail: Pattern points are appended only when price moves by delta*ip points from the last stored point, for ip=1..Nidelt, giving time-independent patterns at multiple volatility scales evaluated in parallel.

ideas.name: Persist learned state to file with throttled saves
ideas.detail: Probability tables are written to a per-symbol file; live saves only after >10 changes, tester saves once at OnDeinit, and optional load at init so learning survives restarts and can be pre-trained in the tester.

ideas.name: Stops-level pre-validation of SL/TP
ideas.detail: Before opening, computes minimum legal SL/TP from SYMBOL stops level and refuses the trade if requested stops are too close; trailing only modifies if new SL is outside the stops-level band.

title: Example of A Simple Breakout Trading Robot
summary: Teaching example: buys when the forming bar's price exceeds the previous bar's high, sells below previous low, closes on the opposite condition. Fixed lot, SL/TP hard-coded to 0. Most of the file is an error-description table.
red_flags: No stop loss at all (StopLoss/TakeProfit inputs commented out and fixed at 0)
Signal from forming bar 0 on every tick - whipsaw/flip-flop entries
Lot normalised with price Digits instead of volume step
CloseAll loops filter magic but not symbol
No spread, session or volatility filter

ideas.name: Two-step market order then attach stops (ECN-style)
ideas.detail: Sends the market order with no SL/TP, re-selects the ticket, then sets SL/TP relative to the actual fill price via OrderModify, logging a decoded error on failure. Useful for market-execution brokers where stops must be relative to the real fill.

title: EURUSD breakout
summary: Session range breakout: at a set hour takes high/low of the previous 24 bars as the 'EU range'; if the range is small (<72 pips), enters when a completed bar is entirely beyond the range, max one buy and one sell per day, fixed SL/TP.
red_flags: Hard-coded EURUSD pip thresholds and server-hour assumptions (72/12/15 pips) - curve-fit, not portable to metals as-is
Default fixed lot 1.0, no risk sizing
Day state (bought/sold/range) in static variables - lost on restart, can re-enter same day
Hard-coded magic, no spread filter, no stops-level check
TP only 15 pips with 12 pip SL - cost sensitive

ideas.name: Compressed-range precondition for session breakout
ideas.detail: Only arm the breakout if the pre-session range (highest-lowest of the previous N bars) is below a threshold; wide pre-session ranges are skipped for the day. For metals the threshold should be ATR-relative rather than fixed pips.

ideas.name: Whole-bar-outside-range confirmation
ideas.detail: Buy requires the last completed bar's LOW to be above range top plus a buffer (sell: bar HIGH below range bottom), i.e. a full bar accepted outside the box, not just a wick or close - filters false breaks.

ideas.name: One long and one short per day with day-of-week switch
ideas.detail: bought/sold flags reset at hour 0 limit the strategy to a single attempt per direction per day; Monday trading is optional and weekends excluded.

ideas.name: Filling-mode autodetect and deal confirmation
ideas.detail: OnInit probes SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE and sets FOK, else IOC, else RETURN; after Buy/Sell checks ResultDeal()!=0 and logs retcode before marking the day's direction as used. Also CheckVolume against free margin before sending.

title: Self Adapting EA - Deep Learning System
summary: No deep learning. Encodes each closed candle as a digit 0-9 (direction x range-% bucket), scores 7-candle patterns via virtual buy/sell trades (+1 win, -3 loss), and trades when the current pattern is among the top-10 scored. No inputs exposed.
red_flags: 'Deep learning' claim is false - simple pattern frequency table
All parameters are non-input globals; RiskPercent=15 with lot = free margin/100000*15 (not risk-based)
SL 60 pips vs TP 19 pips (inverse R:R), magic numbers
No magic number (NULL), OrderSend result ignored, no position limit
Seventeen 1,000,000-element arrays; O(1e6) loops per tick and nested 1e6 x 1e6 worst case - extremely slow
Range buckets are fixed % of price tuned for FX (0.04-0.40%), pip conversion returns 0 for 2-digit symbols like gold - SL/TP would be at entry price
Learning state not persisted; restarts from zero; virtual order slots never recycled
Skips all trading and learning on Fridays without closing positions

ideas.name: Candle tokenisation by direction and range bucket
ideas.detail: Each closed bar becomes one symbol from a 10-letter alphabet (bull/bear x 5 high-low range-% buckets); the last 7 symbols form a pattern key. A compact discretisation usable as a feature for a pattern-statistics filter if buckets are ATR-normalised.

ideas.name: Asymmetric virtual-trade scoring of patterns
ideas.detail: For every pattern occurrence a virtual buy and sell with SL/TP are tracked; the pattern's score gets +1 on virtual TP and -3 on virtual SL, so only patterns with a strongly positive expectancy accumulate a tradable score.

title: Universal Breakout Study
summary: Daily time-box breakout: builds high/low of the last N H1 candles before a GMT-defined hour, places buy-stop and sell-stop with expiry, SL/TP as box-size coefficients, risk-% lots, OCO cancel, breakeven, trailing and time-based exit.
red_flags: LoopPositions() manages/closes ALL account positions - no symbol or magic filter (will trail and time-close other EAs' and manual trades)
Balance for risk sizing captured once in OnInit, never refreshed
StopLoss type can be 'Null'; then CalcLot falls back to min lot
Fixed GMT offset input - no DST handling
Magic number and slippage (0) hard-coded, not inputs
last_box_time not persisted - restart mid-day can place a duplicate order pair
Default trailing 12 / BE 22 'points' multiplied by 10 on 3/5-digit symbols - FX-tuned, too tight for gold
If margin check fails for buy-stop the sell-stop is skipped too (early return)

ideas.name: Reusable daily box session class with weekend skipping
ideas.detail: CBoxSession computes box high/low from N candles ending at a GMT hour (converted by offset), skips weekend bars when counting candles, tracks next box time, per-side cancel flags with reasons and expiry, and rebuilds itself on init from history.

ideas.name: Pending stop pair at box edges with broker-side expiry and OCO
ideas.detail: Buy-stop at box high + shift and sell-stop at box low - shift, ORDER_TIME_SPECIFIED expiry at box end + N minutes; once a position exists the opposite pending order with same magic/symbol is deleted.

ideas.name: SL/TP as fraction of box size with risk-% lot
ideas.detail: SL = k_SL x box height, TP = k_TP x box height (volatility-adaptive without ATR); lot = risk amount / (SL points x tickValue/tickSize x point), floored to volume step and clamped to min/max.

ideas.name: Time exit conditional on minimum profit
ideas.detail: After a position has been open Market_Minute minutes, close it as soon as floating profit in points is >= Close_Level (0 = at breakeven or better); losing trades are left to SL. Cuts stalled breakouts.

ideas.name: Breakeven plus stepped trailing with stops-level validation
ideas.detail: BE moves SL to open+offset after a profit threshold; trailing starts after start+distance profit and modifies only when new SL improves by at least TraillingStep and is outside SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL - avoids modify spam and invalid-stops errors.

ideas.name: Pending-order placement guards
ideas.detail: Skips a stop order if entry is within stops level of current Ask/Bid, checks OrderCalcMargin against free margin and a minimum equity floor before sending, and gates by per-weekday enable switches based on the box date.

title: SMC Liquidity Sweep Scalper (Order Block EA with Live Win-Rate Tracking)
summary: Closed-bar logic: detects fractal swing highs/lows, waits for a bar that wicks beyond the swing by >=0.15 ATR and closes back inside, then a confirmation close beyond that candle's body within 3 bars; enters with SL beyond sweep extreme, 2R TP, risk-% lots.
red_flags: HTF trend filter reads forming HTF bar 0 (close vs EMA) - minor intrabar repaint
Trend filter fails open when indicator data is unavailable
Swing/pending-setup state and win-rate counters are in memory only - lost on restart
PositionSelect(_Symbol) ticket recovery assumes netting / single position per symbol
Fixed max-spread default (25 points) is FX-scale and would block gold on many brokers unless retuned
No stops-level check on SL/TP; no breakeven or trailing, no daily loss limit
Win-rate 'tracking' is display only, does not influence trading

ideas.name: ATR-qualified liquidity sweep with rejection close
ideas.detail: Track latest confirmed fractal swing (N bars each side). A sweep requires the closed bar's wick to exceed the swing by >= k x ATR AND its close back inside the level; each swing can be swept only once (swept flag).

ideas.name: Two-stage setup with confirmation window and momentum check
ideas.detail: After the sweep, store the sweep candle body as the order block; enter only if a later bar closes beyond the body within InpMaxConfirmationBars, and that confirmation bar's range is >= 0.3 ATR; otherwise the setup expires.

ideas.name: Reject trades whose SL is too small vs ATR and vs spread
ideas.detail: Structural SL (sweep extreme +/- 0.1 ATR buffer) must be >= 0.5 ATR and >= 3 x current spread, else skip: prevents noise-level stops and trades where cost dominates the edge. Plus absolute max-spread gate.

ideas.name: Risk-% sizing that skips instead of rounding up
ideas.detail: valuePerPoint = tickValue x point/tickSize; lot = risk$ / (SL points x valuePerPoint), floored to step; if below min lot returns 0 and the trade is skipped rather than forced to min lot (which would exceed the risk budget).

ideas.name: Per-setup-type net win-rate from deal history
ideas.detail: When the tracked ticket disappears, HistorySelectByPosition sums profit+swap+commission of all deals, classifies win/loss per setup type (bullish/bearish) and annotates the chart rectangle with the outcome and running win-rate.

ideas.name: Session window supporting overnight wrap and HTF EMA bias
ideas.detail: InSession() handles start<=end and wrap-around (start>end) hour windows on server time; direction filter requires HTF close above/below a 50 EMA on a configurable higher timeframe.

title: PulseStrike Scalper - Statistical Burst Detection EA
summary: Tick scalper: keeps a 4-second rolling mid-price window, samples window returns into a 120-sample baseline, enters when the current move's z-score exceeds 3 (momentum or fade mode). ATR-based SL/TP attached after fill, daily trade cap and daily loss stop.
red_flags: Tick-driven with 1-second TimeCurrent resolution - backtest results depend on real-tick quality and latency; not reproducible on OHLC modelling
SL/TP attached after the market fill (brief unprotected window), though it closes the position if attach fails
Daily loss limit uses balance not equity and is not persisted - restart resets day-start balance and trade counter
Baseline stats lost on restart; z-score from only >=20 samples of non-overlapping 4s windows (~80s) is noisy
TP 0.35 ATR vs SL 0.55 ATR needs >61% win rate before costs
PositionSelect(_Symbol) assumes one position per symbol (netting)
Fixed max spread 20 points and 5-point slippage are FX-scale for gold

ideas.name: Z-score burst detector on short tick-window returns
ideas.detail: Maintain rolling tick buffer of the last W seconds of mid price; every W seconds sample the window return into a fixed-length baseline; signal when current window move is > k standard deviations from the baseline mean. Switchable momentum/fade.

ideas.name: Fill-then-attach stops with fail-safe close
ideas.detail: Market order sent without stops; SL/TP computed from the ACTUAL open price and attached via PositionModify; if the modify fails the position is immediately closed so no trade is ever left without a stop.

ideas.name: Daily trade cap and daily loss lock from day-start balance
ideas.detail: CheckDailyReset keys on server date string, snapshots day-start balance and zeroes the trade counter; new entries are blocked once balance drop >= X% of day-start balance or trades today >= cap. Should be persisted and equity-based in a new bot.

ideas.name: Minimum stop distance from max(stops level, freeze level) x 1.5
ideas.detail: SL and TP distances are floored at 1.5 x the larger of SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL and SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL, avoiding invalid-stops rejections when ATR-based distances are tiny.

ideas.name: TP-to-spread ratio gate and entry cooldown
ideas.detail: Entry rejected if TP distance < 3 x current spread (cost would dominate) or spread above absolute cap; a cooldown in seconds between entries prevents rapid-fire re-entry on the same burst.

title: MA + Envelope Breakouts
summary: Three copy-pasted 'cycles' (EMA100, two envelope widths): while previous close and current open are beyond the line, opens another fixed-lot position EVERY new bar with no SL/TP; closes the whole side's basket at an equity-% target or loss threshold.
red_flags: No broker-side stop loss on any position; only a software basket equity stop
Unlimited position stacking - one new order every bar while price stays beyond the MA, regardless of floating loss (no max positions)
Default risk_percent=99 with target 1%: basket stop is effectively account wipe-out (buy side of cycle 1 divides by 1000 instead of 100 - inconsistent bug)
MA/envelope read from forming bar 0
Profit/close loops filter by magic only, not symbol; trade results never checked; no filling-mode setup
New-bar detection via comparing bar open price equality (fails when two bars share the same open)
All cycle state in memory - restart loses basket reference equity and counters
Same code triplicated instead of parameterised

ideas.name: Per-strategy basket equity target/stop by magic number
ideas.detail: On the first order of a cycle snapshot account equity; compute target and stop equity levels; each tick sum profit+swap of positions with that magic and direction and close the whole basket when either level is reached, then lock that direction until the opposite signal.
ideas.evidence: FC_Env_Breakout.mq5 OnTick() cycle1 block, MyAccountProfit_Buy(), CloseAllByMagic()

ideas.name: OrderCalcMargin pre-check and volume clamp
ideas.detail: Before each order the lot is clamped to min/max and rounded to step, and required margin from OrderCalcMargin is compared to free margin; order skipped with a log line if insufficient.

title: Metatrader Expert Advisor e-Regr  and Metatrader  Indicator i-Regr
summary: Fades touches of a polynomial-regression channel (i-Regr, degree 3, 250 bars): buy when bar-0 low hits lower band, sell at upper band, exit at midline. Fixed lot, time window, optional fixed-point trailing.
red_flags: StopLoss defaults to 0, so by default there is no broker-side stop; exit relies on the midline only
Signals from forming bar 0 against a regression channel that is refit every bar (repaints), so backtests are optimistic
Hard-coded magic number: yesterday's D1 range > 150 points closes everything and blocks trading (meaningless on gold)
OrderModify in trailing is unchecked, no stops-level or lot normalisation
No new-bar discipline, runs every tick

ideas.name: One entry per bar via open+history scan
ideas.detail: OrdersCountBar0 counts own-magic orders in both open trades and history whose open time >= current bar open; any hit blocks re-entry. Restart-safe because it is derived from broker records, not from a static variable.

ideas.name: Trade window string with midnight wrap
ideas.detail: Parses 'HH:MM-HH:MM', builds today's start/end datetimes and handles windows that cross midnight (tm1 > tm2 uses OR logic). Simple single-input session filter.

ideas.name: Previous-day range kill filter
ideas.detail: If yesterday's D1 high-low exceeds a threshold, flatten all positions and skip the day. Reusable if the threshold is ATR-relative rather than a fixed 150 points: stand aside for mean reversion after abnormal-range days.

ideas.name: Channel midline as mean-reversion exit
ideas.detail: Longs are closed as soon as Bid >= regression midline, shorts when Bid <= midline; the function returns the remaining count so no new entry is attempted until closes are confirmed.

title: Pinball machine
summary: Random-entry toy: each tick draws random numbers, opens buy or sell when two draws match, with random SL and TP of 100-1000 points. No strategy, no position limit. Useful only as a random-entry baseline.
red_flags: Entries are purely random (MathRand) with random SL/TP; no edge
No cap on number of open positions; can stack unlimited trades at fixed 0.3 lots
Seeded with TimeLocal so results are not reproducible
No lot normalisation or stops-level check

ideas.name: Error-class-specific retry policy
ideas.detail: Order send loop with N tries that maps error codes to actions: fatal codes (account disabled, invalid account) set a global disable flag; no-connection/invalid-volume long pause and abort; requote retries immediately; trade-context-busy waits until free.

ideas.name: Timeout de-duplication check
ideas.detail: After a timeout-type error the code waits, then checks whether a position with the same symbol/type/magic opened at or after the request time already exists before retrying, preventing duplicate fills.

ideas.name: Market-execution two-step SL/TP
ideas.detail: MarketWatch flag sends the order with no stops and then attaches SL/TP by modify with its own retry loop, for brokers that reject stops on market-execution orders.

ideas.name: Random-entry benchmark
ideas.detail: A random-entry EA using the same SL/TP and cost model serves as a null hypothesis: a real strategy must beat it in the tester to show the edge is in the signal, not in the exit geometry.

title: Support Vector Machine Learning Trader
summary: Demo wrapper around a closed-source svMachineTool.ex5: trains two SVMs at init on 7 indicators, classifies each new bar, opens fixed 1-lot trades and places paired pending stop/limit orders as synthetic SL/TP.
red_flags: All ML logic is in an imported closed binary (svMachineTool.ex5); cannot be audited and is not included
Positions opened with SL=0/TP=0; protection is via separate pending orders whose placement result is never checked
tickets[] array is indexed by ticket number (resized to ticket+1): breaks or exhausts memory with real ticket numbers; state lost on restart leaving orphan pending orders
OnTrade deletes any pending order on the account without a cached pair, with no magic or symbol filter
Fixed 1.0 lot, no magic number, stacks trades every bar up to an exposure cap
Trained once at init on 100 points, never retrained, no out-of-sample check

ideas.name: Triple-barrier label generation
ideas.detail: Training labels come from hypothetical trades: a bar is positive if TP is hit before SL within a maximum holding time (hours). Separate models for buy and sell. A sound labelling scheme for any ML filter.

ideas.name: Total exposure cap before entry
ideas.detail: Sums volume of outstanding orders and refuses new entries once aggregate exposure exceeds risk_exp lots. Concept reusable as a max-total-lots gate, computed from positions instead.

title: Breakout Bars Trend EA
summary: Trades reversals of the custom BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 indicator (not included) on closed bars, optionally only after N consecutive losing virtual signals. One position, SL/TP in points or percent of price, closes on opposite reversal.
red_flags: Depends on an external custom indicator not in the bundle
Fixed lot (default 1.0), no risk-based sizing
No magic number; uses PositionSelect(_Symbol), netting-style only
PositionOpen return is checked but retcode is not inspected; no filling-mode handling
'Enter after N losses' filter is a gambler's-fallacy style rule unless validated

ideas.name: SL/TP as percent of price
ideas.detail: Stop and target distances can be expressed as a percentage of entry price ((price/100)*distance) instead of points, so parameters stay valid as gold moves from 2000 to 4000 and transfer between gold and silver.

ideas.name: Clamp SL/TP to stops level
ideas.detail: SL is taken as the further of the computed stop and Bid/Ask minus SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, TP likewise, so orders are never rejected for invalid stops.

ideas.name: Virtual-signal loss-streak gate
ideas.detail: Replays past indicator reversals over history, computes each virtual trade's close-to-close result, and only allows a live entry after N consecutive losing virtual signals. A mechanism for tracking shadow-trade outcomes without real orders.

ideas.name: Bar timestamp committed only on success
ideas.detail: The processed-bar time is updated only after the open/close succeeds; on failure the function returns early so the same bar's signal is retried on the next tick.

ideas.name: Volume normalisation by step digits
ideas.detail: Clamps volume to min/max and rounds to digits derived from log10(1/volume step), avoiding invalid-volume rejections.

title: CashMachine 5min
summary: M5 oscillator scalper: buys when DeMarker crosses up 0.30 and Stochastic crosses up 20 on the forming bar (mirror for sells). No stop at entry; software-side hidden SL/TP and three-step profit lock by modifying SL.
red_flags: Position opened with SL=0/TP=0; the 'hidden' stop only works while the terminal is connected and ticking
Signals compare bar 0 with bar 1 on every tick (intrabar, repainting crossings)
Hard-coded magic offset 13 in lock levels; lock distance widens at higher tiers
PositionModify and PositionClose results unchecked; modify is re-sent every tick while in a tier
Fixed lot, fixed pip distances tuned for 2008 FX majors; no spread or session filter

ideas.name: Tiered profit lock
ideas.detail: Three profit thresholds (20/35/50 pips); on reaching each tier a broker-side SL is placed behind price, converting an unprotected trade into a locked-profit one. Reusable if tiers are ATR multiples and SL only ratchets forward.

ideas.name: Hidden SL/TP over broker stops
ideas.detail: EA closes at virtual stop/target levels not shown to the broker. Only safe as a tighter inner layer on top of a wider hard stop, which this EA lacks.

ideas.name: Dual-oscillator threshold-cross confirmation
ideas.detail: Entry requires two independent oscillators (DeMarker 0.30/0.70 and Stochastic 20/80) to cross out of the extreme zone on the same bar, reducing single-indicator noise. Should be evaluated on closed bars.

ideas.name: Zero-quote guard
ideas.detail: RefreshRates wrapper fails if Ask or Bid is zero, and every trade action is skipped on failure, avoiding orders computed from empty quotes at startup or during feed gaps.

title: MTC Neural network plus MACD
summary: Not a neural network: three hand-weighted linear 'perceptrons' on price differences, weights set by optimizer inputs, combined with a MACD cross. One position, fixed lot, SL/TP attached; each perceptron carries its own SL/TP.
red_flags: Weights are 12+ optimizer inputs with no training or validation: pure curve fitting
Bug: perceptron1 uses x12 for w3 and w4, so x13/x14 inputs do nothing
MACD read at index 0 and 2 and iClose(0) on the just-opened bar (effectively the open price)
Fixed lot, fixed pip SL/TP with 3/5-digit adjust that mis-scales gold
Sleep(30000) inside OnTick on failure; no stops-level or volume checks; retcode not inspected
Sell branch of Supervisor can only trigger from perceptron1 < 0, asymmetric logic

ideas.name: Trade-permission pre-check chain
ideas.detail: Before trading, checks terminal autotrading, program trade permission, account expert permission and account trade permission (investor-password detection), with a distinct message for each.

ideas.name: Reset bar latch to retry failed entry
ideas.detail: On order failure or trading-not-allowed the stored bar time is reset to 0 so the same bar's signal is re-evaluated on a later tick rather than lost until the next bar.

ideas.name: Per-signal-source SL/TP profile
ideas.detail: A supervisor picks which sub-model fired and loads that model's own stop and target (sl1/tp1 vs sl2/tp2) before sending the order, so different setups get different exit geometry.

title: Easy Range Breakout EA - MT5
summary: Builds a time-window range (default 01:00-06:00 server) from M1 highs/lows; after it ends, one trade per day on an M15 close beyond the range. SL at opposite range edge, TP one range width, flat at end hour. Minimum lot only.
red_flags: Bug: stops-level check multiplies the enum constant SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL by _Point instead of calling SymbolInfoInteger
No magic number; end-of-day loop closes every position on the account, all symbols, including manual trades
Lot is always the symbol minimum; no risk sizing
trade.Buy/Sell result unchecked yet the daily trade flag is cleared anyway
isTrade/range state is in memory only; a restart re-enables trading and can take a second trade the same day
No new-bar gate: range recomputed and chart objects touched every tick; server-time hours with no DST handling; no range-width or spread filter
SL at opposite range edge means risk is unbounded by design when the range is wide

ideas.name: Session range breakout on closed bar
ideas.detail: Range high/low from M1 data between two clock times; entry only when a completed M15 bar closes outside the range, not on a tick pierce, which filters wick fakeouts typical of gold at the Asian range.

ideas.name: Range-proportional SL/TP
ideas.detail: Stop at the opposite range boundary and target at one range width beyond the breakout edge, so exits scale with the day's actual volatility rather than fixed points.

ideas.name: Time-based flat and one trade per day
ideas.detail: A daily flag permits one entry per day, reset when the range-start datetime changes; all positions are closed after a configurable end time so nothing is held through rollover.

ideas.name: Tick-size rounding of prices
ideas.detail: SL/TP are rounded to SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE rather than to digits, which is required on metals and CFDs where tick size differs from point.

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin check
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin for the intended type/lot/price is compared with free margin before sending; insufficient margin skips the trade and ends trading for the day.

title: Easy Range Breakout EA - MT5
summary: Byte-identical duplicate of 68764 (same Range_BreakOut_EA_1_02.mq5): time-window range from M1 data, one M15 close-breakout trade per day, SL at opposite edge, TP one range width, flat at end hour, minimum lot.
red_flags: Duplicate listing of 68764; file is byte-identical
Bug: stops-level check uses the enum constant SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL instead of its value
No magic number; end-of-day loop closes every position on the account
Minimum lot only, unchecked order result, in-memory daily state lost on restart
No DST handling, no range-width or spread filter

title: SuperTrend_Amarnath_Kondiyan_Mohan
summary: Opens a new fixed-lot position on every bar in the closed-bar SuperTrend direction with no stop, building baskets on both sides. Closes each side at a basket profit target; global stop defaults to 99% of balance.
red_flags: Adds one position every bar without limit other than broker volume limit and margin
No per-position stop; old opposite-side basket stays open after trend flips (hedged losers)
Default global loss limit is 99% of balance: effectively no protection
Basket TP of 1% with unbounded basket loss gives a negative-skew equity curve
HTF filter only blocks scale-ins, not the first position in a new direction
Close loops do not check results or retry; global stop is software-side only
Recomputes SuperTrend over 1500 bars on each new bar for each timeframe

ideas.name: Self-contained closed-bar SuperTrend
ideas.detail: SuperTrend direction computed in-EA from copied HL2 and ATR with ratcheting bands, returning the state of bar 1 only. No external indicator dependency and no repaint. Usable as trend state or regime filter.

ideas.name: Higher-timeframe SuperTrend agreement gate
ideas.detail: The same SuperTrend routine is run on a higher timeframe (H4) with its own ATR handle; additions are blocked when the two trends disagree. Better applied to all entries.

ideas.name: Per-direction basket profit and global loss close
ideas.detail: Each tick sums profit+swap+commission of own-magic positions per side; closes a side at its target and everything at a global loss, target expressed as percent of balance or fixed currency.

ideas.name: Filling-mode auto-detect
ideas.detail: Reads SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE at init and selects FOK, else IOC, else RETURN, avoiding unsupported-filling rejections across brokers.

ideas.name: Symbol volume-limit and margin pre-checks
ideas.detail: Before each order: sums own open volume and compares against SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT, then OrderCalcMargin against free margin; skips the trade rather than generating a server error. Lot rounded to step and clamped to min/max.

ideas.name: Bar latch committed after valid calculation
ideas.detail: New-bar detection uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE and the latch is only advanced once the indicator calculation succeeds, so a bar with unavailable history is retried on the next tick.

title: Viral (1M+ views) 4 Hour Range Strategy coded and tested
summary: Marks the first 4 hours of the New York day (00:00-04:00 NY) as a range on M5. Trades failed breakouts: M5 close back inside after closing outside. SL at the excursion extreme, TP 2R, fixed lot, one position.
red_flags: Title is marketing; name says breakout but logic is a failed-breakout re-entry
No magic number; uses account-wide PositionsTotal()==0 so any other trade blocks it
Fixed lot although SL distance varies per trade, so money risk is inconsistent
Trade.Buy/Sell result not checked
Range state is in memory only; a restart after the window loses the day's range
Broker DST switch is a user-entered month/day approximation; no limit on trades per day, no spread or time-exit filter

ideas.name: DST-aware New York time conversion
ideas.detail: Converts server time to UTC using winter/summer offsets with configurable switch dates, then to New York time using the exact US rule (2nd Sunday of March, 1st Sunday of November, transitions in UTC). Session windows stay anchored year-round and in backtests.

ideas.name: Failed-breakout re-entry at session range
ideas.detail: After the range forms, signal fires when a closed M5 bar returns inside the range after the prior bar closed outside it (liquidity sweep and reclaim). Both bars are closed bars, so no repaint.

ideas.name: Structural stop at sweep extreme with fixed R target
ideas.detail: Walks back through the consecutive bars that closed outside the range (max 15, else abort), takes their lowest low/highest high as SL, sets TP at 2x that distance. Stop is tied to the invalidation point.

ideas.name: Minimum stop distance as multiple of stops level
ideas.detail: Skips the trade unless both SL and TP distances exceed 4x SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, rejecting setups whose stop is too tight relative to broker constraints. A spread-multiple version would be stronger.

ideas.name: Incremental range build on closed bars
ideas.detail: While inside the window each closed M5 bar extends range top/bottom; the first bar outside the window freezes the range and sets RangeFormed; re-entering the window next day resets it. No history copy needed per tick.

ideas.name: Volume validity and margin check
ideas.detail: Validates lot against min, max and step multiple and compares OrderCalcMargin with free margin before sending; returns false rather than silently adjusting.

title: Arbitrage
summary: Not arbitrage: a single-symbol constant-proportion rebalancer. Tracks a virtual money/commodity portfolio from order history and buys or sells 0.1-lot steps on each new bar to keep value split near a fixed ratio; uses OrderCloseBy on opposing tickets.
red_flags: No SL/TP on any order (sent with 0,0)
Rebalancing adds exposure against the move (buys as price falls) with no hard stop
Unchecked OrderSelect/OrderClose/OrderSend return codes
Sleep(30000) after every trade operation
Hardcoded contract math (x10, 0.1 lot step) and curve-fit beginPrice=1.8014
Open-order loop counts other symbols with same magic into exposure
Title claims arbitrage; code is single-instrument rebalancing

ideas.name: OrderCloseBy netting of opposing tickets
ideas.detail: When a buy and a sell ticket of the same magic coexist, close them against each other with OrderCloseBy to save one spread instead of two separate market closes (MT4/hedging accounts only).

ideas.name: Free-margin lot cap before send
ideas.detail: Before sending, compare requested lots x MODE_MARGINREQUIRED against free margin and shrink the lot (floored to step) to what margin allows rather than letting the order fail.

ideas.name: Re-arm new-bar gate when trading is blocked
ideas.detail: If IsTradeAllowed() is false, the stored bar time is reset to the previous bar so the bar's logic is retried on the next tick instead of being skipped for the whole bar.

title: CashMachine | 5 min | Hidden Stop Loss & Hidden Take Profit thresholds || EURUSD
summary: Enters when DeMarker and Stochastic both cross out of oversold/overbought using the forming bar 0. Exits by EA-side hidden SL/TP in points; at three profit thresholds it steps a broker SL into profit.
red_flags: No broker-side SL at entry; protective stop is hidden and only works while terminal is online
Signals read from bar 0 (forming bar) on every tick - repaint/intra-bar flicker
No magic-number filter in management loop; total<1 gate uses all account orders
Fixed point distances (30/60, offset 13) tuned for 4-digit EURUSD
Sell-side OrderModify calls pass wrong argument count/positions (expiration slot receives colour)
Step-lock OrderModify is re-sent every tick with no change check, stops-level check or retcode check
Fixed lot 0.2, no risk sizing

ideas.name: Three-step profit ratchet
ideas.detail: At profit thresholds tp1/tp2/tp3 (20/35/50 pts) the broker SL is moved to lock threshold minus a fixed buffer, stepping up in discrete levels rather than trailing continuously. Reusable if thresholds are ATR-scaled and modifications are sent only on change.

ideas.name: Dual-oscillator threshold-cross confirmation
ideas.detail: Entry requires two independent oscillators (DeMarker 0.30/0.70 and Stochastic 20/80) to cross back out of the extreme zone on the same bar pair. Would need closed-bar indexing (2 vs 1) to avoid repaint.

title: Bollinger Breakout EURUSD M15
summary: Buys/sells when the last close is outside a Bollinger band wider than a threshold, with MACD sign, RSI 50 and EMA3-vs-midline confirmation. SL is the BB midline, re-sent every tick as a trail; fixed 100-point TP; percent-risk lot.
red_flags: Symbol hardcoded to "EURUSD" in OrderSend and lot sizing; pip maths assumes 4/5-digit FX
Orders sent without a magic number while ownership check looks for magic 1 - EA never recognises its own orders
Default risk is 5% of free margin per trade
MACD/RSI/EMA filters read from forming bar 0
OrderModify to midline every tick without change, direction or stops-level check - SL can move against the position
Band-width threshold is a fixed absolute price (15 pips), not volatility-normalised
Global initialisers use Point before chart context; lot not normalised to step
Errors only raise Alert, no retry or handling

ideas.name: One trade per squeeze-expansion cycle latch
ideas.detail: A flag blocks further entries after a breakout trade and is re-armed only when band width contracts below the threshold again; also initialised to blocked at start so the EA never takes a late entry into an expansion already in progress after restart.

ideas.name: Bollinger midline as initial and trailing stop
ideas.detail: Stop is placed at the BB(18) middle band at entry and then follows the midline, giving a volatility-adaptive structure stop. Needs a ratchet-only rule and stops-level check to be safe.

ideas.name: Lot from risk percent and actual stop distance
ideas.detail: Lot = (free margin x percent) / (stop distance in pips x pip value), so position size shrinks when the structural stop is wide. Pip value is hardcoded here; a metals version must use tick value / tick size.

ideas.name: Minimum band-width expansion filter
ideas.detail: Breakout closes outside the band are only accepted when upper-minus-lower band width exceeds a minimum, rejecting band touches inside a flat squeeze.

title: Arbitrage Synthetic
summary: Computes mid prices of EURUSD, GBPUSD, EURGBP, builds three synthetics and opens a single-leg min-lot position in the lagging pair when synthetic-vs-real deviation exceeds a point threshold and tick timestamps differ. Closes on opposite signal if in profit.
red_flags: No SL/TP on any position (0,0)
Not true arbitrage: only one leg is opened, so it is an unhedged directional latency bet
Losing positions are never closed - exit only when opposite deviation appears and profit > 0
Symbols hardcoded, no magic number set, position checks by symbol only
Threshold hardcoded as Spread*0.00001 (5-digit FX assumption)
No retcode checks on PositionOpen/PositionClose
gsTime compares time_msc with tickEUR.time (seconds vs milliseconds bug)
Latency edge unrealistic at retail brokers; tester results not representative

ideas.name: Synthetic-vs-real mid deviation signal
ideas.detail: Build a synthetic price from two related instruments' mid prices and compare with the directly quoted one; deviation beyond a threshold flags the lagging instrument. Transferable as a filter using XAUUSD/XAGUSD ratio or XAUEUR x EURUSD vs XAUUSD.

ideas.name: Tick-timestamp staleness comparison
ideas.detail: Stores time_msc of each symbol's last mid-price change and compares them, so a signal is only valid when one quote is demonstrably older than the other. Reusable as a stale-quote guard before trading.

ideas.name: Signal diagnostics in order comment
ideas.detail: Writes the measured deviation in points and the delay into the position comment at open, giving per-trade telemetry for later analysis from history.

title: Volatile action
summary: On a new bar, enters with H4 Alligator trend when the last bar's range exceeds 3x ATR(23), closes near its extreme and makes a 20/24-bar extreme. Order sent without stops, then SL/TP set to 0.6x/1.0x that bar's range.
red_flags: Two-step entry: order is open with no SL/TP until the following tick's OrderModify succeeds
Fatal-error latch is a static variable - after one fatal error the EA stays dead until reloaded
Management reads OrderTakeProfit/OrderStopLoss of whichever order was selected last in the loop, not necessarily its own
Blocking Sleep up to 180 s inside the error handler
SL/TP computed from ATR(1) at modify time, which can differ from the signal bar if modify is delayed to the next bar
No stops-level or spread check before OrderModify; fatal error 130 would disable the EA
Risk input is leverage-style free-margin sizing unrelated to stop distance; reward 1.0 vs risk 0.6 of a spike bar chases climactic moves

ideas.name: Range-expansion momentum bar trigger
ideas.detail: Closed bar qualifies when its true range exceeds VolN x ATR(23), it closes in its direction, close sits within 30% of the bar's extreme, and its high/low is the 24/20-bar extreme. Fully closed-bar, no repaint.

ideas.name: H4 Alligator alignment filter
ideas.detail: Higher-timeframe trend gate: Lips>Teeth>Jaw (or reverse) on the last closed H4 bar, and that bar's open and close both beyond the Teeth line, before any lower-timeframe signal is taken.

ideas.name: Error taxonomy: retryable vs fatal with halt
ideas.detail: Maps every trade error code to either a recoverable action (wait for connection, wait for free trade context, timed back-off) or a fatal state that stops the EA and shows a chart message.

ideas.name: SL/TP as fractions of the signal bar's range
ideas.detail: Stop = 0.6 x and target = 1.0 x the trigger bar's true range from entry price, so exits scale with the volatility event that caused the entry rather than fixed points.

ideas.name: Missing-stops repair on every tick
ideas.detail: When an owned order is found with SL or TP equal to zero, the EA re-attempts to attach stops, which also covers ECN market-execution brokers and restarts after a failed modify.

title: Adaptive grid
summary: When no own orders exist, on a new M15 bar places a ladder of up to 10 buy-stops above and 10 sell-stops below price at ATR-scaled offset/step, each with its own ATR SL and TP; unfilled pendings are deleted after N bars.
red_flags: Pyramiding grid: up to 10 fixed-lot positions per side stack as price runs, aggregate risk up to 10 x 2.4 ATR
No OCO: opposite-side stop ladder stays live after one side fills, so whipsaw can fill both sides
SC() compares an absolute SL/TP price against a point distance - the stop-level clamp is effectively inactive
Success check compares the last ticket number to grid count (meaningless)
PenDel() loop uses break on the first old order, which can abort deletion of the remaining pendings
Fixed lot only, no spread or session filter

ideas.name: ATR-spaced stop-order ladder in trend direction
ideas.detail: Pending stop orders at price +/- (offset x ATR) + i x (step x ATR): positions are added only as price moves in favour (anti-martingale scaling-in), each with independent ATR-multiple SL and TP and constant lot.

ideas.name: Bar-count expiry of unfilled pendings
ideas.detail: On each new bar, pending orders older than N working-timeframe bars (via iBarShift of open time) are deleted, so stale breakout levels do not trigger after the volatility regime has changed.

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin check and volume normalisation
ideas.detail: AccountFreeMarginCheck for the exact lot/side before each send, and lot clamped to min/max and rounded to the symbol's volume step.

ideas.name: Stop distance floor from max(stop level, freeze level) + spread
ideas.detail: Intended guard: minimum SL/TP distance = max(MODE_STOPLEVEL, MODE_FREEZELEVEL) plus current spread. The formula is a good idea but must be applied to distances, not absolute prices as coded.

ideas.name: Flat-state gate before re-arming the grid
ideas.detail: What() classifies own orders as market, pending or none by magic and symbol; a new grid is only laid when nothing at all is outstanding, preventing overlapping ladders after restart.

title: Narrowest Range Signal Expert
summary: On a narrowest-range (NR-N) signal from a custom indicator on the last closed bar, places a buy-stop above and sell-stop below the range with an indent; each order's SL is the opposite side of the range. Pendings removed once a position exists.
red_flags: Depends on external custom indicator NarrowestRangeSignal not bundled with the EA
No magic number: DeletePendingOrders removes every pending on the symbol, including other EAs' or manual ones
Order tracking flags are in-memory statics, lost on restart
Fixed 500-point TP and 50-point indent, not volatility-scaled
Percent mode sizes by free margin/leverage, not by stop distance
Netting-style PositionSelect(_Symbol) position check; no filling-mode or retcode inspection

ideas.name: NR-N volatility-contraction straddle
ideas.detail: When the latest N-bar range is the narrowest over a lookback, bracket it: buy-stop at range high + indent, sell-stop at range low - indent, entering whichever way the compression resolves.

ideas.name: Opposite range edge as stop
ideas.detail: Each pending order's SL is set to the opposite boundary of the compression range (plus indent), so risk equals the range width and a failed breakout is defined structurally.

ideas.name: OCO cancel of the opposite pending
ideas.detail: As soon as a position exists on the symbol, all remaining pendings are deleted, preventing the double-fill whipsaw; a new signal also clears old pendings before placing a fresh bracket.

ideas.name: Spread-adjusted buy-stop price
ideas.detail: Buy-stop trigger is raised by the current ask-bid spread so the order triggers when bid, not ask, clears the range high - avoids false fills from spread widening, which is common on metals.

ideas.name: Range-not-already-broken check
ideas.detail: Signal is discarded if the currently forming bar already holds the highest high or lowest low of the range window, i.e. the breakout has started before orders could be placed.

title: Triangular Arbitrage
