summary: Compares EURUSD x USDJPY ask product with EURJPY ask; beyond a 0.01% relative threshold opens three equal-lot market legs, then holds all until summed floating profit reaches a currency target. No loss exit.
red_flags: No SL and no loss-side exit: basket is held indefinitely until profit target is hit
Equal 0.01 lots on all three legs are not notional-matched, so the basket is not actually hedged
Uses ask prices only for both directions, ignoring spread and costs; threshold 0.01% is below typical three-leg cost
Legs sent sequentially with no rollback if one leg fails - leaves unhedged exposure
Prints on every tick; hardcoded symbols and hardcoded 1000 balance floor
Profit sum ignores swap and commission
PositionClose(symbol) by name rather than ticket

ideas.name: Basket close on summed floating profit by magic
ideas.detail: Sums POSITION_PROFIT over all positions with the EA's magic across symbols and closes them all, iterating backwards, when the total reaches a money target. Reusable for a gold/silver pair basket if swap and commission are added.

ideas.name: Minimum balance floor gate
ideas.detail: OnTick returns immediately if account balance is below a floor, stopping all new activity on an under-capitalised account. Simple last-resort guard; should be an input, not a constant.

ideas.name: Per-symbol lot validation
ideas.detail: Lot for each leg is clamped to that symbol's min/max and floored to its own volume step before sending, rather than assuming one lot grid across instruments.

title: VR Breakdown level - Trading strategy based on a breakout of the previous High or Low
summary: MT5. On each new bar stores previous bar high/low; when ask touches the high or bid touches the low, sends a market order, then attaches fixed-point SL/TP on the next loop pass after a stops-level check.
red_flags: SL attached after entry in a second step; position is unprotected in between and stays unprotected if CheckSL_TP fails (e.g. spread or stop level too large)
iStopLoss=0 disables the stop entirely
No limit on concurrent positions: a new entry can be added every bar, both directions on hedging accounts
Breakout levels held in memory only; after restart nothing is armed until the next bar
No spread, session or volatility filter; fixed 200/400 points not scaled to instrument
If lot is below minimum lt=0 and trade.Buy(0) is still attempted every tick in the MT5 version
Trade return value used but retcode not inspected

ideas.name: One-shot level latch per bar
ideas.detail: Previous-bar high and low are captured once per new bar and each level is zeroed after its order is sent successfully, so a level can trigger at most one entry per bar without tracking tickets.

ideas.name: Stops-level validation before modify
ideas.detail: Before PositionModify, verifies SL and TP are both farther than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL from the current bid (buys) or ask (sells), avoiding invalid-stops rejections.

ideas.name: Idempotent SL/TP reconciliation loop
ideas.detail: Each tick recomputes target SL/TP from position open price for every owned position and modifies only when they differ from the current values, so stops are restored after restart or a failed first attempt.
ideas.evidence: VR_Breakdown_level.mq5 OnTick() new_sl != sl || new_tp != tp

ideas.name: CTrade initialisation with symbol-derived filling mode
ideas.detail: OnInit sets magic, deviation in points, SetTypeFillingBySymbol and SetMarginMode once, so orders use a filling policy the symbol actually supports.

title: VR Breakdown level - Trading strategy based on a breakout of the previous High or Low
summary: MT4 port of the same EA: market entry when price touches previous bar high/low, order sent with no stops, then fixed-point SL/TP attached by OrderModify after a stops-level check.
red_flags: Bug: modify condition is new_sl != sl && new_tp != tp, so if either SL or TP is disabled (0) the other is never attached
Order opened with SL/TP 0 and protected only in a later step; stays naked if CheckSL_TP fails
iStopLoss=0 disables the stop
Unlimited stacking of positions, one potential new entry per bar per side
OrderModify result stored but never checked; no GetLastError handling
In-memory levels lost on restart; no spread/session filter
Fixed 200/400-point distances

ideas.name: One-shot level latch per bar
ideas.detail: Same mechanism as the MT5 version: previous-bar high/low captured on new bar and zeroed after a successful send so each level fires once.

ideas.name: Two-step ECN-compatible stop attachment with stops-level check
ideas.detail: Market order is sent without stops, then SL/TP are added by OrderModify only if both are beyond the broker stop level from current bid/ask - works on market-execution accounts that reject stops in the initial request.

ideas.name: Lot floored to volume step with invalid-lot lockout
ideas.detail: In OnInit the lot is floored to the symbol's volume step and set to 0 if below the minimum; entries are skipped while lt is 0 instead of sending an invalid volume.

title: MTS Neural network plus MACD
summary: Three hand-weighted 4-input linear 'perceptrons' on open-price differences, gated by a MACD/signal cross below/above zero. Fixed lot, fixed SL/TP in points, one position per magic. Default pass=4 makes Supervisor return 0, so it never trades.
red_flags: 'Neural network' is a linear weighted sum with weights found by the optimiser: pure curve-fit
Default pass=4 is not handled, so no trades with defaults
Copy-paste bug: perceptron1 uses x12 for w2, w3 and w4 (x13/x14 unused)
MACD read on bar 0 versus bar 2 (skips bar 1)
OrderSelect unchecked, slippage 1 point, no stops-level or lot normalisation
Sleep(30000) inside tick handler on failure
Fixed lot, no risk sizing

ideas.name: Supervisor selects per-direction SL/TP set
ideas.detail: A gating function picks which sub-model fires and at the same time switches the SL/TP pair (sl1/tp1 for shorts, sl2/tp2 for longs), so long and short trades have independently tuned exit distances.

ideas.name: Re-arm the bar on failure
ideas.detail: On trade-context busy or OrderSend failure, the new-bar latch is reset to the previous bar time so the same bar's signal is retried on the next tick instead of being lost.

ideas.name: Zero-line qualified MACD cross
ideas.detail: Bullish cross only counts when MACD main is below zero, bearish only when above zero, filtering crosses that happen late in an extended move.

title: BreakOut
summary: Market entry when price trades beyond the previous daily high/low (Monday uses the combined range of two prior days), fixed SL/TP attached by a second OrderModify, fixed-point trailing, Monday/Friday hour cut-offs, optional percent-of-free-margin lot.
red_flags: SL/TP attached by unchecked OrderModify after a naked OrderSend: position stays without SL if modify fails
No one-trade-per-day latch: re-enters on every tick while price is beyond the level after a stop-out
Trailing bug: activation tests use Point*TrailingStop but the new SL uses Point*TrailingStop*d (10x mismatch on 5-digit)
StartTime used in day-of-week filter before it is assigned on first tick
Tick-based breakout with no closed-bar confirmation, no spread filter
MM divides free margin by 100000, ignores SL distance and symbol contract size
Hard-coded magic via #define, void function returning values

ideas.name: Monday range merges the two prior daily bars
ideas.detail: On Monday the breakout levels are max/min of the last two D1 bars, so a short Sunday or thin Friday candle does not produce a trivially narrow range.

ideas.name: Week-edge entry block
ideas.detail: No new entries before a configurable hour on Monday and after a configurable hour on Friday, avoiding the weekly open gap and weekend carry.

ideas.name: Two-step send then attach stops (ECN style)
ideas.detail: Order sent with SL/TP 0, then stops set by modify on the returned ticket. Usable for market-execution brokers only if the modify is checked and retried, which this code omits.

title: EURUSD breakout v0.30
summary: On M15, measures the prior 24 bars (EU session) at the US-session start hour; if the range is small, takes one buy and one sell per day when a whole closed bar sits beyond the range. Fixed 12-point SL, 15-point TP.
red_flags: Author's own header states 'Not yet profitable'
OrderSend result unchecked; bought/sold flag set even if the order failed
Magic number 0, no ownership check
Day state held in static variables, lost on restart
Session length hard-coded as 24 M15 bars regardless of inputs; redundant hard-coded hour window
SL 12 and TP 15 points hard-coded/tiny, would be inside spread on metals
Integer lot input defaulting to 1 lot, no risk sizing
start() has no return value

ideas.name: Compression-conditioned session breakout
ideas.detail: The breakout is only armed when the preceding session's high-low range is at or below a threshold (SmallEUSessionPips); wide prior sessions disable trading that day.

ideas.name: Whole-bar-outside confirmation
ideas.detail: Buy requires the last closed bar's Low above range top plus a buffer (sell: High below range bottom minus buffer), i.e. a full bar accepted outside the range, not just a wick or close.

ideas.name: One buy and one sell per day latch
ideas.detail: Per-direction boolean latches reset at the day change cap entries at one long and one short per day, preventing repeated re-entry after a failed breakout.

ideas.name: Weekday filter with optional Monday skip
ideas.detail: Trades only Monday-Friday and can exclude Monday by input; a code comment also suggests excluding NFP days (not implemented).

title: Artificial Intellegence optimized by Pramod Baviskar
summary: Always-in-market variant of Reshetov's perceptron: weighted sum of Accelerator Oscillator at shifts 0/7/14/21 decides long or short each new bar. Fixed SL, no TP, step trailing, reversal via double-lot opposite order plus OrderCloseBy.
red_flags: 'Artificial Intelligence' is a 4-weight linear sum with optimiser-fitted weights: curve-fit
Always enters: perceptron <= 0 means short, no neutral zone or filter
Default lot 1.0, no risk sizing
Sleep(30000) in tick handler, even after a successful reversal order
OrderSelect and OrderCloseBy unchecked; OrderCloseBy fails on brokers disallowing hedging/close-by
No spread, session or volatility filter; no stops-level check
Reversal opens 2x lot temporarily, doubling margin use until CloseBy succeeds

ideas.name: Step trail with signal re-check at each step
ideas.detail: Only when price is more than 2*SL + spread beyond the current stop does it act: if the signal flipped it reverses, otherwise it moves the SL to price minus SL. Large trailing steps reduce modify spam.

ideas.name: Reversal by opposite order plus OrderCloseBy
ideas.detail: Reverses by sending double lot in the opposite direction and closing the old ticket against it, paying one spread instead of two. Only valid on hedging accounts that allow close-by.

ideas.name: Trade-context gate with bar re-arm
ideas.detail: If IsTradeAllowed() is false or an order/modify fails, the new-bar timestamp is rolled back so the bar is processed again on the next tick.

title: The Fraktrak xonax Expert Advisor based on the fractal breakouts
summary: Buys when Ask exceeds the latest H4 upper fractal by 15 points, sells below the latest lower fractal; SL at the opposite fractal, fixed TP, fixed-point trailing with a minimum step. One entry per fractal level, positions can stack.
red_flags: Position-count guard is commented out: unlimited stacked positions across successive fractals
Fixed lot while SL distance (opposite fractal) varies widely: uncontrolled risk per trade
Fractal at shift 2 depends on the still-forming bar 0, so the level can repaint
Used-fractal memory in static variables is lost on restart (duplicate entry possible)
Trailing loop filters by magic only, not by symbol
Up to 5000 iFractals calls twice per tick, no new-bar discipline
No stops-level check; opposite fractal may be on the wrong side or too close, so OrderSend fails
Hard-coded 15-point buffer and slippage 30

ideas.name: Fractal breakout with consumed-level latch
ideas.detail: Entry when price exceeds the most recent confirmed fractal plus a buffer; the fractal price is stored after a successful order so the same level cannot trigger a second trade.

ideas.name: Structural stop at the opposite fractal
ideas.detail: Initial SL for a long is the latest lower fractal (for a short the latest upper fractal), placing the stop behind market structure rather than at a fixed distance.

ideas.name: Trailing stop with minimum step (hysteresis)
ideas.detail: The SL is only moved when the new level improves on the current one by more than TrStKor points, cutting the number of OrderModify requests to the broker.

title: Basic ATR based take and stop expert adviser
summary: Demonstration template with no entry rules: whenever flat it opens a market order in the input direction, then attaches SL = ATR*1.5 and TP = ATR*2.0 by OrderModify. Author states it must not be used for trading.
red_flags: No entry logic: re-opens immediately in a fixed direction whenever flat
ATR taken from the forming bar 0
SL/TP attached in a second step; if the modify fails the position stays unprotected with no retry
Stale global Ticket: if the margin check fails, the previous ticket value is reused for the success branch
Ownership filter uses && instead of || in the skip condition (harmless only because of the later check)
No stops-level/freeze-level validation or price normalisation of SL/TP

ideas.name: ATR-multiple SL and TP with separate factors
ideas.detail: Stop and target distances computed as ATR(period, selectable timeframe) times independent multipliers (1.5 / 2.0), so exits scale with current volatility instead of fixed points.

ideas.name: Pre-trade free-margin check
ideas.detail: AccountFreeMarginCheck is called for the exact symbol, direction and lot before sending; the order is skipped and logged if the resulting free margin would be negative.

ideas.name: Lot clamp to step/min/max
ideas.detail: Requested lot is rounded to the symbol's lot step and clamped between broker minimum and maximum volume before use.

ideas.name: Fail init on invalid configuration
ideas.detail: OnInit returns INIT_FAILED with a message when a required input is left in an invalid state, so the EA never runs misconfigured.

title: HawaiianTsunamiSurfer, a statistical look at determinant price explosions
summary: Reads 1-period Momentum on M1; if price moved more than 0.24% in one bar it opens a trade AGAINST the move (momentum > 100.24 sells), with fixed 700-point SL and 500-point TP. One position per symbol, fixed 0.1 lot.
red_flags: Description says it rides spikes, the code fades them
isNewBar is never reset to false, so after the first bar the logic runs on every tick
Signal taken from the forming bar (buffer index 0)
All parameters hard-coded as globals ('optimized, do not change'): curve-fit magic numbers, not inputs
Negative risk/reward (SL 700 vs TP 500), fixed lot
No magic number, no retcode check on PositionOpen, no filling-mode or deviation setup
Fades news spikes with no spread or slippage guard, exactly when spreads are widest
Licence: CC BY-NC-ND (no derivatives)

ideas.name: One-bar percent-move shock detector
ideas.detail: Momentum(1) on M1 expressed as a percent of price, compared with a fixed threshold (0.24%), flags abnormal single-bar moves without a news calendar. Reusable as a shock filter to pause entries or tighten management rather than as an entry.

title: Seven strategies in One expert
summary: Seven oscillator sub-strategies (AC, ADX, AO, DeMarker, Force+Bollinger, MFI, MACD+Stochastic) with selectable level-cross rule variants, each with own magic, fixed-pip virtual SL/TP, signal-based close, time/price-spaced add-on grid and optional loss-recovery lot multiplier. FX pair presets only.
red_flags: Default Use_Only_Virtual_Levels: no broker-side SL/TP, stops enforced only while the terminal is running
Grid enabled by default (Make_Grid_Loss_And_Profit) with PipsBetweenOrders=0 and only a 60 s spacing: adds against the move
Optional recovery lot multiplier x2 after a losing trade or while below the profit high-water mark (martingale-style)
Signals read buffer index 0 on the first tick of a new bar (still-forming bar value) plus bar 1
Hard SL/TP for sells in ADX/AO/DeM/FBB/MFI/MS branches computed with buy-side signs (ASK+TP, BID-SL) in OpenOrders lines 2369-2414: invalid stops if hard levels are enabled
MagicNumber input is ignored: per-strategy magics are hardcoded constants (lines 1391-1397), so two instances on different symbols share magics (symbol filter only)
Lot sizing = balance*risk/100000, not tied to stop distance; MathRound to step can round up
Retry loop checks only the bool from OrderSend, not result.retcode; no stops-level/freeze-level check; Sleep(60000) inside OnTick on low margin
Curve-fit magic numbers (indicator values scaled *40000, levels 80/70, per-strategy pip TP/SL defaults such as TP 5 / SL 60)
Symbol restricted to an enum of 28 FX pairs or chart pair; ~290 KB of copy-pasted per-strategy code, no shared structure
CopyBuffer return values unchecked

ideas.name: Per-strategy magic sub-accounts with independent statistics
ideas.detail: Each sub-strategy gets its own magic id, and open-position counts, floating PnL, total lots, last-open time and history PnL are tracked per magic, so strategies can be switched on/off and judged separately inside one EA.

ideas.name: Three-state operation mode input
ideas.detail: Enum input with Stand_by (monitor only, no trading), Normal, and Close_Immediately_All_Orders (flatten all own positions per magic, then stay idle). A simple manual kill-switch without removing the EA.

ideas.name: Week-edge guard from broker session table
ideas.detail: Uses SymbolInfoSessionTrade to read the symbol's actual Monday open and Friday close, then blocks trading for N minutes after the weekly open and N minutes before the weekly close, instead of hardcoded hours.

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin and OrderCheck gate
ideas.detail: Before sending, calls OrderCalcMargin and compares with ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE, then runs OrderCheck on the request; only then enters a bounded retry loop (max 4 attempts) while SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE is FULL.

ideas.name: Aggregate volume and order-count caps
ideas.detail: New lot is trimmed so the sum of all open lots across every sub-strategy never exceeds SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX, and open positions are capped by min(user MaxOrders, ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS).

ideas.name: Selectable hard / virtual / both stop levels
ideas.detail: Enum per strategy chooses broker-side SL/TP, EA-monitored virtual levels, or both. Useful only in the 'both' form: wide hard catastrophic stop at the broker plus a tighter hidden exit managed by the EA.
ideas.evidence: MultiStrategyEA_v1_2.mq5 enum Levels line 15; OpenOrders 2296-2350; GetResultsCurrentOrders 2838-2858

title: London Breakout EA: simple and transparent/London Breakout Expert Advisor: simple and transparent
summary: On each new bar within the London window, buys/sells at market if the last closed bar closed beyond the Asian-session range plus buffer. SL at opposite range side, TP = RR x stop, risk-percent sizing, one trade per day, timed exit.
red_flags: lastTradeDay kept only in memory: after a restart the EA can take a second trade the same day
Session hours are raw broker-server hours with no DST/GMT-offset handling
Spread limit is a fixed point value (default 30 points would block XAUUSD on most brokers unless retuned)
No retcode inspection beyond CTrade bool; filling mode left to CTrade default; freeze level not checked
Close at InpCloseHour only evaluated on a new bar and only while hour >= close hour the same day; a position held past midnight is not closed until that hour next day
No explicit weekend/news handling; range uses chart-timeframe bars so results depend on chart period

ideas.name: Risk-percent sizing via OrderCalcProfit with tick-value fallback
ideas.detail: Loss per 1 lot at the stop is obtained from OrderCalcProfit(type, symbol, 1.0, entry, sl) and only falls back to tick value/tick size if that fails; lots are floored to volume step, and the trade is skipped if below minimum lot rather than rounded up.

ideas.name: Asian-range breakout confirmed by closed bar
ideas.detail: Builds today's high/low from bars whose server hour is inside the Asian window, then enters only when bar 1 close exceeds range plus a point buffer, during a limited entry window. No bar-0 signals, new-bar gate.

ideas.name: Skip day when structural stop exceeds ATR multiple
ideas.detail: Stop is the opposite side of the range; if that distance is greater than InpMaxSlAtr x ATR(H1,14) or below the broker stops level, the day is marked as done and no trade is taken. Filters abnormally wide ranges.

ideas.name: One trade per day key with skip-marks-day
ideas.detail: A dayKey (year*1000 + day_of_year) is stored after a fill and also after a rejected setup (stop too wide, lot too small), so a failed setup does not get retried later the same day. Needs persistence to be restart-safe.

ideas.name: Input sanity validation with hard risk cap
ideas.detail: OnInit returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT unless risk is within 0-2%, RR is positive and session hours are strictly ordered (Asia start < Asia end < trade end <= close hour). Prevents misconfiguration and oversized risk.

ideas.name: Sizing audit log line
ideas.detail: Every sizing decision prints balance, risk money, stop distance, loss per lot, resulting lots and expected loss at stop, making position sizing verifiable from the journal on each trade.

title: RRS Impulse
summary: MT4 multi-symbol scanner: rotates through Market Watch symbols and timeframes each tick, enters counter-trend (or trend) when RSI/Stochastic/Bollinger/MA extremes agree. Virtual or broker SL/TP/trailing, basket loss and profit caps, ForexFactory XML news pause in V2/Plus.
red_flags: Signals read from forming bar 0 (all *_Shift default 0) and evaluated every tick, no new-bar gate
Plus defaults to Virtual_SL/Virtual_TP: no broker-side stop, unprotected if terminal disconnects
Virtual trailing levels kept in in-memory array of 100 tickets, lost on restart
urlmon.dll import (URLDownloadToFileW) declared in V2/Plus although download actually uses WebRequest
WebRequest over plain http to nfs.faireconomy.media; MessageBox and Sleep(3000) in download path
Random lot size mode (MathRand) in V1 and as an option later
Lot_Percentage sizes from margin required, not from stop distance
Most OrderSelect calls unchecked; no retry or requote handling; lots normalised to 2 decimals
Trades any Market Watch symbol matching currency substrings, so one chart can open up to 10 uncorrelated-checked positions
Basket loss cap is floating P/L of this EA only, held in memory, resets on restart; StopEA flag not persisted
News times compared via TimeLocal and PC GMT offset, breaks if PC clock/timezone is wrong; not usable in tester
Buy/sell on separate magics and one-symbol-per-tick trailing means management of many open symbols is round-robin and slow

ideas.name: Weekly calendar XML cached to file with hourly refresh
ideas.detail: Download ff_calendar_thisweek.xml via WebRequest to a local file, re-read from disk on init, refresh only when file modify date is over one hour old, skip refresh on Saturday. Trading continues from cache if download fails.

ideas.name: Symbol-currency news blackout with keyword whitelist
ideas.detail: Split symbol into 3-letter halves (XAU/USD), keep only events for those currencies, drop Low/Medium/Holiday/Tentative/'Speaks'. Block entries BeforeNews/AfterNews minutes around High impact, or only titles matching a user list (CPI, FOMC, NFP, Fed Funds).

ideas.name: Pre-news flatten when basket is near breakeven
ideas.detail: When a news window is active and the EA's floating P/L lies within plus or minus News_CutLoss currency units, close all its positions rather than carry them through the release.

ideas.name: Time stop in bars using entry timeframe stored in order comment
ideas.detail: Entry timeframe is encoded in the order comment (1M/5M/1H...). Exit routine parses it and closes the trade once iBarShift from open time reaches CandleExit bars, so the time stop survives restarts without extra state.
ideas.evidence: RRS_Impulse_Plus_EA.mq4 CandleClose() lines 1208-1258, gTradeComment in SingleTimeFrame()

ideas.name: Trailing gap floored by stop level and live spread
ideas.detail: Trailing distance = max(broker STOPLEVEL+2, current spread+2, user gap), and initial SL/TP distance = max(user value, stop level+2), preventing invalid-stops rejections when gold spread widens.

ideas.name: Basket loss cap and equity target with stop-or-continue action
ideas.detail: Close all EA trades when floating loss reaches fixed money or % of balance; close all when equity reaches a balance-based target, then either disable trading or re-arm the target from the new balance.

title: RSI Grid EA Pro
summary: MT5 hedging grid: first trade when closed-bar H4 RSI crosses 70/30 (or fixed-distance/manual buttons), then adds same-direction positions against price with widening step and 1.1x lots. Exits are virtual basket TP/trailing from the average price plus win/loss pair 'overlap' closes.
red_flags: Averaging grid with LOT_MULTIPLIER 1.1 and MAX_LOT 999.9; no cap on number of grid levels
STOPLOSS defaults to -1 (disabled) and every stop/TP is virtual; no broker-side SL is ever sent
No equity or drawdown stop of any kind
MAGIC_NUMBER default -1 means it manages and closes every position on the symbol, including manual or other EAs' trades
Grid adds have no spread filter and are sent on any tick or 1-second timer
Trailing/breakeven levels held in globals and reset on restart or whenever position count changes
POSITIONS_CLOSE_TICKET ignores its lots argument; OrderSend checks only bool return, not retcode
Step formula (N-1)*multiplier*step is linear, not the geometric widening the input name implies
Requires hedging account; SL-based risk sizing unusable because SL is off by default
Time filter gates entries and grid adds only, uses server time with no DST handling

ideas.name: Pre-trade guard chain before OrderSend
ideas.detail: Before sending: check ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, clamp and step-round volume, OrderCalcMargin against free margin with a buffer, require SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL, and pick filling mode from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE bits (FOK, then IOC, else RETURN).

ideas.name: Basket breakeven price derived from live P/L
ideas.detail: Net zero level per side = bid - basketProfit/(tickValue*totalLots)*point, including swap. Virtual TP, breakeven and step trailing are all measured from this level, so multi-position exits account for swaps and uneven lots.

ideas.name: Empirical tick value from open positions
ideas.detail: Recompute money-per-point-per-lot as abs(profit / price move in points / volume) from a live position, falling back to SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE. Guards against brokers reporting wrong tick value on metals/CFDs.

ideas.name: Closed-bar higher-timeframe RSI trigger with one handle
ideas.detail: RSI handle created once in OnInit on a fixed H4 timeframe; signal reads buffer index 1 (last closed bar) and only fires when no position exists on that side, avoiding intrabar re-triggers.
ideas.evidence: Grid_EA_Pro.mq5 OnInit line 157, GET_RSI_VALUE() lines 436-451, OnTick lines 275-287

ideas.name: HH:MM trading window that wraps midnight
ideas.detail: Parse start/end strings to decimal hours; if start is later than end the allowed window is inverted, so overnight sessions such as 22:00-06:00 work with one comparison. 00:00/00:00 disables the filter.

ideas.name: Skip chart UI in tester and optimisation
ideas.detail: Panel, buttons, lines and Comment are drawn only when MQL_VISUAL_MODE is set or the EA is not in tester/optimisation, keeping optimisation runs fast.

title: Moving Average x Relative Strength Indicator EA
summary: Minimal MT5 example: buys when bid is above SMA14 and RSI14 below 30, sells when below SMA and RSI above 70. One position per symbol, fixed-pip SL and TP, lot sized from balance risk percent.
red_flags: Default riskPercent = 10% of balance per trade
Signals use forming bar (arrays not set as series, index 0 ambiguous) and run every tick with no new-bar gate
Lot formula divides by stopLoss in pips but value per point, so on 3/5-digit symbols real risk is about 10x the stated percent
Lot not clamped to min/max or rounded to volume step; falls back to 0.1 lot if tick data missing
trade.Buy/Sell result and retcode never checked; prints success regardless
No magic number, no stops-level check, no filling mode, slippage input unused
No spread, session or news filter; pip logic assumes forex digits and is wrong for gold/silver

title: The Playground Series v1 to V4 - A combination of trading concepts
summary: ICT-style experiment: detects 3-candle fair value gaps on M5, enters at market when price touches the gap midpoint (direction from forming-bar close), optionally only in 'Silver Bullet' hour windows, exits by dollar profit/loss or session high/low target. Fixed lots.
red_flags: No broker-side SL or TP ever sent (request.sl never set); stop is a virtual price check per tick, so no protection if terminal/VPS disconnects
Entry direction and FVG 'inverse reset' are decided from the still-forming bar 0 close (iClose(...,0)) - intrabar noise, not reproducible in bar-based tests
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK and deviation 20; no retcode inspection, no volume normalisation, no stops-level or spread check
OpenBuy/OpenSell return result.deal and later use it with PositionSelectByTicket - deal ticket is not the position ticket, so trade tracking and 'one trade per window' state can silently break
All trade state (sb_trades, window flags) lives in memory only - lost on restart, leaving positions with no stop at all
Fixed dollar profit/loss exits ($10 / $10 on 0.01 lot) are not volatility- or symbol-scaled
Session hours hard-coded on server time plus manual GMT offset, no DST handling; window hours in library (7-8, 14-15, 18-19) disagree with the input comments
Distance to target computed as point*10 'pips' - wrong scale for metals
v1.00 'dynamic lots' just switches between two fixed lot sizes

ideas.name: FVG detection on closed bars with minimum gap size and midpoint (consequent encroachment) level
ideas.detail: On each new bar compare high of bar 3 with low of bar 1 (and mirror); if gap >= minimum size, store top, bottom and midpoint in a tracked list with id and state. Use midpoint touch as retracement entry level. Minimum gap should be ATR-scaled for metals.

ideas.name: FVG invalidation by a candle that shoots through the whole gap
ideas.detail: An untouched gap is deactivated when a single candle opens beyond one edge and closes beyond the other, so stale zones are not traded. Should be evaluated on closed bars, unlike the source.

ideas.name: One-trade-per-session-window rule
ideas.detail: Trading allowed only in three one-hour windows; a per-window flag blocks further entries while that window's trade is open. Limits overtrading during gold's London/NY bursts. Flags must be persisted and derived from positions, not memory.

ideas.name: Target at a fraction of distance to the prior session's high/low
ideas.detail: Tracks Sydney/Tokyo/London session high and low; target is the session extreme on the far side of price, and TP is placed at a configurable percent (80%) of that distance, with a minimum-distance check to skip trades with too little room.

ideas.name: Liquidity map: PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL, session extremes, swing points and equal highs/lows with sweep and failure-to-displace flags
ideas.detail: Keeps a list of liquidity levels; merges swing levels within a tolerance into equal highs/lows; marks a level swept when price trades through it; flags 'failure to displace' when price pierces the level but closes back inside, flipping daily bias.

ideas.name: Detector libraries that emit events through callbacks
ideas.detail: FVG and liquidity detectors are separate classes that own their state and call an EA callback with an event name (FORMED, ENCROACHED, RESET, SWEPT), keeping signal detection separate from order logic and letting several strategy modes share one detector with different magic numbers.

title: Supertrend Scalper with Breakeven Win Rate Panel
summary: Enters on a closed-bar Supertrend flip that passes a 14-check filter bitmask, with ATR stop, ATR/Fibonacci target, risk-percent sizing and a daily equity loss halt. An on-chart replay scores the same signal with real spread and shows breakeven win rate.
red_flags: Author's own header states the signal has no edge on 5 years of M5 XAUUSD (about -0.035 R per trade after spread); the code is useful as infrastructure, not as a strategy
Default target (1.5 ATR via Fibo level) against a 3 ATR stop gives 0.5:1 payoff and needs about 67% wins just to break even
Daily loss halt only blocks new entries, does not close open positions, and its day-start equity is held in memory - a restart resets the baseline and clears the halt
MinATRValue/MaxATRValue are absolute price units (0.5-2.5), not portable between gold and silver or timeframes
On-chart filter toggle buttons invite in-sample filter selection (the author warns about this); toggles are not persisted
ConfirmOnClosedBar=false allows trading the forming bar 0
Minimum-bars-between-signals and last-direction state are lost on restart; no retry on order failure; early-close PositionClose result is unchecked
Replay enters at the signal bar close while live enters at next-bar ask/bid; replay recomputed over up to 400k bars on every new bar is heavy

ideas.name: Spread gate as a fraction of the trade's own stop distance
ideas.detail: Skip the entry if (ask - bid) exceeds MaxSpreadFracOfRisk (15%) of the SL distance in price. Unlike a fixed point cap, the same setting works on gold and silver and tightens automatically when the stop is small. The reason is logged for the panel.

ideas.name: Breakeven win rate shown next to the actual win rate, gross and net of cost
ideas.detail: For each trade computes risk/(risk+reward) and (risk+cost)/(risk+reward), averages them, and displays them beside the achieved win rate. Exposes setups where a near target inflates win rate without any edge. Also included in the entry alert text.

ideas.name: Pessimistic cost-aware replay in R multiples
ideas.detail: Walks each historical signal bar by bar; if a bar straddles both stop and target, the stop is assumed hit first; charges the bar's recorded spread plus slippage both ways against the result instead of shifting the entry; reports expectancy, profit factor and drawdown in R.

ideas.name: Single evaluator for live and history, with filters stored as a bitmask
ideas.detail: All indicator buffers are loaded once into arrays, trimmed to the shortest successful copy; one Checks(dir, i) function is used at i=1 live and at any i in replay. Every check result is packed into a bitmask so any filter combination can be rescored without rereading prices.

ideas.name: Risk-percent sizing from stop distance with lot cap and margin pre-check
ideas.detail: Lots = balance * risk% / (stop points * value per point from tick value and tick size), floored to the volume step, clamped to min/max and a hard MaxLotCap; the order is skipped if OrderCalcMargin needs more than 90% of free margin. Stop and target are widened to the stops/freeze level first.
ideas.evidence: SupertrendScalper.mq5 CalcLots (1101), NormLots (403), TryTrade lines 1210-1226, OnInit line 1923

ideas.name: Live results grouped by position id including commission and swap, with a visible block reason
ideas.detail: Deal history is aggregated per DEAL_POSITION_ID so entry commission and swap count against the position; only fully closed positions are counted and bucketed by open time. Every rejected entry sets a readable reason string (spread, session, daily cap, margin) shown on the panel.

title: Price Action Intraday Trading - Expert for MT5
summary: New-bar EA: pin bar / engulfing / inside-bar on closed bar 1, filtered by EMA20/50 trend or naive S/R proximity. Market order with fixed-pip SL, RR-multiple TP, %-risk lot, breakeven, step trailing, hours window, EOD close, balance-based daily loss stop.
red_flags: Fixed-pip SL/TP/trail (40/20/30 pips) with pip=_Point on 2-digit symbols: on XAUUSD 40 pips = $0.40, unusable without rescaling; no ATR scaling
Daily loss limit uses balance not equity, start balance resets only if a new bar lands exactly at 00:00 and is re-seeded on every restart (not persisted)
PositionsTotal()==0 gate is account-wide, not filtered by magic/symbol
Inside-bar breakout reads close of bar 0 at the moment the bar opens (effectively the open price)
EMA trend uses still-forming bar 0 value
OrderSend returning true with a non-DONE retcode is only logged; filling retry triggers only when OrderSend returns false
Lot below min is rounded up to min lot (risk overrun on small accounts)
No spread filter, no news filter
Daily-loss message printed every tick once hit (log spam)

ideas.name: Pre-trade validation chain
ideas.detail: Before OrderSend runs sequential checks: volume min/max/step validity, OrderCalcMargin vs free margin, ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, and SL/TP distance against SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL measured from the correct side (bid for buys, ask for sells). Abort with a logged reason on any failure.
ideas.evidence: Daily_Price_Action_EA.mq5: CheckVolumeValue, CheckMoneyForTrade, IsNewOrderAllowed, CheckStopLoss_TakeProfit, ExecuteBuy

ideas.name: Filling-mode autodetect with retry and learning
ideas.detail: Reads SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE bit flags to pick FOK/IOC at init; on send failure retries the same request with the other filling modes and stores the one that worked as the new default.

ideas.name: Freeze-level and no-change guard on SL modification
ideas.detail: Before TRADE_ACTION_SLTP: re-select by ticket, verify symbol+magic, skip if normalized SL/TP unchanged (avoids NO_CHANGES retcode), and skip if current SL/TP is within SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL of price.

ideas.name: Step-gated trailing stop
ideas.detail: Trailing SL only modified when the new level improves on the current SL by at least a step threshold, limiting modify-request spam; breakeven applied first once profit reaches trigger. Would need ATR units for metals.

ideas.name: Closed-bar candle pattern set with trend-or-level gating
ideas.detail: Pin bar (wick >= ratio x body, min wick size, opposite wick < body) and engulfing (min body size) evaluated on bar 1; pin allowed with trend OR when the wick tip is within tolerance of a prior high/low in the lookback.

ideas.name: Tick-value risk sizing with divide-by-zero guard
ideas.detail: lot = risk$ * tickSize / (SLdistance * tickValue), floored to volume step and clamped to min/max; falls back when tickValue/tickSize/SL is zero.

title: ICE (Impulse Confirmation Engine)
summary: Detects an impulse candle on closed bar 1 (tick-volume spike, body ratio, close location, range expansion, SMA50 side+slope), then enters on breakout/pullback/velocity within an expiry window. ATR SL/TP, %-risk lot, breakeven and ATR trailing, spread/ATR/volume/session filters.
red_flags: No max-open-positions or already-in-trade check: every new impulse can stack another position
No daily loss / drawdown limit; only min-equity and margin-level floor
Entry conditions evaluated on new-bar tick using bar 0 OHLC (bar just opened, so close>open tests are near-meaningless) and SMA value of forming bar
Stops-level violation is only logged, order still sent
InpReduceAfterLoss, InpReductionFactor, InpImmediateEntry, InpMaxEntryBars, InpTradingMode, InpUseVolatilityAdjust declared but never used
Lot below min is bumped to min lot (risk overrun)
iATR(100) handle created inside IsGoodTradingSession on every call and never released
Hard-coded session hours in server time without GMT offset; magic numbers throughout (0.8, 1.2, 0.25, 0.618)
Large blocks of commented-out alternative implementations; duplicate filter checks
Sleep loop in OnInit; trailing never tightens SL below breakeven so a losing trade is untouched
Failed order is retried every subsequent bar until impulse expires

ideas.name: Composite impulse-candle detector on closed bar
ideas.detail: Bar 1 qualifies when tick volume >= avg(N) x multiplier, body/range >= threshold, close in top/bottom fraction of range, range >= 1.05x previous bar, and price on correct side of a sloping SMA50. Produces a weighted strength score (volume 40%, body 30%, close position 30%).

ideas.name: Signal state machine with strength-scaled expiry and decay
ideas.detail: Detected impulse is held as state; wait window (min..max bars) scales with strength. Setup is discarded if bars elapsed exceed window, price retraces beyond 61.8% of the impulse body, or volume falls below 25% of the impulse volume ratio.

ideas.name: Relative-volatility session gate (short ATR vs long ATR)
ideas.detail: Instead of clock sessions alone: trade only if ATR(20) >= 0.8 x ATR(100); in Asian/Pacific hours require >= 1.2x. Also skips server hour 0 (rollover). Broker-timezone-agnostic liveliness filter.

ideas.name: Session-adaptive spread cap and ATR band filter
ideas.detail: Max spread scaled by session (x1.2 London/NY, x0.8 Asia/Pacific); trades blocked when ATR in points is below a floor (dead market) or above a ceiling (news spike); also blocks when last closed bar volume < 40% of average.

ideas.name: Indicator data sanity guard
ideas.detail: ATR getter returns 0 (caller aborts) unless BarsCalculated >= period, CopyBuffer succeeds, value is a valid number > 0 and < 10% of price; lot sizing additionally rejects SL distance > 2% of price. Prevents absurd lots from unsynced data.

ideas.name: TP-fraction-triggered breakeven and ATR trail
ideas.detail: Breakeven fires when price has covered X% of the entry-to-TP distance; ATR x multiplier trail activates at Y% of TP distance and only ratchets in profit beyond entry. TP widened 1.2x when trailing is on. Pre-checks terminal/MQL trade permission and SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL.

title: G7 FVG OB Confluence AutoTrader and Institutional SMC Dashboard
summary: Rescans M15 history each new bar for order blocks (displacement + swing break) and 3-candle FVGs, flags unmitigated OB/FVG overlaps, and is meant to market-enter on zone touch with fixed lot. Large button dashboard, breakeven, trailing, daily equity loss/profit circuit breaker.
red_flags: Fake 'AI confidence': a static additive score; News and DXY panels are hard-coded strings ('No High-Impact USD News', +20% always) with no calendar or DXY data
Logic bug: confidence maxes at 60 (the +35 confluence bonus is added to a local variable after assignment), so with default 70% threshold auto-execution can never fire
In Strategy Tester OnTick force-opens an unconditional 'MQL5 Tester Validation Trade' buy and bypasses the spread filter - backtests do not reflect the strategy
Fixed lot only (0.01 default), no risk-based sizing despite 'dynamic risk' naming
SL can be 0 if SL pips set to 0 on manual button trades; SL silently relocated to bid/ask +/- buffer when zone SL is too close
Zone-touch entry on live tick without closed-bar confirmation; zones rebuilt each bar with new IDs so trade_triggered flag is lost on rescan (re-entry controlled only by time cooldown)
Daily reset baseline, circuit-breaker flag and cooldown timers held in memory only - restart clears a daily lock
Magic filter skipped when magic=0; CloseAllPositions on breaker closes all symbols for the magic
Trade results/retcodes not inspected beyond bool; ~186KB mostly UI code and marketing text

ideas.name: Broker-compliant SL/TP engine with composite buffer
ideas.detail: Minimum stop distance = max(stops level, freeze level, current spread) + fixed point buffer; SL measured from the closing side (bid for buys, ask for sells), TP from the opposite; structure-based custom SL accepted only if beyond that distance, else clamped.

ideas.name: Two-sided daily equity circuit breaker
ideas.detail: Timer-driven (1s) check of equity vs day-start balance: on daily loss % or daily profit target % sets a lock flag, alerts, closes all EA positions and blocks new entries until server-day rollover. Needs persistence added.

ideas.name: OB + FVG overlap zone with structural SL
ideas.detail: OB = last opposite candle before a displacement candle (body >= 1.6x avg range) that breaks the prior N-bar swing; FVG = 3-candle gap >= min size; both tracked for mitigation. Entry zone is the price intersection (with tolerance); SL placed beyond the zone edge plus buffer.

ideas.name: Margin-capped lot with 90% free-margin ceiling
ideas.detail: Uses OrderCalcMargin for 1 lot to compute max affordable volume at 90% of free margin, floors to step, and returns 0 (no trade) if even min lot is unaffordable rather than forcing min lot.

ideas.name: Breakeven-plus-lock and gated trailing
ideas.detail: Breakeven moves SL to entry + lock pips after trigger; trailing only updates when improvement exceeds 2 pips, new SL is beyond entry, and distance to price respects the stops/freeze/spread buffer. Partial 50% close helper floors to volume step and checks min lot.

ideas.name: On-chart control panel for runtime overrides
ideas.detail: Chart buttons adjust lot/SL/TP at runtime, toggle auto-trading, and trigger manual buy/sell, force-breakeven, partial close and close-all through the same guarded execution path as automated entries.

title: Martingale Pulse EA
summary: Single-position EA with 4 selectable signals (tick momentum, engulfing, RSI re-cross, close/EMA cross), fixed-point SL with RR-based TP, and loss-streak martingale lot escalation; includes weekly session schedule and daily profit/drawdown lock.
red_flags: Martingale: lot x2.0 after each loss (up to 5 per round, max lot 5.0); percent-risk sizing is defeated by the multiplier
Market orders are sent with SL=0/TP=0 and SL/TP attached afterwards in OnTradeTransaction; if PositionModify fails the position stays naked with no retry
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_FOK regardless of symbol filling mode
Martingale round counter, daily start balance and limit flag are in-memory only; restart resets them
Daily start balance re-sampled at OnInit, so a restart mid-day wipes the daily loss lock
HFT tick-momentum mode trades on raw ticks with no spread filter
No spread, news or volatility filter; fixed 1000-point SL not volatility-scaled
Trailing and session-close run only inside session branch; trailing skipped while in trade cooldown

ideas.name: Daily profit target + daily drawdown lock from day-start balance
ideas.detail: Each tick compares equity against balance captured at day rollover; when equity gain >= target or loss >= fixed/percent limit, closes all positions, cancels pendings, sets a halt flag until next day. Reset boundary selectable: server midnight or custom UTC time.

ideas.name: Per-weekday multi-window session strings
ideas.detail: One input string per weekday in 'HH:MM-HH:MM;HH:MM-HH:MM' format, parsed with StringSplit into minute ranges; optional flatten-and-cancel when leaving a window. Lets metals bot avoid rollover hour and Friday close per day.

ideas.name: Margin-capped lot at send time
ideas.detail: Before sending, computes margin for 1.0 lot via OrderCalcMargin, derives max affordable lot at 98% of free margin, caps and re-normalises requested volume, then re-verifies with a second margin check.

ideas.name: Deal-driven state machine via OnTradeTransaction
ideas.detail: Filters DEAL_ADD by deal magic; DEAL_ENTRY_OUT clears a 'closing for reversal' flag, stamps a cooldown timer and feeds realised deal profit/volume to sizing logic; reversal opens only after close is confirmed, avoiding double positions.

ideas.name: Money-denominated trailing stop
ideas.detail: Trailing start and distance given in account currency; distance converted to price using tick_value*(point/tick_size)*position volume, so the trail locks a fixed cash amount regardless of lot size; checks stops level before modify.

ideas.name: Straddling pending order re-pegged on a timer with OCO cancel
ideas.detail: Stop/limit entry placed at fixed distance from price with SL/TP attached; every N seconds OrderModify re-pegs price/SL/TP to current quote; once any deal fills, remaining pendings of this magic are deleted.

title: MT5-BuildYourGridEA
summary: Signal-less grid: opens buy and/or sell immediately, adds orders every N pips with or against the move, optional doubling lots, closes basket on summed pips/currency target or loss, optional balancing hedge order.
red_flags: No broker-side SL or TP on any order (request.sl/tp always 0); loss exit is software-only basket check
Lot progression doubles (Exponetial_Lot = last*2) with cap default 50x first lot
No entry signal at all: always in the market in both directions
UseCompletedBar branch is broken: OnTick returns unconditionally when enabled, so EA never trades
Exponential step branch tests TypeOfStepProgress==1 twice, so 'Geometrical' is overwritten and 'Exponential' option does nothing
Margin check commented out; lot sized as balance*risk/100000 with no relation to stop distance
OrderSend return bool stored in int and compared >0; result.retcode never inspected
Hedge 'lock' freezes loss instead of exiting; basket loss in pips is unweighted sum across lots
Pip multiplier treats 2-digit symbols as x100 points, which missizes steps on XAUUSD
Auto magic assumes 6-char symbols for suffix detection

ideas.name: Cumulative symbol volume-limit guard
ideas.detail: Before each order compares existing same-direction lots plus new lot against SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT; falls back to min lot if room remains, otherwise blocks the order. Also merges user MaxOrders with ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS via MathMin.
ideas.evidence: MT5_BuildYourGridEA_v1_8.mq5 OpenOrders() lines 434-448, CalcLots() lines 859-865, OnInit lines 241-248

ideas.name: OrderCheck pre-validation and bounded retry gated on trade mode
ideas.detail: Builds MqlTradeRequest with filling type chosen from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE, runs OrderCheck first, then retries OrderSend up to 4 times with 100 ms sleep only while SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE is FULL.

ideas.name: Deterministic magic number derived from symbol name
ideas.detail: When magic input is 0, generates an ID by summing character codes of the symbol weighted by position plus a base constant, so each chart symbol gets its own stable magic across restarts without user input.

ideas.name: Reject nonsensical parameter combos during optimisation
ideas.detail: OnInit returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT/INIT_FAILED in optimisation mode for out-of-range or redundant input combinations, pruning wasted optimiser passes.

title: HedgeCover EA
summary: Watches positions on the chart symbol (any or one magic); when one is 50+ pips in loss it opens a single opposite position at 1.5x volume under a separate magic, with cooldown and max-hedge count.
red_flags: Recovery hedge: opposite position at 1.5x volume against a loser, opened with SL=0 and TP=0
Hedge is never managed or closed by the EA; net exposure flips direction with no exit logic
Author's own footer says demo/testing only, no stop loss or take profit
Hedged-position list and cooldown are in-memory; restart re-hedges already hedged positions
Max-hedge count uses array size that never shrinks, so after N hedges the EA stops forever
Pip conversion (x10 on 3/5 digits) wrong for 2-digit XAUUSD quoting
No retcode inspection, no filling-mode setup, slippage variable declared but never applied
Cooldown message printed on every tick (log flooding)

ideas.name: Separate magic for derivative positions with self-exclusion
ideas.detail: Protective/secondary orders are sent under a different magic from the main strategy, and the scanner skips that magic and tracks POSITION_IDENTIFIER of already-processed positions, preventing recursive action on its own orders.

ideas.name: 80%-of-free-margin pre-trade gate
ideas.detail: Uses CAccountInfo.MarginCheck for the exact order and refuses to send if required margin exceeds 80% of free margin.

title: Tarantella
summary: Averaging grid with Fibonacci-expanding step and lot growth, entered on N consecutive same-colour bars filtered by D1 MA/MACD, ADX and a close-count price profile; adds opposite 'hedge' trades; closes on dollar basket profit.
red_flags: Averaging grid against the move with Fibonacci lot scaling; EnableStopLoss defaults 0 so positions have no SL
When SL is enabled its distance is the TakeProfit input (tick.ask - TakeProfit*_Point), an apparent bug
Hedge trades always opened with SL=0/TP=0
Filters read still-forming bar 0 (close[0] vs MA[0], ADX[0], RSI[0]) so they repaint intrabar
Indicator handles (iADX/iMA/iMACD/iATR/iRSI) created and released on every tick; buffers likely not ready and very slow
CheckProfitClosure sums profit of ALL account positions regardless of symbol or magic
'Market Profile' is a count of bar closes per price bucket, not volume or TPO
Hedge filter logic inverted in effect: sells a hedge only when uptrend filter passes
Partial close implemented as full close then re-open of remaining volume (double spread)
No spread filter, no equity/daily loss stop, no new-bar gating; pips/points mixed inconsistently
No restart persistence for hedge timing snapshots

ideas.name: Throttled, pre-validated position modify
ideas.detail: SafePositionModify enforces a minimum seconds gap between modifies and first checks SL/TP against SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL plus a configurable extra buffer (fallback distance when broker reports 0) before calling PositionModify; avoids modify spam and invalid-stops rejects.

ideas.name: Value-area / POC location filter from price histogram
ideas.detail: Every 5 minutes buckets the last N bars' closes into price levels, takes the most frequent as POC and builds a 70% value area; entries allowed only inside the value area and not within X points of POC. Would need real tick volume to be meaningful.
ideas.evidence: TarantellaV1_37.mq5 UpdateMarketProfile() line 678, CalculateValueArea() line 758, IsInValueArea()/IsNearPOC() lines 829-857

ideas.name: Momentum bar-run filter with ATR body and tick-volume floor
ideas.detail: Requires N consecutive closed bars in the same direction, each with tick volume above a minimum and candle body larger than a multiple of that bar's ATR, before permitting an entry.

ideas.name: Step-precision lot normalisation plus min-balance gate
ideas.detail: Derives decimal precision from SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP by iteration rather than assuming 2 decimals, rounds to step, clamps to min/max; trade wrapper also refuses orders below a minimum account balance and after OrderCalcMargin failure.
ideas.evidence: TarantellaV1_37.mq5 NormalizeLotSize() line 214, ExecuteTrade() line 249, CheckMarginAvailable() line 194

title: BotCilento
summary: H1 cycle EA: enters when closed bar is beyond fast and slow MA with volume/slope/volatility/spread filters, then averages down with 1.3x martingale lots on fixed or ATR step; exits on average-price TP, drawdown, stagnation, age or MA flip.
red_flags: Martingale averaging (lot = initial * 1.3^n) against the move; all orders sent with SL=0, TP=0
All exits are software-side only; terminal offline means unlimited exposure
Daily loss limit uses balance, not equity, and is only evaluated once per hour
Hard-coded market hours 01-22 server time and 5-pip minimum price move before any tick processing (magic numbers)
Stagnation rule closes any cycle within 10 pips of average after 30 minutes, likely churn
Margin computed manually as lot*contract*price/leverage instead of OrderCalcMargin (wrong for metals/CFD margin modes)
Pip factor based on digits parity; XAUUSD 2-digit pip handling unverified
Emergency drawdown measured on whole-account balance vs equity, not per magic
Cycle state rebuilt at init from positions but cooldown timers and daily start balance are lost on restart
Max grid reached closes the whole basket at a loss by design

ideas.name: ATR-ratio volatility spike filter
ideas.detail: Blocks new cycles and grid adds when short ATR(5) divided by long ATR(20) is at or above a threshold (1.5), i.e. volatility is expanding abnormally versus its own baseline.
ideas.evidence: BotCilentoV1_35.mq5 IsMarketTooVolatile() line 1486, CheckForNewCycle() line 904, AddToBuyGrid() line 1221

ideas.name: Time-based exits: max position age excluding weekends, max cycle hours
ideas.detail: Closes positions older than X hours, subtracting 48 h per full week held so weekend closure does not count; separate minimum cycle duration before a signal flip may close, and post-cycle cooldown hours before re-entry.
ideas.evidence: BotCilentoV1_35.mq5 CheckPositionAge() line 591, ManageBuyCycle() lines 1093-1156, CheckForNewCycle() cooldown check

ideas.name: Order rate limiter
ideas.detail: Trade wrapper refuses to send when a trade is flagged in progress, when one trade already went out this tick, or when trades this second exceed a cap; an in-progress flag is auto-cleared by a timer after 5 s.
ideas.evidence: BotCilentoV1_35.mq5 ExecuteTrade() line 627, OnTick() line 817, OnTimer() line 870

ideas.name: Rebuild basket state from open positions at init
ideas.detail: OnInit scans positions by magic and symbol and reconstructs cycle direction, trade count, total lots and volume-weighted average entry, so management resumes after restart instead of orphaning trades.

ideas.name: Closed-bar MA signal with minimum distance, slope and volume expansion
ideas.detail: Uses H1 bar 1 close versus fast and slow MA at shift 1, requires close to be at least N pips beyond fast MA, fast-MA slope above a floor, and bar-1 tick volume >= 1.5x bar-2 volume; evaluated once per new H1 bar.

ideas.name: Spread-compensated basket take-profit with ATR-scaled target
ideas.detail: Basket TP price = volume-weighted average entry plus target pips (ATR*multiplier when ATR step enabled) plus current spread cost, so the target is net of spread; grid step likewise ATR-scaled with a minimum floor.

title: VrDz Bot Scalp and Swing EA with Always ON Secure Layer Pro Panel
summary: Not an autonomous bot: on-chart button panel for manual BUY/SELL with risk-% lot and ATR SL/TP, plus automatic partial close, breakeven and trailing on positions of its magic. RSI is display-only; no entry logic.
red_flags: Title implies a scalp/swing EA and 'Always ON' secure layer, but there is no signal or automated entry, and Secure All runs only on button click
One-click 'REMOVE SL' button strips stop losses from all managed positions and opens new ones without SL
Default risk 5% of balance per trade
InpMaxSpread only changes a status label; spread never blocks an order
ATR and RSI read from still-forming bar 0
Default magic 0 so it manages manually opened trades; close-all/pending-delete loops filter by magic but not by symbol
ClampGlobalLot hard-codes 1.0 max lot; fixed-point trail/BE defaults (20-100 points) are far too tight for XAUUSD
Break-even and trailing modify without stops-level check or retcode handling; partial-close ticket list and panel toggles lost on restart
HasEnoughMargin returns true when OrderCalcMargin fails
Variable g_scalpMode actually means SWING (inverted naming)

ideas.name: One-shot partial close then SL to entry
ideas.detail: At a profit trigger closes a percentage of volume (rounded to lot step, clamped so at least min lot remains), records the ticket so it fires once, then moves SL to open price; ticket list pruned when positions disappear.

ideas.name: Risk-% lot from the actual ATR stop distance
ideas.detail: Lot = balance*risk% / ((slDistance/tick_size)*tick_value), where slDistance is ATR*multiplier when ATR stops are on (else fixed points); then clamped to user max, broker min/max and step.

ideas.name: SL/TP distance floor at 1.2x broker stops level
ideas.detail: GetSLTP widens SL and TP distances to at least 1.2 times SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL (fallback 10 points if broker reports 0) and re-validates each side relative to entry before normalising.

ideas.name: Runtime feature toggles and bulk actions panel
ideas.detail: Buttons toggle partial close, SL-to-entry, trailing and breakeven at runtime without reloading inputs, plus close all / close profitable / close buys / close sells / delete pendings and a 'secure all' that locks SL at entry plus N points on positions beyond a profit buffer.

ideas.name: Mode switch that re-stamps SL/TP on open positions
ideas.detail: Switching to swing mode saves current feature flags, disables partial/BE/trailing, and rewrites SL/TP of every open position to the wider swing distances from entry, skipping ones too close to price; flags restored on switch back.
ideas.evidence: VrDz_Bot.mq5 ApplySwingToOpenPositions() lines 418-492, OnChartEvent ToggleScalp lines 1524-1574

title: Auto Tp
summary: Attaches a fixed-pip TP (and optional SL) to the chart symbol's position, optional fixed-pip trailing stop, optional close when equity falls to a percent of balance. Opens no trades itself.
red_flags: SL disabled by default (UseStopLoss=false); trailing only works when SL is enabled
pip hardcoded as point*10, wrong for gold/silver digit conventions
PositionSelect(_Symbol) handles only one position, breaks on hedging accounts
no retcode, stops-level or freeze-level checks on PositionModify; retries every tick if modify fails
equity protection only closes positions with magic 2025 while header says it manages manual trades (magic 0), so the guard effectively never fires
Slippage input unused

ideas.name: Auto-attach protective SL/TP to naked positions
ideas.detail: On every tick, any position found with SL==0 or TP==0 gets stops computed from its open price. Useful as a safety net in a metals bot: if an entry was filled without stops (market-execution brokers), re-attach them immediately.

ideas.name: Equity floor as percent of balance
ideas.detail: Close positions when equity <= balance * MinEquityPercent/100. Simple floating-drawdown kill switch; needs correct magic filtering, persistence and a trading lock to be robust.

title: Assisted position closing tool
summary: Basket closer for chart-symbol positions that have no SL: closes all when summed floating profit hits a negative money limit, a profit multiple of that limit, or when price reaches the TP level of any one position.
red_flags: designed to manage baskets of positions without stop loss (typical averaging/manual grid workflow)
profit sum ignores swap and commission
raw OrderSend without type_filling set and without retcode check; fails on many brokers
PositionGetSymbol(i) used before PositionGetTicket, state held in ambiguous globals (K_1, pro_2, cor_1)
no magic filter: closes any no-SL position on the symbol
no retry or confirmation that the basket actually closed

ideas.name: Basket money stop with reward multiple
ideas.detail: Sum floating P/L of the symbol's basket; close everything at a fixed money loss L, or at profit of N times L. Gives a basket-level R-multiple exit independent of per-position stops.

ideas.name: One position's TP as master exit line for the basket
ideas.detail: If any position in the basket carries a TP price, that price becomes the close-all line for every position on the symbol, so the trader sets one level to drive the whole basket.

ideas.name: Exclude stop-protected positions from basket logic
ideas.detail: Positions that already have a broker-side SL are skipped by the basket manager, separating long-term protected holdings from the actively managed group without needing magic numbers.

title: YY_Cross_2_Ma
summary: On each new bar, checks SMA(72)/SMA(150) cross on the two closed bars and opens a fixed-lot market order with fixed TP and optional SL. No exit logic, no position count check.
red_flags: SL defaults to 0, so positions have TP only and can float indefinitely against the trend
no check for existing positions and no opposite-signal exit: every cross stacks another position
STOPLEVEL read but never applied to SL/TP distances
lot normalised by digits guessed from step rather than floored to step
new-bar flag is a static variable, not restart-safe
leftover unused variables and inputs; commented-out logging

ideas.name: Pre-trade margin check with OrderCalcMargin
ideas.detail: Before sending, compute required margin for the exact lot and price and skip the trade if it exceeds free margin, with lot clamped to user max and broker min/max.

ideas.name: Closed-bar cross detection
ideas.detail: CopyBuffer from start position 1 for two values, so the cross is evaluated only on bars 1 and 2, executed once per new bar. Avoids repaint from the forming bar.

ideas.name: Filling mode set from symbol
ideas.detail: CTrade.SetTypeFillingBySymbol and SetMarginMode called in OnInit so the order filling policy matches the broker's symbol settings.

title: OHLCMTF Scalper EA - Multi-Timeframe Price Action
summary: On each new bar, if the last closed bar made a higher high than the previous bar and the higher-timeframe bar, places a buy limit at that bar's low (mirror for sells) with percent-of-price SL/TP, order expiry and breakeven.
red_flags: header claims 'professional', 'v8.0 stress test fix' but several inputs are dead (Look_Back_Bar, Look_Forward_Bar, Buy_Cond_*, Sell_Cond_*)
signal de-duplication relies on chart objects (ObjectFind), fragile across restarts, chart changes and object cleanup
no cap on open positions or pending orders; two timeframe sets can stack exposure
breakeven trigger hardcoded at 100 points, not scaled to symbol or volatility
breakeven loop filters by symbol only, not magic, so it modifies other EAs' and manual positions
no retcode checks on OrderOpen/PositionOpen/PositionModify; filling mode never set
hardcoded magic 123456; fixed lot not tied to stop distance

ideas.name: Pullback limit entry at signal-bar extreme with expiry
ideas.detail: After a closed bar breaks the prior high and the higher-timeframe high, place a buy limit at that bar's low with ORDER_TIME_SPECIFIED expiry (60 minutes); falls back to market if price is already within the stops level.

ideas.name: SL/TP as percent of price
ideas.detail: Stop and target distances computed as price * percent/100 instead of fixed points, so the same settings stay proportionate across gold at 2000 or 4000 and silver.

ideas.name: Margin-capped volume using 90 percent of free margin
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin for 1 lot gives the maximum affordable volume from 90% of free margin; requested lot is cut to that, floored to volume step, and the trade is skipped if below minimum lot.

ideas.name: Multi-timeframe closed-bar high/low confirmation
ideas.detail: Breakout of the lower-timeframe prior bar is accepted only if it also exceeds the last closed higher-timeframe bar's high (or low for sells), evaluated on shift 1 bars only.

title: Simple_Three_Inside_Pattern_EA
summary: Every 60 seconds on a timer, checks the last three closed H1 candles for a Three Inside Up/Down pattern and opens one fixed-lot market trade with fixed 500-point SL and TP when no positions exist.
red_flags: PositionsTotal()==0 blocks trading if any position exists on the whole account
no new-bar guard: after an SL/TP exit within the same hour, the same pattern re-triggers a new entry
OrderCheck result is printed but the order is sent anyway
type_filling not set, SL/TP not normalised or checked against stops level
Open_Pos always returns true; margin check always uses ORDER_TYPE_BUY
lot not floored to volume step
fixed 500-point stops unsuited to gold volatility

ideas.name: Three Inside candle pattern on closed bars
ideas.detail: Bar 3 bearish, bar 2 bullish body inside bar 3's range, bar 1 bullish opening inside bar 2's body and closing above bar 3's high (mirror for sells). Usable as a confirmation filter, not a standalone edge.

ideas.name: OrderCheck pre-validation before OrderSend
ideas.detail: Fills MqlTradeRequest and calls OrderCheck to get the server-side validation retcode and comment before sending. In a robust bot the send should be aborted when the check fails, which this code does not do.

title: NY Open Candle: The Basics
summary: Once per day, after the M5 candle at the configured NY-open server time closes, trades its direction if body exceeds wicks and tick volume beats 1.5x average. Fixed SL/TP, risk-money sizing, forced time close.
red_flags: built for index CFDs; SL/TP are price units scaled by price/20000, a rough heuristic not volatility-based
session hour is a manual broker-server input with no DST handling
no spread or slippage filter at the open, when spreads widen
no retcode check or retry after trade.Buy/Sell; day is marked used even if the order fails
lastTradeDay kept in memory only (limited restart exposure because the signal window is one M5 bar)
stops not checked against SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL

ideas.name: Risk-money lot via OrderCalcProfit
ideas.detail: Lot = RiskMoney / abs(OrderCalcProfit for 1 lot from entry to SL). Handles contract size and currency conversion for any symbol without tick-value math; then floored to volume step and rejected if under minimum.

ideas.name: Session-open candle momentum with body and volume filter
ideas.detail: Trade the direction of the closed M5 candle at the session open only if body > sum of wicks and its tick volume > 1.5x the 20-bar average. Transferable to gold's NY or London open.

ideas.name: One trade per day key
ideas.detail: dayKey = year*1000 + day_of_year is stored when the signal candle is evaluated, whether or not a trade results, guaranteeing a single attempt per day. Should be persisted in a GlobalVariable for restart safety.

ideas.name: Forced time exit and stale-day close
ideas.detail: Every tick: close the EA's own position if server hour >= close hour, or if the position's open date differs from today. Prevents overnight and swap exposure and cleans up after downtime.

ideas.name: Margin-aware lot reduction
ideas.detail: After risk sizing, OrderCalcMargin is compared with 90% of free margin; if short, the lot is scaled down proportionally and re-normalised instead of letting the order fail with 'no money'.

ideas.name: Ownership by symbol and magic, input validation at init
ideas.detail: OwnPosition() finds positions by symbol plus magic before any action; OnInit returns INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT on invalid inputs and sets deviation and filling mode by symbol.

title: Smart Trend Follower
summary: MA-cross or MA+Stochastic signal on new bar opens a position; further same-direction signals add layers with lot x2^n when price is 200 points against. Basket TP (and optional SL) set from volume-weighted average price.
red_flags: Martingale multiplier 2.0 with averaging layers
Stop loss defaults to 0 (no SL)
MA-cross branch reads CopyBuffer index 0..2 without ArraySetAsSeries and includes forming bar
No filling mode set on raw OrderSend; no stops-level check
Position/TP comparison with != on doubles can spam modify requests every tick
getTotalVolume reads POSITION_VOLUME inside order loop (bug)
No max layer cap, no equity stop

ideas.name: Basket TP/SL from volume-weighted breakeven
ideas.detail: Compute sum(price*lot)/sum(lot) per direction, then set the same TP/SL on every position relative to that weighted average so the whole basket exits together broker-side.

ideas.name: SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT pre-check
ideas.detail: Before sending, sum existing same-direction position and pending volume on the symbol and refuse the order if adding the new lot exceeds the broker's SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT; also OrderCalcMargin vs free margin.

title: The RSI Engine
summary: New-bar RSI EA: enters on RSI divergence or OB/OS re-cross, optionally confirmed by 50-line cross; fixed-point SL/TP, simple trailing, daily P/L limits, per-weekday session strings, fixed-clock news window.
red_flags: SL can be set to 0 when risk management is off
Divergence/reversal plus same-bar centerline cross is nearly mutually exclusive, so default config rarely trades
RSI-level exit reads forming bar 0
Trailing trigger 3000 points vs TP 300 points: trailing never activates with defaults
Daily limit flag held in memory only, lost on restart (recomputed from history though)
No retcode check after trade.Buy/Sell; no stops-level check
Daily limit defaults (10000/5000 currency) are effectively off for small accounts
News filter is a single manual clock time, not a calendar

ideas.name: Per-weekday multi-window session strings
ideas.detail: Each weekday has an input like "16:30-18:00;09:00-11:00"; parsed with StringSplit on ';', '-', ':' into minute-of-day windows, allowing different trading hours per day and multiple windows.

ideas.name: Session-end flatten via edge detection
ideas.detail: Static was_in_session flag; when the state transitions from in-session to out-of-session, close all magic-number positions once, rather than polling a close time.

ideas.name: Daily profit target and loss limit from deal history plus floating
ideas.detail: Sum profit+commission+swap of today's deals for this magic via HistorySelect(day start, now), add open-position floating profit, and block new entries for the rest of the day once either threshold is crossed.

ideas.name: Two-half-window RSI divergence
ideas.detail: Split lookback in two halves, take iLowest/iHighest of each half on closed bars; divergence if price makes lower low while RSI at that bar is higher, and the earlier pivot's RSI was near oversold (+5).

title: Babi Ngepet
summary: Places buy-limit below and sell-limit above the N-bar low/high; once filled, adds market orders with lot x2 every 28 pips against, up to 8 trades, and closes the basket at a fixed currency profit. No stop loss.
red_flags: Martingale x2 up to 8 levels with no stop loss at all
Series state (s_currentLot, s_totalTradesInSeries) is in memory only; restart resets lot progression and level counter
DeletePendingOrders condition bug: 'type == BUY_STOP || ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT' is always true
GetLastTradeOpenPriceOfSeries ignores magic and symbol
Hard-coded ORDER_FILLING_RETURN on pending orders
Basket target is fixed currency amount independent of lot size
'ForbiddenDates' is a hand-curated date blacklist (curve-fit risk)
OrderGetString used inside a position loop

ideas.name: Forbidden-date blacklist string
ideas.detail: Comma-separated 'YYYY.MM.DD' input; current server date is formatted and matched with StringFind, blocking entries and deleting pendings on listed dates (usable for FOMC/NFP/holiday days).

ideas.name: Pending price clamped to stops level by order type
ideas.detail: For each pending type, clamp the requested price to at least SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL away from current ask/bid on the correct side before sending, instead of letting the server reject it.

ideas.name: Stale pending refresh after N bars
ideas.detail: Count new bars while flat; after ResetAfterBars bars delete the resting limit orders and re-place them at the updated N-bar high/low so levels do not go stale.

title: ICT_conceptsEA by Emil
summary: Intended ICT prop-challenge EA (HTF MA bias, liquidity sweep, MSS, FVG, OTE, partial TPs). As written it never trades: setup.lotSize is never assigned, so OpenTrade() always returns false.
red_flags: Dead code: CalculateLotSize() is never called and setup.lotSize stays 0, so OpenTrade() rejects every setup
MqlTradeRequest not zero-initialised; filling mode hard-coded to FOK
Signals use rates[0] without ArraySetAsSeries (index 0 is oldest bar) and HTF MA buffer likewise, so 'sweep/MSS/FVG' logic does not match its labels
Magic number = ChartID(): changes on chart reopen, orphaning positions
dailyStartEquity reset from current equity on every restart; total-DD check has hard-coded 10.0
GlobalVariables keyed by order ticket, never deleted
Creates and releases an ATR handle on every call
Header claims of 'high win-rate' unsupported

ideas.name: Partial-TP ladder state persisted in GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: On entry store TP1/TP2/TP3 prices, initial volume and TP1Hit/TP2Hit flags as terminal GlobalVariables keyed by magic+ticket, so partial closes (50/25/25% of initial volume) resume correctly after restart.

ideas.name: R-multiple scale-out with BE then trail
ideas.detail: TPs at 1R/2R/3R from the structural stop; close 50% at 1R and move SL to entry + small offset, close 25% at 2R and start a fixed-distance trail, leave the remainder to the broker TP at 3R.

ideas.name: Prop-style dual drawdown gate
ideas.detail: Block all trading when equity falls below initial balance minus max total DD%, or below day-start equity minus daily DD% of initial balance; day-start equity re-snapshotted at server midnight.

ideas.name: Signal-bar range cap as ATR fraction
ideas.detail: Reject the setup when the signal bar's high-low exceeds a multiple (0.5) of ATR(14), avoiding entries on displacement/news spike bars.

title: MeanReversionTrendEA
summary: Every-tick EA entering on SMA 20/50 cross OR price beyond slow MA +/- 2 ATR (using forming bar), one position, fixed lot and fixed-point SL/TP. Mostly a trade-validation wrapper built to pass MQL5 Market checks.
red_flags: No new-bar gating; signals read from forming bar and unsorted buffer indices (index 0 is oldest without ArraySetAsSeries)
'Safety trade': opens an unprotected min-lot buy with magic 999999 in the tester purely to satisfy validation; never managed or closed
ValidateStopLoss returns 0 (no SL) on invalid direction instead of aborting
Contradictory signal combination (trend cross OR reversion) with no exit logic besides SL/TP
Re-enters immediately after stop while condition persists
No filling mode set on raw OrderSend
Fixed lot, no risk sizing

ideas.name: Margin check with 15% reserve and stepwise lot reduction
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin * 1.15 must fit in free margin; if not, cut volume by 25% repeatedly down to min lot until it fits, otherwise return 0 and skip the trade.

ideas.name: SL/TP validator with stops-level safety buffer
ideas.detail: Checks SL/TP direction vs entry, then clamps to at least 1.2 x SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL (minimum 5 points if broker reports 0) from the current bid/ask before normalising.

ideas.name: Dedicated trade-validator class
ideas.detail: Single class caching symbol constraints (min/max/step lot, stops level, tick size/value, calc mode) with Refresh(), exposing NormalizeVolume/ValidateVolume/ValidateStopLoss so strategy code never touches raw broker limits.

title: ZetaBurst Scalper EA
summary: Tick-driven scalper: measures mid-price move over a 4s rolling window, z-scores it against the last 120 window returns, and trades with or against 3-sigma bursts. ATR-based SL/TP, risk% sizing, spread/cost gates, daily caps.
red_flags: SL/TP attached after fill, leaving a brief unprotected window (mitigated by immediate close on failure)
Uses PositionSelect(_Symbol) so assumes one position per symbol; hedging accounts with other EAs may pick the wrong ticket
Daily loss limit uses balance only (ignores floating) and day counters are memory-only, reset on restart
Baseline stats rebuilt from scratch after restart (needs 20+ samples)
Edge unproven; author states neither mode is assumed profitable; highly sensitive to tick data and latency
NormalizeDouble(lot,2) assumes 0.01 step

ideas.name: Self-calibrating z-score burst detector on tick windows
ideas.detail: Keep a rolling tick buffer of mid prices for N seconds; once per window store its return in a 120-sample history; current window move is converted to a z-score and only |z|>=3 qualifies, adapting to each symbol's current noise.

ideas.name: TP-to-spread cost gate
