ideas.detail: Skip the entry if TP distance is less than current spread x ratio (default 3), in addition to an absolute max-spread cap, so trades whose target is mostly consumed by cost are never taken.

ideas.name: Attach stops from actual fill price, close if protection fails
ideas.detail: Send market order without SL/TP, read POSITION_PRICE_OPEN, compute SL/TP from the real fill, PositionModify; if modify fails, immediately close the position rather than leave it unprotected.

ideas.name: Minimum stop distance from max(stops level, freeze level) x1.5
ideas.detail: SL and TP distances are floored at 1.5 x max(SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL) so ATR-derived stops can never be tighter than the broker allows.

ideas.name: Entry cooldown, daily trade cap and daily loss % lock
ideas.detail: New entries blocked if seconds since last entry < cooldown, trades today >= cap, or balance has dropped by X% of the day-start balance; counters reset on server date change.

ideas.name: Per-trade result from HistorySelectByPosition
ideas.detail: When the tracked ticket disappears, sum profit+swap+commission of all its deals to classify win/loss and update a running scorecard (trades, wins, win rate) printed and shown on chart.

title: Opening Range Breakout with NR4 / NR7 Contraction Filters
summary: Crabel-style ORB written for XAUUSD: at London session start places OCO buy/sell stops at open +/- 'stretch' (or ATR fraction), SL at opposite level, optional NR4/NR7/inside-day filters, risk% sizing, timed exit, daily loss lock.
red_flags: Daily-loss day-start balance is memory-only and re-snapshotted on restart
OCO handled client-side on tick; both stops could fill in a fast whipsaw before the opposite is removed
Take profit off by default (exit by time or opposite-level stop only)
No-filter mode is default; contraction filters are presented as a hypothesis to test, not proven edge
DST handled by manual server-timezone enum; wrong setting shifts the session

ideas.name: Crabel 'stretch' offset for ORB stops
ideas.detail: Offset = average over last N sessions of min(sessionHigh - sessionOpen, sessionOpen - sessionLow) from M1 data; buy stop at open+offset, sell stop at open-offset, each using the opposite level as its stop loss.

ideas.name: NR4/NR7/IDnr4/3-bar-NR contraction and WS4/WS7 expansion day filters
ideas.detail: Classify yesterday's D1 bar (Sunday stub bars dropped) as narrowest of 4/7, inside+NR4, narrowest 3-bar window of 20 days, or widest of 4/7; trade only after contraction, optionally skip after expansion; FILTER_NONE as control group.

ideas.name: London-local session time with automatic UK/US/EU DST conversion
ideas.detail: Session start entered in London time; computes UK DST (last Sundays Mar/Oct) and server offset (GMT0, NY-close with US DST, EU DST, fixed) to convert to server time, so backtests stay aligned across DST changes.

ideas.name: Spread limit as percent of the entry offset
ideas.detail: Blocks order placement while (ask-bid)/offset exceeds a percentage (default 10%), plus an optional hard cap in points; scale-free so it works across 2- and 3-digit gold quotes and for silver.

ideas.name: OrderCalcProfit-based risk sizing with guarded min-lot fallback
ideas.detail: Loss per lot from OrderCalcProfit(entry, SL) handles any contract/currency; lots floored to step; if below min lot either skip, or use min lot only when its actual risk% stays under a separate cap (1.5%).

ideas.name: Freeze-level-aware close/delete and exit before broker session end
ideas.detail: Skips close/delete requests while price is inside SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL of the order price or SL/TP and retries next tick; time exit is pulled forward to N minutes before the SymbolInfoSessionTrade session end to avoid the daily break.

title: Awesome Oscillator Pullback EA for EURUSD, +209 Percent in a 2021-2026 Backtest
summary: Once per bar: if open[2] is below LWMA[3] and AO falling, places a buy stop at the D1 low of 3 days ago (mirror for sells). ATR stop, percent-of-price target, BE and pip trailing, fixed-money risk sizing, bar-count order expiry.
red_flags: Headline backtest claim is marketing; parameters (245/145/15 pips, MA14, ATR24, 0.7%) look optimised for EURUSD
Logic is odd: buy stop is placed at a past daily LOW when momentum is falling; silently skipped unless price is below that level
Min-lot fallback can exceed the stated money risk (documented by author)
Trailing/BE only evaluated once per bar
Send() result is ignored for modifications; no logging of failures
Custom ATR recomputed over 2000 bars each signal
Pip-based BE/trail values not portable to metals without rescaling

ideas.name: Fixed-money risk sizing with volume cap
ideas.detail: Lots = risk money / (tick value / tick size x |entry - SL|), rounded down to step decimals, capped by both a user max-lots input and SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX.

ideas.name: Pending-order expiry counted in bars
ideas.detail: Each new bar, delete own pending orders whose ORDER_TIME_SETUP is at least N bars old via iBarShift, independent of broker expiration support.

ideas.name: Market-open check from the symbol session table
ideas.detail: Uses SymbolInfoSessionTrade for the current weekday to confirm server time is inside a trading session (including sessions wrapping midnight) before doing any order work.

ideas.name: Tick-size price rounding and stops-level guard on SL moves
ideas.detail: All prices rounded to SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE; MoveStop() skips the modify if the new SL or existing TP is within SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL of bid/ask; filling mode chosen from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE, time type from SYMBOL_EXPIRATION_MODE.

ideas.name: Replace same-side pending instead of stacking
ideas.detail: Before placing a new stop order, delete any existing own pending of the same type and abort if the delete fails; skip entirely while a position is open, guaranteeing at most one order per side.

title: FxCraft Example EA – Range Breakout with pending orders
summary: Time-range (e.g. Asian session) breakout: once a day places buy/sell stops beyond the M1-derived range with SL on the opposite side and RR-based TP, OCO delete, cancel and close times. Fixed lot. Refuses to run on real accounts.
red_flags: Account-type lock: ExpertRemove() on real/contest accounts (demo/tester only, promotional funnel to vendor site)
Custom licence (LICENSE.txt) rather than plain open source; reuse of code may be restricted
Fixed lot only, no risk-based sizing
Sleep(500) retry loops inside OnTick
Range and times in raw server time with no DST handling
Client-side OCO

ideas.name: Session range from M1 bars with spread-compensated stop orders
ideas.detail: High/low taken from M1 bars between range start/end regardless of chart TF; BuyStop = high + shift + spread, SellStop = low - shift, SL beyond opposite side (+spread for sells), TP = RR x stop distance; min/max range width filter in points.

ideas.name: Restart-safe once-per-day guard via order history
ideas.detail: Before placing the daily orders, checks open positions, pendings, and HistorySelect(day start) for any order with this symbol+magic set up today; if found, marks the day done, preventing duplicate orders after a restart.

ideas.name: Retry only on retryable retcodes
ideas.detail: Up to 3 attempts for place/delete/close, retrying only on REQUOTE, PRICE_CHANGED, PRICE_OFF, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS; any other retcode aborts immediately with a logged description.

ideas.name: Pre-flight broker limit checks
ideas.detail: Checks ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, per-direction SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT across all positions and pendings, and OrderCalcMargin before each pending order; widens SL/TP to the stops level and logs when it does.

ideas.name: Freeze-level check before delete/close
ideas.detail: Does not send a delete or close request when the order price or the position's SL/TP is within SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL of the market; logs once per ticket and retries on later ticks.

ideas.name: Gap-aware side skipping
ideas.detail: If price is already beyond (or within stops level of) a breakout level at placement time, that side is skipped rather than placing an invalid or late stop order.

title: Monday Dip EA- Index Mean Reversion D1
summary: Long-only weekly D1 pattern for index CFDs: buy at market after a Monday close below the prior trading day's close (optional IBS<=0.25 and below-SMA filters), exit after Wednesday's bar closes, mandatory percent-of-price stop. Fixed lot.
red_flags: Designed for equity indices; no evidence the Monday-dip seasonality applies to metals
Stop is 10% of price by default (very wide) with fixed lot, so risk per trade is uncontrolled
Pending-entry and retry state is memory-only; a restart during the delivery window drops the week's signal (by design D10)
No spread filter at the daily rollover when entries are sent
Weekend-dated D1 bars (common on some gold brokers) change behaviour

ideas.name: Confirm-by-readback for SL modify and close
ideas.detail: After PositionModify, re-select the position and compare stored SL to the requested one within a tick tolerance; after PositionClose, verify the position is actually gone before counting the exit; otherwise retry each tick.

ideas.name: Stop-loss watchdog with forced close after N failures
ideas.detail: Every tick checks that the position carries the required SL; counts consecutive failures to attach it and after 5 closes the position rather than hold unprotected risk.

ideas.name: Decide once, deliver with a bounded retry window
ideas.detail: The signal is evaluated once on bar close and stored as a pending-entry bar time; delivery is retried each tick only while that bar remains the last closed bar, and stops on DONE/DONE_PARTIAL/PLACED to avoid duplicate fills.

ideas.name: IBS (internal bar strength) filter
ideas.detail: IBS = (close - low)/(high - low) of the closed signal bar; enter longs only when IBS <= threshold (0.25), with zero-range bars treated as no-trade.

ideas.name: Always-on one-line decision journal per closed bar
ideas.detail: On every closed bar prints a single reconciliation line with bar date, reference close, filter values, position state and the exact SKIP/ENTER reason; cannot be disabled, verbose flag only adds detail.

ideas.name: Never-round-up lot normalisation
ideas.detail: Lots floored to volume step with digits derived from the step; a request below SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN aborts the trade instead of being raised to the minimum, so risk is never silently increased.

title: Reversing Grid on Limit orders
summary: Builder-generated (Mission Automate) averaging grid: opens a market trade, adds one limit order per grid step against the move with lot = last lot x multiplier, sets the basket TP at average price +/- target, and flips direction after each closed cycle. No indicators, no stop.
red_flags: Averaging grid against the move with no stop loss at all (SL parameters disabled in OnInit wiring) - unbounded drawdown, especially dangerous on XAUUSD trends
Lot multiplier input (default 1.0, geometric martingale when >1) applied to last trade lot
No cap on grid levels, no equity/drawdown stop, no spread/session/news filter
Fixed grid step and target in points (400/100) - not volatility-scaled, would be mis-sized for gold/silver
Direction is not a signal: simply alternates versus the last closed trade
Auto-generated 400KB code from a visual builder: 12k lines of generic graph-runner for ~40 lines of logic, hard to audit/maintain
Runs full element graph every tick; no new-bar discipline (not needed for the logic but wasteful)
CheckLot hardcodes NormalizeDouble(lot,2) and silently bumps under-min volume up to min lot (can exceed intended risk)
Failed order sends are not retried with backoff; errors only surfaced via debug macros that are compiled out

ideas.name: Layered pre-trade validation pipeline with own error enum
ideas.detail: Before OrderSend: CanTrade (terminal/connection/autotrading), symbol trade-mode allowed, account max orders, volume normalise, SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT check, tick available, stops-level check, order-type allowed, margin check, then OrderCheck. Each failure returns a distinct custom code (eError) for logging.
ideas.evidence: Grid.mq5 cTrade::OpenTrade lines 6341-6530; enum eError lines 28-62

ideas.name: Freeze-level guard before modify/delete
ideas.detail: CheckFreezed compares current price distance to SL/TP (positions) or entry price (pendings) against SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL and skips the modify/delete when inside the frozen zone, avoiding pointless rejected requests during fast moves.
ideas.evidence: Grid.mq5 cTrade::CheckFreezed lines 4547 and 4624; used in ModifyTrade line 6930

ideas.name: Duplicate in-flight order guard
ideas.detail: CheckPlaced scans live OrdersTotal for a market-type order with same magic/symbol/side that has no position id yet (still being processed) and blocks a second send, preventing double entries on async/slow fills.

ideas.name: Cumulative symbol volume limit and account order-count check
ideas.detail: CheckMaxVolume sums existing same-side volume and rejects when new volume would exceed SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT; CheckMaxOrders compares positions+orders to ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS. Auto filling mode chosen from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE and execution mode (fxsaber method).
ideas.evidence: Grid.mq5 cTrade::CheckMaxVolume line 4291, CheckMaxOrders line 4129, GetFilling line 5995

ideas.name: Stateless restart-safe logic derived from broker state
ideas.detail: No internal variables: every tick the state machine is re-derived from live positions, pending orders and deal history filtered by magic+symbol (last-closed trade type, last-opened price/lot, basket average price), so a restart resumes exactly where it was.
ideas.evidence: Grid.mq5 OnInit wiring lines 560-1549 (cExecutableTradesGroup HISTORY/CURRENT, cExecutablePendingOrdersGroup); cleanup of orphan pendings via cExecutableDeletePendingOrdersGroup

ideas.name: Tighten-only stop modification and SL/TP in points, money or price
ideas.detail: ModifyTrades has a tightenstopsonly flag so a stop can only move in the protective direction; CalculateSLandTP accepts SL/TP as points, account-currency money (converted via per-lot point value) or absolute price. GetLot sizes volume from money risk / SL points.
ideas.evidence: Grid.mq5 cTrade::ModifyTrade/ModifyTrades line 4089, CalculateSLandTP ~line 5700, GetLot line 5690

title: Classic 2 Moving Averages crossover EA
summary: Machine-generated (Bots Builder Pro) SMA 14/28 crossover on closed bars 1 and 2. Opens one fixed-lot market trade per side, attaches SL/TP in a second modify step, closes on opposite cross, point-based breakeven and trailing stop.
red_flags: Position is opened WITHOUT SL/TP and stops are attached by a later modify on the tick loop - a window with no broker-side stop if the modify fails or the terminal disconnects
SL input can be set to 0 (no stop); fixed 0.1 lot, no risk-based sizing wired in (GetLot exists but unused)
No new-bar gate: the crossover condition on bars 1/2 stays true for the whole bar, so after an SL/TP/BE exit the EA re-enters the same signal repeatedly within that bar
All distances in fixed points (500/1000/300/100) - not volatility-scaled, unsuitable as-is for gold/silver
12,000 lines of generated node-graph boilerplate for a trivial strategy; OrderSend failures are returned as codes but never retried or logged outside debug macros
No spread, session, news or account-level drawdown protection
CheckLot normalises volume to 2 decimals hard-coded
CheckPlaced duplicate-order guard is skipped in the tester (behaviour differs live vs backtest)

ideas.name: Layered pre-trade gate with own error enum
ideas.detail: Before OrderSend runs sequential checks: terminal/account/expert trading allowed and connected, symbol trade mode (long-only/short-only/close-only), max orders, volume limit, tick available, stops level, market order mode, margin, then OrderCheck. Each failure returns a distinct custom code.
ideas.evidence: Moving_Averages.mq5 cTrade::OpenTrade (lines 6375-6565), CanTrade (6160), OpeningAllowed (~6180), eError enum (28-63)

ideas.name: In-flight duplicate order guard
ideas.detail: Before sending, scans OrdersTotal for a still-unfilled market order with same symbol, magic and direction and no position id; refuses to send a second one. Prevents double entries on async or slow execution.

ideas.name: Auto filling mode and SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT check
ideas.detail: GetFilling derives FOK/IOC/RETURN from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE and execution mode (cached statically); CheckMaxVolume sums existing same-side position plus pending volume and rejects orders exceeding the symbol's volume limit.

ideas.name: Stops-level fallback to 2x spread and freeze-level guard
ideas.detail: When broker reports stops level 0, minimum distance for pending price/stops is taken as twice current spread. Modifications are skipped if SL/TP lies inside SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL of current price.

ideas.name: Tighten-only stop modification with trail step
ideas.detail: SL/TP setter runs with 'tighten stops only' so it never widens risk; trailing only modifies when new SL improves by at least 5 points (TSLSTEPPOINTS) to avoid modify spam; breakeven moves SL to entry plus a profit offset once profit reaches trigger.

ideas.name: Closed-bar crossover with per-side magic ownership
ideas.detail: Cross detected by comparing fast vs slow MA on bar 1 and the inverse on bar 2 (no bar-0 repaint); entry allowed only if count of own magic+symbol positions on that side is zero; opposite cross closes the other side first.
ideas.evidence: Moving_Averages.mq5 OnInit wiring: BARNUMBER 1/2 (lines 988-1018), compare/AND links (1104-1146), trades-group filters with magic (1152-1194)

title: Reversing Martingale EA
summary: Code-generator (Bots Builder Pro) output with no market signal: opens a market trade in an input direction, sets symmetric SL=TP (500 points), then alternates direction every trade and multiplies the last lot by 2.0 after each loss.
red_flags: Martingale: lot x2.0 after every losing trade, no cap on steps, no equity/drawdown stop
No entry signal at all - direction simply flips after each closed trade; always in the market
Position opened without SL, then SL/TP attached by a separate modify on a later pass (brief naked window; SL missing if modify fails)
No spread, session, news or volatility filter; fixed 500-point target is not scaled to instrument (tiny on XAUUSD)
Lot rounding clamps oversize lots to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX / raises to min silently, hiding real risk
11,700 lines of generated framework for ~10 lines of logic; hard to audit; state derived only from deal history (history-depth dependent)
Next lot depends on last closed trade profit incl. generic history lookup - partial closes/manual trades with same magic could distort the sequence

ideas.name: Pre-send validation chain with own error enum
ideas.detail: Before OrderSend, sequentially check: trading allowed, duplicate-already-placed, ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, volume validity, SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT incl. existing positions+pendings, fresh tick, stops level, free margin, then OrderCheck; each failure returns a distinct custom retcode for logging.
ideas.evidence: Reversing_Martingale.mq5 cTrade::OpenTrade lines 6035-6225; eError enum lines 51-63

ideas.name: Filling-mode auto-detection cached per symbol
ideas.detail: GetFilling derives FOK/IOC/RETURN from SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE bitmask and SYMBOL_TRADE_EXEMODE, cached in a static until the symbol changes; pending orders forced to ORDER_FILLING_RETURN.

ideas.name: Stops-level fallback of 2x spread plus freeze-level check
ideas.detail: When SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL is 0, minimum SL/TP/pending distance falls back to 2x current ask-bid; separate CheckFreezed blocks modifications when price is inside SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL of the stop/entry.
ideas.evidence: Reversing_Martingale.mq5 CheckOrderPrice lines 4185-4215; CheckFreezed lines 4236-4330; CheckStops line 4355

ideas.name: Symbol volume-limit check including pendings
ideas.detail: Sums existing same-side position lots plus same-side pending order lots and rejects a new order if total would exceed SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT; also checks ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS before sending.
ideas.evidence: Reversing_Martingale.mq5 cTrade::ExistingVolume ~3840-3960, CheckMaxVolume line 3965, CheckMaxOrders line 3803

ideas.name: Tighten-only stop modification
ideas.detail: Group SL/TP modifier has a 'tighten stops only' flag: a new SL/TP is applied only if it moves the stop closer to price than the existing one, preventing any routine from widening risk; also supports SL/TP defined in money as well as points/price.
ideas.evidence: Reversing_Martingale.mq5 cTrade::ModifyTrade(tightenstopsonly) line 7008; CalculateSLandTP line 5401; OnInit ELEMENTPARAMETER_TIGHTENSTOPSONLY

ideas.name: Stateless restart recovery from deal history by magic
ideas.detail: Next lot and direction are recomputed each tick from the latest-closed trade (magic+symbol filtered history: type, lots, profit), so no in-memory state is lost on restart; netting vs hedging accounts handled via ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE check.
ideas.evidence: Reversing_Martingale.mq5 OnInit links 'History Trades => Last Closed Ticket => Last Closed Trade'; cTrade::IsNettingAccount line 4621; cTradeInfo::SetFromHistory line 1915

title: MultiTrader
summary: Manual multi-symbol MT4 dashboard: one-click/keyboard buy/sell/close per symbol and per-currency baskets, currency-strength meter from 28 pairs' position in daily range, ATR-based auto SL/TP/lot suggestions, alerts. No automated strategy.
red_flags: SL/TP default 0 and are attached by a second OrderModify after a market order (naked window; modify failure only logged)
Currency strength uses still-forming bar 0 of D1/W1/MN (fine for a meter, repaint if used as signal)
DES-obfuscated strings (dString) in an 'about' MessageBox showing account name/login/server - local display only, no network send found, but obfuscation in open source is odd
_Lots uses tick value * points without tick-size normalisation and clamps up to MinLot when risk is too small (silently exceeds risk); header itself warns lot is 'estimated'
_OnTester opens and closes a dummy min-lot trade purely to pass the Market validator
5.5k-line monolith driven by a 100 ms timer; heavy GlobalVariable use for UI state
Forex-only hardcoded 8-currency logic; not metals-aware

ideas.name: Per-order execution time and slippage log
ideas.detail: Stamps GetTickCount before OrderSend, then logs execution ms and (fill price - requested price)/point for every open and close. For a metals bot, persist these to drive an adaptive slippage/latency guard.

ideas.name: ATR-derived auto SL with RR-derived TP and risk-% lot
ideas.detail: AutoSL = ATR(H1,14) x multiplier in points; AutoTP = SL x RR; AutoLots = balance x risk% / (tickValue x SL points), then rounded to lot step and clamped to min/max. Toggles persisted in GlobalVariables.

ideas.name: Blended multi-window ADR
ideas.detail: ADR computed as the mean of 1-, 5-, 10- and 20-day average high-low ranges, giving a volatility yardstick that reacts to recent expansion yet stays anchored; usable to normalise stops and range filters on gold.

ideas.name: Currency strength from position-in-range across crosses
ideas.detail: Each currency's strength = average of 100*(close-low)/(high-low) over its 7 crosses (inverted when quote currency). A USD strength reading at extremes (>=90 / <=10) could serve as a directional filter for XAUUSD/XAGUSD.

ideas.name: Tick-speed trigger scaled by M1 volume
ideas.detail: Price 'speed' = mid-price change in points between timer polls; alert fires only when |speed| >= previous M1 tick volume/20, i.e. an activity-relative momentum burst threshold instead of a fixed points value.

ideas.name: Panel state persisted in terminal GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: Per-symbol SL/TP/lot inputs, risk %, RR, toggles and theme are saved to GlobalVariables on deinit (with GlobalVariablesFlush) and restored on init, so manual-control settings survive restarts and timeframe changes.

title: V1N1 LONNY MT4
summary: Multi-symbol (incl. XAUUSD/XAGUSD) M15/M30/H1 Asian-range breakout: on closed-bar PSAR flip + MACD + Stochastic during London, places stop orders beyond PSAR swing outside the Asian range with ADR-clamped SL, 1.618R TP, trailing, MACD exit, EOD flatten, daily limits.
red_flags: Many Fibonacci-style hardcoded constants (0.618, 1.382, 0.236, 0.146) plus a per-symbol parameter table explicitly produced by periodic optimisation - curve-fit risk
Server GMT offset is a manual input; wrong value shifts the whole session logic
New-candle tolerance: if the timer misses the first 60 s of a bar, that bar is skipped for both entries AND position management (trailing/MACD exit/EOD close only run once per new bar)
Daily loss limit and EOD flatten are only evaluated on new bars per symbol/TF, not per tick; limit is not latched/persisted, relies on recomputation from history
Stochastic value <=0 silently replaced by 50
OrderSend/OrderModify failures only printed, no retry or retcode classification; pending orders have no expiration (cancelled only by the EOD routine)
Multiple pendings/positions per symbol across 3 timeframes can stack correlated risk (0.3% each, no portfolio cap)
In tester, lot below minimum is forced up to min lot (overstates risk fidelity)
SLIPPAGE_POINTS=100 hardcoded

ideas.name: Asian range as no-trade zone with stop orders beyond structure
ideas.detail: Asian range = high/low of N real H1 bars before DST-adjusted London open. BuyStop only if entry (last PSAR swing top + 0.146 ATR buffer) lies above range high; SellStop mirrored. Range must be 23.6%-76.4% of ADR or the day is skipped.

ideas.name: Structural SL clamped to an ADR band, TP as R-multiple
ideas.detail: SL anchored at opposite PSAR swing plus 0.236 ADR buffer, then distance clamped into [0.618, 1.382] x ADR(D1) rather than rejecting the trade; TP = clamped SL x 1.618; lot sized from the final distance via tickValue/tickSize.

ideas.name: DST-aware session engine plus broker-session flatten
ideas.detail: Computes London/NY DST from last/Nth-Sunday rules, combines with manual server offset and server DST convention to derive placement window (London open-close) and NY-close cutoff; also flattens ~31 min before the symbol's own SymbolInfoSessionTrade end.

ideas.name: Volatility-normalised spread and regime filters
ideas.detail: Max spread = 9% of ADR (not fixed points). Entries need last closed bar range > ATR (expansion bar) and blended ATR variation (fast D1 and TF ATR vs reference) within +/-61.8%, skipping abnormal-volatility spikes.

ideas.name: Full pre-trade validation chain incl. pending-margin and freeze checks
ideas.detail: Before sending: tick-size price rounding, stops-level check, pending gap >= max(stops, freeze, spread), ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, margin level >= max(200%, leverage), AccountFreeMarginCheck minus margin of all existing pendings +5%; skips close/delete inside freeze zone.
ideas.evidence: V1N1_LONNY.mq4 HasSufficientFunds() 1672, PendingOrdersMargin() 1699, CheckPendingDistance() 1771, IsPositionFrozen() 1801, IsPendingFrozen() 1830

ideas.name: Daily P/L limits from start-of-day balance, magic-scoped
ideas.detail: Start-of-day balance = balance - today's closed P/L (own magics); closed+floating P/L (incl. swap, commission) vs that base triggers cancel-pendings + close-all at +11% or -5%. Also min ADR-distance (14.6%) between same-symbol orders to prevent clustering.

title: AutoSet SL TP
summary: One-shot MT5 utility: sets fixed-pip SL/TP on all open positions of the chart symbol (buy/sell/both filter), measured from current price, respecting stops/freeze levels, then removes itself.
red_flags: No magic-number filter - modifies every position on the symbol including other EAs' and manual trades
SL/TP measured from current price, not open price
Bug: sell branch uses m_position.StopLoss() as TP when InpTakeProfit==0
Buy SL referenced from Ask and sell SL from Bid (should be opposite sides for stop-level compliance)
Runs once then ExpertRemove - no ongoing protection for later positions

ideas.name: Stops/freeze level fallback of 3x spread with 10% cushion
ideas.detail: When broker reports StopsLevel or FreezeLevel of 0, substitutes 3 x current spread, multiplies by 1.1, takes the larger of the two as minimum SL/TP distance and widens any requested stop below it. Useful on metals brokers reporting 0 levels.
ideas.evidence: AutoSet_SL_TP.mq5 FreezeStopsLevels() lines ~120-140, Modification() sl/tp checks

ideas.name: Orphan-position stop attacher (concept)
ideas.detail: Loop over positions on the symbol and attach missing SL/TP with retcode logging. In a new bot, run it as a startup/periodic watchdog restricted to own magic to guarantee no position is ever left without a broker-side stop.

title: A System: Championship 2008 Final Edit
summary: Buys/sells when live price breaks the previous closed bar's high/low (close in upper/lower half), SL at that bar's opposite extreme, TP and trail as multiples of bar range, risk-percent sizing, optional loss-lock hedge. Hardcoded for EURUSD/GBPUSD.
red_flags: Optional 'lock' hedge order opened against a losing position (LockSize=0 in shipped parameters, so inactive by default)
OrderSend/OrderClose/OrderModify results unchecked; slippage 0
Position management loop has no symbol filter and uses magic 1..4 - would manage other EAs' orders
Symbols and per-thread parameter table hardcoded (EURUSD only active); curve-fit constants (0.8, 10.0, 16.40, 20/85)
Peak-equity stop and per-order max-profit kept in static memory only - lost on restart
Trade pause uses TimeLocal; no spread filter; obfuscated naming style

ideas.name: Risk-percent sizing from structural stop distance
ideas.detail: Volume = equity * riskLimit / (stop distance in points * tick value), then floored to MINLOT + n*LOTSTEP; if result is below min lot the trade is skipped (volume 0) rather than rounded up.

ideas.name: Loss-ratio risk throttle
ideas.detail: Risk multiplier = 1 + expectedLossRate - observedLossRate, computed from this strategy's closed trades within a rolling time window; risk shrinks when recent losses exceed the expected rate (anti-martingale).

ideas.name: Profit give-back exit
ideas.detail: Track max floating profit per order; close when current profit falls below FallLimit * peak profit, but only after price has travelled more than FallFactor of the distance to TP.

ideas.name: Time-decaying trailing distance
ideas.detail: Trail distance starts as a multiple of a higher-timeframe bar range and shrinks linearly with time in trade down to the broker stops level, so stale trades get tightened automatically.

ideas.name: Peak-equity kill switch
ideas.detail: Every tick gate: trading and management stop when equity drops below 80% of the highest equity seen (SystemStop), with a one-time alert. Needs persistence to be restart-safe.

ideas.name: Previous-bar breakout with stops-level feasibility check
ideas.detail: Entry only if prior bar closed in the breakout half of its range, live price exceeds its high/low, and the structural stop (opposite extreme) is farther than the broker stops level; one action per tick with a 5-second pause after any trade operation.

title: 20/200 expert v 4.2 AntS
summary: Once a day at hour 18, compares Open[6] vs Open[2] and opens one trade with fixed asymmetric SL/TP (wide SL, tiny TP). After a losing trade the next lot is multiplied by 6. Time-stop after 504 hours.
red_flags: Lot x6 after a balance drop (BigLotSize) - martingale recovery
Inverted risk/reward: SL 147/267 points vs TP 39/32
Curve-fit magic numbers (hour 18, t1=6, t2=2, deltas) for one symbol/timeframe
Magic number 0 and OrdersTotal() without symbol filter - collides with other trades
~700-line hardcoded balance-to-lot step table
Shared unnamespaced GlobalVariables (globalBalans, globalPosic)
No spread filter, no stops-level check, no lot normalisation

ideas.name: Last-balance snapshot in GlobalVariable to detect a loss across restarts
ideas.detail: Stores balance at each entry in a terminal GlobalVariable and compares at next entry to know whether the prior trade lost; survives restarts. Reusable for loss-streak cooldowns (not for lot escalation as done here).

ideas.name: Maximum holding-time forced close
ideas.detail: Each tick closes any position whose age in hours exceeds MaxOpenTime, with RefreshRates and close-result check.

title: Angry Bird (Scalping)
summary: Ilan 1.6 clone: first entry by last-two-closes direction with H1 RSI gate, then averages against the move with lot x2 per level at a range-derived step; basket TP at weighted average price; CCI extreme closes all.
red_flags: Martingale LotExponent=2 up to 10 levels
No stop loss: Stoploss value is computed but never sent (OrderModify re-passes existing SL)
Equity stop disabled by default; equity-high tracking logic is buggy
CCI emergency close reads still-forming M15 bar 0 on every tick
OrderSelect/OrderModify/OrderClose results unchecked; 100 retries with Sleep(5000)
No spread filter, no margin check, lot normalised by user-set decimals only
Print message says 'TimeOut' for CCI close; time-out and trailing features are dead/disabled

ideas.name: Range-derived distance clamp
ideas.detail: Distance unit = (highest high - lowest low over N closed bars)/DEL, clamped between Default/DEL and Default*DEL. Reusable as a volatility-adaptive minimum spacing between re-entries or for stop distance, without averaging.

ideas.name: Momentum-extreme emergency exit
ideas.detail: Close all positions when CCI(55) on M15 exceeds +/-Drop against the position direction, i.e. bail out on a strong impulse against you instead of waiting for price levels.

title: VR---STEALS-3
summary: Manual-trading panel: chart buttons to open market/pending orders and per-order toggle buttons for virtual (broker-invisible) SL, TP, breakeven, trailing stop and time-expiry, stored as chart objects and enforced by OrderClose in a 100 ms loop.
red_flags: All stops are virtual chart objects - no broker-side SL; protection lost if terminal/VPS disconnects or objects are deleted
Infinite while(!IsStopped()) loop with Sleep inside OnTick
Orders opened with SL=0/TP=0
OnDeinit deletes all prefixed objects, so virtual levels vanish on timeframe change/reinit
Lot normalised to 2 decimals only; no stops-level or spread checks
Virtual trailing uses Ask-tr for buys while comparing with Bid (spread inconsistency)

ideas.name: Per-ticket virtual levels as draggable chart objects
ideas.detail: Each order gets named objects (sl<ticket>, tp<ticket>, tr<ticket>) whose price the user can drag; EA reads object price each loop and closes at market when crossed. Useful as a stealth layer on top of a wider hard SL.

ideas.name: Vertical-line time expiry per order
ideas.detail: A draggable OBJ_VLINE per ticket defines a deadline; after TimeCurrent passes it, market orders are closed and pending orders deleted.

ideas.name: Per-order toggle buttons anchored to entry point
ideas.detail: ChartTimePriceToXY places Sl/Tp/Br/Tr/Ti/X buttons next to each order's open time/price; button state enables each management feature per ticket; objects for closed tickets are purged from history scan.

title: Ilan 1.6 Dynamic HT
summary: MT5 port of Ilan 1.6 via the HedgeTerminal API: RSI/last-close first entry, then averaging into losers with lot x1.4 per level at range-derived step, basket TP at weighted average; optional SL, equity, CCI, time and trailing stops all off by default.
red_flags: Martingale LotExponent=1.4, up to 10 averaging levels
UseStopLoss=false by default; positions opened with SL=0 and TP set afterwards
Depends on external closed-source library hedgeterminalapi.ex5 (#import from Experts\Market)
GetLot uses exponent positions+1, so second lot jumps by 1.4^2... relative to base
Short trailing condition uses stopLevel>currStopLoss (wrong direction for shorts)
Lot rounded by user 'lotdecimal' input, not symbol volume step; no spread or margin check
SetLimitWaitMsc resets to 3000 then overwrites with the invalid value

ideas.name: Deal-count confirmation with exponential backoff
ideas.detail: Before sending an order remember HistoryDealsTotal; afterwards poll with Sleep(2^i ms) until the deal count changes or a timeout (3 s) is hit, returning false if state never changed - avoids acting on stale position state after async fills.

ideas.name: Environment snapshot class
ideas.detail: One Refresh() per tick computes magic+symbol-filtered counts, direction, volume-weighted average price, first open time, floating profit and peak floating equity; all rules read from this single snapshot instead of rescanning positions.

ideas.name: Basket loss cap vs peak basket equity
ideas.detail: Close all positions when floating loss of the basket exceeds TotalEquityRisk% of the stored equity high, checked on every tick before the new-bar gate.

ideas.name: Time stop measured in traded H1 bars
ideas.detail: Holding time is counted with CopyClose(H1, firstOpen, now) so weekends/market closures do not count toward the MaxTradeOpenHours limit.

ideas.name: Tolerant double comparison before modify
ideas.detail: SL/TP modify requests are sent only if new level differs from current using a relative-epsilon DoubleEquals, avoiding redundant modify calls and 'no changes' errors.

title: Profit Loss Calculator
summary: Chart dialog (CAppDialog) with draggable entry/SL/TP lines and spin edits that convert between pips and account-currency profit/loss for a chosen lot and order type using OrderCalcProfit. Never sends orders.

ideas.name: OrderCalcProfit-based money-at-risk conversion
ideas.detail: Uses OrderCalcProfit(type, symbol, lot, entry, exit) to get exact loss/profit in account currency instead of tick-value arithmetic; correct for metals with non-USD accounts and odd contract sizes. Invertible to size lots from a money risk.

ideas.name: Two-way linked draggable lines and numeric fields
ideas.detail: Dragging entry/SL/TP horizontal lines updates pips and money fields, and editing money or pips moves the lines; min/max bounds are recomputed on each change.

title: TradePanel
summary: MT4 manual one-click panel: Buy/Sell/Close buttons with lot, SL, TP edit fields, close modes (all/last/profit/loss/partial), tick speedometer, daily P/L display and history drawing. No automated signals.
red_flags: SL/TP attached by a second OrderModify after a naked market order (position unprotected if modify fails, no retry)
SL silently reset to 0 when the typed value is below the broker stops level
Function names shadow built-in OrderSend/OrderClose
No retry or requote handling, just Sleep and return
Lots rounded with MathRound (can round up above intended size)

ideas.name: Per-order execution time and slippage logging
ideas.detail: Record GetTickCount before OrderSend, then log elapsed ms and (fill price - requested price)/Point for every open and close. Gives a live record of broker execution quality per trade.

ideas.name: Pre-trade gate: trade allowed, context free, connected, margin
ideas.detail: Before any order: IsTradeAllowed && !IsTradeContextBusy && IsConnected, then AccountFreeMarginCheck>=0 and min/max lot range check, with a distinct log message for each failed condition.

ideas.name: Selective close modes with magic/symbol ownership
ideas.detail: One close routine filtered by symbol and magic number supporting all, last only, only profitable, only losing (profit incl. commission and swap), or partial close of a fixed lot amount capped at OrderLots.

ideas.name: Tick speed meter from mid-price change
ideas.detail: Each tick computes change of (Ask+Bid)/2 in points versus the previous tick, capped at 99, and accumulates up/down tick totals. Could be adapted as a fast-market or spike detector to pause entries.

ideas.name: Panel settings persisted in terminal GlobalVariables
ideas.detail: Lot size, SL, TP, close mode, theme and panel coordinates are written to GlobalVariables on deinit with GlobalVariablesFlush and restored in OnInit, so settings survive restarts and timeframe changes.

title: MACD Sample
summary: MetaQuotes sample: MACD/signal crossover below or above zero with a threshold, filtered by EMA slope. Fixed lots, fixed TP, no initial SL; fixed-distance trailing stop only after profit; exits on opposite MACD cross.
red_flags: No initial stop loss: PositionOpen passes SL 0.0; a stop appears only once the trailing distance is in profit
Signals read from still-forming bar 0 on every tick (intrabar repaint)
Hard-coded magic 12345 and MACD 12/26/9
PositionSelect by symbol only, no magic ownership check (netting assumption)
Pip-based levels and 3/5-digit adjustment do not fit gold or silver quoting
No filling-mode handling or retcode-specific retries

ideas.name: Init-time parameter validation against broker limits
ideas.detail: OnInit fails if TP or trailing distance is below SYMBOL stops level, or if lot is outside min/max or not a multiple of the lot step (remainder test with 1e-10 tolerance).

ideas.name: Post-trade cooldown timer
ideas.detail: After any processed trade action, a static limit_time = TimeCurrent()+10s blocks further processing, preventing duplicate orders while the server state catches up.

ideas.name: Free margin check before open
ideas.detail: Calls FreeMarginCheck(symbol, type, lots, price) and skips the order with a log line if the result is negative, instead of sending an order that will be rejected.

ideas.name: One action per tick, exits before entries
ideas.detail: Processing() refreshes rates and buffers (aborting if CopyBuffer returns fewer than requested), then tries close, then modify, then open, returning after the first action taken.

title: Simple Order Panel
summary: Cross-platform (MT4/MT5 macros) manual order panel: market and pending orders, fixed lots or balance-percent risk sizing from SL distance, SL-to-breakeven, close all/by side, partial close, modify SL/TP, optional auto TP from SL ratio.
red_flags: Risk sizing divides by tick value assuming tick size equals point; wrong on symbols where they differ (common on metals/CFDs)
Order results not checked for market/pending sends; only GetLastError printed on modify/close
No stops-level or freeze-level validation before sending SL/TP
SL may be 0 in fixed-lot mode
affectOtherTrades option lets it modify/close positions with other magic numbers
Optional asynchronous order mode with no result handling

ideas.name: Percent-of-balance lot sizing with loss-side tick value
ideas.detail: lots = floor((balance*risk%/SL_points)/SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE_LOSS/step)*step; refuses to trade if SL is 0 or lots fall below min volume instead of silently using min lot. Needs tick-size correction for metals.

ideas.name: Guarded SL-to-breakeven sweep
ideas.detail: Loops positions by symbol and magic; moves SL to open price only if price is currently beyond entry in profit and SL is not already at entry, keeping the existing TP.

ideas.name: Floor-based volume normalisation with min/max clamp
ideas.detail: NormalizeLots uses MathFloor(lots/step)*step then clamps to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN and MAX, so rounding never increases risk above the requested amount.

ideas.name: Auto stop-vs-limit pending order selection
ideas.detail: For a chosen price, sends BuyStop if price is above Ask, otherwise BuyLimit (mirrored for sells), with SL/TP computed from the pending price and risk recalculated from that price.

ideas.name: Macro abstraction layer for MT4/MT5 trade calls
ideas.detail: POS_BUY, POS_MODIFY, POS_CLOSE_PARTIAL, POS_SELECT_BY_INDEX etc. are defined per platform under #ifdef so one logic body compiles for both MQL4 and MQL5.

ideas.name: Linked SL/TP by reward-to-risk ratio
ideas.detail: When SL is edited, TP is auto-set to SL*ratio (autoSetTP); optionally the reverse. Values persisted in GlobalVariables across restarts.

title: No Nonsense Backtester
summary: Custom in-OnInit bar-loop simulator for NNFX systems (baseline + 2 confirmations + volume + exit via iCustom) across many symbols, with virtual orders, ATR sizing, scale-out, grid-search optimisation and CSV reports. No real trading logic.
red_flags: Sends a real 0.01-lot market order in OnInit as a 'Commission test' when run in the tester, with no SL
Source file is encoding-damaged (UTF-16 nulls replaced); will not compile as downloaded
Huge global arrays of 100000 elements and single-letter globals shared across functions
Simulation checks SL before TP on the same bar (pessimistic) but uses a fixed spread and no slippage or swap
Lot can be below broker minimum with only a print warning
Hard-coded 28 FX pairs and EURUSD as the end-of-test clock; not metals-aware
orderClosed[i-1] indexed at i=0 (out-of-range risk)

ideas.name: ATR-normalised percent risk sizing
ideas.detail: Lot = balance*risk% / (ATR*SL_multiplier/Point) / TickValue using the closed bar's ATR; falls back to 0.01 with explicit log if ATR, point or tick value are zero.

ideas.name: Two-half scale-out with ATR TP then breakeven and ATR trail
ideas.detail: Opens two half-lot orders with the same 1.5 ATR SL; first has TP at 1 ATR, second has none (or TP2). After the first closes, runner SL moves to entry, then trails by 1.5 ATR once price is 2 ATR in profit, using the entry-time ATR.
ideas.evidence: NoNonsenseTester.mq4 OnTick() closing/trailing block and orderSend calls

ideas.name: Distance-from-baseline overextension filter
ideas.detail: Skip entry if the last close is more than distanceFromBL*ATR (default 1 ATR) beyond the baseline value, avoiding chasing extended moves.

ideas.name: Closed-bar confluence with fresh-flip requirement and continuation flag
ideas.detail: All components read from bar+1; entry requires all aligned now and at least one not aligned on bar+2 (new signal). A continuation flag permits re-entry without volume/distance checks while baseline stays on the same side.

ideas.name: Drawdown-normalised return metric
ideas.detail: Tracks peak-to-trough balance drawdown, then reports yearly return rescaled to a 5% max drawdown ('goodEnough') plus profit factor, TP-hit rate and CAGR, written per parameter set to CSV.

ideas.name: Generic indicator-to-signal adapter table
ideas.detail: signal() maps any iCustom indicator to +1/-1/0 using a type code (zero cross, two-line cross, MA vs close, level cross, slope, non-empty buffer) and buffer indices, so signal components are swappable by configuration.

title: Renko Live Charts v4.13
summary: MT4 offline-chart builder: converts time bars and live Bid ticks into fixed-size Renko bricks with wicks, writes them to a .hst history file and refreshes the offline chart via user32 window messages. Opens no trades.
red_flags: DLL import (user32.dll RegisterWindowMessageA/PostMessageA) required to refresh offline chart
Historic bricks rebuilt from OHLC bars guess intrabar order (UpTrend heuristic), so backtests on the Renko chart are not faithful to live brick formation
MT4 .hst v400 format only, not portable to MT5

ideas.name: ATR-derived Renko brick size smoothed by MA of ATR
ideas.detail: Brick size is not a fixed pip count: optionally computed from ATR(24) on H1, itself averaged by a 120-period MA, so the price-noise unit adapts to current volatility. Reusable as an adaptive 'noise unit' for stops/grids on metals.

ideas.name: Tick-driven brick state machine (price-move bars instead of time bars)
ideas.detail: Keeps PrevHigh/PrevLow of last brick; a new brick is confirmed only when Bid exceeds PrevHigh+Box or falls below PrevLow-Box, with wick extremes tracked between bricks. Gives closed-brick, non-repainting trend/reversal events independent of timeframe.

ideas.name: Pre-flight guards before starting work
ideas.detail: Refuses to run until IsConnected, DLL permission is confirmed, parameters are sane (|offset| < box size) and the target timeframe is not a standard one; each failure is printed and retried on the next tick rather than aborting.

title: Renko Charts
summary: Older v3.2 of the same MT4 Renko offline-chart generator: builds fixed-pip Renko bricks from history and live Bid into a .hst file and pokes the offline chart window through user32. No trading.
red_flags: DLL import (user32.dll) for chart refresh
Fixed brick size in pips only, no volatility adaptation
Historic brick reconstruction from OHLC is approximate, misleading for backtests run on the offline chart

title: RoNz Auto SL-TS-TP v2.06
summary: MT4 trade manager for manually opened orders: attaches SL/TP (broker-side or hidden client-side), locks a fixed profit after a trigger distance, then trails with one of three methods. Opens trades only as a tester dummy.
red_flags: Default mode is hidden (client-side) SL/TP: no broker-side stop if terminal or connection drops
OrderModify/OrderClose results not checked for error codes, no retry
No magic-number or ticket ownership filter: manages every order on the account (or symbol)
Stop distance silently enlarged by adding MODE_STOPLEVEL instead of clamping
Fixed point distances, no volatility scaling
Tester dummy entry reads bar 0 EMAs

ideas.name: Two-phase exit: profit-lock then trailing
ideas.detail: When profit reaches LockProfitAfter points, SL jumps once to entry+ProfitLock. Trailing only takes over once profit exceeds LockProfitAfter+TrailingStop, so the lock step and the trail never fight over the SL.

ideas.name: Three selectable trailing modes incl. stepped
ideas.detail: Classic (SL=bid-dist every tick), Step-keep-distance (modify only after price moved a full dist, SL=bid-(dist-step)), Step-by-step (SL advances by fixed step). Stepped modes cut OrderModify spam and broker rejections on fast metals ticks.

ideas.name: Selectable server-side vs virtual SL/TP
ideas.detail: One enum switches between placing SL/TP at the broker (only filling in whichever side is still 0) and hidden levels enforced by OrderClose when floating points cross the threshold. A robust bot could combine: wide broker 'disaster' SL plus tighter virtual exit.

ideas.name: Per-order symbol properties for multi-symbol management
ideas.detail: For each order it reads point, digits, stop level, bid and ask of OrderSymbol() via MarketInfo rather than chart-symbol globals, so one instance can manage XAUUSD and XAGUSD with different digits correctly.

title: Close at Profit
summary: MT4 account utility: sums floating profit+swap+commission of open orders (all symbols or chart symbol) and closes everything, optionally deleting pendings, when total exceeds a money profit target or falls below a money loss limit.
red_flags: maxSlippage variable is never assigned from the MaxSlippage input, so closes run with 0 slippage and can be rejected
No magic-number filter: closes all trades on the account
No RefreshRates or retry inside the close loop; first failure aborts the pass
Loss limit is in account currency, disabled by default, and not persisted; other EAs can reopen immediately after the flush
Four near-identical copy-pasted close functions

ideas.name: Basket profit/loss flush in account currency
ideas.detail: Aggregates OrderProfit+swap+commission across the selected scope each tick; if above profitToClose or below -lossToClose, closes all market orders and optionally deletes pendings. Simple equity-style kill-switch for a multi-position basket.

ideas.name: Latch flag to finish an interrupted close-all
ideas.detail: If any close fails, a 'clear=false' flag is set and on every subsequent tick the EA retries the full close/delete before evaluating anything else, so a triggered flush cannot be half-executed and then forgotten.

title: Simple Scalping EA
summary: MT4 straddle: keeps one buy-stop and one sell-stop 100 points from price with fixed pip SL/TP, and tries to re-position pendings on every tick. No indicator signal; several inputs (Periods, UseCompletedBars) are unused.
red_flags: Reposition conditions are broken: (OrderOpenPrice()+Bid)>0.007 is always true, so pendings are modified on every tick
Hardcoded 0.0005/0.0007 price thresholds are FX-specific and meaningless on gold/silver
CountAll counts only pending orders, so a new pending is placed as soon as one fills: unbounded position stacking
No spread, session or news filter on a tick scalper
SL becomes 0 if StopLoss input is 0; stop level and freeze level never checked
'continue' inside an if within the while-retry loop can spin; Sleep busy-wait on trade context
No lot normalisation or money management

ideas.name: Error-class-based order retry loop
ideas.detail: After each OrderSend/Modify, the error code is classified: transient (server busy, off quotes, no connection, context busy) increments a try counter capped at 10; requote/price-changed retries immediately with RefreshRates; fatal (invalid stops, volume, no money, market closed) aborts with a log.

ideas.name: Separate magic number per direction for a stop-order straddle
ideas.detail: Buy-stop and sell-stop legs carry distinct magic numbers, so each side is counted, updated and managed independently. Useful for breakout straddles where each leg needs its own lifecycle and OCO handling (OCO itself is not implemented here).

title: An Expert Advisor, based on Bollinger Bands
summary: MT5 netting EA: on a new bar, buys when the last closed candle crosses back above the M30 lower Bollinger band while D1 DEMA rises (mirror for sells); exits on the opposite band re-entry candle. Fixed 0.5 lot, no SL/TP.
red_flags: No stop loss or take profit at all (sl=0, tp=0); exit only by opposite band signal
OrderSend result/retcode never checked
Hardcoded ORDER_FILLING_FOK, will be rejected on many brokers
Fixed 0.5 lot default, no volume normalisation or margin check
Magic number 0 and PositionSelect(_Symbol): netting-only, no ownership check
DEMA trend filter uses forming D1 bar (demaVal[0])
Bands hardcoded to M30 while candles come from chart timeframe: mismatched indexing if chart is not M30
Close uses fixed Lot rather than actual position volume

ideas.name: Band re-entry candle instead of band touch
ideas.detail: Entry requires the closed bar to open outside the band and close back inside (open<lower && close>lower for buys), i.e. confirmation of rejection rather than fading the first touch. Reduces knife-catching during gold trend extensions.

ideas.name: Higher-timeframe slope gate for mean-reversion
ideas.detail: Counter-band entries are only taken in the direction of a daily DEMA(20) that has risen (or fallen) for two consecutive values, so mean-reversion trades are pullback entries with the D1 trend, never against it.

ideas.name: New-bar gate via CopyTime with static last-bar time
ideas.detail: Compares the current bar open time from CopyTime against a static datetime and runs signal logic once per bar; copy failures abort the tick with an error rather than trading on stale data.

title: MQL5 Wizard - Trade Signals Based on Reversal Candlestick Patterns
summary: Standard-library CExpert with a custom signal: detects hammer/shooting-star style reversal candles, merging up to N bars into a composite candle until a minimum range is met, then enters with SL/TP as multiples of that candle's range. Fixed lot.
red_flags: Default SL 2.0x and TP 1.0x candle range gives a 1:2 reward:risk against the trader
Fixed-lot money management (CMoneyFixedLot), lot not tied to the variable stop distance
Minimum candle size is a fixed point count (50), not volatility-normalised
No trend, session or spread filter; shadow ratios are magic numbers
Educational wizard sample, no evidence of edge

ideas.name: Composite-candle pattern detection
ideas.detail: If the last closed bar's range is below a minimum, it is merged backward with up to Range-1 earlier bars (first open, max high, min low, last close) until the range qualifies, and the shadow test is applied to the composite. Makes pin-bar detection timeframe-robust.

ideas.name: Ratio-based rejection candle definition
ideas.detail: Bullish rejection = upper shadow < ShadowSmall x range and lower shadow (close-low) > ShadowBig x range; bearish mirrored. Purely proportional, so it needs no pip constants and works on any instrument's price scale.

ideas.name: SL/TP and limit-entry offset scaled by signal candle range
ideas.detail: Entry price = ask - Limit x size, SL = price - StopLoss x size, TP = price + TakeProfit x size where size is the composite candle's high-low; pending order expires after N bars. Stops adapt to the structure that generated the signal.

ideas.name: Signal / trailing / money modules plugged into a CExpert shell
ideas.detail: Signal class only answers CheckOpenLong/Short and CheckCloseLong/Short with price, sl, tp, expiration; order handling, new-bar processing, trailing and sizing live in separate replaceable modules initialised in OnInit with validation.

title: MQL5 Wizard - Trade Signals Based on Crossover of Two Exponentially Smoothed Moving Averages
summary: Standard-library CExpert sample: opens long when fast EMA(12) crosses above slow EMA(24) between closed bars 2 and 1, short on the opposite cross, closes on reverse cross. No SL/TP, fixed lot, no trailing.
red_flags: Signal returns sl=0 and tp=0: positions have no protective stop
Fixed lot sizing, CTrailingNone
Plain MA crossover with no trend-strength, volatility or session filter: whipsaws in ranges
Educational sample, no evidence of edge

ideas.name: Crossover confirmed on two closed bars
ideas.detail: Cross is defined as sign change of (fast-slow) between bar 2 and bar 1, never bar 0, so the signal cannot repaint within the forming bar; the same state function drives both entry and reverse-exit.

title: KSQ CommandCenter Remote Google Sheets Trade Manager
summary: MT5 timer-driven remote manager: POSTs account and position status as JSON to a user-supplied Google Apps Script URL, polls it for commands, and executes CLOSE_ALL or BREAKEVEN per symbol or account-wide, then reports the result row.
red_flags: WebRequest remote control channel: anyone controlling the sheet/URL can close all positions or move stops
Password sent in plaintext JSON body, default 'Secret'
Sends account login, balance, equity and positions to an external server
Deliberately opens a no-SL dummy trade in the tester labelled 'MQL5 Validator Bypass'
Naive string-search JSON parsing, only the first command in a response is processed
No magic filter: acts on all positions on the account; breakeven does not verify price is beyond the new SL or stop level
Blocking WebRequest with 10s timeout in OnTimer

ideas.name: Remote kill-switch / breakeven command queue with acknowledgement
ideas.detail: EA polls an endpoint every N seconds for a command row (account, symbol or ALL, action, value), executes it, then posts mark_command_done with SUCCESS/FAILED and details so each command runs once and the operator sees the outcome.

ideas.name: Heartbeat telemetry with event-forced push
ideas.detail: Status JSON (balance, equity, margin level, per-position ticket/symbol/type/volume/profit) is pushed on a fixed interval and immediately whenever PositionsTotal() changes, giving near-real-time external monitoring without per-tick traffic.

ideas.name: Tighten-only breakeven with offset
ideas.detail: New SL = open price +/- offset points, applied only if no SL exists or the new SL is more favourable than the current one, so a remote or automated breakeven command can never loosen an existing stop.

ideas.name: Account-login match and margin pre-check
ideas.detail: Commands are ignored unless their account field equals ACCOUNT_LOGIN; before any market order OrderCalcMargin is compared against free margin with a buffer. Both are cheap guards against wrong-account actions and not-enough-money rejections.

title: JPAlonso-modoki
summary: Wizard CExpert with a modified Envelopes(200 SMA, 0.35%) signal: long if live Ask is below the lower band or between midline and upper band; short mirrored. Fixed 77-point SL and 127-point TP, fixed 5.0 lots, no trailing.
red_flags: Signal compares the live tick price against bands, not closed-bar values: intrabar flip-flop
Rule set gives a signal in nearly every price zone, so it is effectively always in the market with fixed SL/TP
Default fixed volume 5.0 lots
77/127-point stops and 0.35% envelope are curve-fit FX constants, far too tight for gold or silver
Uses global Symbol() rather than the module's m_symbol
No spread, session or volatility filter

ideas.name: Envelope zone map: trend inside, fade outside
ideas.detail: Price zones relative to a 200-SMA percentage envelope decide bias: above midline but inside the upper band = long continuation, beyond the upper band = short fade (mirrored below). A regime map combining trend-following and over-extension reversal on one indicator.

title: The MasterMind 2 (Version2.0)
summary: MT4 always-in reversal EA: buys when Stochastic(100,3,3) signal <3 and WPR(100) < -99.9, sells at the opposite extreme; closes on opposite signal. Fixed SL 2000 pts, optional trailing/breakeven, retrying order wrappers, email alerts.
red_flags: Stochastic read from forming bar 0 (WPR from bar 1) - intrabar signal can repaint
Default Lots=200 and hidden mm=-1 sizing formula with magic constant (FreeMargin*Risk/715)
MagicNumber default 0 makes it manage/close ALL orders on the symbol incl. manual ones
StopLoss can be set to 0; no spread, session or stops-level checks
OrderSelect return values unchecked; old pre-strict MQL4 style
Extreme thresholds (<3 / >97, WPR -99.9) are curve-fit and fire very rarely

ideas.name: Dual-oscillator extreme confirmation
ideas.detail: Entry only when two long-lookback oscillators (Stochastic signal line and Williams %R, both period 100) are simultaneously pinned at the extreme (<3 / >97, %R within 0.1 of bound). Usable as an exhaustion filter, evaluated on closed bars.

ideas.name: Throttled repeating alerts
ideas.detail: Alert/email repeated at most Repeat times with a minimum Periods-second gap, counter reset when signal state clears; avoids notification spam on persistent signals.

title: MQL5 Wizard - Trade Signals Based on Morning/Evening Stars + RSI
summary: MQL5 Wizard CExpert template: signal module votes 80 for Morning/Evening Star confirmed by RSI(1)<40 / >60 on closed bars, votes 40 for RSI 30/70 crossings used for exits. Fixed lot, no trailing, SL/TP level inputs default 0.
red_flags: Signal_StopLevel and Signal_TakeLevel default to 0 - no broker-side SL unless configured
Fixed-lot money management (MoneyFixedLot), no risk-based sizing
RSI period 47 / MA 3 are optimised magic numbers
No spread, session or volatility filter

ideas.name: Candle body size normalised by average body
ideas.detail: Pattern legs qualified relative to AvgBody (SMA of |close-open| over N bars): long candle > AvgBody, star body < 0.5*AvgBody, third candle closes above midpoint of first. Scale-free, so it transfers to gold/silver without point tuning.

ideas.name: Weighted vote with separate open/close thresholds
ideas.detail: Signal modules return 0-100 scores; pattern+oscillator confirmation scores 80, plain oscillator crossing 40. Open needs ThresholdOpen (40), opposite score above ThresholdClose (20) closes. Cleanly separates entry strength from exit triggers.

ideas.name: Closed-bar-only evaluation with oscillator exit
ideas.detail: All checks use bars 1..3 with Expert_EveryTick=false; exit votes come from RSI crossing back through 30/70 between bar 2 and bar 1 rather than from a price target.

title: Support Resistance Trader
summary: MT4 new-bar EA: builds sloped support/resistance from the last ZigZag segment, enters when SMA(7) of highs/lows crosses the line with rising but capped StdDev, gated by BB-width band, ADX minimum and hour window. Fixed SL/TP, pip trailing.
red_flags: Many curve-fit constants tuned to EURUSD H1 (BB width 25-70 pips, StdDev*1000 < 1.38, ADX 24) - not scale-free, unusable on metals as is
Fixed lot only, no risk-based sizing
OrderSend/OrderModify failures only printed, no retry; stops level not checked
CheckMoneyForTrade resets lots above MAXLOT to MINLOT (typo-level logic)
No spread filter

ideas.name: Bollinger width band regime filter
ideas.detail: Trades only when BB(20,2) upper-lower width on the closed bar lies between a lower and an upper limit, excluding both dead and overextended volatility; combined with ADX minimum. Should be expressed in ATR multiples for metals.

ideas.name: Sloped S/R channel from last ZigZag segment
ideas.detail: Takes bars since last confirmed ZigZag pivot, slope = (close[first]-close[last])/bars; anchors parallel lines at the segment's highest high and lowest low, projects them to bar 1 as resistance/support values.

ideas.name: Smoothed-extreme breakout with rising-but-capped volatility
ideas.detail: Breakout requires SMA of highs (not a single tick/close) above resistance, plus StdDev increasing versus prior bar yet below a ceiling - confirms expansion while avoiding entries after a spike.

ideas.name: Opposite-signal close filtered by profit sign
ideas.detail: On opposite trigger the open trade is closed only if it matches a profit-type selector (0 all, 1 only non-negative, 2 only negative), letting losers ride to their hard SL instead of being cut by a noisy flip.

ideas.name: Start-hour plus duration window with midnight wrap
ideas.detail: Session defined as entry hour + number of open hours, with wrap handling past 23:00; plus per-symbol and account-wide open-order caps.

title: Smart Tunel Trading
summary: MT4 EA draws trendlines through ZigZag highs/lows (pivot 0 and 3) and trades touches: buys within N points above the low line, sells below the high line. SL=10xATR capped, TP=channel height, risk-% sizing, points trailing, spread and time filters.
red_flags: Default Risk_Percentage=30% of balance per trade
Trendlines use unconfirmed ZigZag pivots (incl. bar 0) and are redrawn every tick - repainting levels
Tick-based entry, no closed-bar confirmation
MaxStopLoss cap condition for buys is dimensionally wrong (SL/Point > MaxStopLoss*Point), so cap behaviour is unreliable
Order sent without SL then modified - brief naked exposure; if modify retries fail the position stays without SL
Declared Stochastic/CCI/RSI inputs are never used; WeekendClose commented out
Loops entire history calling iCustom ZigZag on every tick (slow)
Spread only refreshed on new bar

ideas.name: Risk-% lots with free-margin cap
ideas.detail: lots = balance*risk% / (tickValue*SL points); if lots*MARGINREQUIRED exceeds free margin, shrink to freeMargin/marginRequired, then round to lot step and clamp to broker and user min/max.

ideas.name: TP equal to structure height, SL ATR-multiple with hard cap
ideas.detail: TP distance = height between latest ZigZag high and low (channel height); SL = 10x ATR from entry, replaced by MaxStopLoss when larger; user TakeProfit caps TP.

ideas.name: Proximity-band touch entry on projected trendline
ideas.detail: Entry allowed only while price sits inside a narrow band (TouchPip points) on the inner side of the projected trendline value at bar 0, i.e. buy just above support, sell just below resistance.

ideas.name: One-entry-per-bar cooldown plus weekday/spread gate
ideas.detail: Blocks new orders until LastOrderTime + PeriodSeconds has elapsed, on Fri/Sat/Sun, when open-order count hits cap, or when spread > MaxSpread.

ideas.name: Trade-context wait and bounded retry loop
ideas.detail: Waits up to 50x100ms while IsTradeContextBusy, then retries OrderSend/OrderModify up to RETRYCOUNT with RETRYDELAY sleep and RefreshRates between attempts.

title: FMOneEA
summary: MT4 tick scalper using fast MA-of-MA slope and MACD on bar 0; opens with 157-pip SL and small timeframe-based TP, breakeven and step trailing. 'Redemption' closes a losing trade and reopens with lots x2 (capped 4x).
red_flags: Martingale 'Redemption': lot multiplied by LotsRedempt=2.0 after a loss, up to 4x base
Signals and force-close logic computed from forming bar 0 (iMA/iMAOnArray shift 0, High[0]/Close[0])
Risk/reward inverted: SL 157 pips vs TP 14-42 pips
Hard-coded magic number 1119 and hard-coded pip constants (bep 7.7 pips, TP array 14/28/42)
Copyright input string acts as a check - EA silently stops initialising if the string is edited
Equity-based lot heuristic unrelated to stop distance; no spread filter
Uses undeclared-scope variables (pre-strict MQL4), recovery state held in memory only - lost on restart

ideas.name: Three-phase stop: breakeven, trail start, stepped ratchet
ideas.detail: Once profit exceeds BE limit plus spread, SL moves to open+7.7 pips; then to open+trailStart; afterwards SL advances in fixed step increments counted by an integer (trxb*step) while TP is pushed further out, making TP dynamic.

ideas.name: Timeframe-tiered TP/trailing distances
ideas.detail: TP and trailing distances chosen from a small table keyed by chart period (<M30, M30-H4, >=H4) instead of one fixed value. Better done with ATR, but the tiering idea prevents a single constant across timeframes.

ideas.name: Pre-trade free-margin check
ideas.detail: Before OrderSend, AccountFreeMarginCheck for the intended lots must be positive and last error not 134; otherwise the order is skipped with a log message; send is retried once on failure with error description.

title: ASQ Command Desk
summary: MT5 manual-trading panel: one-click/hotkey market and pending orders with risk-% sizing, three-stage partial take-profits, ATR/points/previous-bar trailing, auto breakeven, session-peak equity drawdown guard that flattens and blocks orders, reverse and close-all buttons.
red_flags: SL distance can be set to 0 (no stop); sizing then silently assumes 100 points
Drawdown guard off by default, peak kept only in memory (resets on restart) and auto re-arms when DD falls below half the limit
Stage flags encoded in order comment are written only at entry (EX000) - partial-close progress is not actually persisted, so restart recovery of stages is unreliable
Pending-to-track matching by direction within 30s can mis-assign positions
ATR trailing reads forming bar 0; close-all does not check retcodes or retry
No filling-mode setup (SetTypeFillingBySymbol not called)

ideas.name: Staged partial take-profit on original volume
ideas.detail: Per-ticket tracker stores base volume and entry; at three point distances closes 40%/30%/remainder of ORIGINAL volume via PositionClosePartial, normalising to lot step and skipping a stage if the slice is below min lot. Broker TP sits at the furthest stage.

ideas.name: Session-peak equity drawdown guard with flatten and entry lock
ideas.detail: Tracks highest equity since start; when drawdown from peak >= limit %, closes all positions, deletes pendings and blocks new orders; lock releases only after drawdown recovers below half the limit (hysteresis).

ideas.name: Re-anchor SL/TP to actual fill price
ideas.detail: After a market fill, if ResultPrice differs from intended entry by more than one point, SL and TP are recomputed from the real fill and PositionModify is sent, keeping the risk distance constant under slippage - relevant for gold spikes.

ideas.name: Selectable trail engine with profit-only and min-step rules
ideas.detail: Trail gap from fixed points, ATR*multiplier, or previous bar low/high; new SL accepted only if beyond entry (never trails in loss), improves by at least a minimum step, and respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL; separate breakeven with lock offset.

ideas.name: Risk sizing via tick value/tick size per point
ideas.detail: Lots = risk money (balance % or flat amount) / (SL points * tickValue*(point/tickSize)); falls back to fixed lot if symbol data invalid; SL/TP distances bumped to stops level + 5 points when too tight.

ideas.name: Rebuild trade-management state from open positions on init
ideas.detail: OnInit scans positions by symbol+magic, decodes stage flags from a comment tag (|EXabc) and back-computes original volume from remaining volume and stage percentages. Concept is good; flags would need persisting elsewhere (GlobalVariables/file) to work.

title: ZigZag EA
summary: MT5 EA takes the last three ZigZag extremes, forms a corridor from the two confirmed ones, and places buy-stop/sell-stop just outside it when corridor width is within min/max; SL as Fibonacci % of corridor; pending deleted once a position exists; pip trailing.
red_flags: TakeProfit computed from the enum index (Fibo_TakeProfit) instead of GetFibo() - yields negative value so TP is effectively 0 (bug, flagged '???' in code)
StartHour/StopHour inputs are validated but never used - no actual time filter
Default Risk=5% via CMoneyFixedMargin (margin-based, not stop-based risk)
Corridor min/max in fixed pips (20-100) - not volatility-scaled, wrong for gold
Pending orders have no expiration; runs full logic every tick, no new-bar gate
Leftover unused account-lock variables (NumberAccount, gbDisabled)

ideas.name: Bracket stop orders around confirmed swing corridor
ideas.detail: Buy-stop above the higher and sell-stop below the lower of the two last confirmed ZigZag pivots (offset N pips), only if the still-forming pivot 0 lies inside the corridor by at least the stops level.

ideas.name: Corridor width min/max gate
ideas.detail: Breakout bracket is placed only when corridor height is between Min_Corridor and Max_Corridor, filtering both noise ranges and ranges too wide for a sane stop. Should be ATR-relative for metals.

ideas.name: Structure-proportional SL/TP via Fibonacci fractions
ideas.detail: Stop distance = chosen Fibonacci percentage (default 61.8%) of corridor height measured from the pending entry; TP intended as an extension (161.8%) minus corridor. Stops scale with structure rather than fixed pips.

ideas.name: Pending order follow-and-cancel management
ideas.detail: Each tick counts own buy/sell stops; if price level changed (digit-wise compare) the existing pending is modified rather than duplicated; when a position exists all remaining pendings are deleted (OCO); >1 pending per side aborts.

ideas.name: Mutually exclusive lots-or-risk input validation
ideas.detail: OnInit rejects configurations where both fixed lots and risk are set or both zero, and validates fixed volume against min/max/step with explicit error text, returning INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT.

title: CCI and Martin
summary: MT5 EA: one position at a time; enters on CCI(27) turn plus a three-candle reversal pattern evaluated on the forming bar after second 40; fixed pip SL/TP, step trailing; lot multiplied x3 after losing deals (max 3 multiplications) via OnTradeTransaction.
red_flags: Martingale: lot x3.0 after each loss, up to 3 multiplications (27x base) by default
Signal uses bar 0 CCI and bar 0 candle colour (forming bar), mitigated only by 'seconds >= 40' hack tied to M1
Martingale state (m_lots, m_martin, m_loss) kept in memory only - lost on restart
Step-lot branch is buggy: resets to InpLots when lot_check <= max instead of applying the increment
SL can be disabled (0); no spread/session filter; SL 20 pips vs trailing step logic not volatility-scaled

ideas.name: Loss/win streak tracking from DEAL_ENTRY_OUT transactions
ideas.detail: OnTradeTransaction filters TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD, selects the deal, checks symbol+magic and DEAL_ENTRY_OUT, and updates consecutive loss counters from DEAL_PROFIT. Reusable for loss-streak cooldown or risk reduction instead of martingale.

ideas.name: Skip entry when SL already inside spread
ideas.detail: Before a buy, if computed SL >= Bid (or sell SL <= Ask) the trade is skipped, preventing instantly-stopped or rejected orders when spread exceeds stop distance - common on metals at rollover/news.

ideas.name: Oscillator turn confirmed by candle engulf sequence
ideas.detail: Buy requires CCI falling over bars 3-2-1 and turning up, with two bearish candles followed by a bullish candle closing above the prior open (sell mirrored). Would need shifting to closed bars 1-3.

ideas.name: Capped multiplication count with lot validation fallback
ideas.detail: Lot escalation is bounded by a max-multiplications counter and each new lot passes LotCheck (step/min/max normalisation); failure resets to base lot. The cap/validate pattern applies equally to anti-martingale scaling.

title: EA Stochastic
summary: MT5 skeleton EA: single position; buys when Stochastic main at bar 0 and bar N-1 are both below 80, sells when both above 20 - conditions true almost always, so it is effectively constantly in market. Fixed pip SL/TP, step trailing, margin-% sizing.
red_flags: Entry logic is degenerate: 'below 80' / 'above 20' are nearly always true and both buy and sell can fire in the same tick
Uses forming bar 0 stochastic, runs every tick with no new-bar gate
Default Risk=5% with CMoneyFixedMargin (percent of margin, not stop-based)
SL can be 0; no spread, session or volatility filter
No stops-level/freeze-level validation before sending SL/TP or trailing modifications

ideas.name: Strict indicator buffer copy validation
ideas.detail: Indicator read wrapper returns false unless CopyBuffer returns exactly the requested count, logging the error; trading logic is skipped on incomplete data rather than acting on stale/empty arrays.

ideas.name: Quote sanity gate before order maths
ideas.detail: RefreshRates wrapper fails if symbol refresh fails or Ask/Bid is zero, and every entry path aborts on failure; CTrade configured with SetTypeFillingBySymbol and SetMarginMode in OnInit.

title: Multi Lot Scalper
summary: MT4 martingale grid: direction from MACD main bar0 vs bar1 slope, adds a doubled (or x1.5) lot every 15 pips against the move up to MaxTrades, shared TP/trailing, closes whole basket when any order closes.
red_flags: Martingale lot x2 (x1.5 if MaxTrades>12) per added order, up to 10 levels
InitialStop defaults to 0: averaging with no hard stop
No magic number: manages/closes every order on the symbol
OrderSend/OrderClose/OrderModify/OrderSelect results never checked
Signal from still-forming bar 0 MACD, evaluated every tick
Hard-coded per-symbol pip values and 2005-2006 date window, lots normalised to 1 decimal
Loop starts at OrdersTotal() (off-by-one index)

ideas.name: Basket liquidation when order count drops
ideas.detail: Tracks PreviousOpenOrders; if the count of open orders falls (one hit TP/SL) it closes every remaining order on the symbol, so a basket never lingers half-closed. Useful only as a pattern for multi-leg position sync.

ideas.name: Late-stage basket profit lock
ideas.detail: When open orders reach MaxTrades-OrderstoProtect and floating basket profit >= SecureProfit, it closes the latest (largest) order and stops adding. Concept: reduce exposure once near the exposure cap and in profit.

title: Show Pips
summary: Chart indicator (not an EA) that displays floating profit in pips, currency and percent of balance, current spread and seconds to bar close as text following price, a comment, or a corner label.
red_flags: Reads OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TYPE/ORDER_MAGIC) while iterating positions, so type and magic filters are unreliable
Pip conversion via TICK_VALUE and a 3/5-digit x10 guess, wrong for metals with other digit counts
Recomputed only on ticks (OnCalculate), OnTimer empty

ideas.name: One-line status: pips | money | % | spread | time-to-bar-close
ideas.detail: Compact text object anchored a few bars right of current Bid, coloured by profit sign, showing floating P/L in points, currency, percent of balance, live spread and countdown computed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + PeriodSeconds() - TimeCurrent().

title: Expert adviser Easy Robot
summary: MT4 H1 EA: on each new H1 bar, buys if the previous H1 candle closed bullish, sells if bearish, one position at a time, fixed 0.01 lot, ATR(14)-multiple SL and TP, optional step trailing stop.
red_flags: Trivial signal (previous candle colour), optimised factors 4.2/4.9 look curve-fit
