Fixed 0.01 lot, no risk-based sizing
Magic filter uses && instead of || in the skip condition (works only because of the later explicit check)
Hard-coded magic 1234567, no spread or session filter
Trailing evaluated only once per H1 bar

ideas.name: ATR-multiple SL/TP clamped to broker stops level
ideas.detail: SL and TP distances are ATR(14,H1, closed bar) times a factor, then passed through SC() which raises any distance below MODE_STOPLEVEL to the minimum, so orders are never rejected for invalid stops.

ideas.name: Pre-trade volume and margin validation
ideas.detail: CheckVolumeValue() clamps to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/MAX and snaps to VOLUME_STEP; CheckMoneyForTrade() calls AccountFreeMarginCheck and skips the order if free margin would go negative.

ideas.name: Input sanity gate in OnInit
ideas.detail: tcheck() rejects inconsistent inputs (trailing step > trailing start) with INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT, and in the tester the same check aborts the pass early so the optimiser skips nonsensical combinations.

ideas.name: Start/step trailing with stops-level guard
ideas.detail: Trailing begins only after price is Tstart beyond entry, sets SL at price minus Tstep, only tightens, and only modifies when the new SL is further than the broker stops level from price.

title: Dual Trix Expert Advisor
summary: MT5 EA: on first tick of a bar, enters on a TRIX turning point (local min/max over three closed bars) confirmed by second TRIX slope; fixed-point SL/TP; lot doubles after a losing trade up to DoublingCount.
red_flags: Martingale: lot x2 after a loss (default 1 doubling)
Loss detection compares the last two history ORDERS by open price for the whole account, not deals by magic/symbol
GVarGet() resets the stored counter to 0 when the global variable exists, so persistence is broken
New-bar detection via tick_volume>1 can miss bars
OrderSend result unchecked, ORDER_FILLING_FOK hard-coded
Both TRIX periods default to 9 (same indicator twice)

ideas.name: Custom OnTester fitness penalising loss streaks
ideas.detail: OnTester returns (wins/losses ratio) divided by (longest losing series + 1), and returns 0 when TP < SL, steering the optimiser away from long-drawdown-streak and negative reward:risk parameter sets.

ideas.name: Closed-bar indicator turning-point entry
ideas.detail: Reads three closed bars (shift 1..3) of TRIX and enters on a V-shaped local minimum (or inverted V for sells), confirmed by the direction of a second TRIX, avoiding bar-0 repaint.

ideas.name: Balance-step lot sizing
ideas.detail: Base lot = floor(balance / Shape) * SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN, capped at SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX, i.e. one minimum lot per fixed chunk of balance. Simple anti-overleverage scale (the doubling part should be dropped).

title: Simple Expert Advisor based on the Simple Moving Average and ADX
summary: MQL5 tutorial EA: on a new bar, buys when EMA(8) is rising over 3 bars, previous close above EMA, ADX above 22 and +DI above -DI (mirror for sells); fixed lot, fixed pip SL/TP.
red_flags: No open-position check in this version: a new deal is sent on every bar while the condition holds (volume piles up on netting accounts)
Uses bar 0 indicator values (just-opened bar) for MA slope, ADX and DI
ORDER_FILLING_FOK hard-coded, deviation 100 points
Pip scaling only for 3/5 digits, wrong for 2-digit gold
Fixed lot, stops level not checked

ideas.name: ADX + DI regime gate on a trend entry
ideas.detail: Trend entry (MA slope over 3 bars plus close beyond the MA) is allowed only when ADX exceeds a minimum and the directional index agrees (+DI > -DI for longs), filtering range conditions.

ideas.name: CopyTime-based new-bar gate with data validation
ideas.detail: New bar detected by comparing CopyTime bar-0 time with a static; every CopyRates/CopyBuffer/SymbolInfoTick call is checked and the tick aborted on failure; minimum bar count required before trading.

title: EA_MARSI
summary: MT5 always-in-market reversal EA: crossover of two custom RSI-adaptive EMAs (EMA_RSI_VA, long RSI periods) on closed bars opens or reverses a position; SL/TP default 0; optional lot scaling by balance.
red_flags: SL and TP default to 0: no protective stop, relies on opposite crossover
Filling mode never set; SLTP request has no position ticket (netting only)
Sleep(1000) retry loop inside OnTick
Position selected by symbol only, magic not checked
Very long default periods (RSI 310/200) look curve-fit
Lots normalised to 2 decimals instead of volume step

ideas.name: RSI-volatility-adaptive EMA
ideas.detail: EMA whose effective period shrinks when RSI is far from 50: multi=(5+100/RSIPeriod)/(0.06+0.92v+0.02v^2), v=|RSI-50|+1, period=multi*EMAPeriods (min 1). The average speeds up in strong momentum and slows in ranges.

ideas.name: Closed-bar crossover with close-then-reverse
ideas.detail: Crossover evaluated on shifts 1 and 2 only at a new bar; an opposite cross closes the existing position and opens the reverse only if the close succeeded.

ideas.name: Two-step entry with bounded SL/TP attach retries
ideas.detail: Position is opened without stops, then SL/TP are attached via TRADE_ACTION_SLTP with up to N_modify_sltp retries, for market-execution brokers that reject stops on the deal. Needs a fail-safe close if all retries fail.

ideas.name: Lot scaled by balance / drawdown budget
ideas.detail: Lot = Lots * balance / Max_drawdown, capped at SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX: the base lot is defined for a reference capital equal to the expected historical drawdown and scales linearly with balance.

title: Jolly Roger EA Version
summary: MT5 championship EA: when closed-bar RSI is below 30 (above 70) places three buy-stop (sell-stop) orders just beyond price at stops level, drags pending orders toward price, then trails SL from breakeven-plus-spread.
red_flags: No magic number; uses account-wide PositionsTotal/OrdersTotal
Global MqlTradeRequest reused without ZeroMemory (stale fields between actions)
Sell-stop modify path sends OrderSend twice
Runs on every tick, no new-bar gate
Lot = free margin/2000 clamped 0.1-15: aggressive, unrelated to SL distance
Hard-coded 20-point pending offset, FOK filling on pending orders, no expiry on pendings

ideas.name: Oversold reversal confirmed by a trailing stop-entry order
ideas.detail: Instead of buying at market when RSI is oversold, a buy-stop sits a small distance above Ask and is moved down as price falls; entry triggers only when price actually bounces by that distance.
ideas.evidence: champion.mq5 OnTick(), 'set orders' and 'move the order' blocks

ideas.name: Trailing stop floored at entry plus spread
ideas.detail: New SL = max(open price + spread, Bid - SL distance) for longs, applied only once price exceeds entry by stops level plus spread, so the first trail step already locks in a cost-covered breakeven.

ideas.name: Entry split into three equal orders
ideas.detail: Total volume is divided by three and sent as three separate orders with identical SL/TP; on a hedging account this allows independent management or partial exits per leg.

ideas.name: Retcode-to-text logging helper
ideas.detail: Switch mapping every TRADE_RETCODE_* constant to a readable message, printed whenever a request is not DONE/PLACED, making broker rejections diagnosable from the journal.

title: An Expert Advisor, based on the "Puria method" Forex Strategy
summary: MT5 EA: on a new bar, buys when closed-bar EMA(5) is above LWMA(75) and LWMA(85) of lows, close above EMA(5) and MACD above zero (mirror for sells); fixed lot, 14-pip SL, 15-pip TP.
red_flags: OrderSend result never checked; one-trade flags flipped even if the order failed
BuyOne/SellOne flags are in-memory only (lost on restart)
Tiny fixed 14/15-pip SL/TP with no spread filter; unusable on gold as-is
MA period inputs are declared but handles use hard-coded 75/85/5
FOK filling hard-coded, pip scaling only for 3/5 digits
Condition is a state (above/below), not an actual cross

ideas.name: One entry per direction until the opposite signal
ideas.detail: BuyOne/SellOne flags allow a single long per bullish regime; another long is permitted only after a short has been taken, preventing repeated re-entries after a stop-out in the same stale trend state.

ideas.name: Fast EMA above a slow LWMA band plus MACD sign, on closed bar
ideas.detail: Trend state requires the fast EMA beyond both of two close-period LWMAs (a band built on lows), the closed bar beyond the fast EMA, and MACD(15,26) sign agreement, all read at shift 1.

title: DreamBot - Fully working trading robot
summary: MT4 H1 EA: on a new H1 bar, buys when closed-bar Force Index(13) crosses above a threshold, sells when it crosses below a negative threshold; fixed 0.01 lot, fixed-point SL/TP attached after entry, optional trailing.
red_flags: Order sent with no SL/TP then modified; if OrderModify fails the position stays unprotected, no retry
Tfunc() swaps start and step (Tstart=_step, Tstep=_start) - trailing bug
Force Index thresholds 1.056 / -0.078 are symbol-scale-dependent curve-fit magic numbers
Timeframe restriction hidden inside CheckMoneyForTrade (silently refuses to trade off H1)
Ticket variable reused: a failed OrderSend can lead to modifying a previous ticket
Fixed 0.01 lot, hard-coded magic, no spread/session filter

ideas.name: Force Index threshold cross on closed bars
ideas.detail: Entry when Force Index (price change times volume, SMA 13) crosses a positive threshold between shift 2 and shift 1, i.e. volume-weighted momentum ignition. Thresholds would need normalising (e.g. by ATR times average volume) for metals.

ideas.name: Stop distance clamp plus volume/margin pre-checks
ideas.detail: SC() lifts SL/TP distances to at least MODE_STOPLEVEL; CheckVolumeValue() snaps to min/max/step; AccountFreeMarginCheck gates the send.

ideas.name: Early abort of invalid optimiser combinations
ideas.detail: In the tester, OnTick returns immediately if TrailingStep > TrailingStart or TrailingStart >= TakeProfit, so illogical parameter sets produce no trades and are discarded by the optimiser.

title: An Expert Advisor - Index Moving Average
summary: MT5 EA using a custom 'ima' indicator (price/SMA - 1): opens when its relative bar-to-bar change exceeds k, with no broker SL at entry; EA-side loss close at 'drop' points and a trailing SL once in profit.
red_flags: Position opened with SL=0/TP=0; loss cap is a virtual stop enforced only while the terminal is running (default 1000 points)
Signal uses bar 0 of the indicator on the first tick of a new bar
Signal is a ratio divided by |ima[1]|, which explodes when price is near the MA
No magic number, trade results unchecked
Lot stepped by VOLUME_MIN instead of VOLUME_STEP
Risk based on free margin, not balance/equity

ideas.name: Risk-fraction sizing from stop distance and tick value
ideas.detail: lot = free margin * r / stop points / SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE, floored to the lot grid, then capped by max_lots and SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX and raised to VOLUME_MIN.

ideas.name: Margin-driven lot reduction loop
ideas.detail: After sizing, the lot is decremented step by step while CAccountInfo.FreeMarginCheck for that order type and price is <= 0, so the order is shrunk to what the margin allows instead of being rejected.

ideas.name: Normalised price-to-MA deviation oscillator
ideas.detail: Indicator value = price / SMA(n) - 1, a scale-free distance from the mean that is comparable across symbols and price levels (usable as a stretch/momentum filter for gold and silver alike).

ideas.name: Profit-only trailing with gap condition
ideas.detail: Trailing SL is placed only when the position is in profit by more than 'take' points and the current SL is more than 'take' points away, which also throttles modify requests.

title: LotScalp
summary: MT4 time-of-day EA: at hour 7 compares Open[6] vs Open[2]; fades the move with TP 5 points and SL 6000 points. Balance-tier lot ladder, forced close after 504 hours.
red_flags: TP 5 points vs SL 6000 points (1:1200 reward:risk), win-rate illusion
Loss-triggered lot multiplier scaffolding (volume=lot*BigLotSize when balance fell) present but inert with BigLotSize=1
Hard-coded 70-line balance-to-lot ladder, about 4 percent of balance per 0.01 lot at low balances, no volume normalisation
Magic number 0, uses OrdersTotal() of whole account, no symbol filter in time-exit loop (closes other EAs' orders)
LotSize() declared int with no return value
Curve-fit magic numbers (t1=6,t2=2,delta_L=6,delta_S=21, hour 7)
No spread filter although TP is 5 points
cantrade daily flag held in memory only, lost on restart

ideas.name: Maximum holding time exit
ideas.detail: Loop open orders, compute (TimeCurrent()-OrderOpenTime())/3600 and force-close at market once age exceeds MaxOpenTime hours; 0 disables. Useful as a stale-trade time stop.
ideas.evidence: LotScalp.mq4 start(), 'block of a trade validity time checking' (MaxOpenTime)

ideas.name: Pre-trade free margin check
ideas.detail: Call AccountFreeMarginCheck(Symbol(),type,lot) and abort entry if result <=0 or error 134 before sending the order.
ideas.evidence: LotScalp.mq4 start(), AccountFreeMarginCheck lines before OpenShort/OpenLong

title: DayTrading
summary: MT4 M5 EA: enters on Parabolic SAR flip plus momentum, MACD and stochastic conditions from bar 0; TP 20 points, fixed-point trailing, SL defaults to 0, closes on opposite signal.
red_flags: SL defaults to 0 and header advises 'Do not place any stop loss'
All indicators read on forming bar 0 (repaint) and evaluated every tick, no new-bar gate
Order ownership by OrderComment()==nameEA (brokers alter comments); magic 16384 not checked
realSL/realTP are globals never reset, stale values reused
OrderSelect/OrderClose/OrderModify return values unchecked; no stop-level or price normalisation
Fixed 1.0 lot, margin check is a hard-coded 1000*lots
Alert() popup on every action

ideas.name: SAR flip with multi-oscillator pullback confluence
ideas.detail: Buy only when SAR flipped below price (sarPrev>sarCur, sar<=Ask) while momentum<100, MACD main<signal and stochastic<35, i.e. trend flip entered on oscillator pullback; mirror for sells. Would need closed-bar values.

ideas.name: Opposite-signal close before trailing
ideas.detail: In the position loop, close a buy when the sell condition is active (and vice versa) before applying the trailing stop, so reversal exits take priority over trailing.

title: Fractal ZigZag Expert
summary: Indicator code pasted into an MT4 EA: builds an N-bar fractal zigzag trend state, then opens buy or sell with 20-point SL, 25-point TP and 10-point trailing when no order exists on the symbol.
red_flags: Uses IndicatorCounted() and indicator buffers inside an EA; zigzag loop runs only if counted_bars==0, otherwise Trend stays at default 2 and it always buys
Fractal test uses Low[shift-n]/High[shift-n] down to the forming bar (unconfirmed fractal, repaint)
Re-enters every tick as soon as flat, no new-bar gate
No magic number; trailing only looks at order index 0 of the whole account
All OrderSend/OrderModify unchecked, slippage 0, fixed 1 lot
Author states 'I'm not a programmer'
20/25-point stops unusable on metals

ideas.name: Fractal swing sequence trend state
ideas.detail: Track last confirmed N-bar fractal high and low; flip trend state to up when a new fractal low is higher than the prior low, to down when a new fractal high is lower than the prior high. Usable as structure filter if only confirmed fractals are used.

title: SuperForex V2
summary: MT4 EA: RSI(4) on bar 0; buy below 42, sell above 62, SL 9 points, TP 109 points, 6-point trailing, closes on opposite RSI extreme. Lot = balance/10000.
red_flags: Signal from forming bar 0 RSI evaluated every tick, immediate re-entry after stop-out
SL 9 points and trailing 6 points are inside spread/stop level on most symbols; curve-fit numbers (Pos 62, Neg 42, SET 4)
Slippage 0, all OrderSend/OrderClose/OrderModify results unchecked
Lots=AccountBalance()/10000 with no normalisation to lot step or min lot
Loops run cnt=OrdersTotal() (off-by-one) with unchecked OrderSelect
Close loop ignores magic number and closes with input Lots instead of OrderLots()
Donation request strings as inputs

ideas.name: Trailing gated by profit and current stop gap
ideas.detail: Move SL to price minus trail only when both order profit in points exceeds the trail distance and the current SL-to-price gap exceeds it, avoiding redundant modify requests.

title: RSI EA
summary: MT4 EA: RSI(14) crossing back through 30/70 (bar 0 vs bar 1) opens one buy and/or one sell; optional SL/TP/trailing all default 0; closes on opposite cross; lot = balance*Risk/10000.
red_flags: StopLoss, TakeProfit and TrailingStop all default to 0: positions rely on opposite RSI cross only
Cross detected with forming bar 0 RSI, evaluated every tick (repaint, can fire and vanish)
'Risk' is not risk-per-trade: lot = balance*Risk/10000 regardless of stop distance; default 10 gives 1 lot per 1000 balance
Buy SL computed from Bid rather than Ask, no stop-level check on initial SL
OrderSend/OrderClose return codes stored but never checked; no min-lot floor
Ownership needs exact OrderComment match, which brokers may modify

ideas.name: Trailing distance clamped to broker stop level
ideas.detail: Read MODE_STOPLEVEL each tick and raise the trailing distance to at least that value before computing the new normalised SL, preventing invalid-stops rejections.

ideas.name: RSI re-entry cross instead of level touch
ideas.detail: Enter long only when RSI crosses back above the oversold level (prev below, current above) and short when crossing back below overbought, rather than on first touch of the extreme. Should use closed bars 1 and 2.

ideas.name: Independent long/short enable switches
ideas.detail: Separate OpenBUY/OpenSELL inputs and separate per-direction position counters allow running one-sided or both sides independently.

title: DDE - Server
summary: MT5 example that every second pushes EMA(21), broker name and server time to an external 'MT4.DDE.2' window via user32/kernel32 atoms and SendMessageW. Never trades.
red_flags: DLL imports: user32.dll (SendMessageW, FindWindowW) and kernel32.dll (global atoms)
Depends on an external DDE server window that is not included
LOWORD/HIWORD helper implementations are swapped
32-bit int handles used for HWND (unsafe on 64-bit)
CopyBuffer result unchecked; Alert() fired every second when window missing

ideas.name: Timer-driven telemetry push decoupled from ticks
ideas.detail: Use EventSetTimer(1)/OnTimer to publish indicator values, broker name and server time to an external consumer as topic/item pairs, independent of tick flow. Concept reusable with files or GlobalVariables instead of DLL calls.

title: 20/200 pips - Simple profitable Expert Advisor
summary: MT5 EA: once per day at hour 18 compares H1 Open[7] with Open[2]; if they differ by 70 points it fades the move with fixed 0.1 lot, SL 2000 and TP 200 points.
red_flags: Risk 2000 points to make 200 (1:10 reward:risk), title claims 'profitable'
Curve-fit constants (hour 18, t1=7, t2=2, delta=70) tuned to EURUSD
ORDER_FILLING_FOK hard-coded, fails on brokers without FOK
Volume NormalizeDouble(volume,1), no symbol step/min check
Retcode only printed, no retry or validation; CopyOpen return unchecked
Once-per-day flag kept in memory only, restart inside the trade hour can re-enter
PositionSelect(_Symbol) without magic filter (netting assumption)

ideas.name: Fixed-hour displacement fade
ideas.detail: At one configured server hour compare two H1 opens (t1 and t2 bars back); if displacement exceeds delta points, open one counter-move trade. A testable session-drift-fade template, e.g. around the metals fixing or NY close.

ideas.name: One-entry-per-day latch
ideas.detail: Boolean latch cleared after an entry and re-armed only when server hour is past the trade hour, capping the strategy at one entry per day. Needs persistence to survive restarts.

title: Moving Average
summary: MetaQuotes MT5 sample: on first tick of a new bar, opens when the last closed candle crosses a shifted SMA(12), closes on opposite cross. No SL/TP. Margin-based lot reduced after consecutive losses.
red_flags: PositionOpen with sl=0, tp=0: no broker-side stop at all
New-bar detection via tick_volume>1 can miss bars on restart or skipped first tick
No magic number, PositionSelect(_Symbol) assumes netting and sole ownership
CTrade result/retcode never checked
'MaximumRisk' is fraction of free margin per lot margin, not risk to stop
Loss-streak reduction can go negative for long streaks and is then silently clamped to min lot; HistorySelect(0,now) scans full history each entry

ideas.name: Loss-streak lot reduction (anti-martingale)
ideas.detail: Walk deal history backwards for this symbol counting consecutive losing deals until the first winner; if more than one, cut lot by lot*losses/DecreaseFactor. Reduces exposure during drawdown streaks.

ideas.name: Margin-based sizing via OrderCalcMargin with step/min/max clamp
ideas.detail: Get margin for 1 lot with OrderCalcMargin, size as freeMargin*risk/margin, then round to SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP and clamp to VOLUME_MIN/MAX. Good as a leverage cap alongside stop-based sizing on high-margin metals.

ideas.name: Closed-candle body cross of shifted MA
ideas.detail: Signal requires the completed bar to open on one side of a forward-shifted SMA and close on the other, evaluated only at the first tick of the next bar, so no repaint.

ideas.name: Data-availability guards before trading
ideas.detail: Abort the tick if CopyRates/CopyBuffer return fewer elements than requested, require Bars>100 and TERMINAL_TRADE_ALLOWED before sending; INIT_FAILED on invalid indicator handle.

title: Simple Copier
summary: MT4 local trade copier: master writes all open orders to a common-folder CSV each second; slave opens, modifies SL/TP and closes mirrored orders tagged 'C4F<ticket>', with a lot multiplier.
red_flags: `if(!OrderSend(...))` treats ticket -1 as success, so open failures are never logged
Slave opens with SL/TP 0 and adds stops on a later timer pass; position briefly unprotected
Lot multiplier with no risk cap or margin check
Fixed opened_list[500] with no bounds check
Mapping relies on OrderComment, which brokers can truncate or alter; no symbol suffix mapping
Master rewrites the file non-atomically; slave may read a half-written or empty file and close everything
ObjectsDeleteAll() wipes all chart objects on init/deinit
Openly a copier (not hidden), file-based only, no network or DLL

ideas.name: Price-deviation guard before mirroring an entry
ideas.detail: Before copying a market order, compute |current price - source open price| in points and skip the entry if it exceeds the allowed slippage, avoiding late chasing fills.

ideas.name: Stateless reconciliation against a desired-state list
ideas.detail: Each timer cycle rebuilds the set of expected tickets from the source file, then opens missing ones, syncs SL/TP differences and closes any tagged order not in the set; self-healing after restart with no stored state.

ideas.name: Cross-terminal sharing through FILE_COMMON CSV
ideas.detail: Terminals exchange state through a CSV in the shared common data folder (FILE_COMMON), needing no DLL or network; usable for cross-account exposure or risk-lock signals.

title: Multi-currency night scalper - Night Scalper Multi
summary: MT5 multi-symbol night mean-reversion: after a per-symbol start hour, on new chart bar, fades price outside Bollinger bands when band width is below a point threshold; wide SL, small TP; closes next day before start hour.
red_flags: Reward:risk heavily inverted (e.g. SL 370 vs TP 20 points)
iBands handle created on every call and never released; first CopyBuffer may return no data and results are unchecked
Band values read from forming bar 0
Uses chart symbol's _Point and chart bar clock for other symbols (wrong for differing digits)
No magic number: counts and closes any position on the symbol, including manual or other EAs
Fixed Lot=1 default, no sizing, no spread filter despite night-session spread widening
CTrade results unchecked, no filling-mode setup; time window ends only at midnight rollover
Per-symbol parameters are curve-fit

ideas.name: Band-width squeeze gate for mean-reversion entries
ideas.detail: Allow a fade of a Bollinger band breach only when upper minus lower band is below a maximum width in points, i.e. only in quiet range conditions. For metals the threshold should be ATR-relative.

ideas.name: Session-end flatten
ideas.detail: If a position exists and server time is outside the strategy window (before the start hour of the next day), close all positions on that symbol so session trades are not carried into the active day.

ideas.name: Per-symbol parameter sets through one trade function
ideas.detail: A single SymbolTrade(symbol, stop, take, period, dev, width, startHour) is called per configured symbol with its own parameter block; empty symbol name disables the slot. Suits a combined XAUUSD/XAGUSD bot with separate settings.

title: Artificial Intelligence
summary: Single-layer 'perceptron' = weighted sum of 4 Accelerator Oscillator values (shifts 0,7,14,21) with hand-optimised weights. Always in market on new bar; fixed-point SL, step-trails SL once 2xSL in profit, or reverses via double-lot opposite order plus OrderCloseBy.
red_flags: 'AI' is just a 4-weight linear sum with optimiser-fitted magic numbers (x1..x4), no training
Always-in-market: opens a trade every bar with no flat/neutral state or filter
Fixed lots=1 default, no risk sizing or volume normalisation
SL in raw points (85) not adapted to digits/volatility; no stops-level check
OrderSelect return unchecked; Sleep(30000) blocking on errors
Reversal briefly opens 2x lot before CloseBy (margin spike; impossible on netting/FIFO accounts)
No spread filter although spread is read

ideas.name: Profit-gated decision point: trail or reverse
ideas.detail: Position is only re-evaluated once price is 2xSL+spread beyond the current stop; at that point the signal is re-read: if it flipped, reverse, otherwise step the SL up to price-SL. Gives a coarse step-trail that never moves on noise.

ideas.name: Retry-next-tick by rewinding the new-bar stamp
ideas.detail: On trade-context busy or failed OrderSend/OrderModify, prevtime is reset to Time[1] so the once-per-bar logic re-runs on the next tick instead of losing the bar's signal.

ideas.name: Spread-inclusive trail threshold
ideas.detail: Trail activation distance adds the live spread (MODE_SPREAD) to the fixed distance, so wide-spread moments do not trigger premature stop moves.

title: Automated Trading System "Сombo"
summary: New-bar EA, one position at a time. Direction from CCI(open price) baseline, overridden by up to three linear 'perceptrons' on open-price differences via a supervisor; each branch carries its own fixed SL/TP in points.
red_flags: Up to 24 optimisable parameters with staged 'pass' optimisation - heavy curve-fit risk
Always enters long or short each bar when flat; no neutral zone or filters
Fixed lot 0.01, no risk sizing
SL/TP in raw points, no stops-level/digits handling; slippage 1 point
OrderSelect unchecked, Sleep(30000) on failure
Default weights all 100 (zero weight) so perceptrons are inert until optimised

ideas.name: Supervisor that lets specialist models override a baseline
ideas.detail: A baseline signal (CCI) is used unless a long-only specialist or short-only specialist model agrees with a third gating model; each specialist is only allowed to vote in one direction.

ideas.name: Per-signal-source SL/TP profile
ideas.detail: SL and TP are selected by which sub-model fired the entry (sl1/tp1 baseline, sl2/tp2 short specialist, sl3/tp3 long specialist), allowing asymmetric long/short exits.

ideas.name: Open-price-only features (no bar-0 repaint)
ideas.detail: All inputs use bar open prices (Close[0] read on first tick equals the open; CCI on PRICE_OPEN), so the signal is fixed for the bar and matches open-prices backtests.

ideas.name: Staged optimisation switch
ideas.detail: A 'pass' input enables sub-models one at a time (1 baseline, 2 short model, 3 long model, 4 gate), so each stage is optimised with earlier parameters frozen instead of one huge search.

title: cs2011
summary: Always-in-market netting reversal EA: MACD(30,500,36) zero-cross or signal-line turn on closed bars flips the position. Lot scales with symbol-only realised plus floating P/L against a hardcoded 5000 deposit. TP 2200 points, SL disabled by default.
red_flags: SL=0 by default - no protective stop, relies on opposite signal
Contest EA: default Risk=3 lots per 5000 deposit is extreme leverage
Hardcoded Deposit=5000 baseline
NormalizeDouble(volume,1) assumes 0.1 lot step; hardcoded FOK filling
No magic number - manages whole symbol position, netting only
HistorySelect(0,now) full history scan on each trade
No spread/session filters

ideas.name: Recount flag for failed indicator reads
ideas.detail: If CopyBuffer fails on the new bar, a static Recount flag forces signal recalculation on following ticks until data is available, so a bar's signal is never silently skipped.

ideas.name: Persistent signal until position confirmed
ideas.detail: Up/Down signal flags are static and only cleared when the position actually exists after the send loop; failed executions are retried on subsequent ticks.

ideas.name: OrderCheck pre-flight with margin-driven volume step-down and retcode triage
ideas.detail: Up to 10 attempts: OrderCheck first, reduce volume by one step if margin level <100; split by VOLUME_MAX and subtract filled volume; break on fatal retcodes (disabled, closed, no money, frozen), sleep on transient ones.

ideas.name: Per-symbol virtual equity for sizing
ideas.detail: Lot is computed from deposit baseline plus only this symbol's closed deal profit/swap and floating P/L, so sizing of one strategy is isolated from other symbols' results; clamped to VOLUME_MIN and VOLUME_LIMIT.

ideas.name: Deviation set to current spread
ideas.detail: Allowed slippage for market orders is set dynamically to the live SYMBOL_SPREAD instead of a constant.

title: Grr-al
summary: Timer-driven (1s) intrabar fade: records bid at bar open, and when bid moves 30 points away it enters against the move with SL 100 / TP 700 points, once per bar. All parameters are compile-time defines.
red_flags: No check for existing position: a new trade each bar stacks/nets volume
All parameters hardcoded via #define (30/100/700 points magic numbers), no inputs
OrderSend result/retcode unchecked; hardcoded FOK filling
Tick-level intrabar logic not reproducible in open-price tests, very spread-sensitive
No spread, session or volatility filter; point distances not scaled for metals
Unused lastbar variable, duplicated RISK check

ideas.name: One-shot intrabar displacement trigger from bar open
ideas.detail: Anchor price is captured at the new bar; a per-bar boolean latch allows only one entry when price is displaced by a threshold from the anchor, reset at the next bar. Usable for fade or momentum if threshold is ATR-scaled.

ideas.name: Margin-capacity lot cap
ideas.detail: OrderCalcMargin for 1 lot gives the max lot affordable from 90% of free margin; the lot is a fraction of that, capped by VOLUME_MAX. Useful as an upper bound on top of SL-based sizing.

ideas.name: Timer-based processing with price-change gate
ideas.detail: Logic runs from a 1-second OnTimer and only acts when bid changed since last check, decoupling work from tick bursts.

title: Simple MA Expert Advisor
summary: Tutorial EA: EMA(17) vs EMA(19) cross on the two last closed bars sends a fixed 0.1-lot market order with SL/TP in points. No new-bar or position check, so it fires on every tick while the cross condition holds.
red_flags: No new-bar gate and no open-position check: sends an order every tick for the whole bar after a cross (volume stacking)
OrderSend return and retcode never checked
Buffers not set as series, so indices [1],[2] are reversed versus the comments - trade direction is effectively inverted relative to the stated intent
Fixed 0.1 lot, hardcoded FOK filling, deviation 1 point
Only handles 5-digit symbols (not 3-digit or metals) for point scaling
Curve-fit looking defaults (17, 31, 69)
